// 移动光源 (dynamic lights; our own, no one else's code or art): things that give light light up what is around them as
// they move, with and without 光影, and the light spreads the way a placed one does - one level a block, around corners,
// not through walls:
//   - a light-giving item held in either hand or worn on the head, by you, a mob or an armour stand (a torch 14, a
//     lantern / glowstone / lava bucket / jack o'lantern 15 ...: the light of the block it places, and a few items of
//     their own - blaze rods, glow berries, glowstone dust ...), the same lying on the ground or in an item frame
//   - anything burning (15), blazes, magma cubes, glow squids (not while dark), fireballs, dragon fireballs, spectral
//     arrows, eyes of ender, fireworks in flight, falling light blocks, a furnace minecart with fuel
//   - lit TNT (and a lit TNT minecart) and a swelling creeper: 关 / 简单 / 精致 (精致: TNT flashes, a creeper brightens
//     as it swells)
// Torches, campfires, lava buckets and the like go out under water. 视频设置 → 移动光源… : 关 / 流畅 / 平衡 / 精致
// (how often moving lights are redrawn: twice a second, four times, every frame), your own light, the others', under
// water, TNT, creepers. It is not in the world's light: mobs still spawn, crops don't grow by it. Single player only,
// as every mod (in a room: none).
//
// How: a 128 x 64 x 128 volume of block light around the player (vol, R8 3D texture on unit 15) holds the lights'
// levels. Each light has a BFS from its block, by the world's own rule (World.propagate: a step costs max(1, opacity),
// opacity 15 stops it), redone when it enters another block, when a block near it changes and every 2 s; a cell
// gets L + 0.5 - (the exact |dx|+|dy|+|dz| from the light to the cell's centre) - (the detour the BFS found), at most L,
// so a light moving inside its block moves smoothly and is about as bright as one placed in that block. Opaque blocks beside lit cells get the level of that cell - 1 (what a face
// of theirs shows). The terrain's fragment shaders (render.js CHUNK_FS and the 光影 pack's FXCHUNK_FS: both read
// v_light, .y the block light) take the cell in front of each face (the face's normal from the derivatives, half a
// block out), interpolated, and raise the block light to it - nothing is meshed again; particles too (the same
// program). Mobs, held and dropped items (Entity.lightAt) and chests / signs / campfire food / pets ... (World.getLight
// while the world is drawn) read the same volume.
(function () {
  const DEF = {
    mode: 3,
    self: true,
    ents: true,
    water: true,
    tnt: 2,
    creeper: 2
  };
  const cfg = g => {
    const s = g.settings || (g.settings = {});
    let c = s.dynLights;
    if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') c = s.dynLights = {};
    for (const k in DEF) if (c[k] === undefined) c[k] = DEF[k];
    return c;
  };
  const INTERVAL = [0, 500, 250, 0]; // ms between redraws of a moving light: 关, 流畅, 平衡, 精致 (every frame)
  const MAXL = 32; // the nearest this many lights
  let broken = false,
    fails = 0;
  const fail = (where, e) => {
    if (fails++ < 3) {
      console.warn('[移动光源]', where, e);
      try {
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.event('dynlights_err', {
          where,
          msg: String(e && e.message || e).slice(0, 160)
        });
      } catch (x) {}
    }
    if (where !== 'compile') broken = true;
  };

  // ---- the volume ----
  const SX = 128,
    SY = 64,
    SZ = 128,
    SXZ = SX * SZ,
    UNIT = 15;
  const vol = new Uint8Array(SXZ * SY); // level * 17, at x + z * SX + y * SXZ (the texture: width x, height z, depth y)
  let ox = 0,
    oy = 0,
    oz = 0,
    placed = false;

  // ---- shaders ----
  const MARK = 'v_light = u_lightOv.z > 0.5 ? u_lightOv.xy : a_light;';
  const VDECL = '\nuniform vec3 u_dynO; out vec4 v_dynP; out vec3 v_dynV;\nvoid main(){';
  const VADD = ' v_dynP = vec4(wp.xyz - u_dynO, u_lightOv.z > 0.5 ? 0.0 : 1.0); v_dynV = u_cam - wp.xyz;';
  const F = n => n.toFixed(1);
  const FDECL = `
uniform mediump sampler3D u_dynVol; uniform float u_dynOn; in vec4 v_dynP; in vec3 v_dynV;
vec2 dynL;
void dynInit(){
  dynL = v_light;
  vec3 p = v_dynP.xyz, n = cross(dFdx(p), dFdy(p));
  if (u_dynOn > 0.5 && v_dynP.w > 0.5) {
    float ln = length(n);
    n = ln > 1e-10 ? n / ln : vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    if (dot(n, v_dynV) < 0.0) n = -n;
    vec3 q = p + n * 0.5;
    if (all(greaterThan(q, vec3(0.5))) && all(lessThan(q, vec3(${F(SX - 0.5)}, ${F(SY - 0.5)}, ${F(SZ - 0.5)}))))
      dynL.y = max(dynL.y, textureLod(u_dynVol, q.xzy / vec3(${F(SX)}, ${F(SZ)}, ${F(SY)}), 0.0).r);
  }
}
#define v_light dynL
`;
  const progs = [];
  // (the program that was in use may have been deleted meanwhile - the start-up's one-off programs: using it again is
  // an INVALID_OPERATION)
  const restore = (gl, p) => gl.useProgram(p && gl.isProgram(p) ? p : null);
  if (typeof compile === 'function') {
    const comp = compile;
    compile = function (gl, vs, fs) {
      const okV = !broken && typeof vs === 'string' && vs.includes(MARK) && vs.includes('\nvoid main(){') && vs.includes('uniform vec3 u_cam') && /vec4 wp\b/.test(vs);
      if (!okV) return comp(gl, vs, fs);
      const okF = typeof fs === 'string' && fs.includes('in vec2 v_light;') && fs.split('void main(){').length === 2;
      const vs2 = vs.replace('\nvoid main(){', VDECL).replace(MARK, MARK + VADD);
      const fs2 = okF ? fs.replace('in vec2 v_light;', 'in vec2 v_light;' + FDECL).replace('void main(){', 'void main(){ dynInit();') : fs;
      let P;
      try {
        P = comp(gl, vs2, fs2);
      } catch (e) {
        fail('compile', e);
        return comp(gl, vs, fs);
      }
      if (okF && P && P.u && P.u.u_dynVol && P.u.u_dynOn) {
        const cur = gl.getParameter(gl.CURRENT_PROGRAM);
        gl.useProgram(P.p);
        gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_dynVol, UNIT);
        restore(gl, cur); // (on 0 it would clash with the tiles)
        progs.push({
          gl,
          P,
          on: 0,
          o: null
        });
      }
      return P;
    };
  }

  // ---- what gives light ----
  const EXTRA = {
    blaze_rod: 10,
    blaze_powder: 8,
    glowstone_dust: 8,
    glow_berries: 14,
    glow_ink_sac: 8,
    magma_cream: 8,
    nether_star: 14,
    fire_charge: 12,
    spectral_arrow: 6,
    ender_eye: 6,
    prismarine_crystals: 6,
    amethyst_shard: 4,
    sea_pickle: 6
  };
  const WET = /^(torch|soul_torch|copper_torch|campfire|soul_campfire|fire_charge|blaze_powder|lava_bucket)$/;
  const MOB = {
    blaze: 10,
    magma_cube: 8
  };
  const itemLum = new Map();
  const blockLum = (b, meta) => {
    if (!b) return 0;
    if (!b.stateLight) return b.light || 0;
    if (meta !== undefined) return b.stateLight[meta] | 0;
    // an item: the block as it is placed (its default state) - a campfire and a redstone torch lit, the light block 15;
    // candles, furnaces, lamps, bulbs, redstone ore unlit
    return /campfire$|^redstone_(wall_)?torch$|^light$/.test(b.key || '') ? Math.max(0, ...b.stateLight) : 0;
  };
  const lumOf = st => {
    if (!st || st.id === undefined || st.id === null) return 0;
    let v = itemLum.get(st.id);
    if (v === undefined) {
      const d = ITEMS[st.id];
      v = 0;
      if (d) {
        let b = d.block !== undefined ? BLOCKS[d.block] : null;
        if (!b && d.places && typeof BID !== 'undefined' && BID[d.places] !== undefined) b = BLOCKS[BID[d.places]];
        v = Math.max(blockLum(b), EXTRA[d.key] || 0);
        if (v && WET.test(d.key)) v = -v; // goes out under water
      }
      itemLum.set(st.id, v);
    }
    return v;
  };
  const clamp01 = v => v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v;
  const lumOfEntity = (g, e, S, a) => {
    const me = e === g.player;
    if (me ? !S.self || g.mode === 'spectator' : !S.ents) return 0;
    const isLiving = typeof Living === 'function' && e instanceof Living;
    let wet = false;
    if (S.water) {
      if (me) wet = !!(g.headInWater || e.eyeInWater);else if (isLiving) wet = !!e.eyeInWater;else if (e.inWater) wet = true;else if (g.world && e.pos) {
        const x = Math.floor(e.pos[0]),
          y = Math.floor(e.pos[1] + (e.h || 0) * 0.5),
          z = Math.floor(e.pos[2]),
          id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
        wet = id === WATER || !!WLOG[id] && g.world.isWaterlogged(x, y, z);
      }
    }
    const st = s => {
      const v = lumOf(s);
      return v < 0 ? wet ? 0 : -v : v;
    };
    let v = 0;
    if (e.fire > 0 && !e.fireproof && !e.inWater) v = 15;
    if (e.type && MOB[e.type]) v = Math.max(v, MOB[e.type]);
    if (e.type === 'glow_squid') v = Math.max(v, 8 * clamp01(1 - (e.darkT || 0) / 20));
    if (e.type === 'creeper' && e.fuse >= 0 && S.creeper) {
      const f = (e.prevFuse >= 0 ? e.prevFuse + (e.fuse - e.prevFuse) * a : e.fuse) / 30;
      v = Math.max(v, S.creeper === 1 ? 10 : 2 + 13 * clamp01(f));
    }
    const tnt = fuse => S.tnt === 1 ? 10 : Math.floor(fuse / 5) % 2 === 0 ? 15 : 10; // (精致: with its white flashes)
    if (S.tnt) {
      if (typeof PrimedTNT === 'function' && e instanceof PrimedTNT) v = Math.max(v, tnt(e.fuse));
      if (typeof Minecart === 'function' && e instanceof Minecart && e.kind === 'tnt' && e.primed !== undefined) v = Math.max(v, tnt(e.primed));
    }
    if (typeof Minecart === 'function' && e instanceof Minecart && e.kind === 'furnace' && e.fuel > 0) v = Math.max(v, 13);
    if (typeof Fireball === 'function' && e instanceof Fireball) v = Math.max(v, e.small ? 12 : 14);
    if (typeof DragonFireball === 'function' && e instanceof DragonFireball) v = Math.max(v, 12);
    if (typeof EyeOfEnder === 'function' && e instanceof EyeOfEnder) v = Math.max(v, 8);
    if (typeof FireworkRocket === 'function' && e instanceof FireworkRocket) v = Math.max(v, 10);
    if (typeof FallingBlock === 'function' && e instanceof FallingBlock) v = Math.max(v, blockLum(BLOCKS[e.blockId], e.meta | 0));
    if (typeof Arrow === 'function' && e instanceof Arrow) {
      if (e.tip && ITEMS[e.tip.id] && ITEMS[e.tip.id].key === 'spectral_arrow') v = Math.max(v, 8);
      if (e.snowball !== undefined) v = Math.max(v, st({
        id: e.snowball
      }));
    }
    if (e.inv && e.inv.slots) v = Math.max(v, st(e.inv.held), st(e.inv.slots[40]), st(e.inv.slots[36]));
    if (e.hand) v = Math.max(v, st(e.hand));
    if (e.offhand) v = Math.max(v, st(e.offhand));
    if (e.armorItems && e.armorItems[0]) v = Math.max(v, st(e.armorItems[0]));
    if (e.gear && e.type === 'armor_stand') v = Math.max(v, st(e.gear[3]), st(e.gear[4]), st(e.gear[5]));
    if (e.stack) v = Math.max(v, st(e.stack));
    if (e.item && (e.type === 'item_frame' || e.type === 'glow_item_frame')) v = Math.max(v, st(e.item));
    return Math.min(15, v);
  };

  // ---- one light's BFS (in a 37-block cube around its block) ----
  const R = 18,
    D = 2 * R + 1,
    D2 = D * D,
    D3 = D2 * D,
    MAXC = R - 1;
  const LX = new Int8Array(D3),
    LY = new Int8Array(D3),
    LZ = new Int8Array(D3),
    TX = new Uint8Array(D3);
  for (let i = 0; i < D3; i++) {
    const x = i % D,
      z = Math.floor(i / D) % D,
      y = Math.floor(i / D2);
    LX[i] = x - R;
    LY[i] = y - R;
    LZ[i] = z - R;
    TX[i] = Math.abs(x - R) + Math.abs(y - R) + Math.abs(z - R);
  }
  const STEPS = [1, -1, D, -D, D2, -D2];
  const dist = new Uint8Array(D3).fill(255),
    opc = new Uint8Array(D3),
    seenB = new Uint8Array(D3),
    touched = new Int32Array(D3);
  let nT = 0;
  const BK = [];
  for (let c = 0; c <= MAXC; c++) BK.push([]);
  let cw = null,
    ccx = 0,
    ccz = 0,
    cch = null;
  const opAt = (w, x, y, z) => {
    if (y < 0) return 15;
    if (y >= HEIGHT) return 0;
    const cx = x >> 4,
      cz = z >> 4;
    if (cw !== w || cx !== ccx || cz !== ccz) {
      cw = w;
      ccx = cx;
      ccz = cz;
      cch = w.chunks.get(ckey(cx, cz));
    }
    return cch ? OPACITY[cch.getB(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15)] : 15;
  };
  const grow = a => {
    const b = new Uint32Array(a.length * 2);
    b.set(a);
    return b;
  };
  // rec.air: cell | (cost - its |dx|+|dy|+|dz|) << 16; rec.bnd: an opaque cell beside them | the air cell it was found from << 16
  const bfs = (rec, w) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < nT; i++) {
      const k = touched[i];
      dist[k] = 255;
      opc[k] = 0;
      seenB[k] = 0;
    }
    nT = 0;
    cw = null;
    const sx = rec.sx,
      sy = rec.sy,
      sz = rec.sz,
      maxC = Math.min(MAXC, Math.ceil(rec.L + 2));
    const s0 = R + R * D + R * D2;
    opc[s0] = 1 + opAt(w, sx, sy, sz);
    touched[nT++] = s0;
    if (opc[s0] - 1 < 15) {
      dist[s0] = 0;
      BK[0].push(s0);
    } else for (const s of STEPS) {
      // a light inside a block (a mob's middle in a slab ...): from the blocks beside it
      const k = s0 + s;
      opc[k] = 1 + opAt(w, sx + LX[k], sy + LY[k], sz + LZ[k]);
      touched[nT++] = k;
      if (opc[k] - 1 < 15) {
        dist[k] = 1;
        BK[1].push(k);
      }
    }
    let air = rec.air,
      bnd = rec.bnd,
      nA = 0,
      nB = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c <= maxC; c++) {
      const B = BK[c];
      for (let j = 0; j < B.length; j++) {
        const k = B[j];
        if (dist[k] !== c) continue;
        if (nA >= air.length) air = rec.air = grow(air);
        const ai = nA++;
        air[ai] = k | c - TX[k] << 16;
        if (c === maxC) continue;
        for (let d = 0; d < 6; d++) {
          const n = k + STEPS[d];
          let o = opc[n];
          if (!o) {
            o = opc[n] = 1 + opAt(w, sx + LX[n], sy + LY[n], sz + LZ[n]);
            touched[nT++] = n;
          }
          o--;
          if (o >= 15) {
            if (!seenB[n]) {
              seenB[n] = 1;
              if (nB >= bnd.length) bnd = rec.bnd = grow(bnd);
              bnd[nB++] = (n | ai << 16) >>> 0;
            }
            continue;
          }
          const nc = c + (o > 1 ? o : 1);
          if (nc <= maxC && nc < dist[n]) {
            dist[n] = nc;
            BK[nc].push(n);
          }
        }
      }
      B.length = 0;
    }
    for (let c = maxC + 1; c <= MAXC; c++) BK[c].length = 0;
    rec.nA = nA;
    rec.nB = nB;
    rec.bL = rec.L;
    rec.r = maxC + 1;
  };

  // ---- writing lights into the volume ----
  const tmp = new Float32Array(D3);
  const stamp = (rec, b) => {
    const L = rec.L,
      px = rec.x - ox,
      py = rec.y - oy,
      pz = rec.z - oz,
      cx = rec.sx - ox,
      cy = rec.sy - oy,
      cz = rec.sz - oz;
    const x0 = b[0],
      y0 = b[1],
      z0 = b[2],
      x1 = b[3],
      y1 = b[4],
      z1 = b[5],
      air = rec.air,
      bnd = rec.bnd;
    for (let i = 0, n = rec.nA; i < n; i++) {
      const a = air[i],
        k = a & 0xFFFF,
        vx = cx + LX[k],
        vy = cy + LY[k],
        vz = cz + LZ[k];
      const v = Math.min(L, L + 0.5 - (a >>> 16) - Math.abs(vx + 0.5 - px) - Math.abs(vy + 0.5 - py) - Math.abs(vz + 0.5 - pz));
      tmp[i] = v;
      if (v <= 0 || vx < x0 || vx >= x1 || vy < y0 || vy >= y1 || vz < z0 || vz >= z1) continue;
      const q = v >= 15 ? 255 : v * 17 + 0.5 | 0,
        j = vx + vz * SX + vy * SXZ;
      if (q > vol[j]) vol[j] = q;
    }
    for (let i = 0, n = rec.nB; i < n; i++) {
      const a = bnd[i],
        k = a & 0xFFFF,
        v = tmp[a >>> 16] - 1;
      if (v <= 0) continue;
      const vx = cx + LX[k],
        vy = cy + LY[k],
        vz = cz + LZ[k];
      if (vx < x0 || vx >= x1 || vy < y0 || vy >= y1 || vz < z0 || vz >= z1) continue;
      const q = v >= 15 ? 255 : v * 17 + 0.5 | 0,
        j = vx + vz * SX + vy * SXZ;
      if (q > vol[j]) vol[j] = q;
    }
  };
  // boxes: [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] in the volume's cells
  const boxOf = rec => {
    const r = rec.r,
      cx = rec.sx - ox,
      cy = rec.sy - oy,
      cz = rec.sz - oz;
    const b = [Math.max(0, cx - r), Math.max(0, cy - r), Math.max(0, cz - r), Math.min(SX, cx + r + 1), Math.min(SY, cy + r + 1), Math.min(SZ, cz + r + 1)];
    return b[0] < b[3] && b[1] < b[4] && b[2] < b[5] ? b : null;
  };
  const vbox = b => (b[3] - b[0]) * (b[4] - b[1]) * (b[5] - b[2]);
  const meets = (a, b) => a[0] < b[3] && b[0] < a[3] && a[1] < b[4] && b[1] < a[4] && a[2] < b[5] && b[2] < a[5];
  const union = (a, b) => [Math.min(a[0], b[0]), Math.min(a[1], b[1]), Math.min(a[2], b[2]), Math.max(a[3], b[3]), Math.max(a[4], b[4]), Math.max(a[5], b[5])];
  const merge = list => {
    const out = [];
    for (let b of list) {
      for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
        const u = union(out[i], b);
        if (meets(out[i], b) || vbox(u) <= 1.3 * (vbox(out[i]) + vbox(b))) {
          out.splice(i, 1);
          b = u;
          i = -1;
        }
      }
      out.push(b);
    }
    return out;
  };
  const clearBox = b => {
    for (let y = b[1]; y < b[4]; y++) for (let z = b[2]; z < b[5]; z++) {
      const j = y * SXZ + z * SX;
      vol.fill(0, j + b[0], j + b[3]);
    }
  };

  // ---- the texture ----
  let tex = null,
    texGl = null;
  const withUnit = (gl, fn) => {
    const act = gl.getParameter(gl.ACTIVE_TEXTURE);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + UNIT);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tex);
    try {
      fn();
    } finally {
      gl.activeTexture(act);
    }
  };
  const send = (gl, boxes) => withUnit(gl, () => {
    const keys = [gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, gl.UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH, gl.UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT, gl.UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS, gl.UNPACK_SKIP_ROWS, gl.UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES, gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL];
    const keep = keys.map(k => gl.getParameter(k)),
      pbo = gl.getParameter(gl.PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER_BINDING);
    if (pbo) gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER, null);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, false);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, false);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH, SX);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT, SZ);
    for (const b of boxes) {
      gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS, b[0]);
      gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_SKIP_ROWS, b[2]);
      gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES, b[1]);
      gl.texSubImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_3D, 0, b[0], b[2], b[1], b[3] - b[0], b[5] - b[2], b[4] - b[1], gl.RED, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, vol);
    }
    keys.forEach((k, i) => gl.pixelStorei(k, typeof keep[i] === 'boolean' ? keep[i] : keep[i] | 0));
    if (pbo) gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER, pbo);
  });
  const ensureTex = gl => {
    if (tex && texGl === gl && gl.isTexture(tex)) return false;
    tex = gl.createTexture();
    texGl = gl;
    withUnit(gl, () => {
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_R, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
      gl.texStorage3D(gl.TEXTURE_3D, 1, gl.R8, SX, SZ, SY);
    });
    return true; // (all of vol to send)
  };

  // ---- each frame ----
  const recs = new Map(); // entity -> its light
  let curWorld = null,
    nz = null,
    count = 0,
    frame = 0;
  const update = (g, a) => {
    frame++;
    const r = g.renderer,
      gl = r && r.gl;
    if (!gl || gl.isContextLost()) return;
    const S = cfg(g),
      now = performance.now(),
      p = g.player;
    const on = !broken && S.mode > 0 && !g.net && g.state === 'play' && !!p && !!g.world;
    const dirty = [];
    if (g.world !== curWorld) {
      curWorld = g.world;
      for (const rec of recs.values()) if (rec.box) dirty.push(rec.box);
      recs.clear();
      placed = false;
    }
    // the lights of this frame, nearest first
    const cand = [];
    if (on) {
      const px = p.pos[0],
        py = p.pos[1],
        pz = p.pos[2];
      const look = e => {
        if (!e || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0 || !e.pos) return;
        const v = lumOfEntity(g, e, S, a);
        if (v <= 0) return;
        const q = e.ipos ? e.ipos(a) : e.pos,
          h = e.h || 0;
        const y = q[1] + (e === p ? Math.min(1.2, h * 0.66) : typeof Living === 'function' && e instanceof Living ? h * 0.66 : h * 0.5);
        const d2 = (q[0] - px) ** 2 + (y - py) ** 2 + (q[2] - pz) ** 2;
        if (d2 < 96 * 96) cand.push({
          e,
          d2,
          x: q[0],
          y,
          z: q[2],
          L: v
        });
      };
      look(p);
      for (const e of g.entities || []) if (e !== p) look(e);
      // (the 灯笼小精灵 pet floating by the player - cosmetics.js: a light of its own; not with 自己 off)
      if (S.self !== false && typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.lights) for (const s of Cosmetics.lights(g)) {
        const d2 = (s.x - px) ** 2 + (s.y - py) ** 2 + (s.z - pz) ** 2;
        if (d2 < 96 * 96) cand.push({
          e: s.key,
          d2,
          x: s.x,
          y: s.y,
          z: s.z,
          L: s.L
        });
      }
      cand.sort((u, w) => u.d2 - w.d2);
      if (cand.length > MAXL) cand.length = MAXL;
      // the volume follows the player (in steps of 8; what was drawn at the old place is cleared)
      const bx = Math.floor(px),
        by = Math.floor(py),
        bz = Math.floor(pz);
      if (!placed || Math.abs(bx - (ox + SX / 2)) > 16 || Math.abs(by - (oy + SY / 2)) > 8 || Math.abs(bz - (oz + SZ / 2)) > 16) {
        if (nz) dirty.push(nz);
        for (const rec of recs.values()) {
          rec.box = null;
          rec.force = true;
        }
        ox = (bx & ~7) - SX / 2;
        oy = (by & ~7) - SY / 2;
        oz = (bz & ~7) - SZ / 2;
        placed = true;
      }
    }
    for (const c of cand) {
      let rec = recs.get(c.e);
      if (!rec) {
        rec = {
          air: new Uint32Array(2048),
          bnd: new Uint32Array(1024),
          nA: -1,
          nB: 0,
          box: null,
          t: 0,
          tB: 0,
          bDirty: false,
          force: true
        };
        recs.set(c.e, rec);
      }
      rec.f = frame;
      rec.lx = c.x;
      rec.ly = c.y;
      rec.lz = c.z;
      rec.lL = c.L;
    }
    for (const [e, rec] of recs) if (rec.f !== frame) {
      if (rec.box) dirty.push(rec.box);
      recs.delete(e);
    }
    const iv = INTERVAL[S.mode] || 0,
      t0 = performance.now();
    let budget = 4;
    for (const c of cand) {
      const rec = recs.get(c.e),
        first = rec.nA < 0;
      const moved = first || rec.force || Math.abs(rec.lx - rec.x) + Math.abs(rec.ly - rec.y) + Math.abs(rec.lz - rec.z) > 0.004 || rec.lL !== rec.L;
      let want = rec.force || first || moved && (iv === 0 || now - rec.t >= iv);
      const cx = Math.floor(rec.lx),
        cy = Math.floor(rec.ly),
        cz = Math.floor(rec.lz);
      const needB = first || rec.bDirty || now - rec.tB > 2000 || want && (cx !== rec.sx || cy !== rec.sy || cz !== rec.sz || Math.ceil(rec.lL) !== Math.ceil(rec.bL));
      if (needB && (c.e === p || budget > 0 && performance.now() - t0 < 3)) {
        if (c.e !== p) budget--;
        rec.sx = cx;
        rec.sy = cy;
        rec.sz = cz;
        rec.L = rec.lL;
        bfs(rec, g.world);
        rec.tB = now + Math.random() * 300;
        rec.bDirty = false;
        want = true;
      }
      if (want && rec.nA >= 0) {
        if (rec.box) dirty.push(rec.box);
        rec.x = rec.lx;
        rec.y = rec.ly;
        rec.z = rec.lz;
        rec.L = rec.lL;
        rec.t = now;
        rec.force = false;
        rec.box = boxOf(rec);
        if (rec.box) dirty.push(rec.box);
      }
    }
    // redraw what changed
    const fresh = ensureTex(gl);
    let boxes = dirty.length ? merge(dirty) : [];
    for (const b of boxes) {
      clearBox(b);
      for (const rec of recs.values()) if (rec.box && rec.nA >= 0 && meets(rec.box, b)) stamp(rec, b);
    }
    if (fresh) boxes = [[0, 0, 0, SX, SY, SZ]];
    if (boxes.length) send(gl, boxes);
    nz = null;
    count = 0;
    for (const rec of recs.values()) if (rec.box) {
      nz = nz ? union(nz, rec.box) : rec.box.slice();
      count++;
    }
    // the programs: on / off and where the volume is
    const onN = count ? 1 : 0;
    let cur = null;
    for (let i = progs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const pr = progs[i];
      if (pr.gl !== gl) continue;
      if (!gl.isProgram(pr.P.p)) {
        progs.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const o = pr.o;
      if (pr.on === onN && (!onN || o && o[0] === ox && o[1] === oy && o[2] === oz)) continue;
      if (cur === null) cur = gl.getParameter(gl.CURRENT_PROGRAM);
      gl.useProgram(pr.P.p);
      gl.uniform1f(pr.P.u.u_dynOn, onN);
      pr.on = onN;
      if (onN && pr.P.u.u_dynO) {
        gl.uniform3f(pr.P.u.u_dynO, ox, oy, oz);
        pr.o = [ox, oy, oz];
      }
    }
    if (cur !== null) restore(gl, cur);
    if (onN) withUnit(gl, () => {}); // (bound on its unit every frame)
  };

  // ---- the light the volume gives at a point (block light 0..15) ----
  const cellLv = (x, y, z) => {
    const vx = x - ox,
      vy = y - oy,
      vz = z - oz;
    if (vx < 0 || vy < 0 || vz < 0 || vx >= SX || vy >= SY || vz >= SZ) return 0;
    return vol[vx + vz * SX + vy * SXZ] / 17;
  };
  const pointLv = (x, y, z) => {
    const X = x - 0.5,
      Y = y - 0.5,
      Z = z - 0.5,
      i = Math.floor(X),
      j = Math.floor(Y),
      k = Math.floor(Z),
      u = X - i,
      v = Y - j,
      w = Z - k;
    let s = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const dx = c & 1,
        dy = c >> 1 & 1,
        dz = c >> 2;
      s += cellLv(i + dx, j + dy, k + dz) * (dx ? u : 1 - u) * (dy ? v : 1 - v) * (dz ? w : 1 - w);
    }
    return s;
  };
  let drawing = false;
  self.DynLights = {
    get count() {
      return count;
    },
    cellLv,
    pointLv,
    recs,
    vol,
    progs,
    cfg,
    origin: () => [ox, oy, oz],
    lumOfEntity
  };
  if (typeof Game === 'function') {
    const render = Game.prototype.render;
    Game.prototype.render = function (a, now) {
      try {
        update(this, a !== null && a !== void 0 ? a : 1);
      } catch (e) {
        fail('update', e);
        count = 0;
      }
      drawing = true;
      try {
        return render.call(this, a, now);
      } finally {
        drawing = false;
      }
    };
  }
  if (typeof UI === 'function' && UI.prototype.draw) {
    // (the interface, F3 among it, shows the world's own light)
    const draw = UI.prototype.draw;
    UI.prototype.draw = function (...args) {
      const was = drawing;
      drawing = false;
      try {
        return draw.apply(this, args);
      } finally {
        drawing = was;
      }
    };
  }
  // chests, signs, bells, campfire food, pets, rain ...: what is drawn with the world's light where it is
  if (typeof World === 'function') {
    const getLight = World.prototype.getLight;
    World.prototype.getLight = function (x, y, z) {
      const l = getLight.call(this, x, y, z);
      if (!drawing || !count || this !== curWorld) return l;
      const b = Math.round(cellLv(x, y, z));
      return b > (l & 15) ? l & 0xF0 | b : l;
    };
    // a block changed near a light: its BFS again
    const setBlock = World.prototype.setBlock;
    World.prototype.setBlock = function (x, y, z, id, meta, flags) {
      const ok = setBlock.call(this, x, y, z, id, meta, flags);
      if (ok && recs.size && this === curWorld) for (const rec of recs.values()) if (Math.abs(x - rec.sx) <= R && Math.abs(y - rec.sy) <= R && Math.abs(z - rec.sz) <= R) rec.bDirty = true;
      return ok;
    };
  }
  // mobs, items lying about, your hand: the light where they are
  if (typeof Entity === 'function') {
    const la = Entity.prototype.lightAt;
    Entity.prototype.lightAt = function () {
      const L = la.call(this);
      if (count && this.world === curWorld) {
        const b = pointLv(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + (this.h || 0) * 0.5, this.pos[2]) / 15;
        if (b > L[1]) L[1] = b;
      }
      return L;
    };
  }

  // ---- 视频设置 → 移动光源… ----
  if (typeof OptionsListScreen === 'function') {
    const MODES = ['关', '流畅', '平衡', '精致'],
      LV = ['关', '简单', '精致'];
    const options = OptionsListScreen.prototype.options;
    OptionsListScreen.prototype.options = function () {
      const g = this.game;
      if (this.page === 'dynlights') {
        const c = cfg(g),
          onoff = v => v ? '开' : '关';
        const bt = (label, fn, tip, wide) => ({
          label,
          wide,
          tip,
          onClick: () => {
            fn();
            g.saveSettings();
          }
        });
        return [bt(() => '移动光源：' + MODES[c.mode], () => c.mode = (c.mode + 1) % 4, ['拿着火把这类发光物品，周围跟着亮', '流畅：每秒更新 2 次　平衡：每秒 4 次', '精致：每帧都更新（最平滑）'], true), bt(() => '自己发光：' + onoff(c.self), () => c.self = !c.self, ['你手里、头上的发光物品照亮周围']), bt(() => '其他光源：' + onoff(c.ents), () => c.ents = !c.ents, ['生物拿着的、掉在地上的、物品展示框里的发光物品', '着火的生物、烈焰人、岩浆怪、发光鱿鱼、火球、光灵箭……']), bt(() => '水下熄灭：' + onoff(c.water), () => c.water = !c.water, ['火把、营火、岩浆桶这类在水下不发光']), bt(() => '点燃的 TNT：' + LV[c.tnt], () => c.tnt = (c.tnt + 1) % 3, ['简单：一直发光', '精致：随着闪白一明一暗']), bt(() => '苦力怕引爆：' + LV[c.creeper], () => c.creeper = (c.creeper + 1) % 3, ['简单：膨胀时发光', '精致：越接近爆炸越亮'])];
      }
      const o = options.call(this);
      if (this.page === 'video' && Array.isArray(o)) o.push({
        label: '移动光源…',
        tip: ['模组「移动光源」的设置'],
        onClick: () => g.ui.open(new OptionsListScreen(g, this, '移动光源', 'dynlights'))
      });
      return o;
    };
  }
})();

// 农夫乐事教程地图 (tutorial map: the 模组 screen's 教程地图 on 农夫乐事's card; first made for the recording build #V2): a superflat world with 农夫乐事's play laid out along a route, ① to ⑥ -
// the kitchen (a stew already cooking in the pot on a lit stove, meat roasting on another, the skillet, the cutting
// board with cabbages on it), the farm (cabbages, onions, tomatoes up their ropes, a rice paddy, rich soil with
// mushroom colonies, compost), the wild crops each on its own ground, the feasts and pies on their tables, the cabinets
// / crates / tatami / baskets / rope fence / safety net, and a wall of finished dishes - each with signs and full chests.
// Built each time the world is entered (the user 11-13: a fresh map every time, whatever was done to it before); /demo reset builds it all again (every block, chest, sign, frame, the
// dropped items and the player's inventory), /demo tp goes back to the start. Our own code; the map laid out by hand.
(function () {
  if (window.__OFFLINE_MODS) return; // 离线包：停用教程地图玩法（不再自动建图/传送）
  if (typeof Game !== 'function' || !self.FD) return;
  const FD = self.FD;
  // the area (x, z from -R to R), the ground (grass at y 60 in a superflat world), what is built goes from y 61
  const R = 27,
    G = 60,
    TOP = 82,
    BOTTOM = 48;
  const START = [0.5, 61, 23.5];

  // ---- blocks ----
  const idOf = k => BID[k] !== undefined ? BID[k] : -1;
  function metaOf(id, props) {
    const st = BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].states;
    if (!st || !props) return 0;
    const i = st.findIndex(s => Object.keys(props).every(k => !(k in s) || String(s[k]) === String(props[k])));
    return i < 0 ? 0 : i;
  }
  let W = null,
    g0 = null;
  const missing = new Set();
  function set(x, y, z, key, props) {
    const id = key === 'air' ? 0 : idOf(key);
    if (id < 0) {
      missing.add(key);
      return;
    }
    const m = id ? metaOf(id, props) : 0;
    if (W.getBlock(x, y, z) === id && W.getMeta(x, y, z) === m) return;
    W.setBlock(x, y, z, id, m);
  }
  function fill(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, key, props) {
    for (let x = Math.min(x0, x1); x <= Math.max(x0, x1); x++) for (let y = Math.min(y0, y1); y <= Math.max(y0, y1); y++) for (let z = Math.min(z0, z1); z <= Math.max(z0, z1); z++) set(x, y, z, key, props);
  }
  // ---- stacks ----
  const item = (k, n = 1) => ITEM_KEY[k] !== undefined ? {
    id: ITEM_KEY[k],
    count: n,
    dmg: 0
  } : (missing.add(k), null);
  function chest(x, y, z, stacks, facing = 'south') {
    set(x, y, z, 'chest', {
      facing
    });
    const be = g0.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'chest');
    be.slots = new Array(27).fill(null);
    delete be.loot;
    stacks.filter(Boolean).slice(0, 27).forEach((s, i) => {
      be.slots[i] = s;
    });
    g0.markBlockEntity && g0.markBlockEntity(be);
  }
  // a standing sign facing the start (south), or a wall sign; up to 4 lines a side, the back the same
  function sign(x, y, z, lines, wall, color) {
    if (wall) set(x, y, z, 'oak_wall_sign', {
      facing: wall
    });else set(x, y, z, 'oak_sign', {
      rotation: '0'
    });
    const t = g0.signAt(x, y, z),
      L = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => lines[i] || '');
    t.f.l = L.slice();
    t.f.c = color || 'black';
    t.f.g = false;
    t.b.l = L.slice();
    t.b.c = color || 'black';
    t.b.g = false;
  }
  const be = (x, y, z, kind) => {
    const b = FD.beAt(g0, x, y, z, kind);
    return b;
  };

  // ---- clearing the area: the ground back to grass over dirt over stone, air above, nothing left on it ----
  const inArea = (x, y, z) => x >= -R && x <= R && z >= -R && z <= R && y >= BOTTOM && y <= TOP;
  function clear(g) {
    for (let x = -R; x <= R; x++) for (let z = -R; z <= R; z++) {
      for (let y = BOTTOM; y <= TOP; y++) set(x, y, z, y > G ? 'air' : y === G ? 'grass_block' : y >= G - 3 ? 'dirt' : 'stone');
    }
    for (const [k, b] of [...g.blockEntities]) if (b.pos && inArea(b.pos[0], b.pos[1], b.pos[2])) g.blockEntities.delete(k);
    if (g.signs) for (const k of [...g.signs.keys()]) {
      const [x, y, z] = k.split(',').map(Number);
      if (inArea(x, y, z)) g.signs.delete(k);
    }
    const p = g.player;
    g.entities = g.entities.filter(e => e === p || !inArea(Math.floor(e.pos[0]), Math.floor(e.pos[1]), Math.floor(e.pos[2])));

  function toStart(g) {
    const p = g.player;
    p.pos = [...START];
    p.prev = [...START];
    p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
    p.yaw = 0;
    p.pitch = 0.1;
    p.fallDist = 0;
  }
  function resetPlayer(g) {
    const p = g.player;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.inv.slots.length; i++) p.inv.slots[i] = null;
    // (hungry, so the dishes can be eaten on camera)
    p.health = p.maxHealth || 20;
    p.food = 8;
    p.saturation = 0;
    p.fire = 0;
    if (p.effects && p.effects.clear) p.effects.clear();
    toStart(g);
  }
  self.FDDemo = {
    build,
    clear,
    toStart,
    R
  };

  // ---- built each time the world is entered (once its area is loaded): the world's meta object is new for each
  // entry, so the game remembers which one it built for ----
  const loaded = g => {
    const w = g.world;
    for (let x = -R; x <= R; x += 9) for (let z = -R; z <= R; z += 9) if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) return false;
    return w.isLoaded(R, R);
  };
  const tk = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const r = tk.apply(this, arguments);
    if (window.__OFFLINE_MODS) return r; // 离线包：不自动建造教程地图
    if (this.state === 'play' && !this.net && this.worldMeta && this.dim === 'overworld' && this.fddemoFor !== this.worldMeta && loaded(this)) {
      this.fddemoFor = this.worldMeta;
      this.worldMeta.fddemoBuilt = true;
      build(this);
      resetPlayer(this);

/* ==== js/main.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input binding & bootstrap
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function bindInput(g) {
  const canvas = g.canvas,
    ui = g.ui;
  const locked = () => document.pointerLockElement === canvas;
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (document.activeElement === ui.input) return;
    Sound.init();
    const code = e.code;
    if (code === 'Escape' && !e.repeat) g.escHeld = performance.now();
    if (['Space', 'Tab', 'F1', 'F3', 'F5', 'Slash', 'KeyQ'].includes(code) || e.ctrlKey && ['KeyS', 'KeyD', 'KeyW', 'KeyA'].includes(code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (ui.screen) {
      if (ui.key(e)) return;
      if (code === 'Escape' || bindingsFor(g, code).includes('inventory') && ui.screen instanceof ContainerScreen) {
        if (ui.screen.onEsc) ui.screen.onEsc();else if (g.state === 'play' && !(ui.screen instanceof DeathScreen)) ui.close();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (g.state !== 'play') return;
    if (e.repeat && !code.startsWith('Digit')) {
      g.keys[code] = true;
      return;
    }
    g.keys[code] = true;
    const p = g.player,
      now = performance.now();
    if (code === 'Escape') {
      ui.open(new PauseScreen(g));
      return;
    }
    // vanilla F3 combos: F3 toggles the debug screen on release unless used as a modifier
    if (g.keys.F3 && code !== 'F3') {
      g.f3Used = true;
      if (code === 'KeyH') {
        g.settings.advTooltips = !g.settings.advTooltips;
        g.saveSettings();
        ui.message('[调试]：高级提示框：' + (g.settings.advTooltips ? '显示' : '隐藏'), '#FFFF55');
        return;
      }
      if (code === 'KeyN' || code === 'F4') {
        if (!g.cheats && !g.net) {
          ui.message('[调试]：无法切换游戏模式；没有权限', '#FF5555');
          return;
        }
        g.requestMode(code === 'KeyN' ? g.mode === 'spectator' ? g.prevMode && g.prevMode !== 'spectator' ? g.prevMode : 'creative' : 'spectator' : MODE_NEXT[g.mode]);
        return;
      }
      if (code === 'KeyL') {
        g.perfReport();
        return;
      }
      if (code === 'KeyQ') {
        ui.message('F3 + H = 高级提示框，F3 + N = 旁观模式切换，F3 + F4 = 切换游戏模式，F3 + L = 记录 10 秒性能报告', '#FFFF55');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (code === 'F3') g.f3Used = false;
    // everything else goes through the key bindings (选项 → 按键控制 → 按键绑定)
    for (const act of bindingsFor(g, code)) if (pressAction(g, act, e)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.code === 'F3' && g.keys.F3 && !g.f3Used && !ui.screen && g.state === 'play') {
      ui.debug = !ui.debug;
      PerfMon.gpuOn = ui.debug;
    }
    g.keys[e.code] = false;
    if (e.code === 'Escape') {
      g.escHeld = 0;
      if (g.escCapture) {
        g.escCapture = false;
        if (g.state === 'play' && !ui.screen) {
          g.clickToResume = performance.now();
          g.capturePointer();
        }
      }
    }
    for (const act of bindingsFor(g, e.code)) releaseAction(g, act);
  });
  const releaseAll = () => {
    g.keys = {};
    g.rawMouse = [false, false, false];
    g.mouseBtn = [false, false, false];
    g.sprintToggle = false;
  };
  window.addEventListener('blur', releaseAll);
  document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
    // (not when the lock went because the game is now played by touch - see touch.js)
    if (locked()) g.lockFails = 0;
    if (!locked()) {
      releaseAll();
      if (g.state === 'play' && !ui.screen && !touchOn(g)) ui.open(new PauseScreen(g));
    }
  });
  // the browser refuses the mouse lock (some browsers and app web views never give it): played with the mouse free
  // instead of the pause menu coming back each time "back to game" is clicked (players' feedback 2026-10-31, ~10)
  // (a soft refusal - asked with no click behind it, or again right after the player left the lock: game.js
  // capturePointer marks the request with lockSoftAt - is not counted: the browser said nothing about itself. This
  // listener runs before game.js's own, which then finds lockSoftAt cleared)
  document.addEventListener('pointerlockerror', () => {
    if (g.lockSoftAt && performance.now() - g.lockSoftAt < 1500) {
      g.lockSoftAt = 0;
      return;
    }
    g.lockFails = (g.lockFails || 0) + 1;
  });
  const freeMouse = () => g.lockFails > 0 && !locked() && !touchOn(g);
  // a button let go where the page never heard it (Edge's mouse gestures take the right button's mouseup): the buttons
  // the event says are down win - before, use stayed held and blocks went on being placed with nothing pressed
  const syncButtons = e => {
    if (typeof e.buttons !== 'number' || !g.rawMouse) return;
    for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) if (g.rawMouse[b] && !(e.buttons & [1, 4, 2][b])) {
      g.rawMouse[b] = false;
      for (const act of bindingsFor(g, 'Mouse' + b)) releaseAction(g, act);
    }
    unlockIfUp();
  };
  // a screen opened by a held button (right click on a chest, a villager): the lock is let go once the button is up
  // (ui.open, g.unlockOnUp). Let go at once, the pointer jumped back with the button down - to Edge a right-button
  // drag, its mouse gestures closed or left the page ("右键箱子 / 村民闪退", feedback 11-01 to 11-08)
  const unlockIfUp = () => {
    if (!g.unlockOnUp || g.rawMouse && (g.rawMouse[0] || g.rawMouse[1] || g.rawMouse[2])) return; // (side buttons aside)
    g.unlockOnUp = false;
    if (ui.screen && !ui.screen.keepPointer) g.releasePointer();
  };
  // a spike: one event far off the other way to the last (Chrome's lock without raw input as it puts the hidden pointer
  // back). A fast flick is no spike - every move past 400 was dropped, the view did not follow (feedback 11-01 to 11-08);
  // with raw input (g.lockRaw) nothing is dropped, as in vanilla
  let lastMove = [0, 0],
    lastMoveT = 0;
  const spike = (v, last) => Math.abs(v) > 400 && Math.abs(last) >= 8 && last * v < 0 && !(g.lockRaw && locked());
  // the mouse left free (freeMouse): held against an edge of the page the view keeps turning that way - the pointer
  // cannot go on and movementX stays 0 there ("鼠标到屏幕边缘就转不动", phones / tablets with a mouse, browsers that
  // refuse the lock; the pointer itself is hidden while playing, ui.draw)
  let edge = null,
    edgeT = 0,
    edgeRaf = 0;
  const edgeTurn = t => {
    if (!edge || !freeMouse() || ui.screen || g.state !== 'play') {
      edge = null;
      edgeRaf = 0;
      edgeT = 0;
      return;
    }
    const dt = edgeT ? Math.min(0.1, (t - edgeT) / 1000) : 0;
    edgeT = t;
    const p = g.player,
      st = g.settings,
      k = (st.sens * 0.006 + 0.0006) * 450 * dt; // (as 450 px a second)
    p.yaw -= edge[0] * k * (st.invertX ? -1 : 1);
    p.pitch = clamp(p.pitch - edge[1] * k * (st.invertY ? -1 : 1), -Math.PI / 2 + 0.001, Math.PI / 2 - 0.001);
    edgeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(edgeTurn);
  };
  // (free mouse: the first move back in the window is the whole way it went outside - dropped, the view jumped by it)
  let reenter = false;
  document.addEventListener('mouseout', e => {
    if (!e.relatedTarget) {
      edge = null;
      reenter = true;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    edge = null;
    reenter = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    syncButtons(e);
    if ((locked() || freeMouse()) && !ui.screen && g.state === 'play') {
      const p = g.player,
        st = g.settings,
        s = st.sens * 0.006 + 0.0006,
        now = performance.now(),
        last = now - lastMoveT < 100 ? lastMove : [0, 0];
      if (reenter) {
        reenter = false;
        if (!locked()) return;
      }
      if (spike(e.movementX, last[0]) || spike(e.movementY, last[1])) return;
      lastMove = [e.movementX, e.movementY];
      lastMoveT = now;
      p.yaw -= e.movementX * s * (st.invertX ? -1 : 1);
      p.pitch = clamp(p.pitch - e.movementY * s * (st.invertY ? -1 : 1), -Math.PI / 2 + 0.001, Math.PI / 2 - 0.001);
      if (!locked()) {
        const m = 2,
          ex = e.clientX <= m ? -1 : e.clientX >= innerWidth - 1 - m ? 1 : 0,
          ey = e.clientY <= m ? -1 : e.clientY >= innerHeight - 1 - m ? 1 : 0;
        edge = ex || ey ? [ex, ey] : null;
        if (edge && !edgeRaf) edgeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(edgeTurn);
      } else edge = null;
    } else ui.mouseMove(e);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  ui.canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  // (Edge's mouse gestures start from a right-button drag on the page: the right button and its menu kept from it)
  window.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => {
    if (e.target !== ui.input) e.preventDefault();
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    if (e.button === 2 && e.target !== ui.input) e.preventDefault();
  }, true);
  // Edge / 360: their mouse gestures (a right-button drag: back, close the tab) are the browser's, past what the page can
  // stop - the first right click in a world says where they are turned off (the first 3 sessions)
  const gestureUA = /Edg\/|QIHU|360SE|360EE/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '');
  let gestureTold = false;
  const gestureTip = () => {
    if (!gestureUA || gestureTold) return;
    gestureTold = true;
    const n = g.settings.gestureTip || 0;
    if (n >= 3) return;
    g.settings.gestureTip = n + 1;
    g.saveSettings();
    ui.message('[提示] 浏览器的「鼠标手势」会把按住右键拖动当成后退或关闭网页；用不到的话，可以在浏览器设置里搜索「鼠标手势」关掉', '#FFFF55');
  };
  window.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    if (e.target === ui.input) return;
    Sound.init();
    syncButtons(e);
    if (ui.screen) {
      ui.mouseDown(e);
      return;
    }
    if (g.state !== 'play') return;
    if (!locked()) {
      g.capturePointer();
      if (!freeMouse()) return;
    }
    if (e.button === 1) e.preventDefault();
    (g.rawMouse || (g.rawMouse = [false, false, false]))[e.button] = true;
    for (const act of bindingsFor(g, 'Mouse' + e.button)) pressAction(g, act, e);
    if (e.button === 2) gestureTip();
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {
    if (ui.screen) {
      ui.mouseUp(e);
    }
    if (g.rawMouse) g.rawMouse[e.button] = false;
    for (const act of bindingsFor(g, 'Mouse' + e.button)) releaseAction(g, act);
    unlockIfUp();
  });
  window.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
    var _st$scrollSens;
    if (ui.screen) {
      ui.wheelShift = e.shiftKey;
      ui.wheel(e.deltaY);
      return;
    }
    if (g.state !== 'play') return;
    // vanilla scroll: wheel sensitivity scales the steps, discrete scrolling counts one step per notch
    const st = g.settings,
      k = (_st$scrollSens = st.scrollSens) !== null && _st$scrollSens !== void 0 ? _st$scrollSens : 1;
    // a mouse wheel's notch is one step whatever the browser makes of it (100, 300 pixels with Windows' "lines to
    // scroll", 3 lines in Firefox: one notch went 3 slots, players' feedback 2026-10-31); a touchpad's small deltas add up
    const notch = e.deltaMode !== 0 || Math.abs(e.deltaY) >= 50;
    g.scrollAcc = (g.scrollAcc || 0) + (st.discreteScroll || notch ? Math.sign(e.deltaY) * k : e.deltaY / 100 * k);
    const n = Math.trunc(g.scrollAcc);
    if (n) {
      g.scrollAcc -= n;
      const p = g.player;
      p.inv.sel = mod(p.inv.sel + n, 9);
    }
  }, {
    passive: true
  });
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', e => {
    if (g.state === 'play') {
      g.saveWorld(true);
      e.preventDefault();
      e.returnValue = '';
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden && g.state === 'play') g.saveWorld(true);
  });
}

// Player preview for the survival inventory
Renderer.prototype.playerPreview = function (game, ui, x, y, w, h, opts) {
  const gl = this.gl,
    S = Math.max(2, ui.scale),
    W = w * S,
    H = h * S;
  // only re-render when the head would turn (it follows the mouse). The picture comes back from the GPU
  // asynchronously: read into a pixel buffer, fenced, and copied out a frame or two later once the fence has
  // passed - a plain readPixels made the CPU wait for the whole frame (the world behind the inventory
  // included) every time the mouse moved
  // (a dyed piece's colour too: two leather chestplates swapped differ by it alone - the frame below no longer covers it)
  const P = game.player,
    gear = P ? [P.inv.sel, ...[P.inv.held, ...P.inv.slots.slice(36, 41)].map(s => {
      var _s$color;
      return s ? s.id + ':' + (s.dmg || 0) + ':' + ((_s$color = s.color) !== null && _s$color !== void 0 ? _s$color : '') : 0;
    })].join('/') : '';
  // (the skin, the cape and its frame: the wardrobe's turning preview, skins.js / capes.js. The frame (8 a second) only
  // for an animated cape or the wardrobe, whose pet moves - and for 1.5 s after what is worn changed, as an armour or
  // wing texture seen for the first time loads a moment later (emodel.js etex: null until then). Always in the key,
  // the inventory drew the player again 8 times a second with nothing changed)
  const cape = P && typeof Capes !== 'undefined' ? Capes.of(game, P) : null,
    cp = cape && Capes.get(cape),
    now = performance.now();
  const look = P && typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.texOf(game, P) + Skins.modelOf(game, P) + (cape || '') : '';
  const worn = x + ',' + y + ',' + W + ',' + H + ',' + gear + look;
  if (this.pvWorn !== worn) {
    this.pvWorn = worn;
    this.pvWornT = now;
  }
  // (asked for every frame while its screen is open: a gap means the screen was opened again - drawn again once then,
  // as what the key leaves out may have changed meanwhile: a crossbow loaded, a hat, a trim, where the compass points.
  // Without it a reopened inventory showed the last picture until the mouse moved - on phones until a touch, 11-04)
  if (now - (this.pvAt || -1e9) > 500) this.pvForce = true;
  this.pvAt = now;
  // (a held compass / clock turns in the hand - the frame keeps it going as before)
  const dyn = s => /^(compass|recovery_compass|clock)$/.test(keyOfStack(s) || '');
  const moving = opts && opts.yaw !== undefined || !!(cp && cp.frames && cp.frames.length > 1) || now - this.pvWornT < 1500 || !!(P && (dyn(P.inv.held) || dyn(P.inv.slots[40])));
  const key = (opts && opts.yaw !== undefined ? 'y' + opts.yaw.toFixed(2) : Math.round(ui.mouse.x) + ',' + Math.round(ui.mouse.y)) + ',' + worn + (moving ? ',' + Math.floor(now / 125) : '');
  if (this.pv && this.pv.sync && this.pv.W === W && this.pv.H === H) {
    const pv = this.pv;
    if (gl.getSyncParameter(pv.sync, gl.SYNC_STATUS) !== gl.SIGNALED) return pv.cv;
    gl.deleteSync(pv.sync);
    pv.sync = null;
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pv.pbo);
    gl.getBufferSubData(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0, pv.px);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
    for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) pv.img.data.set(pv.px.subarray((H - 1 - r) * W * 4, (H - r) * W * 4), r * W * 4);
    pv.ctx.putImageData(pv.img, 0, 0);
    pv.key = pv.pendingKey;
  }
  if (this.pv && this.pv.key === key && !this.pvForce) return this.pv.cv;
  this.pvForce = false;
  if (!this.pv || this.pv.W !== W || this.pv.H !== H) {
    if (this.pv) {
      gl.deleteFramebuffer(this.pv.fb);
      gl.deleteTexture(this.pv.tex);
      gl.deleteRenderbuffer(this.pv.rb);
      if (this.pv.pbo) gl.deleteBuffer(this.pv.pbo);
      if (this.pv.sync) gl.deleteSync(this.pv.sync);
    }
    const fb = gl.createFramebuffer(),
      tex = gl.createTexture(),
      rb = gl.createRenderbuffer();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, W, H, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
    gl.bindRenderbuffer(gl.RENDERBUFFER, rb);
    gl.renderbufferStorage(gl.RENDERBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT24, W, H);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fb);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    gl.framebufferRenderbuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, gl.RENDERBUFFER, rb);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = W;
    cv.height = H;
    const pbo = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pbo);
    gl.bufferData(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, W * H * 4, gl.STREAM_READ);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
    this.pv = {
      fb,
      tex,
      rb,
      pbo,
      W,
      H,
      cv,
      ctx: cv.getContext('2d'),
      px: new Uint8Array(W * H * 4),
      img: cv.getContext('2d').createImageData(W, H),
      first: true
    };
  }
  const pv = this.pv;
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, pv.fb);
  gl.viewport(0, 0, W, H);
  gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
  gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  const vp = M4.create();
  M4.ortho(vp, -0.7, 0.7, -0.05, 1.95, -5, 5);
  const mx = (ui.mouse.x - (x + w / 2)) / 40,
    my = (ui.mouse.y - (y + h * 0.25)) / 40;
  // (turned toward the mouse: past the half turn that faces the camera, a positive angle turns the figure to the
  // screen's right; the head's pitch is negative looking down, like the player's own - both were the wrong way
  // round, players said the figure looked away from the pointer)
  const m = M4.create();
  M4.translate(m, 0, 0, 0);
  M4.rotY(m, opts && opts.yaw !== undefined ? opts.yaw : Math.PI + Math.atan(mx) * 0.7);
  M4.scale(m, 0.9375, 0.9375, 0.9375);
  // lit like vanilla's inventory (full light), not by the world's time of day: the light table and the shaders' sun
  // follow the world, so at dusk or at night the preview went dark. Drawn with the plain entity shader
  const LT = [1, 1],
    savedFx = this.fxOn;
  this.fxOn = false;
  const env = {
    day: 1,
    fogColor: [0, 0, 0],
    fogNear: 1e8,
    fogFar: 2e8,
    nightTint: [1, 1, 1]
  };
  const savedCam = this.camPos;
  this.camPos = [0, 0, 0];
  const poses = opts && opts.yaw !== undefined ? {} : {
    head: {
      ry: Math.atan(mx) * 0.5,
      rx: -Math.atan(my) * 0.6
    }
  };
  // worn armour, the elytra and the held items too (held items draw with the renderer's projection)
  const savedVP = this.vp;
  this.vp = vp;
  const attach = P && game.heldAttach ? game.heldAttach(P, typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.modelOf(game, P) : 'steve', P.inv.held, P.inv.slots[40], LT, env) : null;
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  const pm = P && typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.modelOf(game, P) : 'steve';
  this.drawModel(pm, P && typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.texOf(game, P) : 'steve', m, poses, LT, env, {
    vp,
    attach,
    inv: true
  });
  if (P && typeof Capes !== 'undefined') Capes.draw(game, P, m, poses, LT, env, {
    vp,
    still: true,
    inv: true
  });
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  if (P) {
    game.drawArmor(P.inv.slots.slice(36, 40), m, poses, LT, env, {
      vp,
      inv: true
    });
    if (game.drawWings) game.drawWings(P, m, LT, env, null, vp);
  }
  this.vp = savedVP;
  this.fxOn = savedFx;
  this.camPos = savedCam;
  if (pv.first) {
    // the first picture is read at once, so the inventory never opens with an empty space for a frame
    pv.first = false;
    gl.readPixels(0, 0, W, H, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, pv.px);
    for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) pv.img.data.set(pv.px.subarray((H - 1 - r) * W * 4, (H - r) * W * 4), r * W * 4);
    pv.ctx.putImageData(pv.img, 0, 0);
    pv.key = key;
  } else {
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pv.pbo);
    gl.readPixels(0, 0, W, H, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
    pv.sync = gl.fenceSync(gl.SYNC_GPU_COMMANDS_COMPLETE, 0);
    gl.flush();
    pv.pendingKey = key;
  }
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
  gl.viewport(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
  return pv.cv;
};
window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
  const g = window.game = new Game();
  try {
    await g.init();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    const d = document.getElementById('err');
    d.style.display = 'block';
    d.textContent = '启动失败：' + (e && e.message || e) + '\n\n请使用最新版 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 浏览器打开，并确保已启用 WebGL2 / 硬件加速。';
  }
});
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/touch.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Touch input. Detects the device (phones / tablets get touch controls by default), makes every menu usable
// by touch (tap = click, drag = scroll or move a slider; in inventories a long press = right click and a
// double tap = shift-click) and, while playing, draws Bedrock-style on-screen controls: a D-pad with sneak in
// the middle, jump / fly-down / sprint buttons, drag anywhere to look, tap to use or attack, hold to mine
// (or to eat / draw a bow), tap a hotbar slot to select it and hold it to drop the stack.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const TouchDevice = (() => {
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '',
    mq = q => !!(window.matchMedia && matchMedia(q).matches);
  const points = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0,
    touch = points > 0 || 'ontouchstart' in window;
  const iPadOS = /Macintosh/.test(ua) && points > 1;
  const mobile = !!(navigator.userAgentData && navigator.userAgentData.mobile) || /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile|HarmonyOS|OpenHarmony/i.test(ua) || iPadOS;
  const tablet = iPadOS || /iPad|Tablet/i.test(ua) || /Android/i.test(ua) && !/Mobile/i.test(ua);
  const kind = mobile ? tablet ? 'tablet' : 'phone' : touch ? 'touchpc' : 'pc';
  return {
    kind,
    touch,
    // a touchscreen PC only defaults to touch when it has no mouse / trackpad
    defaultOn: mobile || touch && mq('(pointer: coarse)') && !mq('(any-pointer: fine)'),
    name: {
      phone: '手机',
      tablet: '平板',
      touchpc: '触屏电脑',
      pc: '电脑'
    }[kind]
  };
})();
// (touchPick: the first-run device choice - only where the game starts, touching / the mouse still switch; settings.touch
// is the option's own on / off)
// the look speed: a multiple of the old default (0.0045 rad a CSS pixel), 25%-500%; if never set 150% on phones (their
// players 10-31 to 11-02: too slow, even the old most - 1.8x - was not enough), 100% elsewhere (the user, 11-03).
// An old touchSens is carried over once
function touchLook(st) {
  var _st$touchLook;
  if (st.touchLook === undefined && st.touchSens !== undefined && st.touchSens !== 0.5) st.touchLook = Math.round((st.touchSens * 1.6 + 0.2) * 20) / 20;
  return (_st$touchLook = st.touchLook) !== null && _st$touchLook !== void 0 ? _st$touchLook : TouchDevice.kind === 'phone' ? 1.5 : 1;
}
// the buttons' size: tablets start larger (their buttons were too small to hit: feedback 11-01/02)
const touchSizeOf = st => {
  var _st$touchSize;
  return (_st$touchSize = st.touchSize) !== null && _st$touchSize !== void 0 ? _st$touchSize : TouchDevice.kind === 'tablet' ? 1.3 : 1;
};
const touchOn = g => {
  var _ref, _g$settings$touch;
  return (_ref = (_g$settings$touch = g.settings.touch) !== null && _g$settings$touch !== void 0 ? _g$settings$touch : g.touchAuto) !== null && _ref !== void 0 ? _ref : g.settings.touchPick ? g.settings.touchPick === 'phone' : TouchDevice.defaultOn;
};
// items whose use is held (eating, drinking, drawing a bow ...): a long press uses them instead of mining
function touchHoldUse(st) {
  const d = st && ITEMS[st.id];
  return !!d && (!!d.food || /^(bow|crossbow|trident|shield|spyglass|milk_bucket|potion|honey_bottle|goat_horn)$/.test(d.key));
}

// 9x9 pixel icons
const TOUCH_ICONS = (() => {
  const I = {
    up: ['....#....', '...###...', '..#####..', '.#######.', '#########', '...###...', '...###...', '...###...', '...###...'],
    ul: ['#####....', '####.....', '####.....', '#####....', '#..###...', '....###..', '.....###.', '......###', '.......##'],
    jump: ['....#....', '...###...', '..#####..', '.#######.', '#########', '...###...', '...###...', '.........', '#########'],
    sneak: ['..#####..', '.##...##.', '##.....##', '#.......#', '#.......#', '#.......#', '##.....##', '.##...##.', '..#####..'],
    sneakOn: ['..#####..', '.#######.', '#########', '#########', '#########', '#########', '#########', '.#######.', '..#####..'],
    sprint: ['....#....', '...###...', '..##.##..', '.##...##.', '##..#..##', '...###...', '..##.##..', '.##...##.', '##.....##'],
    pause: ['.........', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.##...##.', '.........'],
    chat: ['.........', '#########', '#.......#', '#.#.#.#.#', '#.......#', '#########', '.##......', '.#.......', '.........'],
    view: ['.........', '..#####..', '.##...##.', '##.###.##', '#..###..#', '##.###.##', '.##...##.', '..#####..', '.........'],
    close: ['##.....##', '###...###', '.###.###.', '..#####..', '...###...', '..#####..', '.###.###.', '###...###', '##.....##']
  };
  const cw = a => a[0].split('').map((_, i) => a.map(r => r[i]).reverse().join(''));
  I.right = cw(I.up);
  I.down = cw(I.right);
  I.left = cw(I.down);
  I.ur = I.ul.map(r => [...r].reverse().join(''));
  I.descend = [...I.jump].reverse();
  return I;
})();
class TouchControls {
  constructor(g) {
    this.g = g;
    this.ui = g.ui;
    this.t = new Map();
    this.pend = [];
    this.lastSlotTap = null;
    g.touchHeld = {};
    const opt = {
      passive: false
    };
    window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => this.onStart(e), opt);
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => this.onMove(e), opt);
    window.addEventListener('touchend', e => this.onEnd(e, false), opt);
    window.addEventListener('touchcancel', e => this.onEnd(e, true), opt);
    document.addEventListener('gesturestart', e => e.preventDefault()); // iOS pinch zoom
    // the text field (chat, signs, names ...): focused by the tap itself. On iPhones the browser's own handling took
    // the first tap as a "hover" and needed a second one, and the second was a double tap that zoomed the page
    const inp = this.ui.input;
    if (inp) inp.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      if (inp.style.display === 'none' || document.activeElement === inp) return; // (focused: a tap moves the caret)
      e.preventDefault();
      inp.focus();
    }, opt);
  }
  on() {
    return touchOn(this.g);
  }
  playing() {
    return this.g.state === 'play' && !this.ui.screen;
  }
  gui(cx, cy) {
    const r = this.ui.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),
      k = this.ui.dpr / this.ui.scale;
    return [(cx - r.left) * k, (cy - r.top) * k];
  }
  reset() {
    const g = this.g;
    for (const s of this.t.values()) if (s.holding) g.mouseBtn[s.holdBtn] = false;
    this.t.clear();
    this.pend.length = 0;
    if (g.touchHeld && g.touchHeld.forward) releaseAction(g, 'forward');
    g.touchHeld = {};
  }

  // ---- events -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  onStart(e) {
    const ui = this.ui;
    if (e.target === ui.input) return; // the text field takes the tap itself (opens the on-screen keyboard)
    ui.lastTouch = performance.now();
    this.prune(e);
    const play = this.playing();
    if (play && !this.on()) return; // touch controls off: leave the browser's mouse emulation alone
    e.preventDefault();
    Sound.init();
    for (const ct of e.changedTouches) {
      const [x, y] = this.gui(ct.clientX, ct.clientY);
      const s = {
        sx: ct.clientX,
        sy: ct.clientY,
        cx: ct.clientX,
        cy: ct.clientY,
        x0: x,
        y0: y,
        x,
        y,
        t0: performance.now()
      };
      // (an id given again while the old touch is still here, its end lost: that one is ended first)
      const old = this.t.get(ct.identifier);
      if (old) {
        this.t.delete(ct.identifier);
        this.endTouch(old, true);
      }
      this.t.set(ct.identifier, s);
      if (play) this.startPlay(s);else this.startMenu(s);
    }
  }
  endTouch(s, cancel) {
    if (s.kind === 'menu') this.endMenu(s, cancel);else this.endPlay(s, cancel);
  }
  // touches whose end never came (a system gesture - a screenshot, the notification shade - took the touchend): ended as
  // cancelled once an event lists the fingers down without them. Kept, the joystick (or the attack / use button) stayed
  // held - the player walked or mined on alone and a new thumb on the stick did nothing (feedback 11-01 to 11-11)
  prune(e) {
    if (!e.touches || !this.t.size) return;
    const live = new Set();
    for (const ct of e.touches) live.add(ct.identifier);
    for (const [id, s] of [...this.t]) if (!live.has(id)) {
      this.t.delete(id);
      this.endTouch(s, true);
    }
  }
  onMove(e) {
    this.prune(e);
    let mine = false;
    for (const ct of e.changedTouches) {
      const s = this.t.get(ct.identifier);
      if (!s) continue;
      mine = true;
      const pcx = s.cx,
        pcy = s.cy;
      s.cx = ct.clientX;
      s.cy = ct.clientY;
      [s.x, s.y] = this.gui(s.cx, s.cy);
      if ((s.cx - s.sx) ** 2 + (s.cy - s.sy) ** 2 > 100) s.moved = true;
      if (s.kind === 'menu') this.moveMenu(s);else this.movePlay(s, s.cx - pcx, s.cy - pcy);
    }
    if (mine) e.preventDefault();
  }
  onEnd(e, cancel) {
    let mine = false;
    this.ui.lastTouch = performance.now();
    for (const ct of e.changedTouches) {
      const s = this.t.get(ct.identifier);
      if (!s) continue;
      mine = true;
      this.t.delete(ct.identifier);
      this.endTouch(s, cancel);
    }
    this.prune(e);
    if (!mine) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    Sound.init();
    // first tap in touch mode in a world: go fullscreen in landscape, like an app. Not on the first-run screens (it
    // was the very first tap, on the agreement - players on tablets and learning phones: 「一点同意就卡死」, feedback
    // 2026-11-02) and not inside the Bilibili app, whose own container is fullscreen already
    if (this.on() && !this.fsTried && !cancel && this.g.state === 'play' && !/BiliApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
      this.fsTried = true;
      // (screens.js's checks: iPads and older Safari only have the webkit-prefixed call, iPhones none at all, a frame
      // may not - fullscreenEnabled false)
      const de = document.documentElement,
        req = de.requestFullscreen || de.webkitRequestFullscreen;
      if (!fsElement() && req && fsSupported()) {
        // (counted and sent first: a device that hangs here still tells)
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) {
          Telemetry.count('fs_try');
          Telemetry.flush && Telemetry.flush(false);
        }
        try {
          const r = req.call(de, {
            navigationUI: 'hide'
          });
          if (r && r.then) r.then(() => {
            Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('fs_ok');
            if (screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) return screen.orientation.lock('landscape');
          }).catch(() => {});
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  }
  synth(type, s, button, atStart) {
    const ev = {
      clientX: atStart ? s.sx : s.cx,
      clientY: atStart ? s.sy : s.cy,
      button,
      shiftKey: false
    };
    if (type === 'down') this.ui.mouseDown(ev);else if (type === 'up') this.ui.mouseUp(ev);else this.ui.mouseMove(ev);
  }
  focusInput() {
    const ui = this.ui;
    if (ui.screen && ui.screen.isChat && ui.input.style.display === 'block' && document.activeElement !== ui.input) ui.input.focus();
  }

  // ---- menus --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  startMenu(s) {
    const ui = this.ui,
      sc = ui.screen;
    s.kind = 'menu';
    s.mode = 'pending';
    const cr = this.closeRect();
    if (cr && ui.hit(cr, s.x, s.y)) {
      s.mode = 'close';
      return;
    }
    if (document.activeElement === ui.input && !(ui.inputBox && ui.hit(ui.inputBox, s.x, s.y))) ui.input.blur();
    ui.mouse.x = s.x;
    ui.mouse.y = s.y;
    if (!sc) return;
    // (a list that scrolls smoothly - mods_ui.js: a finger down stops it flying on)
    if (sc.touchHold) sc.touchHold();
    const slider = !(sc instanceof ContainerScreen) && sc.widgets && sc.widgets.some(w => w.slider && w.enabled !== false && ui.hit(w, s.x, s.y));
    const scrollbar = sc instanceof CreativeScreen && s.x >= sc.x + 172 && s.x < sc.x + 190 && s.y >= sc.y + 16 && s.y < sc.y + 132;
    // (sc.touchDrag: a screen that is all dragging - the button layout editor - gets the finger as a held mouse)
    if (slider || scrollbar || sc.touchDrag) {
      this.synth('down', s, 0);
      s.mode = 'drag';
    }
  }
  moveMenu(s) {
    const ui = this.ui,
      sc = ui.screen;
    if (s.mode === 'drag' || s.mode === 'down' || s.mode === 'long') {
      this.synth('move', s);
      return;
    }
    if (s.mode === 'scroll') {
      this.scrollBy(s);
      return;
    }
    if (s.mode !== 'pending' || !s.moved) return;
    const cont = sc instanceof ContainerScreen,
      dx = s.cx - s.sx,
      dy = s.cy - s.sy;
    const from = cont && sc.slotAt ? sc.slotAt(s.x0, s.y0) : null;
    // a stack under the finger goes with it whichever way it is dragged (#B1, 11-11: a screen with a list to scroll took
    // every upright drag for its list - in the crafting table, the inventory, trading ... a stack could not be dragged up
    // or down). Not the creative list's own items, nor where the screen's list lies over the slots (a recipe book on a
    // narrow screen: sc.scrollsAt)
    const grab = !ui.cursor && !!from && !!from.get() && !from.creative && !(sc.scrollsAt && sc.scrollsAt(s.x0, s.y0));
    if (sc && sc.wheel && (!cont || !ui.cursor && !grab && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx))) {
      s.mode = 'scroll';
      s.acc = 0;
      s.ly = s.y0;
      this.scrollBy(s);
    } else if (cont) {
      // a stack dragged from its slot with nothing in hand: carried, and put down where the finger lets go (11-03:
      // before, it stayed on the finger and needed another tap - "背包里放东西不舒服")
      if (!ui.cursor && from && from.get()) s.carry = from;
      this.synth('down', s, 0, true);
      s.mode = 'down';
      this.synth('move', s);
    } else s.mode = 'none';
  }
  scrollBy(s) {
    const sc = this.ui.screen;
    // (one that scrolls by the pixel - mods_ui.js, 11-12: follows the finger exactly, not in steps of a row)
    if (sc && sc.scrollPx) {
      sc.scrollPx(s.y - s.ly);
      s.ly = s.y;
      return;
    }
    const step = sc instanceof WorldListScreen ? 36 : sc instanceof OptionsListScreen ? 25 : sc instanceof ContainerScreen ? 18 : 20;
    s.acc += s.y - s.ly;
    s.ly = s.y;
    while (Math.abs(s.acc) >= step) {
      const d = Math.sign(s.acc);
      s.acc -= d * step;
      this.ui.wheel(-d);
    }
  }
  endMenu(s, cancel) {
    const ui = this.ui;
    switch (s.mode) {
      case 'close':
        {
          const cr = this.closeRect();
          if (!cancel && cr && ui.hit(cr, s.x, s.y)) this.closeScreen();
          break;
        }
      case 'pending':
        if (!cancel) this.tap(s);
        break;
      case 'drag':
      case 'down':
        this.synth('up', s, 0);
        if (s.carry && !cancel) this.dropCarried(s);
        break;
      case 'long':
        this.synth('up', s, 2);
        break;
      // (let go: it flies on at the finger's speed)
      case 'scroll':
        if (ui.screen && ui.screen.scrollRelease) ui.screen.scrollRelease();
        break;
    }
    // no hover highlight left behind on buttons (inventories keep the position for the carried stack)
    if (!(ui.screen instanceof ContainerScreen)) {
      ui.mouse.x = -1000;
      ui.mouse.y = -1000;
    }
  }
  // the carried stack let go: onto the slot under the finger (a click there: put down, stacked on the same, or swapped
  // - the swapped one goes back where the carried came from); let go off the slots or back on its own slot, it goes
  // home (never dropped into the world by a finger slipping off the window)
  dropCarried(s) {
    const ui = this.ui,
      sc = ui.screen;
    if (!(sc instanceof ContainerScreen) || !ui.cursor) return;
    const to = sc.slotAt(s.x, s.y),
      home = s.carry;
    // (no double click made of these: a quick flick put back on its own slot within 300 ms of the pick-up was one, and
    // gathered the stack up again instead of putting it down - #B1)
    const clickAt = atStart => {
      sc.lastClick = null;
      this.synth('down', s, 0, atStart);
      this.synth('up', s, 0, atStart);
    };
    if (to && to !== home && !to.output) {
      clickAt(false);
      if (ui.cursor && !home.output && !home.get()) clickAt(true); // (the swapped stack: into the emptied slot)
    } else if (!home.output && !home.get()) clickAt(true);
    sc.lastClick = null; // (no double click made of these)
  }
  tap(s) {
    const sc = this.ui.screen;
    if (sc instanceof ContainerScreen && this.quickMoveTap(s)) return;
    this.synth('down', s, 0, true);
    this.synth('up', s, 0, true);
    this.focusInput();
  }
  // double tap a slot: the first tap picked the stack up, the second puts it back and shift-clicks it
  quickMoveTap(s) {
    const ui = this.ui,
      sc = ui.screen,
      slot = sc.slotAt(s.x0, s.y0),
      now = performance.now(),
      last = this.lastSlotTap;
    this.lastSlotTap = slot ? {
      slot,
      sc,
      t: now
    } : null;
    if (!slot || !last || last.slot !== slot || last.sc !== sc || now - last.t > 350) return false;
    if (slot.output || !ui.cursor || slot.get() || !sc.canPlace(slot, ui.cursor)) return false;
    if (sc.net) {
      sc.net.click(sc, slot.v, 0, 0);
      sc.net.click(sc, slot.v, 0, 1);
      this.lastSlotTap = null;
      return true;
    } // a server's window: as clicks
    slot.set(ui.cursor);
    ui.cursor = null;
    sc.quickMove(slot);
    sc.changed();
    this.lastSlotTap = null;
    return true;
  }
  closeRect() {
    const g = this.g,
      sc = this.ui.screen;
    if (!sc || g.state !== 'play' || !this.on()) return null;
    // (sc.touchClose: a screen of a mod's own with nothing to close it on a phone - 匠魂's books, 11-13)
    if (!(sc instanceof ContainerScreen || sc.isChat || sc.touchClose || typeof CreditsScreen !== 'undefined' && sc instanceof CreditsScreen)) return null;
    const {
        B
      } = this.metrics(),
      ts = Math.round(B * 0.9); // (larger than the top buttons: players could not find how to close the inventory)
    return {
      x: this.ui.w - 4 - ts,
      y: 4,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
  }
  closeScreen() {
    const ui = this.ui,
      sc = ui.screen;
    if (sc.onEsc) sc.onEsc();else ui.close();
  }

  // ---- playing ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  metrics() {
    const ui = this.ui,
      W = ui.w,
      H = ui.h,
      k = ui.dpr / ui.scale,
      st = this.g.settings;
    let B = Math.round(50 * touchSizeOf(st) * k);
    B = Math.max(12, Math.min(B, Math.floor((W / 2 - 97) / 3.3), Math.floor((W / 2 - 117) / 2.4), Math.floor((H - 40) / 3.6)));
    return {
      B,
      m: Math.max(3, Math.round(B * 0.3)),
      gp: Math.max(1, Math.round(B * 0.06)),
      W,
      H
    };
  }
  layout() {
    const {
        B,
        m,
        gp,
        W,
        H
      } = this.metrics(),
      g = this.g,
      p = g.player,
      th = g.touchHeld,
      st = g.settings;
    const L = {
      B,
      gp,
      x0: m,
      y0: H - m - 3 * B
    };
    L.dpad = {
      x: L.x0,
      y: L.y0,
      w: 3 * B,
      h: 3 * B
    };
    const cell = (r, c) => ({
      x: L.x0 + c * B + gp,
      y: L.y0 + r * B + gp,
      w: B - 2 * gp,
      h: B - 2 * gp
    });
    L.cells = {
      up: cell(0, 1),
      left: cell(1, 0),
      right: cell(1, 2),
      down: cell(2, 1)
    };
    if (th.forward) {
      L.cells.ul = cell(0, 0);
      L.cells.ur = cell(0, 2);
    }
    if (!p.flying) L.cells.sneak = cell(1, 1);
    const jx = W - m - B,
      jy = H - m - 2 * B - gp;
    L.jump = {
      x: jx,
      y: jy,
      w: B,
      h: B
    };
    // (editAll: the layout editor, mobile.js - the buttons that only come now and then are there to be moved and sized
    // too; the fly-down button could not be, and an enlarged jump covered it)
    if (p.flying || this.editAll) L.descend = {
      x: jx,
      y: H - m - B,
      w: B,
      h: B
    };
    if (st.touchSprintBtn !== false && g.mode !== 'spectator') L.sprint = {
      x: jx - B - gp,
      y: H - m - B,
      w: B,
      h: B
    };
    const te = g.targetEntity;
    if (g.mode !== 'spectator' && (te && !(te.T && te.T.hostile) || this.editAll)) {
      L.interactText = te && typeof Villager !== 'undefined' && te instanceof Villager ? '交易' : '互动';
      const iw = Math.max(B, Font.width(L.interactText) + 12),
        ih = Math.round(B * 0.6);
      L.interact = {
        x: W - m - iw,
        y: jy - ih - 2 * gp,
        w: iw,
        h: ih
      };
    }
    const ts = Math.round(B * 0.7);
    L.pause = {
      x: W - 4 - ts,
      y: 4,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
    L.chat = {
      x: W - 4 - 2 * ts - gp,
      y: 4,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
    L.view = {
      x: W - 4 - 3 * ts - 2 * gp,
      y: 4,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
    if (g.mode !== 'spectator') {
      const hx = Math.floor(W / 2 - 91),
        hy = H - 22;
      L.hotbar = {
        x: hx,
        y: hy,
        w: 182,
        h: 22
      };
      L.inv = {
        x: hx + 184,
        y: hy,
        w: 20,
        h: 22
      };
    }
    L.chatLift = Math.max(0, m + 3 * B - 38);
    return this.L = L;
  }
  hitL(r, x, y, pad = this.L.gp) {
    return !!r && x >= r.x - pad && y >= r.y - pad && x < r.x + r.w + pad && y < r.y + r.h + pad;
  }
  dpadCell(x, y, start) {
    const L = this.L,
      B = L.dB || L.B,
      pad = start ? 0 : B * 0.75; // (dB: the D-pad's own cell size, resized - mobile.js)
    if (x < L.x0 - pad || y < L.y0 - pad || x >= L.x0 + 3 * B + pad || y >= L.y0 + 3 * B + pad) return null;
    const c = clamp(Math.floor((x - L.x0) / B), 0, 2),
      r = clamp(Math.floor((y - L.y0) / B), 0, 2);
    const id = [['ul', 'up', 'ur'], ['left', 'sneak', 'right'], [null, 'down', null]][r][c];
    if (id === 'sneak') return start && L.cells.sneak ? 'sneak' : null;
    if ((id === 'ul' || id === 'ur') && start) return null; // the diagonals only appear while moving forward
    return id;
  }
  setDir(c) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld,
      f = c === 'up' || c === 'ul' || c === 'ur',
      was = !!th.forward;
    th.forward = f;
    th.back = c === 'down';
    th.left = c === 'left' || c === 'ul';
    th.right = c === 'right' || c === 'ur';
    if (f && !was) pressAction(g, 'forward'); // double tap forward sprints, like the keyboard
    if (!f && was) {
      releaseAction(g, 'forward');
      th.sprint = false;
    }
  }
  hotbarAt(s) {
    const L = this.L,
      p = this.g.player;
    const i = clamp(Math.floor((s.x - L.hotbar.x - 1) / 20), 0, 8);
    if (i !== s.slot) {
      s.slot = i;
      s.t0 = performance.now();
      s.dropped = false;
      p.inv.sel = i;
    }
  }
  startPlay(s) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld,
      L = this.layout(),
      x = s.x,
      y = s.y;
    s.kind = 'look';
    for (const id of ['pause', 'chat', 'view', 'inv', 'interact']) if (this.hitL(L[id], x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'button';
      s.btn = id;
      return;
    }
    if (L.hotbar && this.hitL(L.hotbar, x, y, 0)) {
      s.kind = 'hotbar';
      this.hotbarAt(s);
      return;
    }
    if (this.hitL(L.jump, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'jump';
      th.jump = true;
      pressAction(g, 'jump');
      return;
    }
    if (L.descend && this.hitL(L.descend, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'descend';
      th.down = true;
      return;
    }
    if (L.sprint && this.hitL(L.sprint, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'none';
      th.sprint = !th.sprint;
      return;
    }
    const c = this.dpadCell(x, y, true);
    if (c === 'sneak') {
      s.kind = 'none';
      th.sneak = !th.sneak;
      return;
    }
    if (c) {
      s.kind = 'dpad';
      s.cell = c;
      this.setDir(c);
    }
  }
  movePlay(s, dx, dy) {
    const g = this.g,
      p = g.player,
      st = g.settings;
    if (s.kind === 'look') {
      // radians per CSS pixel (touchLook: 1 = the old default, a swipe across a phone about 180°)
      const k = 0.0045 * touchLook(st);
      p.yaw -= dx * k * (st.invertX ? -1 : 1);
      p.pitch = clamp(p.pitch - dy * k * (st.invertY ? -1 : 1), -Math.PI / 2 + 0.001, Math.PI / 2 - 0.001);
    } else if (s.kind === 'dpad') {
      const c = this.dpadCell(s.x, s.y, false);
      if (c !== s.cell) {
        s.cell = c;
        this.setDir(c);
      }
    } else if (s.kind === 'hotbar' && this.hitL(this.L.hotbar, s.x, s.y, 4)) this.hotbarAt(s);
  }
  endPlay(s, cancel) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld;
    switch (s.kind) {
      case 'look':
        if (s.holding) g.mouseBtn[s.holdBtn] = false;else if (!s.moved && !cancel && performance.now() - s.t0 < 350) this.click(g.targetEntity ? 0 : 2);
        break;
