<script>
/* ==== js/net.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Playing on a vanilla Java server through the proxy (multiplayer/proxy, a WebSocket <-> Java protocol bridge).
// The server's terrain, block changes and light, the other players and the mobs (with what they hold), dropped
// items, day time, rain and chat. This player walks, flies, digs, places, attacks and uses items: each action is
// shown at once and sent to the server, whose answer (block changes, inventory, health) always wins.
// While connected the world is "remote": nothing is generated, ticked or saved here.
// Inventory numbering: the server's player window has 0 result, 1-4 crafting, 5-8 armour, 9-35 main, 36-44 hotbar,
// 45 offhand; this game's inventory 0-8 hotbar, 9-35 main, 36-39 armour (helmet first).
// Windows (the inventory, chests, furnaces, crafting tables, villagers ...): the server's. A click is worked out
// here at once, like vanilla's client does, and sent with the slots it changed; the server checks it and sends
// back whatever came out differently.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// vanilla entity types this game can draw
const NET_MOBS = new Set(['pig', 'cow', 'sheep', 'chicken', 'zombie', 'skeleton', 'creeper', 'spider', 'enderman', 'blaze', 'ghast', 'zombified_piglin', 'magma_cube', 'villager', 'zombie_villager', 'iron_golem', 'cat', 'piglin', 'hoglin', 'strider']);
const NET_PLAYER_T = {
  cn: '玩家',
  hp: 20,
  w: 0.6,
  h: 1.8,
  speed: 0,
  model: 'steve',
  tex: 'steve',
  scale: 0.9375,
  drops: []
};
const R2D = 180 / Math.PI;
const angDiff = (a, b) => {
  let d = a - b;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
};
// vanilla yaw (degrees, 0 = facing +Z) <-> this game's (radians, 0 = facing -Z); vanilla pitch is positive looking down
const toYaw = deg => Math.PI - deg / R2D,
  fromYaw = rad => 180 - rad * R2D;
// this game's face order (-x +x -y +y -z +z) -> vanilla's Direction (down up north south west east)
const NET_FACE = [4, 5, 0, 1, 2, 3];
const oursToWin = i => i === 40 ? 45 : i < 9 ? 36 + i : i < 36 ? i : 5 + i - 36; // 40: the offhand (window slot 45)
// the render distance told to the server (vanilla's options range; the proxy keeps it within the server's)
const netRd = g => clamp(Math.round(+(g.settings && g.settings.renderDist) || 10), 2, 32);
// set_player_inventory numbering: 0-8 hotbar, 9-35 main, 36-39 armour from the feet up
const pinvToOurs = s => s < 36 ? s : s <= 39 ? 36 + 39 - s : -1;
// two stacks of the same item that may merge (same components; unknown items by their name)
const sameItem = (a, b) => a.id === b.id && (a.x || '') === (b.x || '') && (a.unk || '') === (b.unk || '');
const sameStack = (a, b) => !a && !b || !!a && !!b && sameItem(a, b) && a.count === b.count && (a.dmg || 0) === (b.dmg || 0);
// a stack as the proxy takes it: the item's name, the count, the components' signature
// a stack as the proxy takes it: the item's name, the count, the components' signature (the server's own stack);
// a stack made here (the creative inventory) carries its data so the proxy can build the components
const netStack = s => {
  if (!s) return null;
  const o = {
    n: s.unk || ITEMS[s.id].key,
    c: s.count,
    x: s.x
  };
  if (!s.x) {
    if (s.dmg) o.d = s.dmg;
    if (s.name) o.name = s.name;
    if (s.e && s.e.length) o.e = s.e;
    if (s.pot) o.pot = s.pot;
    if (s.color != null) o.color = s.color;
    if (s.pv) o.pv = s.pv;
    if (s.instrument) o.ins = s.instrument;
    if (s.patterns) o.pat = s.patterns;
    if (s.base) o.base = s.base;
    if (s.flight) {
      o.flight = s.flight;
      o.ex = s.explosions || [];
    }
    if (s.fw) o.fw = s.fw;
  }
  return o;
};

// another player: the player model, moved by the server
class NetPlayer extends Mob {
  constructor(game, x, y, z, name) {
    super(game, 'zombie', x, y, z);
    this.type = 'player';
    this.T = NET_PLAYER_T;
    this.w = 0.6;
    this.h = 1.8;
    this.name = name || '?';
  }
  pose(a) {
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    const l = Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt,
      r = -l;
    const t = this.swingT > 0 ? clamp((6 - this.swingT + a) / 6, 0, 1) : 0,
      sw = Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
    const off = this.swingHand === 'off'; // (the off hand's swing: animation 3)
    const P = {
      head: {
        ry: this.headYaw,
        rx: this.pitch
      },
      rarm: {
        rx: r * 0.7 + (off ? 0 : sw * 1.5)
      },
      larm: {
        rx: l * 0.7 + (off ? sw * 1.5 : 0)
      },
      rleg: {
        rx: l
      },
      lleg: {
        rx: r
      }
    };
    if (this.sneaking) {
      P.body = {
        rx: -0.5,
        t: [0, -1.73 / 16, 5.75 / 16]
      };
      P.head.t = [0, -4.2 / 16, 0];
    }
    if (this.vehicleRef) {
      P.rleg = {
        rx: 1.4137167,
        ry: -0.31415927
      };
      P.lleg = {
        rx: 1.4137167,
        ry: 0.31415927
      };
    } // sitting in a boat or minecart
    else if (this.netSwim) return swimLimbs(P, lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a), this.swimming);
    return P;
  }
  // the server's swimming / crawling pose: eased in and out like the local player's (0.09 a tick); lying along the
  // view only in water (vanilla setupRotations)
  swimTick() {
    this.prevSwimAmt = this.swimAmt || 0;
    this.swimAmt = clamp(this.prevSwimAmt + (this.netSwim ? 0.09 : -0.09), 0, 1);
    this.swimming = !!this.netSwim && this.world.waterAt(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 0.3), Math.floor(this.pos[2]));
  }
}
// what a server-driven entity does each tick: glide to where the server put it (vanilla spreads a move over 3
// ticks), turn toward its rotation, animate its legs from the movement
// the dragon on a server: its wing beats (faster the slower it flies, slow while sitting), the trail of places the
// neck and tail follow, and the nearest crystal beaming at it - like vanilla's client works them out itself
EnderDragon.prototype.netAnimTick = function () {
  this.prevFlap = this.flap;
  this.hist.unshift([this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], this.yaw]);
  if (this.hist.length > 64) this.hist.length = 64;
  this.vel = [this.pos[0] - this.prev[0], this.pos[1] - this.prev[1], this.pos[2] - this.prev[2]];
  if (this.deathTime > 0) {
    this.flap += 0.02;
    return;
  }
  this.flap += this.flapSpeed();
  if (Math.floor(this.flap) !== Math.floor(this.prevFlap)) Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.flap', this.pos, 5, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.3);
  if (this.age % 10 === 0) {
    this.healer = null;
    let bd = 32;
    for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof EndCrystal && !e.dead) {
      const d = e.distTo(this);
      if (d < bd) {
        bd = d;
        this.healer = e;
      }
    }
  }
};
// a dropped item: glides like the rest, spins and bobs (drawEntities uses its age)
function netVehicleTick() {
  const p = this.game.player;
  if (this instanceof Boat && this.rider === p) {
    Boat.prototype.tick.call(this);
    return;
  }
  this.savePrev();
  this.age++;
  if (this.lerpN > 0) {
    const k = 1 / this.lerpN;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += (this.netPos[i] - this.pos[i]) * k;
    this.lerpN--;
  }
  if (this.netYaw !== undefined) this.yaw += angDiff(this.netYaw + (this.netYawOff || 0), this.yaw) * 0.5;
  if (this.hurtT > 0) this.hurtT--;
  // (Boat.tick sets this for a boat steered here only: a sunk one would still draw its water patch)
  if (this instanceof Boat) {
    const ws = this.waterState();
    this.status = ws.under ? 'under' : ws.top !== null ? 'water' : 'air';
  }
  if (this.rider) {
    if (this.rider === p) p.followVehicle(this);else {
      const s = this.seat();
      this.rider.pos = s;
      this.rider.netPos = s.slice();
      this.rider.lerpN = 0;
    }
  }
}
function netItemTick() {
  this.savePrev();
  this.age++;
  if (this.lerpN > 0) {
    const k = 1 / this.lerpN;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += (this.netPos[i] - this.pos[i]) * k;
    this.lerpN--;
  }
}
function netEntityTick() {
  var _this$netHead;
  this.savePrev();
  this.age++;
  if (this.lerpN > 0) {
    const k = 1 / this.lerpN;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += (this.netPos[i] - this.pos[i]) * k;
    this.lerpN--;
  }
  this.yaw += angDiff(this.netYaw, this.yaw) * 0.5;
  const head = (_this$netHead = this.netHead) !== null && _this$netHead !== void 0 ? _this$netHead : this.netYaw;
  // the body follows the head once it turns too far, or while moving (vanilla's body rotation, simplified)
  const moving = Math.hypot(this.pos[0] - this.prev[0], this.pos[2] - this.prev[2]) > 0.01;
  const v = this.vehicleRef && this.vehicleRef.rider === this && this.vehicleRef.bodyYaw !== undefined ? this.vehicleRef : null;
  if (v) this.bodyYaw = v.bodyYaw; // a passenger faces the way its mount (a mob) does
  else if (moving || Math.abs(angDiff(head, this.bodyYaw)) > 0.9) this.bodyYaw += angDiff(moving ? this.yaw : head, this.bodyYaw) * 0.3;
  this.headYaw = clamp(angDiff(head, this.bodyYaw), -1.3, 1.3);
  this.pitch = this.netPitch || 0;
  if (this.swimTick) this.swimTick();
  this.animate();
  // what the drawing asks that the mob's own tick would have worked out: in water (fish swim instead of flopping,
  // squids, dolphins ...), and per kind (the dragon's wing beats and neck / tail trail)
  if (!(this instanceof EnderDragon)) this.updateFluids();
  if (this.netAnimTick) this.netAnimTick();
  if (this.hurtTime > 0) this.hurtTime--;
  if (this.swingT > 0) this.swingT--;
  if (this.deathTime > 0 && ++this.deathTime > 20) this.dead = true;
}
class NetClient {
  constructor(game, url, name, opts = {}) {
    this.g = game;
    this.url = url;
    this.name = name;
    this.opts = opts;
    this.room = null;
    this.stateMap = null;
    this.bookStates = new Set();
    this.lecternBooks = new Set();
    this.biomes = [];
    this.minY = -64;
    this.ents = new Map();
    this.players = new Map();
    this.unknown = new Map();
    this.missing = new Map();
    this.stats = {
      chunks: 0,
      msgs: 0
    };
    this.inv = new Array(40).fill(null);
    this.w0x = new Array(5).fill(null);
    this.off = null;
    this.win = null;
    this.sentSel = -1;
    this.unknownItems = new Set();
    this.eid = 0;
    this.pendingItems = new Map();
    const ws = this.ws = new WebSocket(url);
    ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
    // (rd: this player's render distance - the proxy asks the server for no more chunks than that, like vanilla's client
    // information; it asked for 10 whatever the client's: a phone at 6 got 473 chunks out to 11 rings, 26 MB in 20 s on
    // the local test server, now 265 and 16 MB, 11-03)
    ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({
      t: 'hello',
      name,
      version: 1,
      proto: 1,
      room: opts.room,
      key: opts.key,
      token: opts.room && typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.token || undefined,
      rd: netRd(game)
    }));
    ws.onmessage = e => {
      this.stats.msgs++;
      try {
        if (typeof e.data === 'string') this.onMessage(JSON.parse(e.data));else this.onBinary(e.data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('net', err);
      }
    };
    ws.onerror = () => {
      if (!this.closed) this.fail(opts.room ? '游戏正在更新中…请稍后' : '无法连接到联机中转 ' + url + '（中转程序没有启动？）');
    };
    ws.onclose = () => {
      if (!this.closed) this.fail('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
    };
  }
  send(o) {
    if (this.ws.readyState === 1) this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(o));
  }
  // the render distance for the server (session.js writes it as the client information): when it changed, a second
  // after the last change - a slider dragged, or 自动画质 stepping it, is one message
  sendSettings() {
    const rd = netRd(this.g);
    if (rd === this.sentRd) return;
    this.sentRd = rd;
    this.send({
      t: 'settings',
      rd
    });
  }
  settingsSoon() {
    clearTimeout(this.rdTimer);
    this.rdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!this.closed && this.g.net === this) this.sendSettings();
    }, 1000);
  }
  close() {
    this.closed = true;
    clearTimeout(this.rdTimer);
    try {
      this.ws.close();
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  fail(reason) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    const g = this.g;
    g.leaveServer();
    g.ui.open(new ConfirmScreen(g, reason === '游戏正在更新中…请稍后' ? '游戏正在更新中' : '连接已断开', reason === '游戏正在更新中…请稍后' ? '请稍后再试' : reason, '返回标题画面', () => g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g))));
  }

  // ---- JSON messages ----
  onMessage(m) {
    var _m$rate;
    const g = this.g,
      w = g.world,
      p = g.player;
    switch (m.t) {
      case 'states':
        {
          // the server's block state ids -> this game's blocks (id << 8 | meta); blocks it lacks get the closest one
          // (mapVanillaStateNear), or air
          const map = this.stateMap = new Uint32Array(m.list.length);
          this.subst = new Set();
          this.bookStates = new Set();
          const wls = this.wlStates = new Uint8Array(m.list.length); // waterlogged=true states of blocks that hold water here
          m.list.forEach((s, i) => {
            if (/lectern\[[^\]]*has_book=true/.test(s)) this.bookStates.add(i); // (this game's lectern keeps only its facing)
            let r = null;
            try {
              r = mapVanillaStateNear(s);
            } catch (e) {}
            const n = s.split('[')[0];
            if (!r) {
              this.missing.set(n, (this.missing.get(n) || 0) + 1);
              r = [0, 0];
            } else if (r[2]) this.subst.add(n);
            if (s.includes('waterlogged=true')) {
              if (!r[0]) r = [WATER, 0];else if (canWaterlog(r[0], r[1])) wls[i] = 1;
            }
            map[i] = r[0] << 8 | r[1];
          });
          break;
        }
      case 'biomes':
        this.biomes = m.list.map(n => Math.max(VB_BASE, vbiomeIndex(n)));
        break;
      // (the render distance again once in the game: the room service passes on a hello of its own, without it)
      case 'login':
        this.eid = m.eid;
        this.enterWorld(m, true);
        this.sentRd = null;
        this.sendSettings();
        break;
      case 'respawn':
        this.enterWorld(m, false);
        break;
      case 'pos':
        {
          const r = m.rel || {};
          p.pos[0] = r.x ? p.pos[0] + m.x : m.x;
          p.pos[1] = r.y ? p.pos[1] + m.y : m.y - this.minY;
          p.pos[2] = r.z ? p.pos[2] + m.z : m.z;
          p.yaw = r.yaw ? p.yaw - m.yaw / R2D : toYaw(m.yaw);
          p.pitch = r.pitch ? p.pitch - m.pitch / R2D : -m.pitch / R2D;
          p.prev = [...p.pos];
          p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
          p.fallDist = 0;
          this.send({
            t: 'tpok',
            id: m.id
          });
          this.posDue = true; // (vanilla answers a teleport with its position at once, its chunk there or not)
          break;
        }
      case 'abilities':
        p.flying = !!(m.flags & 2);
        p.canFly = !!(m.flags & 4);
        break;
      case 'mode':
        g.setMode(m.mode === 'adventure' ? 'survival' : m.mode, true);
        break;
      case 'time':
        g.worldTime = m.day;
        g.timeRate = (_m$rate = m.rate) !== null && _m$rate !== void 0 ? _m$rate : 1;
        if (w) w.time = m.day;
        break;
      case 'rain':
        if (m.on !== undefined) g.rainTarget = m.on ? 1 : 0;
        if (m.level !== undefined) {
          g.rainTarget = m.level;
          g.weather = m.level;
        }
        break;
      // (a message of several lines - a command's error and where it is - is several chat lines, in its colour)
      case 'chat':
        if (m.bar) g.ui.actionBar = {
          text: m.text,
          t: performance.now(),
          color: m.color
        };else for (const l of String(m.text).split('\n')) g.ui.message(l, m.color);
        break;
      case 'unload':
        this.unload(m.cx, m.cz);
        break;
      // sign texts (blockents.js draws them)
      case 'signs':
        for (const [x, y, z, t] of m.list) g.signs.set(x + ',' + (y - this.minY) + ',' + z, t);
        break;
      case 'block':
        this.setBlock(m.x, m.y, m.z, m.s);
        break;
      case 'blocks':
        for (let i = 0; i < m.list.length; i += 4) this.setBlock(m.list[i], m.list[i + 1], m.list[i + 2], m.list[i + 3]);
        break;
      case 'players':
        this.players = new Map(m.list.map(o => [o.uuid, o.name]));
        break;
      case 'spawn':
        this.spawn(m);
        break;
      case 'move':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id) || this.pendingItems.get(m.id);
          if (!e) break;
          if (m.x !== undefined) {
            e.netPos = [m.x, m.y - this.minY, m.z];
            e.lerpN = m.tp ? 1 : 3;
          }
          if (m.yaw !== undefined) {
            e.netYaw = toYaw(m.yaw);
            e.netPitch = -m.pitch / R2D;
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'head':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e) e.netHead = toYaw(m.yaw);
          break;
        }
      case 'pass':
        {
          const v = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (!v || !(v.isVehicle || v.seat)) break;
          const riders = m.list.map(id => id === this.eid ? p : this.ents.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
          if (v.rider && !riders.includes(v.rider)) {
            if (v.rider === p) {
              p.vehicle = null;
              p.rideInput = null;
            } else v.rider.vehicleRef = null;
            v.rider = null;
          }
          const r = riders[0];
          if (r === p) {
            if (p.vehicle !== v) {
              p.vehicle = v;
              v.rider = p;
              p.followVehicle(v);
              p.savePrev();
            }
          } else if (r) {
            v.rider = r;
            r.vehicleRef = v;
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'vmove':
        {
          const v = p.vehicle;
          if (v) {
            v.pos = [m.x, m.y - this.minY, m.z];
            v.yaw = toYaw(m.yaw);
            v.vel = [0, 0, 0];
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'remove':
        for (const id of m.ids) {
          const e = this.ents.get(id);
          if (e) {
            e.dead = true;
            this.ents.delete(id);
          }
          this.pendingItems.delete(id);
        }
        break;
      case 'anim':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e && (m.a === 0 || m.a === 3)) {
            e.swingT = 6;
            e.swingHand = m.a === 3 ? 'off' : 'main';
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'hurt':
        {
          if (m.id === this.eid) {
            p.hurtTime = 10;
            Sound.ev('entity.player.hurt', p.pos, 1, 1);
            break;
          }
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e) e.hurtTime = 10;
          break;
        }
      // ---- this player ----
      // ---- windows (see "windows" below) ----
      case 'open':
        {
          // a new window replaces whatever was open (the server has closed that one)
          const sc = g.ui.screen;
          if (sc && sc.net === this) sc.serverClosed = true;
          this.win = {
            id: m.id,
            kind: m.kind,
            title: m.title,
            slots: [],
            props: [],
            trades: null
          };
          break;
        }
      case 'win':
        {
          const id = m.id,
            w = this.win,
            mine = !!w && w.id === id;
          if (id !== 0 && !mine) break;
          if (mine && w.n === undefined) w.n = w.kind === 'lectern' ? m.items.length : w.kind === 'crafter_3x3' ? 9 : Math.max(0, m.items.length - 36);
          m.items.forEach((o, v) => this.slotSet(id, v, this.stackIn(o)));
          if (this.screenFor(id)) g.ui.cursor = this.stackIn(m.carried);
          this.applyInv();
          if (mine && !w.screen) this.openWindow(w); // the contents follow the opening: now it can be shown
          break;
        }
      case 'wslot':
        if (m.id === 0 || this.win && this.win.id === m.id) {
          this.slotSet(m.id, m.i, this.stackIn(m.item));
          this.applyInv();
        }
        break;
      case 'cursor':
        if (g.ui.screen && g.ui.screen.net === this) g.ui.cursor = this.stackIn(m.item);
        break;
      case 'wclose':
        {
          const sc = this.screenFor(m.id);
          if (sc) {
            sc.serverClosed = true;
            g.ui.close();
          }
          if (this.win && this.win.id === m.id) this.win = null;
          break;
        }
      case 'prop':
        if (this.win && this.win.id === m.id) {
          this.win.props[m.k] = m.v;
          if (m.name !== undefined) (this.win.pnames || (this.win.pnames = {}))[m.k] = m.name;
        }
        break;
      case 'trades':
        if (this.win && this.win.id === m.id) Object.assign(this.win, {
          trades: m.list,
          level: m.level,
          xp: m.xp,
          regular: m.regular,
          offers: null
        });
        break;
      case 'pinv':
        {
          const s = this.stackIn(m.item);
          if (m.i === 40) this.off = s;else {
            const i = pinvToOurs(m.i);
            if (i >= 0) this.inv[i] = s;
          }
          this.applyInv();
          break;
        }
      case 'held':
        p.inv.sel = this.sentSel = m.slot;
        break;
      // status effects: the server's (effects.js counts them down and applies what moving and seeing need)
      case 'effect':
        if (m.e) {
          (p.effects || (p.effects = new Map())).set(m.e, {
            amp: m.amp,
            dur: m.dur,
            ambient: !!(m.f & 1),
            hidden: !(m.f & 4),
            max: m.dur
          });
        }
        break;
      case 'uneffect':
        if (p.effects) p.effects.delete(m.e);
        break;
      case 'health':
        p.health = m.hp;
        p.food = m.food;
        p.saturation = m.sat;
        if (m.hp <= 0 && p.deathTime === 0) {
          p.deathTime = 1;
          g.deathMsg = this.deathMsg || '你死了';
          p.usingItem = null;
          // joined while dead: the server sends no world until the respawn, so the death screen comes at once
          if (g.state === 'loading') {
            g.state = 'play';
            g.ui.open(new DeathScreen(g));
          } else setTimeout(() => {
            if (g.net === this && g.state === 'play') g.ui.open(new DeathScreen(g));
          }, 1000);
        } else if (m.hp > 0 && p.deathTime > 0) {
          p.deathTime = 0;
          if (g.ui.screen instanceof DeathScreen) g.ui.close();
        }
        break;
      // the level and the bar (the total isn't kept up by vanilla's "xp add ... levels")
      case 'xp':
        p.xp = g.xpTotalFor(m.level) + Math.round(m.bar * g.xpNeeded(m.level));
        break;
      case 'death':
        this.deathMsg = m.msg;
        g.ui.message(m.msg);
        break;
      // ---- what entities hold and look like ----
      // (only the slots that changed come: no main hand in it leaves what it holds alone)
      case 'equip':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e && m.item !== undefined) {
            const s = this.stackIn(m.item);
            e.heldId = s && !s.unk ? s.id : null;
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'meta':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id) || this.pendingItems.get(m.id);
          if (!e) break;
          if (m.pose !== undefined) {
            e.sneaking = m.pose === 'crouching' || m.pose === 5;
            e.netSwim = m.pose === 'swimming' || m.pose === 3;
          }
          if (m.item !== undefined && e instanceof ItemEntity) {
            const s = this.stackIn(m.item);
            if (s && !s.unk) {
              e.stack = s;
              if (this.pendingItems.delete(m.id)) {
                g.entities.push(e);
                this.ents.set(m.id, e);
              }
            }
          } else if (m.item && e.netPotion) {
            const s = this.stackIn(m.item);
            if (s) e.netPot = s.pot;
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'collect':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e) {
            e.dead = true;
            this.ents.delete(m.id);
            if (m.by === this.eid) Sound.pop && Sound.pop(p.pos);
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'status':
        {
          const e = this.ents.get(m.id);
          if (e && m.s === 3) e.deathTime = 1;
          break;
        }
      case 'kick':
        this.fail(m.reason || '被服务器断开');
        break;
      // the admin panel changed a live setting (js/live.js): read them again now
      case 'live':
        if (typeof Live !== 'undefined') Live.fetch(m.v);
        break;
      // the room service: waiting for the room's server, then which room this is
      case 'notice':
        if (g.ui.screen instanceof LoadingScreen) {
          g.ui.screen.text = m.text;
          g.ui.screen.setQueue(null);
        } else g.ui.message(m.text, '#AAAAAA');
        break;
      // the server's rooms are full: this room waits its turn (rooms.js queue)
      case 'queue':
        if (g.ui.screen instanceof LoadingScreen) g.ui.screen.setQueue(m);
        break;
      case 'room':
        this.room = m;
        g.ui.message('已进入房间「' + m.name + '」，邀请码 ' + m.code + '（暂停菜单 → 房间：邀请朋友、看玩家' + (m.isOwner ? '、管理' : '、举报') + '）', '#FFFF55');
        // the sponsor line (its text and how long it stays put come from the room service's config)
        if (m.sponsorText) {
          const q = {
            text: String(m.sponsorText).slice(0, 80),
            ms: clamp(+m.sponsorSeconds || 30, 0, 300) * 1000
          };
          if (g.state === 'play') g.ui.pinMessage(q.text, q.ms);else g.pendingPin = q;
        }
        break;
      case 'error':
        console.warn('proxy:', m.msg);
        break;
    }
  }
  // a new dimension (or the first): a fresh remote world
  enterWorld(m, first) {
    const g = this.g;
    if (g.world) g.unloadAll();
    setWorldFormat(2);
    if (!NetClient.biomesReady) {
      initVanillaBiomes(g.renderer.grassMap, g.renderer.foliageMap);
      NetClient.biomesReady = true;
    }
    const dim = m.dim;
    const w = new World(0, dim);
    w.gen2 = true;
    w.remote = true;
    w.minY = m.minY;
    w.seedStr = '0';
    w.structures = false;
    w.grassMap = g.renderer.grassMap;
    w.foliageMap = g.renderer.foliageMap;
    w.listener = g;
    w.useCW = !!(g.chunkWorker && g.chunkWorker.ready && !g.chunkWorker.failed);
    this.minY = m.minY;
    g.world = w;
    g.dim = dim;
    g.dimData = null;
    g.entities = [];
    g.blockEntities = new Map();
    g.signs = new Map();
    g.particles.list = [];
    g.genQueue = [];
    g.meshQueue = [];
    g.genEpoch = (g.genEpoch || 0) + 1;
    g._lastCC = null;
    g.meshResQ = [];
    this.ents.clear();
    if (first) {
      const p = g.player = new Player(g, 0.5, 100, 0.5);
      p.hurt = () => false; // health is the server's (stage 3)
      g.worldMeta = null;
      g.hardcore = false;
      g.difficulty = 2;
      g.cheats = false;
      g.tutorial = -1;
      g.tutStat = {
        moved: 0
      };
      g.adv = {};
      g.stats = {
        kills: 0,
        placed: 0,
        mined: 0
      };
      g.welcome = false;
      g.iconAt = 0;
      g.sleeping = null;
      g.portalOverlay = 0;
    } else g.player.world = w;
    g.mode = m.mode === 'adventure' ? 'survival' : m.mode || 'survival';
    g.state = 'loading';
    g.loadStart = performance.now();
    if (g.ui.screen && g.ui.screen.net === this) g.ui.screen.serverClosed = true; // the server closes windows itself
    this.win = null;
    g.ui.open(new LoadingScreen(g, first ? '正在加入服务器…' : '正在进入' + (DIM_CN[dim] || dim) + '…'));
  }

  // ---- blocks ----
  setBlock(x, y, z, s) {
    const w = this.g.world;
    if (!w) return;
    const v = this.stateMap[s] || 0,
      yy = y - this.minY;
    // the cell's water comes with the server's state (taken off first: world.setBlock would leave it as water)
    const ch = w.getChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4),
      i = yy << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15,
      old = ch ? ch.getB(i) : 0,
      was = !!(ch && ch.wl && ch.wl.delete(i));
    w.setBlock(x, yy, z, v >> 8, v & 255, 0);
    if (ch && this.wlStates[s]) (ch.wl || (ch.wl = new Set())).add(i);
    if (ch && was !== !!this.wlStates[s]) w.markBlock(ch, x & 15, yy, z & 15);
    // (a sea pickle's light comes with its water, set after world.setBlock looked)
    if (ch && (was || this.wlStates[s]) && (WET_EMIT[old] || WET_EMIT[v >> 8])) w.relight(x, yy, z);
    const k = x + ',' + yy + ',' + z;
    if (this.bookStates.has(s)) this.lecternBooks.add(k);else this.lecternBooks.delete(k);
  }
  unload(cx, cz) {
    const g = this.g,
      w = g.world,
      k = ckey(cx, cz);
    if (!w || !w.chunks.has(k)) return;
    g.renderer.dropChunk(cx, cz);
    w.chunks.delete(k);
    for (const sk of g.signs.keys()) {
      const [x,, z] = sk.split(',');
      if (x >> 4 === cx && z >> 4 === cz) g.signs.delete(sk);
    }
    this.dropBooks(cx, cz);
    if (g.meshVer) for (let sy = 0; sy < SECTIONS; sy++) g.meshVer.delete(k * 32 + sy);
  }
  // forgets the books on a chunk's lecterns (it is unloaded, or sent again)
  dropBooks(cx, cz) {
    for (const k of this.lecternBooks) {
      const [x,, z] = k.split(',');
      if (x >> 4 === cx && z >> 4 === cz) this.lecternBooks.delete(k);
    }
  }
  // ---- binary: chunks (type 1) and light updates (type 2), layout in multiplayer/proxy/src/chunk.js ----
  onBinary(buf) {
    const g = this.g,
      w = g.world;
    if (!w || !this.stateMap) return;
    const dv = new DataView(buf),
      u8 = new Uint8Array(buf);
    let p = 0;
    const type = dv.getUint8(p),
      cx = dv.getInt32(p + 1, true),
      cz = dv.getInt32(p + 5, true),
      n = dv.getUint8(p + 9);
    p += 10;
    const k = ckey(cx, cz);
    let ch = w.chunks.get(k);
    if (type === 1) {
      ch = new Chunk(cx, cz);
      this.stats.chunks++;
    } else if (!ch) return;
    const L = new Uint8Array(4096),
      map = this.stateMap,
      bs = this.bookStates,
      wls = this.wlStates;
    let topSky = -1;
    const noSky = [];
    if (type === 1) this.dropBooks(cx, cz);
    for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) {
      const len = dv.getUint16(p, true);
      p += 2;
      const pal = new Array(len);
      let books = null,
        wet = null; // palette entries that are lecterns with a book / waterlogged
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++, p += 2) {
        const raw = dv.getUint16(p, true);
        pal[i] = map[raw] || 0;
        if (bs.size && bs.has(raw)) (books || (books = new Set())).add(i);
        if (wls && wls[raw]) (wet || (wet = new Set())).add(i);
      }
      let idx = null;
      if (len > 1) {
        if (len <= 256) {
          idx = u8.subarray(p, p + 4096);
          p += 4096;
        } else {
          idx = new Uint16Array(buf.slice(p, p + 8192));
          p += 8192;
        }
      }
      if (wet && type === 1 && s < SECTIONS) for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) if (wet.has(idx ? idx[j] : 0)) (ch.wl || (ch.wl = new Set())).add(s << 12 | j);
      if (books && type === 1 && s < SECTIONS) for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) if (books.has(idx ? idx[j] : 0)) this.lecternBooks.add(cx * 16 + (j & 15) + ',' + (s * 16 + (j >> 8)) + ',' + (cz * 16 + (j >> 4 & 15)));
      if (type === 1 && s < SECTIONS) this.putSection(ch, s, pal, idx);
      const f = u8[p++],
        sky = f & 1 ? u8.subarray(p, p + 2048) : null;
      if (sky) p += 2048;
      const bl = f & 2 ? u8.subarray(p, p + 2048) : null;
      if (bl) p += 2048;
      if (type === 1 && s < SECTIONS) {
        if (sky) topSky = s;else noSky.push(s);
      }
      if (s >= SECTIONS || !sky && !bl && type === 2) continue;
      // light: sky << 4 | block, a nibble array each; a half that isn't sent keeps its value (updates) or is 0
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const sh = (j & 1) << 2,
          old = type === 2 ? ch.getL(s << 12 | j) : 0;
        L[j] = (sky ? sky[j >> 1] >> sh & 15 : old >> 4) << 4 | (bl ? bl[j >> 1] >> sh & 15 : old & 15);
      }
      const v = L[0];
      let uni = true;
      for (let j = 1; j < 4096; j++) if (L[j] !== v) {
        uni = false;
        break;
      }
      if (uni) {
        ch.ls[s] = null;
        ch.lu[s] = v;
      } else ch.ls[s] = L.slice();
      if (type === 2) this.markSection(cx, cz, s);
    }
    if (type !== 1) return;
    // vanilla sends no sky light for the air above the highest lit section: there it is full daylight
    for (const s of noSky) if (s > topSky) {
      if (ch.ls[s]) {
        const a = ch.ls[s];
        for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) a[j] |= 0xF0;
      } else ch.lu[s] = 0xF0 | ch.lu[s] & 15;
    }
    for (let c = 0; c < 256; c++) ch.biome[c] = this.biomes[u8[p + c]] || VB_BASE;
    ch.lit = true;
    ch.final = true;
    ch.recount();
    w.chunks.set(k, ch);
    g.chunkTints(ch);
    ch.dirty = ALL_SECTIONS;
    for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) {
      const nb = w.getChunk(cx + a, cz + b);
      if (nb && nb !== ch) nb.dirty |= ALL_SECTIONS;
    }
  }
  // one section: the palette of (id << 8 | meta) and the cells' palette indices -> this game's sections
  putSection(ch, s, pal, idx) {
    const ids = [],
      pos = new Map();
    let anyMeta = false,
      solid = false;
    const local = pal.map(v => {
      const id = v >> 8;
      if (v & 255) anyMeta = true;
      if (id) solid = true;
      let i = pos.get(id);
      if (i === undefined) {
        i = ids.length;
        pos.set(id, i);
        ids.push(id);
      }
      return i;
    });
    if (!solid) return;
    const d = new Uint8Array(4096),
      mt = anyMeta ? new Uint8Array(4096) : null;
    if (ids.length > 256) {
      // more kinds than one byte holds: plain ids
      const raw = new Uint16Array(4096);
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const v = pal[idx ? idx[j] : 0];
        raw[j] = v >> 8;
        if (mt) mt[j] = v & 255;
      }
      ch.bs[s] = {
        p: SEC_IDENT,
        n: -1,
        d: raw
      };
    } else {
      const P = new Uint16Array(256);
      P.set(ids);
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const i = idx ? idx[j] : 0;
        d[j] = local[i];
        if (mt) mt[j] = pal[i] & 255;
      }
      ch.bs[s] = {
        p: P,
        n: ids.length,
        d
      };
    }
    ch.ms[s] = mt;
  }
  markSection(cx, cz, s) {
    const w = this.g.world;
    for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) {
      const c = w.getChunk(cx + a, cz + b);
      if (c) c.dirty |= 1 << s | (s > 0 ? 1 << s - 1 : 0) | 1 << s + 1;
    }
  }

  // ---- entities ----
  spawn(m) {
    const g = this.g;
    if (this.ents.has(m.id)) return;
    let e;
    const y = m.y - this.minY;
    if (m.type === 'item') {
      // shown once the server says which item it is (entity data follows the spawn)
      const it = new ItemEntity(g, m.x, y, m.z, {
        id: ITEM_KEY.stone,
        count: 1
      }, [0, 0, 0]);
      it.netId = m.id;
      it.remote = true;
      it.tick = netItemTick;
      it.netPos = [m.x, y, m.z];
      it.lerpN = 0;
      it.pickup = 1e9;
      this.pendingItems.set(m.id, it);
      return;
    }
    if (m.type === 'player') e = new NetPlayer(g, m.x, y, m.z, m.name || this.players.get(m.uuid));else if (NET_MOBS.has(m.type)) e = createMob(g, m.type, m.x, y, m.z);else if (/_(chest_)?(boat|raft)$/.test(m.type) || /(^|_)minecart$/.test(m.type)) {
      // boats and minecarts: drawn by vehicles.js, moved by the server (or by this client while it steers a boat)
      const bm = /^(\w+?)_(chest_)?(boat|raft)$/.exec(m.type);
      e = bm ? new Boat(g, m.x, y, m.z, bm[1], !!bm[2]) : new Minecart(g, m.x, y, m.z, m.type === 'minecart' ? '' : m.type.replace(/_minecart$/, ''));
      e.netId = m.id;
      e.remote = true;
      e.alwaysTick = true;
      e.tick = netVehicleTick;
      e.hurt = () => false;
      e.netPos = [m.x, y, m.z];
      e.lerpN = 0;
      e.netYaw = e.yaw = toYaw(m.yaw) + (bm ? 0 : Math.PI / 2);
      if (!bm) e.netYawOff = Math.PI / 2;
      g.entities.push(e);
      this.ents.set(m.id, e);
      return;
    } else {
      this.unknown.set(m.type, (this.unknown.get(m.type) || 0) + 1);
      return;
    }
    e.netId = m.id;
    e.remote = true;
    e.persistent = true;
    e.alwaysTick = true;
    e.tick = netEntityTick;
    e.netPos = [m.x, y, m.z];
    e.lerpN = 0;
    e.netYaw = e.yaw = e.bodyYaw = e.prevBodyYaw = toYaw(m.yaw);
    e.netPitch = -m.pitch / R2D;
    e.hurt = () => false;
    g.entities.push(e);
    this.ents.set(m.id, e);
  }

  // ---- inventory ----
  // the proxy's stack -> this game's; an item this game lacks stays in its slot as "unknown" (drawn as a missing
  // texture), so moving it around still works
  stackIn(o) {
    if (!o) return null;
    const id = ITEM_KEY[o.n],
      s = {
        id,
        count: o.c,
        dmg: o.d || 0
      };
    if (id === undefined) {
      this.unknownItems.add(o.n);
      s.id = ITEM_KEY.stone;
      s.unk = o.n;
    }
    if (o.x) s.x = o.x;
    if (o.name) s.name = o.name;
    if (o.lore) s.lore = o.lore;
    if (o.e) s.e = o.e;
    if (o.pot) s.pot = o.pot;
    if (o.g !== undefined) s.g = o.g;
    if (o.ch) s.charged = o.ch.map(c => this.stackIn(c));
    return s;
  }
  applyInv() {
    const s = this.g.player.inv.slots;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) s[i] = this.inv[i] ? {
      ...this.inv[i]
    } : null;
    s[40] = this.off ? {
      ...this.off
    } : null;
  }

  // ---- windows ----
  // a slot by the server's numbering: window 0 is this player's (0 crafting result, 1-4 the 2x2 grid, 5-8 armour,
  // 9-35 main, 36-44 hotbar, 45 offhand); an open container's has its own n slots, then the main inventory and
  // the hotbar
  slotGet(id, v) {
    if (id === 0) return v < 5 ? this.w0x[v] : v < 9 ? this.inv[36 + v - 5] : v < 36 ? this.inv[v] : v < 45 ? this.inv[v - 36] : v === 45 ? this.off : null;
    const w = this.win;
    if (!w || w.id !== id || v < 0) return null;
    if (v < w.n) return w.slots[v];
    const j = v - w.n;
    return j < 27 ? this.inv[9 + j] : j < 36 ? this.inv[j - 27] : null;
  }
  slotSet(id, v, s) {
    if (id === 0) {
      if (v < 5) this.w0x[v] = s;else if (v < 9) this.inv[36 + v - 5] = s;else if (v < 36) this.inv[v] = s;else if (v < 45) this.inv[v - 36] = s;else if (v === 45) this.off = s;
      return;
    }
    const w = this.win;
    if (!w || w.id !== id || v < 0) return;
    if (v < w.n) {
      w.slots[v] = s;
      return;
    }
    const j = v - w.n;
    if (j < 27) this.inv[9 + j] = s;else if (j < 36) this.inv[j - 27] = s;
  }
  screenFor(id) {
    const sc = this.g.ui.screen;
    return sc && sc.net === this && sc.netWin === id ? sc : null;
  }
  // the survival inventory (E): window 0 in this game's inventory screen, with the offhand slot
  inventoryScreen() {
    const sc = new CraftingScreen(this.g, 2);
    this.netify(sc, 0, [1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 5, 6, 7, 8], 9);
    sc.slots.push(this.netSlot(sc, {
      x: 77,
      y: 62
    }, 45));
    return sc;
  }
  // a container the server opened, in this game's screen for it; the kinds without one show their slots in rows
  openWindow(w) {
    const g = this.g,
      k = w.kind,
      n = w.n;
    let sc, pre;
    if (k === 'lectern') {
      sc = this.lecternScreen(w);
      w.screen = sc;
      g.ui.open(sc);
      return;
    }
    if (k === 'crafting') {
      sc = new CraftingScreen(g, 3);
      pre = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0];
    } else if (k === 'furnace' || k === 'blast_furnace' || k === 'smoker') {
      // the window's properties: 0 burn time left, 1 the fuel's burn time, 2 cooking progress, 3 cooking time
      const P = w.props,
        be = {
          get burn() {
            return P[0] || 0;
          },
          get burnMax() {
            return P[1] || 200;
          },
          get cook() {
            return P[3] ? (P[2] || 0) / P[3] * 200 : 0;
          }
        };
      sc = new FurnaceScreen(g, be);
      sc.title = w.title;
      pre = [0, 1, 2];
    } else if (k === 'merchant') {
      sc = new MerchantScreen(g, this.merchantView(w));
      pre = [0, 1, 2];
      Object.defineProperty(sc, 'title2', {
        get: () => w.title + (w.regular && w.level ? ' - ' + LEVEL_CN[w.level - 1] : '')
      });
      // choosing a trade: the server moves the payment into the slots
      sc.pick = i => {
        sc.sel = i;
        this.send({
          t: 'trade',
          i
        });
      };
      sc.update = () => {};
    } else if (NET_STATION[k]) {
      sc = NET_STATION[k](this, w);
      pre = [...Array(n).keys()];
    } else {
      const rows = /^generic_9x\d$/.test(k) ? +k.slice(-1) : k === 'shulker_box' ? 3 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(n / 9));
      const full = /^generic_|^shulker_box$|^hopper$|^crafter_3x3$/.test(k);
      sc = new ContainerScreen(g, 'generic_54', 176, 114 + rows * 18, w.title + (full ? '' : '（暂不完整支持）'));
      sc.rows = rows;
      sc.drawBase = ChestScreen.prototype.drawBase;
      // the background's slots past the window's own: covered with the panel colour
      sc.drawExtra = ui => {
        ui.ctx.fillStyle = '#C6C6C6';
        for (let i = n; i < rows * 9; i++) ui.ctx.fillRect(sc.x + 7 + i % 9 * 18, sc.y + 17 + Math.floor(i / 9) * 18, 18, 18);
      };
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) sc.slots.push({
        x: 8 + i % 9 * 18,
        y: 18 + Math.floor(i / 9) * 18,
        output: NET_OUTPUT[k] === i
      });
      if (k !== 'lectern') sc.addPlayerSlots(31 + rows * 18, 89 + rows * 18);
      pre = [...Array(n).keys()];
    }
    this.netify(sc, w.id, pre, n);
    if (sc.onNetClose) {
      const c = sc.close;
      sc.close = function () {
        c.call(this);
        this.onNetClose();
      };
    }
    w.screen = sc;
    g.ui.open(sc);
  }
  // a lectern: its book (window slot 0) in the book screen, property 0 the page; turning pages and taking the book
  // are window buttons like vanilla's LecternScreen (1 back, 2 forward, 3 take, 100 + n page n)
  lecternScreen(w) {
    const n = this,
      P = w.props;
    const sc = new BookScreen(this.g, {
      pages: []
    }, false, {
      pos: null,
      get page() {
        return P[0] || 0;
      },
      set page(v) {
        n.send({
          t: 'button',
          id: w.id,
          b: 100 + v
        });
      }
    });
    Object.defineProperty(sc, 'pages', {
      get: () => {
        const b = w.slots[0];
        return b && b.pages && b.pages.length ? b.pages : [''];
      },
      set: () => {}
    });
    Object.defineProperty(sc, 'page', {
      get: () => clamp(P[0] || 0, 0, sc.pages.length - 1),
      set: v => {
        P[0] = v;
      }
    });
    const md = sc.mouseDown,
      cl = sc.close;
    sc.mouseDown = function (ui, mx, my) {
      const take = this.btns().find(b => b.act === 'take');
      if (take && ui.hit(take, mx, my)) {
        Sound.click && Sound.click();
        n.send({
          t: 'button',
          id: w.id,
          b: 3
        });
        ui.close();
        return;
      }
      md.call(this, ui, mx, my);
    };
    sc.net = this;
    sc.netWin = w.id;
    sc.close = function () {
      cl.call(this);
      if (!this.serverClosed) n.send({
        t: 'wclose',
        id: w.id
      });
      if (n.win && n.win.id === w.id) n.win = null;
    };
    return sc;
  }
  // a villager's trades as MerchantScreen shows them (the first price adjusted like vanilla's getCostA)
  merchantView(w) {
    return {
      restock() {},
      pos: this.g.player.pos,
      get vlevel() {
        return w.regular ? w.level || 1 : 5;
      },
      get vxp() {
        return w.xp || 0;
      },
      offers: () => w.offers || (w.offers = (w.trades || []).map(o => {
        const a = this.stackIn(o.a),
          b = o.b && this.stackIn(o.b),
          r = this.stackIn(o.r);
        if (!a || !r) return null;
        const an = clamp(a.count + Math.max(0, Math.floor(a.count * o.dem * o.mul)) + o.sp, 1, maxStack(a.id));
        return {
          a: a.id,
          an,
          b: b ? b.id : null,
          bn: b ? b.count : 0,
          r: r.id,
          rn: r.count,
          used: o.off ? o.max : o.used,
          uses: o.max
        };
      }).filter(Boolean))
    };
  }
  // a screen made for this game's own containers, turned into one of the server's windows: its slots read and
  // write the window (pre: the window slots of the screen's own slots in order, then the inventory from first)
  netify(sc, id, pre, first) {
    sc.net = this;
    sc.netWin = id;
    sc.slots = sc.slots.map((s, i) => this.netSlot(sc, s, i < pre.length ? pre[i] : first + i - pre.length));
    Object.assign(sc, NET_SCREEN);
    // (a crafting screen's recipe book shows the server's recipes: netRecipes at the end of this file)
  }
  netSlot(sc, s, v) {
    const k = this.win && sc.netWin === this.win.id ? this.win.kind : 'player';
    let accept = null;
    if (sc.netWin === 0 && v >= 5 && v <= 8) accept = st => !!ITEMS[st.id].armor && !st.unk && ITEMS[st.id].armor.slot === v - 5;else if (/furnace|smoker/.test(k) && v === 1) accept = st => fuelValue(st.id) > 0 || st.id === ITEM_KEY.bucket;
    const output = !!s.output || v === 0 && (sc.netWin === 0 || k === 'crafting') || v === 2 && /furnace|smoker|merchant/.test(k);
    if (!accept && s.accept && sc.netWin !== 0) accept = s.accept; // what the screen's own slots take (a loom's banner, dye ...)
    return {
      x: s.x,
      y: s.y,
      v,
      output,
      accept,
      max: sc.netWin === 0 && v >= 5 && v <= 8 ? 1 : s.max || 0,
      emptyIcon: s.emptyIcon,
      group: s.group,
      get: () => this.slotGet(sc.netWin, v),
      set: st => this.slotSet(sc.netWin, v, st)
    };
  }
  // a click: worked out here (predict), then sent with the slots that changed and what the cursor holds now.
  // mode / button as vanilla's: 0 pick up (left / right), 1 quick move (shift), 2 swap with a hotbar slot (0-8,
  // 40 offhand), 3 clone (creative), 4 throw (one / all), 5 drag (start / add / end), 6 gather (double click)
  click(sc, v, button, mode, predict = () => this.predict(sc, v, button, mode)) {
    const ui = this.g.ui,
      before = new Map(sc.slots.map(s => [s.v, s.get()]));
    if (predict) try {
      predict();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('net predict', e);
    }
    const changed = [];
    for (const s of sc.slots) {
      const a = before.get(s.v),
        b = s.get();
      if (a !== b && !sameStack(a, b)) changed.push([s.v, netStack(b)]);
    }
    this.send({
      t: 'click',
      id: sc.netWin,
      slot: v,
      button,
      mode,
      changed,
      carried: netStack(ui.cursor)
    });
    this.applyInv();
  }
  // a drag over several slots: start, each slot, end (the items are spread at the end)
  drag(sc, list, b) {
    const t = b === 0 ? 0 : 4;
    this.click(sc, -999, t, 5, null);
    for (const s of list) this.click(sc, s.v, t + 1, 5, null);
    this.click(sc, -999, t + 2, 5, () => {
      const ui = this.g.ui,
        C = ui.cursor;
      if (!C) return;
      const per = b === 0 ? Math.floor(C.count / list.length) : 1;
      if (per < 1) return;
      let left = C.count;
      for (const s of list) {
        const S = s.get();
        if (S && !sameItem(S, C) || !netMayPlace(s, C)) continue;
        const have = S ? S.count : 0,
          k = Math.min(per, netMax(s, C) - have, left);
        if (k <= 0) continue;
        s.set({
          ...(S || C),
          count: have + k
        });
        left -= k;
      }
      ui.cursor = left > 0 ? {
        ...C,
        count: left
      } : null;
    });
  }
  // vanilla's click rules (AbstractContainerMenu.doClick), for what this game can tell; stacks are replaced, never
  // changed in place, so the slots that changed can be found afterwards. Results (crafting, furnace, trades) are
  // left to the server.
  predict(sc, v, b, mode) {
    const ui = this.g.ui,
      C = ui.cursor,
      slot = v >= 0 ? sc.slots.find(s => s.v === v) : null,
      S = slot && slot.get();
    const cp = (st, c) => c > 0 ? {
      ...st,
      count: c
    } : null;
    if (mode === 0 && v === -999) {
      if (C) ui.cursor = b === 0 ? null : cp(C, C.count - 1);
      return;
    }
    // a trade's result taken: one more use of it (the server doesn't send the trades again)
    const mw = this.win;
    if (slot && slot.output && S && mode === 0 && mw && mw.kind === 'merchant' && mw.trades && mw.trades[sc.sel] && (!C || sameItem(C, S) && C.count + S.count <= netMax({}, S))) {
      mw.trades[sc.sel].used++;
      mw.offers = null;
    }
    if (!slot || slot.output) return;
    if (mode === 0) {
      if (b === 0) {
        if (!S) {
          if (C && netMayPlace(slot, C)) {
            const k = Math.min(C.count, netMax(slot, C));
            slot.set(cp(C, k));
            ui.cursor = cp(C, C.count - k);
          }
        } else if (!C) {
          ui.cursor = S;
          slot.set(null);
        } else if (sameItem(S, C)) {
          if (netMayPlace(slot, C)) {
            const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(C.count, netMax(slot, S) - S.count));
            slot.set(cp(S, S.count + k));
            ui.cursor = cp(C, C.count - k);
          }
        } else if (netMayPlace(slot, C) && C.count <= netMax(slot, C)) {
          slot.set(C);
          ui.cursor = S;
        }
      } else if (b === 1) {
        if (!C) {
          if (S) {
            const k = Math.ceil(S.count / 2);
            ui.cursor = cp(S, k);
            slot.set(cp(S, S.count - k));
          }
        } else if (!S) {
          if (netMayPlace(slot, C)) {
            slot.set(cp(C, 1));
            ui.cursor = cp(C, C.count - 1);
          }
        } else if (sameItem(S, C)) {
          if (netMayPlace(slot, C) && S.count < netMax(slot, S)) {
            slot.set(cp(S, S.count + 1));
            ui.cursor = cp(C, C.count - 1);
          }
        } else if (netMayPlace(slot, C) && C.count <= netMax(slot, C)) {
          slot.set(C);
          ui.cursor = S;
        }
      }
    } else if (mode === 1) this.predictQuickMove(sc, slot);else if (mode === 2) {
      // the hotbar slot (or the offhand) in this window
      const w = sc.netWin === 0 ? null : this.win;
      const hv = b === 40 ? w ? null : 45 : w ? w.n + 27 + b : 36 + b;
      if (hv === v) return;
      const H = hv === null ? this.off : this.slotGet(sc.netWin, hv),
        hset = st => {
          if (hv === null) this.off = st;else this.slotSet(sc.netWin, hv, st);
        };
      if (!H) {
        if (S) {
          hset(S);
          slot.set(null);
        }
      } else if (!S) {
        if (netMayPlace(slot, H)) {
          const k = Math.min(H.count, netMax(slot, H));
          slot.set(cp(H, k));
          hset(cp(H, H.count - k));
        }
      } else if (netMayPlace(slot, H) && H.count <= netMax(slot, H)) {
        slot.set(H);
        hset(S);
      }
    } else if (mode === 3) {
      if (this.g.mode === 'creative' && S && !C) ui.cursor = cp(S, netMax({}, S));
    } else if (mode === 4) {
      if (S && !C) slot.set(b === 0 ? cp(S, S.count - 1) : null);
    } else if (mode === 6 && C) {
      // gather: from the slots in order, stacks that aren't full first
      let c = C;
      const list = [...sc.slots].sort((a, d) => a.v - d.v);
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) for (const s of list) {
        if (c.count >= netMax({}, c)) break;
        const T = s.get();
        if (!T || s.output || !sameItem(T, c) || pass === 0 && T.count >= netMax({}, T)) continue;
        const k = Math.min(T.count, netMax({}, c) - c.count);
        c = cp(c, c.count + k);
        s.set(cp(T, T.count - k));
      }
      ui.cursor = c;
    }
  }
  // shift-click (quickMoveStack) for the inventory and the plain containers; other windows wait for the server
  predictQuickMove(sc, slot) {
    const id = sc.netWin,
      S = slot.get(),
      v = slot.v;
    if (!S) return;
    const move = (from, to, rev) => netMoveTo(sc, slot, from, to, rev);
    if (id === 0) {
      const a = ITEMS[S.id].armor;
      if (v >= 1 && v <= 8) move(9, 45, false);else if (a && !S.unk && !this.slotGet(0, 5 + a.slot)) {
        this.slotSet(0, 5 + a.slot, {
          ...S,
          count: 1
        });
        slot.set(S.count > 1 ? {
          ...S,
          count: S.count - 1
        } : null);
      } else if (v >= 9 && v < 36) move(36, 45, false);else if (v >= 36 && v < 45) move(9, 36, false);else if (v === 45) move(9, 45, false);
      return;
    }
    const w = this.win;
    if (!w || !/^generic_|^shulker_box$|^hopper$/.test(w.kind)) return;
    if (v < w.n) move(w.n, w.n + 36, true);else move(0, w.n, false);
  }
  // ---- each game tick: this player's position, keys, held slot and (creative) inventory for the server ----
  tick() {
    const g = this.g,
      p = g.player;
    if (!p || g.state !== 'play') return;
    if (p.inv.sel !== this.sentSel) {
      this.sentSel = p.inv.sel;
      this.send({
        t: 'held',
        slot: p.inv.sel
      });
    }
    if (g.mode === 'creative') {
      // creative mode sets slots itself (the creative inventory, picking a block)
      for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
        const s = p.inv.slots[i],
          had = i === 40 ? this.off : this.inv[i];
        if (sameStack(s, had)) continue;
        if (i === 40) this.off = s ? {
          ...s
        } : null;else this.inv[i] = s ? {
          ...s
        } : null;
        this.send({
          t: 'creative',
          slot: oursToWin(i),
          item: netStack(s)
        });
      }
    } else if (!(g.ui.screen instanceof ContainerScreen)) {
      // survival: the inventory is the server's (moved around through windows)
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) if (!sameStack(p.inv.slots[i], this.inv[i])) {
        this.applyInv();
        break;
      }
    }
    // the player's chunk not here yet (the player stands still, game.js tick): no move, look or keys - vanilla's client
    // doesn't tick its player there - only the end of the tick. A position every tick of hanging in the air is what a
    // server without allow-flight kicks for flying; the answer to a teleport still goes (posDue)
    if (!p.loadedHere() && !this.posDue) {
      this.send({
        t: 'tick'
      });
      return;
    }
    this.posDue = false;
    const input = g.ui.screen ? null : g.readInput();
    const keys = input && {
      f: input.fwd > 0,
      b: input.fwd < 0,
      l: input.strafe < 0,
      r: input.strafe > 0,
      j: input.jump,
      s: input.sneak,
      sp: !!p.sprinting
    };
    const v = p.vehicle;
    if (v) {
      // riding: the look and keys; a boat is moved here and its place and paddles sent (vehicle_move / steer_boat)
      const boat = v instanceof Boat;
      this.send({
        t: 'tick',
        look: [fromYaw(p.yaw), -p.pitch * R2D],
        keys,
        // (only for what this client steers, like vanilla: a minecart is the server's - sending its place back pinned it)
        vmove: boat || v.vm && v.ridden ? [v.pos[0], v.pos[1] + this.minY, v.pos[2], fromYaw(v.yaw), 0, v.onGround] : null,
        paddles: boat && input ? [input.fwd > 0 || input.strafe > 0, input.fwd > 0 || input.strafe < 0] : null
      });
      return;
    }
    this.send({
      t: 'tick',
      pos: [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + this.minY, p.pos[2], fromYaw(p.yaw), -p.pitch * R2D, p.onGround, p.collidedH],
      keys
    });
  }
  // drop the held item (or the whole stack): like vanilla's client, take it out at once - the server doesn't
  // send the slot back
  drop(all) {
    const p = this.g.player,
      i = p.inv.sel,
      s = p.inv.slots[i];
    if (!s) return;
    this.send({
      t: 'drop',
      all
    });
    const left = all ? 0 : s.count - 1;
    p.inv.slots[i] = left > 0 ? {
      ...s,
      count: left
    } : null;
    this.inv[i] = p.inv.slots[i] ? {
      ...p.inv.slots[i]
    } : null;
  }
  // a block action: dig (0 start, 1 abort, 2 finish) at a target
  dig(status, t) {
    var _NET_FACE$t$face;
    this.send({
      t: 'dig',
      status,
      x: t.pos[0],
      y: t.pos[1] + this.minY,
      z: t.pos[2],
      face: (_NET_FACE$t$face = NET_FACE[t.face]) !== null && _NET_FACE$t$face !== void 0 ? _NET_FACE$t$face : 1
    });
    this.digging = status === 0 ? {
      key: t.pos.join(','),
      t
    } : null;
  }
  chat(text) {
    this.send({
      t: 'chat',
      text
    });
  }
  // name tags over the other players, in the world like vanilla's: a fixed size over the head (they were drawn on the
  // interface canvas, the same size at every distance - growing and shrinking against the player, 2026-10-31), seen
  // faintly through walls; one sneaking: dimmed, hidden by walls; none for the invisible
  drawNames(a) {
    const g = this.g;
    for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (!(e instanceof NetPlayer) || e.dead || e.invisible) continue;
      const h = e.netSwim || e.gliding ? 0.6 : e.sneaking ? 1.5 : e.h;
      g.drawNameTag(e, e.ipos(a), e.name, {
        color: this.colors && this.colors.get(e.name) || '#FFFFFF',
        max: 64,
        h,
        through: !e.sneaking,
        faded: e.sneaking
      });
    }
  }
}

  enchantment(n, w) {

    sc.changed = () => {};

      } : null)
    });

    });

      });

    });

      if (k === sc.leftKey) return;
      sc.leftKey = k;
      sc.name = L ? L.name || ITEMS[L.id].cn : '';

      if (inp) inp.value = sc.name;
    };
    sc.onName = v => n.send({
      t: 'rename',
      name: v
    });
    sc.onNetClose = () => n.g.ui.hideInput();
    return sc;
  },

  // 0: the chosen recipe; choosing one is a button click with its place in the list
  stonecutter(n, w) {

const netMayPlace = (s, st) => !s.output && (!s.accept || s.accept(st));
const netMax = (s, st) => Math.min(s.max || 99, st.unk ? 64 : maxStack(st.id));
// moveItemStackTo: onto stacks of the same item first, then into the first empty slot that takes it
function netMoveTo(sc, src, from, to, rev) {
  let S = src.get();
  const list = sc.slots.filter(s => s.v >= from && s.v < to && s !== src).sort((a, b) => rev ? b.v - a.v : a.v - b.v);
  if (netMax({}, S) > 1) for (const t of list) {
    const T = t.get();
    if (!T || !sameItem(T, S) || T.count >= netMax(t, T)) continue;
    const k = Math.min(S.count, netMax(t, T) - T.count);
    t.set({
      ...T,
      count: T.count + k
    });
    S = S.count - k > 0 ? {
      ...S,
      count: S.count - k
    } : null;
    if (!S) break;
  }
  if (S) for (const t of list) {
    if (t.get() || !netMayPlace(t, S)) continue;
    const k = Math.min(S.count, netMax(t, S));
    t.set({
      ...S,
      count: k
    });
    S = S.count - k > 0 ? {
      ...S,
      count: S.count - k
    } : null;
    break;
  }
  src.set(S);
}
// mixed into a window's screen (NetClient.netify): mouse and keys become vanilla clicks
const NET_SCREEN = {
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const n = this.net,
      b = button === 2 ? 1 : button === 1 ? 2 : 0; // vanilla numbers the buttons left, right, middle
    Sound.init();
    if (this.offerAt) {
      const i = this.offerAt(mx, my);
      if (i >= 0) {
        this.pick(i);
        return;
      }
    }
    const s = this.slotAt(mx, my);
    if (!s) {
      if (ui.cursor && b < 2 && this.outside(mx, my)) n.click(this, -999, b, 0);
      return;
    }
    if (b === 2) {
      if (this.game.mode === 'creative' && !ui.cursor && s.get()) n.click(this, s.v, 2, 3);
      return;
    }
    const now = performance.now(),
      last = this.lastClick;
    this.lastClick = {
      t: now,
      v: s.v,
      b
    };
    if (b === 0 && !shift && ui.cursor && last && last.v === s.v && last.b === 0 && now - last.t < 250) {
      this.lastClick = null;
      n.click(this, s.v, 0, 6);
      return;
    }
    if (shift) {
      n.click(this, s.v, b, 1);
      return;
    }
    // holding something over a slot it fits: maybe a drag (decided when the button goes up)
    if (ui.cursor && !s.output && (!s.get() || sameItem(s.get(), ui.cursor))) {
      this.dragSlots = new Set([s]);
      this.dragButton = b;
      return;
    }
    n.click(this, s.v, b, 0);
  },
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (!this.dragSlots || !ui.mouse.down || !ui.cursor) return;
    const s = this.slotAt(mx, my),
      C = ui.cursor;
    if (s && !s.output && (!s.get() || sameItem(s.get(), C)) && netMayPlace(s, C) && this.dragSlots.size < C.count) this.dragSlots.add(s);
  },
  mouseUp(ui) {
    if (!this.dragSlots) return;
    const list = [...this.dragSlots],
      b = this.dragButton;
    this.dragSlots = null;
    if (list.length === 1) this.net.click(this, list[0].v, b, 0);else if (ui.cursor) this.net.drag(this, list, b);
  },
  key(ui, ev) {
    // (the keys as bound - ContainerScreen.key)
    const acts = bindingsFor(this.game, ev.code),
      s = this.slotAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y),
      n = this.net,
      hb = acts.find(a => a.startsWith('hotbar.'));
    if (acts.includes('inventory')) return false;
    if (hb) {
      if (s && !ui.cursor) n.click(this, s.v, +hb.slice(7) - 1, 2);
      return true;
    }
    if (acts.includes('swapOffhand')) {
      if (s && !ui.cursor) n.click(this, s.v, 40, 2);
      return true;
    }
    if (acts.includes('drop')) {
      if (s && !ui.cursor && s.get()) n.click(this, s.v, ev.ctrlKey ? 1 : 0, 4);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  },
  // closing: the server puts the cursor's and the crafting grid's items back (and says so)
  close() {
    const n = this.net;
    this.game.ui.cursor = null;
    if (!this.serverClosed) n.send({
      t: 'wclose',
      id: this.netWin
    });
    if (this.netWin && n.win && n.win.id === this.netWin) n.win = null;
  },
  quickMove(s) {
    this.net.click(this, s.v, 0, 1);
  } // touch controls' quick move
};
