const romanNum = n => ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X'][n] || String(n);
// the tooltip of a server's stack: its name, its enchantments under it, what potion it is
function netItemLines(stack, lines) {
  if (stack.pot) {
    const base = stack.pot.replace(/^(long|strong)_/, ''),
      eff = NET_POTION_CN[base],
      key = stack.unk || ITEMS[stack.id].key;
    const pre = key === 'splash_potion' ? '喷溅型' : key === 'lingering_potion' ? '滞留型' : '';
    lines[0].text = NET_POTION_PLAIN[base] ? pre + NET_POTION_PLAIN[base] : eff ? key === 'tipped_arrow' ? eff + '之箭' : pre + eff + '药水' : lines[0].text;
    if (eff) lines.splice(1, 0, {
      text: eff + (stack.pot.startsWith('strong_') ? ' II' : '') + (stack.pot.startsWith('long_') ? '（延长）' : ''),
      color: '#5555FF'
    });else lines.splice(1, 0, {
      text: '无效果',
      color: '#AAAAAA'
    });
  }
  if (stack.e && stack.e.length) {
    if (lines[0].color === '#FFFFFF') lines[0].color = '#55FFFF'; // enchanted: the "rare" colour
    lines.splice(1, 0, ...stack.e.map(([k, l]) => ({
      text: (NET_ENCH_CN[k] || k) + (NET_ENCH_ONE.has(k) && l === 1 ? '' : ' ' + romanNum(l)),
      color: /curse/.test(k) ? '#FF5555' : '#AAAAAA'
    })));
  }
  if (stack.name) lines[0].text = stack.name;
  // the lines under the name (a minigame shop's prices: minigame.js Legacy), in their first colour; vanilla's purple
  if (stack.lore && typeof Legacy !== 'undefined') for (const l of stack.lore) lines.push({
    text: Legacy.strip(l) || ' ',
    color: Legacy.first(l, '#AA00AA')
  });
  return lines;
}

// ---- Game hooks ----
// interaction on a server: like handleInteraction (same mining time, cracks, swings), but the effects are the
// server's - a mined block disappears at once and comes back if the server says no
Game.prototype.netInteraction = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    n = this.net;
  if (this.useCd > 0) this.useCd--;
  if (this.attackCd > 0) this.attackCd--;
  // eating / drawing a bow: the server times it; letting go of the button tells it
  if (p.usingItem) {
    const held = p.useHand === 'off' ? p.inv.slots[40] : p.inv.held;
    if (!this.mouseBtn[2] || !held || held.id !== p.usingItem) {
      n.send({
        t: 'release'
      });
      p.usingItem = null;
      p.useT = 0;
      p.useHand = null;
    } else {
      p.useT++;
      const def = ITEMS[held.id];
      if (def.food && p.useT % 4 === 0 && p.useT > 6) {
        Sound.eat(p.pos);
        this.foodParticles(held.id);
      }
      // (done when the server says so - entity event 9; asking again before it had finished started the same food over,
      // so a second one never got eaten. A second's grace if that never comes)
      if (def.food && p.useT >= 52) {
        p.usingItem = null;
        p.useT = 0;
      }
    }
  }
  // (no attacking or mining while an item is in use, and a spear mines nothing: vanilla's client, as handleInteraction)
  const spear = typeof isSpear === 'function' && p.inv.held && ITEMS[p.inv.held.id] && isSpear(ITEMS[p.inv.held.id].key);
  // (a spear's click does nothing before a full charge: vanilla minimum_attack_charge 1, as spearJab)
  const spearWait = spear && this.attackStrength(0.1) < 1;
  if ((this.mouseBtn[0] || this.mouseClicked0) && !p.usingItem) {
    // (a click let go within the tick counts too: handleInteraction)
    if (this.targetEntity) {
      const e = this.targetEntity;
      if (this.mouseClicked0 && this.attackCd <= 0 && e.netId != null && !spearWait) {
        n.send({
          t: 'attack',
          id: e.netId
        });
        n.send({
          t: 'swing'
        });
        p.swing();
        p.attackT = 0;
        this.attackCd = 4;
      }
      this.breaking = null;
    } else if (this.target && spear) {
      this.breaking = null;
      if (this.mouseClicked0 && !spearWait) {
        p.swing();
        n.send({
          t: 'swing'
        });
        p.attackT = 0;
      }
    } else if (this.target) {
      const t = this.target,
        key = t.pos.join(','),
        b = BLOCKS[t.id];
      if (this.mode === 'creative') {
        if (this.attackCd <= 0) {
          const held = p.inv.held;
          if (!(held && ITEMS[held.id].tool && ITEMS[held.id].tool.type === 'sword')) {
            n.dig(0, t);
            n.digging = null;
            this.netBreak(t.pos);
          }
          this.attackCd = 5;
          p.swing();
          n.send({
            t: 'swing'
          });
        }
      } else {
        if (!this.breaking || this.breaking.key !== key) {
          this.breaking = {
            key,
            pos: t.pos,
            progress: 0,
            id: t.id
          };
          n.dig(0, t);
        }
        if (b.hardness >= 0 && this.attackCd <= 0) {
          this.breaking.progress += this.breakSpeed(t.id);
          p.swing();
          if (this.tickCount % 4 === 0) {
            n.send({
              t: 'swing'
            });
            Sound.block('hit', b.sound, [t.pos[0] + 0.5, t.pos[1] + 0.5, t.pos[2] + 0.5]);
            this.particles.blockHit(...t.pos, t.face, t.id, this.world.getMeta(...t.pos));
          }
          if (this.breaking.progress >= 1) {
            n.dig(2, t);
            this.netBreak(t.pos);
            this.breaking = null;
            this.attackCd = 5;
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      this.breaking = null;
      if (this.mouseClicked0 && !spearWait) {
        p.swing();
        n.send({
          t: 'swing'
        });
        if (spear) p.attackT = 0;
      }
    }
  } else this.breaking = null;
  // a block given up half-mined
  if (n.digging && (!this.breaking || this.breaking.key !== n.digging.key)) {
    n.dig(1, n.digging.t);
    n.digging = null;
  }
  this.mouseClicked0 = false;
  if ((this.mouseBtn[2] || this.useClicked) && this.useCd <= 0 && !p.usingItem) this.netUse();
  this.useClicked = false;
};
// items with no use on a block (Item.useOn passes), so a right click at a block uses them in the air too
const NET_USE_ON_PASS = /^(snowball|egg|blue_egg|brown_egg|ender_pearl|splash_potion|lingering_potion|experience_bottle|ender_eye|wind_charge|fishing_rod|bucket|water_bucket|lava_bucket|(cod|salmon|pufferfish|tropical_fish|axolotl|tadpole)_bucket|map|bundle|\w+_bundle|elytra|crossbow|knowledge_book|turtle_helmet|\w+_(helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots))$/;
// right click on a server: an entity (trade, ride, shear ...), a block (place, open, press), or the item itself
Game.prototype.netUse = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    n = this.net,
    held = p.inv.held,
    def = held && ITEMS[held.id],
    t = this.target;
  this.useCd = 4;
  // held to use (the server times it; letting go says so): food, drinks, bows, crossbows, shields, tridents, spears
  const heldUse = (st, d) => !!d && !!(d.food || /^(bow|potion|milk_bucket|honey_bottle|shield|trident|crossbow|spyglass|goat_horn|brush)$|_spear$/.test(d.key)) && !(d.key === 'crossbow' && st.charged);
  const usable = heldUse(held, def);
  // the other hand's turn (vanilla's client tries it when the main hand passes): the main hand has no use of its own
  // and no tool that works on the aimed block, the other hand's item has one - only its shield and blocks were ever
  // tried, so its food, bow, crossbow, spear, wind charge, firework or potion did nothing ("副手的东西不能用")
  const off = p.inv.slots[40],
    od = off && ITEMS[off.id],
    offHeld = heldUse(off, od);
  const tb = t && !this.targetEntity && BLOCKS[t.id],
    blockUse = !!(tb && (tb.onUse || tb.door || tb.trapdoor || tb.gate || tb.bed));
  // what an axe, shovel or hoe does to the aimed block (vanilla useOn; anywhere else, or at the air or a mob, it
  // passes): an axe strips, scrapes or takes wax off (not with a shield in the other hand unless sneaking), a shovel
  // makes a path or puts a campfire out, a hoe tills
  const toolOn = () => {
    const tt = def.tool.type,
      tk = tb.key,
      [x, y, z] = t.pos,
      w = this.world,
      airUp = !w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z);
    if (tt === 'axe') {
      const cu = copperInfo(tk);
      return !(od && od.key === 'shield' && !p.sneaking) && (STRIP.test(tk) && !tk.startsWith('stripped_') && BID['stripped_' + tk] !== undefined || !!(cu && (cu.waxed || cu.stage > 0)));
    }
    if (tt === 'shovel') return t.face !== 2 && (PATHABLE.has(tk) && airUp || /campfire$/.test(tk) && Features.propOf(t.id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'lit') === 'true');
    if (tt === 'hoe') return tk === 'rooted_dirt' || /^(grass_block|dirt|dirt_path|coarse_dirt)$/.test(tk) && t.face !== 2 && airUp;
    return false;
  };
  const idle = !usable && !(def && (NET_USE_ON_PASS.test(def.key) || /_(boat|raft)$/.test(def.key))) && !this.mainHandBusy(held, def) && !(def && def.tool && tb && toolOn());
  const offTurn = !!od && idle && (offHeld || NET_USE_ON_PASS.test(od.key) || od.key === 'firework_rocket') && !(blockUse && !p.sneaking);
  if (this.targetEntity && this.targetEntity.netId != null) {
    const e = this.targetEntity;
    n.send({
      t: 'interact',
      id: e.netId,
      x: 0,
      y: e.h / 2,
      z: 0,
      sneak: p.sneaking
    });
    // most mobs have nothing to do with an empty hand or a weapon (PASS): on to the other hand - its shield goes up
    // with the crosshair on a mob ("准星对着生物时右键不能举盾"); not at one that trades, carries a rider, sits down
    // or hands an item back (vanilla mobInteract SUCCESS)
    const takes = /^(villager|wandering_trader|horse|donkey|mule|llama|trader_llama|camel|camel_husk|zombie_horse|skeleton_horse)$/.test(e.type) ? !e.baby : /^(pig|strider)$/.test(e.type) ? !!e.saddled && !e.baby : /^(wolf|cat|parrot|nautilus|zombie_nautilus)$/.test(e.type) ? !!e.owner : e.type === 'happy_ghast' ? !!e.harness : e.type === 'allay' ? !!e.hand : e.type === 'copper_golem' && !!(def && def.tool && def.tool.type === 'axe');
    if (!(offTurn && (!def || def.tool || def.attack) && e instanceof Mob && !takes)) {
      p.swing();
      n.send({
        t: 'swing'
      });
      return;
    }
  }
  // books open their screen here (like vanilla's client); the pages go back with edit_book
  if (def && /^(writable_book|written_book)$/.test(def.key) && !(t && BLOCKS[t.id].key === 'lectern')) {
    this.ui.open(new BookScreen(this, held, def.key === 'writable_book'));
    return;
  }
  // boats are put down by using the item (on water too), not on a block
  const itemUse = !!def && /_(boat|raft)$/.test(def.key);
  // (not at a block with a use of its own - doors, trapdoors, gates and beds too: the shield went up and the door
  // stayed shut, 10-31 feedback; a firework at a block is launched from it, below)
  if (offTurn && !(od.key === 'firework_rocket' && t && !this.targetEntity && !p.gliding)) {
    n.send({
      t: 'use',
      hand: 'off',
      yaw: fromYaw(p.yaw),
      pitch: -p.pitch * R2D
    });
    if (offHeld && (!od.food || p.food < 20 || this.mode === 'creative' || od.key === 'golden_apple')) {
      p.usingItem = off.id;
      p.useHand = 'off';
      p.useT = 0;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (t && !itemUse && (!usable || BLOCKS[t.id].onUse && !p.sneaking)) {
    var _NET_FACE$t$face2;
    const pt = t.point || [t.pos[0] + 0.5, t.pos[1] + 0.5, t.pos[2] + 0.5];
    n.send({
      t: 'place',
      x: t.pos[0],
      y: t.pos[1] + n.minY,
      z: t.pos[2],
      face: (_NET_FACE$t$face2 = NET_FACE[t.face]) !== null && _NET_FACE$t$face2 !== void 0 ? _NET_FACE$t$face2 : 1,
      cx: clamp(pt[0] - t.pos[0], 0, 1),
      cy: clamp(pt[1] - t.pos[1], 0, 1),
      cz: clamp(pt[2] - t.pos[2], 0, 1)
    });
    // like vanilla's client: when neither the block nor the item does anything there (PASS), the item is used
    // as well - throwables, buckets, armour, a loaded crossbow, an eye of ender away from a portal frame ...
    const pass = def && NET_USE_ON_PASS.test(def.key) && !(BLOCKS[t.id].onUse && !p.sneaking) && !(def.key === 'ender_eye' && BLOCKS[t.id].key === 'end_portal_frame');
    if (pass) {
      n.send({
        t: 'use',
        yaw: fromYaw(p.yaw),
        pitch: -p.pitch * R2D
      });
      p.swing();
      n.send({
        t: 'swing'
      });
      return;
    }
    // the other hand's block or torch when the main hand has nothing to do there (vanilla's client tries the other
    // hand after the main one passes; only the main hand went, 10-31 feedback)
    const offPlace = !!(od && (od.block !== undefined || od.places || od.key === 'firework_rocket') && !od.armor && idle && !(blockUse && !p.sneaking));
    if (offPlace) {
      var _NET_FACE$t$face3;
      n.send({
        t: 'place',
        hand: 'off',
        x: t.pos[0],
        y: t.pos[1] + n.minY,
        z: t.pos[2],
        face: (_NET_FACE$t$face3 = NET_FACE[t.face]) !== null && _NET_FACE$t$face3 !== void 0 ? _NET_FACE$t$face3 : 1,
        cx: clamp(pt[0] - t.pos[0], 0, 1),
        cy: clamp(pt[1] - t.pos[1], 0, 1),
        cz: clamp(pt[2] - t.pos[2], 0, 1)
      });
    }
    // (placing from the other hand swings that hand here)
    if (offPlace && p.swingOff) p.swingOff();else if (held) p.swing();
    n.send(offPlace ? {
      t: 'swing',
      hand: 'off'
    } : {
      t: 'swing'
    });
    return;
  }
  if (!def) return;
  n.send({
    t: 'use',
    yaw: fromYaw(p.yaw),
    pitch: -p.pitch * R2D
  });
  if (usable && (!def.food || p.food < 20 || this.mode === 'creative' || def.key === 'golden_apple')) {
    p.usingItem = held.id;
    p.useHand = 'main';
    p.useT = 0;
  } else p.swing();
};
// a mined block goes at once (the server's block change follows, or puts it back)
Game.prototype.netBreak = function (pos) {
  const w = this.world,
    [x, y, z] = pos,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id || IS_FLUID[id]) return;
  const b = BLOCKS[id];
  Sound.block('break', b.sound, [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5]);
  this.particles.blockBreak(x, y, z, id, w.getMeta(x, y, z));
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, WLOG[id] ? WATER : 0, 0, 0);
  this.flushMesh();
};
Game.prototype.joinServer = function (url, name) {
  if (this.world) {
    this.unloadAll();
    this.world = null;
  }
  this.net = new NetClient(this, url, name);
  this.ui.open(new LoadingScreen(this, '正在连接…'));
};
Game.prototype.leaveServer = function () {
  const n = this.net;
  if (!n) return;
  this.net = null;
  n.close();
  this.startTitle();
};
// the server's world: the player moves (the server checks it), everything else comes from the server
Game.prototype.netTick = function () {
  const p = this.player;
  for (const e of this.entities) if (!e.dead) this.tickEntity(e);
  this.entities = this.entities.filter(e => !e.dead);
  this.guard('particles', () => this.particles.tick());
  const eyeY = p.pos[1] + p.eye(),
    eb = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(p.pos[0]), Math.floor(eyeY), Math.floor(p.pos[2]));
  this.headInWater = this.world.waterAt(Math.floor(p.pos[0]), Math.floor(eyeY), Math.floor(p.pos[2]));
  this.headInLava = eb === LAVA;
  this.guard('ambient sounds', () => this.ambientSounds());
  this.weather += clamp(this.rainTarget - this.weather, -0.01, 0.01);
  this.net.tick();
  Sound.listener = {
    x: p.pos[0],
    y: p.pos[1] + 1.6,
    z: p.pos[2],
    yaw: p.yaw
  };
};

// 多人游戏: rooms on the room service (multiplayer/rooms). Anyone creates a room (a server of its own on the service's
// machine, 4-10 players, public: in the list for anyone); friends also join with its invite code or link (?room=CODE). The service's address comes from
// js/netconfig.js (NET_CONFIG.rooms), or ?rooms=<address> in the page's address for testing.
const RoomService = {
  base() {
    const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('rooms');
    // a test page on this machine (localhost, *.localhost, *.test) leaves the live service alone unless ?rooms= says
    // otherwise: it refuses those pages anyway, and each refusal counted against the developer's address until it
    // was banned (2026-11-03)
    if (!q && /^(localhost|127\.|\[::1\])|\.(localhost|test)$/.test(location.hostname)) return '';
    return String(q || window.NET_CONFIG && NET_CONFIG.rooms || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  },
  ws() {
    return this.base().replace(/^http/, 'ws') + '/ws';
  },
  // this browser's own key: rooms it made and names it took belong to it
  key() {
    const make = () => [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    try {
      let k = localStorage.getItem('mcjs-room-key');
      if (!k) {
        k = make();
        localStorage.setItem('mcjs-room-key', k);
      }
      return k;
    } catch (e) {
      return this._k || (this._k = make());
    }
  },
  // bytes sent as they are (a save for a room), with the upload's progress (0-1)
  upload(path, bytes, progress) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('POST', this.base() + path);
      x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain'); // (the bytes as they are; text/plain so no preflight - account.js)
      x.upload.onprogress = e => {
        if (e.lengthComputable && progress) progress(e.loaded / e.total);
      };
      x.onload = () => {
        let j = null;
        try {
          j = JSON.parse(x.responseText);
        } catch (e) {}
        if (x.status === 200 && j && !j.error) resolve(j);else reject(new Error(j && j.error || 'HTTP ' + x.status));
      };
      x.onerror = () => reject(new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后'));
      x.send(bytes);
    });
  },
  async api(path, body) {
    let r;
    // (sent as plain text: no preflight - account.js)
    try {
      r = await fetch(this.base() + path, body ? {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      } : {});
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
    }
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({
      error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
    }));
    if (!r.ok || j && j.error) throw new Error(j && j.error || 'HTTP ' + r.status);
    return j;
  },
  link(code) {
    const share = window.NET_CONFIG && NET_CONFIG.share,
      base = share || location.origin + location.pathname;
    return base + (base.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'room=' + code;
  },
  fromUrl() {
    const c = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('room');
    return c ? c.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 8) : '';
  }
};
Game.prototype.joinRoom = function (code, name) {
  if (this.world) {
    this.unloadAll();
    this.world = null;
  }
  this.net = new NetClient(this, RoomService.ws(), name, {
    room: code,
    key: RoomService.key()
  });
  this.ui.open(new LoadingScreen(this, '正在连接房间 ' + code + '…'));
};
// an invite link opens the join screen once the title screen is up
(() => {
  const st = Game.prototype.startTitle;
  Game.prototype.startTitle = function (...a) {
    const r = st.apply(this, a);
    if (!this.roomLinkUsed && RoomService.fromUrl()) {
      this.roomLinkUsed = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.state === 'title') this.ui.open(new MultiplayerScreen(this, null));
      }, 400);
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// text fields drawn like the game's, typed into through the page's input box
class FormScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, title, parent) {
    super(game, title);
    this.parent = parent;
    this.titleY = 20;
    this.fields = {};
    this.field = null;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
  }
  addField(k, x, y, w, label, max, filter) {
    this.fields[k] = {
      x,
      y,
      w,
      h: 20,
      label,
      max,
      filter
    };
  }
  focus(k) {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      b = this.fields[k];
    if (!b) return;
    this.field = k;
    u.showInput(b.x + 4, b.y + 6, b.w - 8, 10, this[k], () => this.submit(), {
      onInput: v => {
        this[k] = b.filter ? b.filter(v) : v;
      },
      onEsc: () => this.onEsc(),
      max: b.max
    });
  }
  submit() {}
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    for (const k in this.fields) {
      const r = this.fields[k];
      if (mx >= r.x && mx < r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my < r.y + r.h) {
        this.focus(k);
        return;
      }
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  drawFields(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx;
    for (const k in this.fields) {
      const r = this.fields[k];
      Font.draw(c, r.label, r.x, r.y - 11, '#A0A0A0');
      ui.nine(this.field === k ? 'text_field_hl' : 'text_field', r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 1);
      if (this.field !== k) Font.draw(c, String(this[k] || ''), r.x + 4, r.y + 6, '#E0E0E0');
    }
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, ui.w / 2, ui.h - 52, this.noteColor);
  }
  say(text, bad) {
    this.note = text;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0';
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
}
const nameOnly = v => v.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
const codeOnly = v => v.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 8);

// 多人游戏: the public rooms (every room on the service is public: anyone may come in), joining one by its
// invite code, making one, the rooms this browser made
const GM_CN = {
  survival: '生存',
  creative: '创造',
  adventure: '冒险',
  spectator: '旁观'
};
// text cut to a width (with an ellipsis), for the lists on narrow screens
const fitText = (t, w) => {
  t = String(t);
  if (Font.width(t) <= w) return t;
  while (t.length && Font.width(t + '…') > w) t = t.slice(0, -1);
  return t + '…';
};
const roomAge = t => {
  if (!t) return '';
  const m = Math.floor((Date.now() - t) / 60000);
  return m < 60 ? `${m} 分钟` : `${Math.floor(m / 60)} 小时 ${m % 60} 分`;
};
class MultiplayerScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '多人游戏', parent);
    const s = game.settings;
    this.name = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && Account.name || s.netName || 'Steve' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100);
    this.code = RoomService.fromUrl() || '';
    this.list = null;
    this.page = 0;
    this.cap = null;
    if (!RoomService.base()) this.say(location.protocol === 'http:' ? '没有配置房间服务（js/netconfig.js）：可以用下面的“直接连接”' : '还没有配置联机服务器地址（js/netconfig.js）', true);
    this.field = this.code ? 'name' : null;
    this.load();
  }
  async load() {
    if (!RoomService.base()) return;
    this.loading = true;
    try {
      const r = await RoomService.api('/api/public');
      this.list = r.rooms || [];
      this.cap = r.capacity || null;
      this.maint = r.maintenance || null;
    } catch (e) {
      this.list = [];
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.loading = false;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 82 - 62) / 24));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      n = this.rows(),
      list = this.list || [];
    this.fields = {};
    // (logged in: the account's game name, changed in 选项 → 账号)
    if (!(typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn)) this.addField('name', cx - 152, 42, 148, '你的名字（英文、数字、下划线）', 16, nameOnly);else this.name = Account.name;
    this.addField('code', cx + 4, 42, 98, '邀请码', 8, codeOnly);
    const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx + 106,
      y: 42,
      w: 46,
      h: 20,
      label: '加入',
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx + 106,
      y: 66,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 130,
      y: 66,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    }];
    list.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((r, i) => {
      // (a super administrator goes into a full room too - the service lets it, and the room's server keeps two places)
      // (the owner too, into their own room - its button blue: the user, 2026-11-01)
      const full = r.players >= r.max,
        sup = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && !!(Account.data && Account.data.super);
      const mine = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && !!Account.name && String(r.owner || '').toLowerCase() === Account.name.toLowerCase();
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 106,
        y: 84 + i * 24,
        w: 46,
        h: 20,
        label: full && !sup && !mine ? '已满' : '进入',
        enabled: !full || sup || mine,
        gold: full && sup && !mine,
        blue: mine,
        tip: [r.name, `房主 ${r.owner}，${r.players}/${r.max} 人，${GM_CN[r.gamemode] || ''}`].concat(mine ? ['你的房间：满员了也能进'] : full && sup ? ['满员了，管理员可以进'] : []),
        onClick: () => this.join(r.code)
      });
      // (a super administrator: any room's 管理 - its server stopped, the room deleted, a player banned; the user 11-08)
      if (sup) this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 76,
        y: 84 + i * 24,
        w: 28,
        h: 20,
        label: '管理',
        gold: true,
        tip: ['管理员：关闭这个房间的服务器、删除房间、封禁里面的玩家'],
        onClick: () => {
          this.game.ui.hideInput();
          this.game.ui.open(new AdminRoomScreen(this.game, this, r.code));
        }
      });
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 152,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '创建房间',
      onClick: () => this.go(CreateRoomScreen)
    }, {
      x: cx - 50,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '我的房间',
      onClick: () => this.go(MyRoomsScreen)
    }, {
      x: cx + 52,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 100,
      h: 20,
      label: this.loading ? '正在刷新…' : '刷新列表',
      onClick: () => {
        this.list = null;
        this.layout();
        this.load();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 152,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
    if (location.protocol === 'http:') this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 2,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '直接连接（局域网）',
      onClick: () => {
        this.game.ui.hideInput();
        this.game.ui.open(new DirectConnectScreen(this.game, this));
      }
    });
    if (this.field) this.focus(this.field);
  }
  okName() {
    const n = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && Account.name ? Account.name : nameOnly(this.name);
    if (n.length < 1) {
      this.say('先输入名字', true);
      this.focus('name');
      return null;
    } // (one- and two-character Bilibili names too: the service takes 1-16, 2026-11-01)
    const g = this.game;
    g.settings.netName = n;
    g.saveSettings();
    return n;
  }
  go(Cls) {
    const n = this.okName();
    if (!n) return;
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.open(new Cls(this.game, this, n));
  }
  join(code) {
    const n = this.okName();
    if (!n || !RoomService.base()) return;
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.joinRoom(code, n);
  }
  submit() {
    const code = codeOnly(this.code);
    if (code.length < 4) {
      this.say('输入朋友给你的邀请码，或者从下面的公开房间里选一个', true);
      this.focus('code');
      return;
    }
    this.join(code);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      n = this.rows(),
      list = this.list || [];
    const nt = this.note;
    this.note = '';
    this.drawFields(ui);
    this.note = nt; // (the note goes above the buttons, below)
    if (typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn) {
      Font.draw(c, '你的名字', cx - 152, 31, '#A0A0A0');
      Font.draw(c, fitText(Account.name, 146), cx - 150, 48, '#FFFFFF');
    }
    Font.draw(c, '公开房间' + (list.length ? `（${list.length}）` : ''), cx - 152, 69, '#FFFFFF');
    if (this.maint) Font.draw(c, this.maint, cx - 80, 69, '#FF5555');
    if (!this.list) Font.center(c, '正在读取公开房间…', cx, 100, '#A0A0A0');else if (!list.length) Font.center(c, '现在还没有公开房间，创建一个吧', cx, 100, '#A0A0A0');
    list.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = 84 + i * 24,
        run = r.state !== 'stopped';
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(cx - 152, y, 254, 20);
      const tw = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.data && Account.data.super ? 222 : 248; // (room for 管理)
      Font.draw(c, fitText(r.name, tw), cx - 149, y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
      const st = run ? `${r.players}/${r.max} 人 · ${GM_CN[r.gamemode] || ''} · ${roomAge(r.started)}` : `休息中 · 最多 ${r.max} 人 · ${GM_CN[r.gamemode] || ''}`;
      Font.draw(c, fitText(`房主 ${r.owner} · ${st}`, tw), cx - 149, y + 11, run ? '#90C890' : '#909090');
    });
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 62, this.noteColor);
  }
}
class CreateRoomScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, name) {
    super(game, '创建新房间', parent);
    this.owner = name;
    this.roomName = name + ' 的世界';
    this.seed = '';
    this.save = null; // a single-player save as the world
    this.gamemode = 'survival';
    this.difficulty = 'normal';
    this.pvp = true;
    this.busy = false;
    this.size = 4;
    this.cap = null;
    this.loadCap();
  }
  async loadCap() {
    try {
      this.cap = await RoomService.api('/api/capacity');
      if (this.cap && !this.cap.sizes[this.size] && this.cap.max) this.size = this.cap.max;
    } catch (e) {
      this.cap = null;
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  sizes() {
    return this.cap ? Object.keys(this.cap.sizes).map(Number) : [4, 6, 8, 10];
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.fields = {};
    if (!this.save) this.addField('seed', cx + 2, 166, 98, '种子（留空：随机）', 32, v => v.slice(0, 32));
    const GM = {
        survival: '生存',
        creative: '创造',
        adventure: '冒险'
      },
      DF = {
        peaceful: '和平',
        easy: '简单',
        normal: '普通',
        hard: '困难'
      };
    const next = (o, k) => {
      const ks = Object.keys(o);
      return ks[(ks.indexOf(k) + 1) % ks.length];
    };
    const ok = n => !this.cap || this.cap.sizes[n];
    this.widgets = [
    // (the room is named after its owner - the service decides it - 2026-10-31)
    {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 52,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: () => fitText('房间名：' + this.roomName, 192),
      enabled: false,
      tip: ['房间名就是「你的名字 的世界」，不能自己起名', '每个人只能建一个房间，不要了可以在「我的房间」里删掉']
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 80,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '模式：' + GM[this.gamemode],
      onClick: () => {
        this.gamemode = next(GM, this.gamemode);
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: 80,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '难度：' + DF[this.difficulty],
      onClick: () => {
        this.difficulty = next(DF, this.difficulty);
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 104,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => 'PVP：' + (this.pvp ? '开' : '关'),
      tip: ['玩家能不能互相伤害'],
      onClick: () => {
        this.pvp = !this.pvp;
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: 104,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => `人数：${this.size}${ok(this.size) ? '' : '（要排队）'}`,
      tip: ['房间最多几个人（包括你）', '人越多服务器给的内存越多，资源紧张时要排队等别的房间关掉'],
      onClick: () => {
        const s = this.sizes();
        this.size = s[(s.indexOf(this.size) + 1) % s.length];
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 166,
      w: this.save ? 200 : 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.save ? '存档：' + this.save.name : '世界：新世界',
      tip: ['可以用你的单人存档（新版地形）开房间，大小不超过 100 MB'],
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new SavePickScreen(this.game, this))
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 196,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.busy ? '正在创建…' : ok(this.size) ? '创建并进入' : '创建并排队',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    if (this.field) this.focus(this.field);
  }
  async submit() {
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在创建房间…');
    this.layout();
    let code = null;
    try {
      // a save: turned into a vanilla world here (export.js) first, so nothing is made when it can't be
      let pack = null;
      if (this.save) {
        const meta = await DB.getWorld(this.save.id);
        if (!meta) throw new Error('找不到这个存档');
        const ex = await RoomExport.build(meta, f => {
          this.say(`正在转换存档… ${Math.round(f * 100)}%`);
        });
        pack = RoomExport.packFiles(ex.files);
        this.seed = ex.info.seed;
      }
      const r = await RoomService.api('/api/rooms', {
        name: this.roomName,
        owner: this.owner,
        key: RoomService.key(),
        gamemode: this.gamemode,
        difficulty: this.difficulty,
        pvp: this.pvp,
        seed: this.seed,
        size: this.size
      });
      code = r.code;
      if (pack) {
        const mb = (pack.length / 1048576).toFixed(1);
        await RoomService.upload('/api/rooms/' + code + '/world?key=' + RoomService.key(), pack, f => {
          this.say(`正在上传存档… ${Math.round(f * 100)}%（${mb} MB）`);
        });
      }
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      this.game.joinRoom(code, this.owner);
    } catch (e) {
      // (a room whose save didn't arrive is not kept)
      if (code) RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + code + '/delete', {
        key: RoomService.key()
      }).catch(() => {});
      this.busy = false;
      this.say(e.message, true);
      this.loadCap();
      this.layout();
      if (e.gate) this.game.ui.open(Account.loggedIn ? new UnlockScreen(this.game, this, e.message, () => this.game.ui.open(this)) : new LoginScreen(this.game, () => this.game.ui.open(this)));
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    const nt = this.note;
    this.note = '';
    this.drawFields(ui);
    this.note = nt;
    const cap = this.cap;
    const line = !cap ? '' : cap.max ? `现在能开：最多 ${cap.max} 人的房间` : `现在开不了新房间：${cap.reason || '服务器满了'}`;
    Font.center(c, fitText(line, ui.w - 8), cx, 130, cap && !cap.max ? '#FF8080' : '#80FF80');
    Font.center(c, fitText(cap && !cap.max ? '可以先加入一个正在玩的公开房间' : '房间公开，所有人都能进；你是房主，能踢人、封禁、禁言', ui.w - 8), cx, 142, '#808080');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, cx, 222, this.noteColor);
  }
}

// picking the world of a new room: a new one, or a single-player save (new terrain only: the room's server generates
// the rest of the world the same way)
class SavePickScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '房间的世界');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.worlds = null;
    this.page = 0;
    this.load();
  }
  async load() {
    try {
      this.worlds = (await DB.listWorlds()).filter(w => w.gen === 2 && !w.flat);
    } catch (e) {
      this.worlds = [];
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 68 - 60) / 24));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      W = this.worlds || [],
      n = this.rows(),
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(W.length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    const pick = w => {
      const P = this.parent;
      P.save = w ? {
        id: w.id,
        name: w.name
      } : null;
      this.game.ui.open(P);
    };
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 38,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '新世界',
      onClick: () => pick(null)
    }];
    W.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((w, i) => this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 68 + i * 24,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: fitText(w.name, 190),
      onClick: () => pick(w)
    }));
    if (pages > 1) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 54,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '上一页',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: u.h - 54,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '下一页',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    if (this.worlds && !this.worlds.length) Font.center(ui.ctx, '没有能用的存档（只能用新版地形的单人存档）', ui.w / 2, 70, '#A0A0A0');else Font.center(ui.ctx, fitText('只能用新版地形的单人存档，最大 100 MB；房间里的进度不会回到单人存档', ui.w - 8), ui.w / 2, 22, '#909090');
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
class MyRoomsScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, name) {
    super(game, '我的房间', parent);
    this.name = name;
    this.rooms = null;
    this.confirm = null;
    this.load();
  }
  async load() {
    try {
      this.rooms = await RoomService.api('/api/rooms?key=' + RoomService.key());
      this.say(this.rooms.length ? '' : '你还没有建过房间');
    } catch (e) {
      this.rooms = [];
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    (this.rooms || []).slice(0, 5).forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = 44 + i * 30;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 64,
        y,
        w: 50,
        h: 20,
        label: '进入',
        blue: true,
        tip: ['你的房间：满员了也能进'],
        onClick: () => {
          this.game.ui.hideInput();
          this.game.joinRoom(r.code, this.name);
        }
      });
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 118,
        y,
        w: 50,
        h: 20,
        label: () => this.confirm === r.code ? '确定？' : '删除',
        onClick: () => this.del(r)
      });
    });
  }
  async del(r) {
    if (this.confirm !== r.code) {
      this.confirm = r.code;
      return;
    }
    this.confirm = null;
    try {
      await RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + r.code + '/delete', {
        key: RoomService.key()
      });
      this.say('已删除 ' + r.name);
      this.load();
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    if (!this.rooms) Font.center(c, '正在读取…', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
    (this.rooms || []).slice(0, 5).forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = 44 + i * 30;
      Font.draw(c, r.name, cx - 170, y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, `${r.code}  ${r.state === 'running' ? '运行中 ' + r.players.length + '/' + r.max : '休息中'}`, cx - 170, y + 12, '#909090');
    });
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, cx, ui.h - 52, this.noteColor);
  }
}

// 直接连接: a proxy's address (multiplayer/proxy on this computer, the LAN or Radmin: 开服给朋友.bat), not the room service.
// Only on pages opened over http (local / LAN); the published (https) game has rooms only.
class DirectConnectScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '直接连接');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.titleY = 20;
    const s = game.settings;
    this.url = s.netUrl || 'ws://' + (location.hostname || 'localhost') + ':8780';
    this.name = s.netName || 'Web' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000);
    this.field = 'name';
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.boxes = {
      name: {
        x: cx - 100,
        y: 60,
        w: 200,
        h: 20
      },
      url: {
        x: cx - 100,
        y: 106,
        w: 200,
        h: 20
      }
    };
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 140,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '加入服务器',
      onClick: () => this.join()
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.onEsc()
    }];
    this.focus(this.field);
  }
  focus(f) {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      b = this.boxes[f];
    this.field = f;
    u.showInput(b.x + 4, b.y + 6, b.w - 8, 10, this[f], () => this.join(), {
      onInput: v => {
        this[f] = v;
      },
      onEsc: () => this.onEsc(),
      max: f === 'name' ? 16 : 120
    });
  }
  join() {
    const g = this.game,
      name = this.name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
    if (!name) return;
    g.settings.netUrl = this.url.trim();
    g.settings.netName = name;
    g.saveSettings();
    g.ui.hideInput();
    g.joinServer(this.url.trim(), name);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    for (const f of ['name', 'url']) {
      const r = this.boxes[f];
      if (mx >= r.x && mx < r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my < r.y + r.h) {
        this.focus(f);
        return;
      }
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    Font.draw(c, '玩家名（英文字母、数字、下划线）', this.boxes.name.x, this.boxes.name.y - 11, '#A0A0A0');
    Font.draw(c, '联机中转地址（multiplayer/proxy）', this.boxes.url.x, this.boxes.url.y - 11, '#A0A0A0');
    for (const f of ['name', 'url']) {
      const r = this.boxes[f];
      ui.nine(this.field === f ? 'text_field_hl' : 'text_field', r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 1);
      if (this.field !== f) Font.draw(c, this[f], r.x + 4, r.y + 6, '#E0E0E0');
    }
    Font.center(c, '先启动 multiplayer/proxy 的联机中转（node src/proxy.js），它会连到 Minecraft 服务器', cx, 170, '#808080');
    Font.center(c, '目前可以：走动、挖掘、放置、战斗、聊天，用箱子、工作台、熔炉，和村民交易', cx, 182, '#808080');
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
}

// in a room: the code and the link to send, copied with one click; the owner can lock the room
// 房间 (pause menu, in a room): the invite code and link; the players - for the owner kick / ban / mute / member,
// for the others a report; the owner's setting (guests only look) and the banned list. (No locking: a room is open
// to anyone until it is full; the owner keeps someone out by banning.)
class RoomScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '房间');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#80FF80';
    this.info = null;
    this.page = 0;
    this.confirm = null;
    this.load();
  }
  get R() {
    return this.game.net && this.game.net.room;
  }
  get me() {
    return this.game.net && this.game.net.name || '';
  }
  async load() {
    const R = this.R;
    if (!R) return;
    try {
      this.info = await RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + R.code + (R.isOwner ? '?key=' + RoomService.key() : ''));
      R.guestMode = this.info.guestMode;
      R.players = this.info.players;
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#80FF80';
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 108 - 56) / 22));
  }
  // the owner's action on a player (or a setting): the service does it and answers with the room as it is now
  async act(action, name, value) {
    const R = this.R;
    try {
      this.info = await RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + R.code + '/manage', {
        key: RoomService.key(),
        action,
        name,
        value
      });
      R.guestMode = this.info.guestMode;
      R.max = this.info.max;
      this.say('已完成');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.confirm = null;
    this.layout();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      R = this.R,
      I = this.info,
      owner = !!(R && R.isOwner);
    this.widgets = [];
    if (!R) {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 100,
        y: u.h - 30,
        w: 200,
        h: 20,
        label: '完成',
        onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
      });
      return;
    }
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 160,
      y: 48,
      w: 78,
      h: 20,
      label: '复制邀请码',
      onClick: () => this.copy(R.code, '邀请码已复制')
    }, {
      x: cx - 78,
      y: 48,
      w: 78,
      h: 20,
      label: '复制链接',
      onClick: () => this.copy(RoomService.link(R.code), '链接已复制，发给朋友打开就能加入')
    });
    if (owner) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 4,
      y: 48,
      w: 96,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '访客：' + ((I && I.guestMode) === 'view' ? '只能看' : '能建造'),
      tip: ['只能看：不是成员的人进来是冒险模式，不能破坏和放置方块', '能建造：所有人都能建造'],
      onClick: () => this.act('guestMode', '', (I && I.guestMode) === 'view' ? 'build' : 'view')
    },
    // the room's size: the next one up, round to the smallest that still holds everyone in it
    {
      x: cx + 104,
      y: 48,
      w: 56,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '人数 ' + (I && I.max || R.max),
      tip: ['点一下换下一档人数上限', '不能少于房间里现在的人数'],
      enabled: !!(I && I.sizes),
      onClick: () => {
        const S = I.sizes,
          cur = I.max,
          n = (I.players || []).length,
          ok = S.filter(s => s >= n);
        this.act('size', '', ok.find(s => s > cur) || ok[0]);
      }
    });
    const players = I && I.players || R.players || [],
      n = this.rows(),
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(players.length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    players.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((p, i) => {
      const y = 96 + i * 22,
        isOwner = I && p.toLowerCase() === I.owner.toLowerCase(),
        lo = p.toLowerCase();
      if (owner && !isOwner) {
        const muted = I && (I.mutes || []).includes(lo),
          member = I && (I.members || []).includes(lo);
        this.widgets.push({
          x: cx - 20,
          y,
          w: 42,
          h: 18,
          label: () => this.confirm === 'kick:' + p ? '确定？' : '踢出',
          onClick: () => this.twice('kick:' + p, () => this.act('kick', p))
        }, {
          x: cx + 24,
          y,
          w: 42,
          h: 18,
          label: () => this.confirm === 'ban:' + p ? '确定？' : '封禁',
          tip: ['踢出并且以后不让他进这个房间'],
          onClick: () => this.twice('ban:' + p, () => this.act('ban', p))
        }, {
          x: cx + 68,
          y,
          w: 44,
          h: 18,
          label: muted ? '解除禁言' : '禁言',
          onClick: () => this.act(muted ? 'unmute' : 'mute', p)
        }, {
          x: cx + 114,
          y,
          w: 46,
          h: 18,
          label: member ? '取消成员' : '设为成员',
          tip: ['成员和房主有一样的游戏内权限：切换生存 / 创造、用命令', '但不能管理房间（踢人、封禁、设成员只有房主能做）'],
          onClick: () => this.act('member', p, !member)
        });
      } else if (!owner && p !== this.me) this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 114,
        y,
        w: 46,
        h: 18,
        label: '举报',
        onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new ReportScreen(this.game, this, p))
      });
    });
    if (pages > 1) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 114,
      y: 80,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 138,
      y: 80,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    });
    if (owner && I && (I.bans || []).length) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 160,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: `封禁名单（${I.bans.length}）…`,
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new BanListScreen(this.game, this))
    });
    if (typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.data && Account.data.super) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 10,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '管理员：管理房间…',
      gold: true,
      tip: ['关闭这个房间的服务器、删除房间、全服封禁玩家'],
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new AdminRoomScreen(this.game, this, R.code))
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100 + (owner && I && (I.bans || []).length ? 110 : 0),
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200 - (owner && I && (I.bans || []).length ? 110 : 0),
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    });
  }
  twice(k, f) {
    if (this.confirm === k) f();else {
      this.confirm = k;
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  async copy(s, msg) {
    this.say((await copyText(s)) ? msg : '复制失败：' + s, false);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      R = this.R,
      I = this.info;
    if (!R) {
      Font.center(c, '不在房间里', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    Font.center(c, fitText(`${R.name}　邀请码 ${R.code}　房主 ${R.owner}`, ui.w - 8), cx, 28, '#FFFF55');
    Font.center(c, R.isOwner ? '房间公开，所有人都能在列表里看到并进入' : '有人捣乱可以举报，房主也能踢人和封禁', cx, 38, '#909090');
    const players = I && I.players || R.players || [],
      n = this.rows();
    Font.draw(c, `玩家（${players.length}/${I && I.max || R.max}）`, cx - 160, 82, '#FFFFFF');
    players.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((p, i) => {
      const y = 96 + i * 22,
        lo = p.toLowerCase(),
        tags = [];
      if (I && lo === I.owner.toLowerCase()) tags.push('房主');else if (I && (I.members || []).includes(lo)) tags.push('成员');
      if (I && (I.mutes || []).includes(lo)) tags.push('禁言');
      if (p === this.me) tags.push('你');
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(cx - 160, y, 320, 18);
      const pn = typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics.preName(this.game, p) : p; // (a name prefix's icon, cosmetics.js)
      Font.draw(c, pn, cx - 157, y + 5, '#FFFFFF');
      if (tags.length) Font.draw(c, tags.join(' '), cx - 157 + Font.width(pn) + 6, y + 5, '#A0A0A0');
    });
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, cx, ui.h - 62, this.noteColor);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
// the owner's banned list: unban
class BanListScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '封禁名单');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 20;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      bans = this.parent.info && this.parent.info.bans || [];
    this.widgets = bans.slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => ({
      x: cx + 40,
      y: 44 + i * 22,
      w: 60,
      h: 18,
      label: '解除封禁',
      onClick: async () => {
        await this.parent.act('unban', b);
        this.layout();
      }
    }));
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const bans = this.parent.info && this.parent.info.bans || [];
    if (!bans.length) Font.center(ui.ctx, '没有封禁的人', ui.w / 2, 60, '#A0A0A0');
    bans.slice(0, 8).forEach((b, i) => Font.draw(ui.ctx, b, ui.w / 2 - 100, 49 + i * 22, '#FFFFFF'));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
// 管理房间 (a super administrator, from the public list or 房间 - the user 11-08): anyone's room - its server stopped
// (everyone in it out; whoever goes in again starts it), the room deleted, a player in it banned from the whole
// service (the account frozen, its address banned: 管理员 → 冻结名单 lifts it)
class AdminRoomScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, code) {
    super(game, '管理房间');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.code = code;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.info = null;
    this.gone = false;
    this.page = 0;
    this.confirm = null;
    this.busy = false;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#80FF80';
    this.load();
  }
  async load() {
    try {
      this.info = await RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + this.code);
    } catch (e) {
      this.info = null;
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#80FF80';
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 96 - 56) / 22));
  }
  twice(k, f) {
    if (this.confirm === k) {
      this.confirm = null;
      f();
    } else {
      this.confirm = k;
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  async room(action) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.layout();
    try {
      const j = await Account.api('/api/account/admin/room', {
        code: this.code,
        action
      });
      if (action === 'delete') {
        this.gone = true;
        this.info = null;
        this.say('房间已删除');
      } else {
        this.info = j.room;
        this.say('服务器已关闭，房间里的人都被请出了');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  async ban(name) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.layout();
    try {
      const j = await Account.api('/api/account/admin/freeze', {
        name
      });
      this.say(`已封禁 ${j.name}：账号冻结${j.ip ? `，IP 封禁 ${j.hours} 小时` : ''}（冻结名单里可以解除）`);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600));
      await this.load(); // (out of the room by then)
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      I = this.info,
      me = this.game.net && this.game.net.name || typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.name || '';
    const run = !!I && I.state !== 'stopped';
    this.widgets = [];
    if (!this.gone) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 160,
      y: 48,
      w: 100,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.confirm === 'stop' ? '确定关闭？' : '关闭服务器',
      enabled: run && !this.busy,
      tip: ['保存世界并关掉这个房间的服务器', '房间里的人都会被请出；之后有人进入会重新启动'],
      onClick: () => this.twice('stop', () => this.room('stop'))
    }, {
      x: cx - 56,
      y: 48,
      w: 100,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.confirm === 'delete' ? '确定删除？' : '删除房间',
      enabled: !!I && !this.busy,
      tip: ['删除这个房间和它的世界，不能恢复', '房间里的人都会被请出'],
      onClick: () => this.twice('delete', () => this.room('delete'))
    });
    const players = I && I.players || [],
      n = this.rows(),
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(players.length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    players.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((p, i) => {
      if (p === me) return;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 92,
        y: 96 + i * 22,
        w: 68,
        h: 18,
        label: () => this.confirm === 'ban:' + p ? '确定封禁？' : '全服封禁',
        enabled: !this.busy,
        tip: ['冻结这个玩家的账号，并封禁他的 IP', '他会被请出所有房间，以后也登录不了', '管理员 → 冻结名单 里可以解除'],
        onClick: () => this.twice('ban:' + p, () => this.ban(p))
      });
    });
    if (pages > 1) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 114,
      y: 80,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 138,
      y: 80,
      w: 22,
      h: 14,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.onEsc()
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      I = this.info,
      n = this.rows();
    if (this.gone) Font.center(c, '房间 ' + this.code + ' 已删除', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');else if (!I) Font.center(c, '正在读取…', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');else {
      const st = I.state === 'running' ? '运行中' : I.state === 'starting' ? '正在启动' : '休息中';
      Font.center(c, fitText(`${I.name}　邀请码 ${I.code}　房主 ${I.owner}　${st}`, ui.w - 8), cx, 30, '#FFFF55');
      const players = I.players || [];
      Font.draw(c, `玩家（${players.length}/${I.max}）`, cx - 160, 82, '#FFFFFF');
      if (!players.length) Font.draw(c, '房间里没有人', cx - 157, 101, '#909090');
      players.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((p, i) => {
        const y = 96 + i * 22;
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
        c.fillRect(cx - 160, y, 320, 18);
        Font.draw(c, fitText(p, 240), cx - 157, y + 5, '#FFFFFF');
      });
    }
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 44, this.noteColor);
  }
  onEsc() {
    const P = this.parent;
    if (P && P.load) {
      if (P instanceof MultiplayerScreen) P.list = null;
      P.load();
    }
    this.game.ui.open(P);
  }
}
// reporting a player: why, a few words; it goes to the service (and to us)
const REPORT_REASONS = [['cheat', '作弊'], ['abuse', '说脏话 / 刷屏'], ['grief', '破坏别人的建筑'], ['other', '其他']];
class ReportScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, target) {
    super(game, '举报 ' + target, parent);
    this.target = target;
    this.reason = 0;
    this.text = '';
    this.busy = false;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.fields = {};
    this.addField('text', cx - 120, 90, 240, '说明（可以不写，最多 300 字）', 300);
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 120,
      y: 50,
      w: 240,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '原因：' + REPORT_REASONS[this.reason][1],
      onClick: () => {
        this.reason = (this.reason + 1) % REPORT_REASONS.length;
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 120,
      y: 124,
      w: 118,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.busy ? '发送中…' : '举报',
      enabled: !this.busy && !this.sent,
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: 124,
      w: 118,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    this.focus('text');
  }
  async submit() {
    const g = this.game,
      R = g.net && g.net.room;
    if (!R) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.layout();
    try {
      await RoomService.api('/api/rooms/' + R.code + '/report', {
        key: RoomService.key(),
        from: g.net.name,
        target: this.target,
        reason: REPORT_REASONS[this.reason][0],
        text: this.text
      });
      this.sent = true;
      this.say('已举报，谢谢！我们会查看');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    this.drawFields(ui);
    Font.center(ui.ctx, '举报会连同房间和在场的玩家一起发给我们', ui.w / 2, 154, '#909090');
  }
}
const InviteScreen = RoomScreen; // (the old name)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server's entities beyond the first mobs: every mob drawn with the vanilla models (vmobs.js), item frames,
// paintings, armor stands, lead knots, projectiles, experience orbs, primed TNT, falling blocks, fishing
// bobbers, evoker fangs; their entity data (the proxy names the fields: variants, colours, tamed / sitting,
// saddles and armour from the equipment) applied to what the single player code draws.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const NET_DIR = [2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 1]; // vanilla Direction (down up north south west east) -> DIRS index
const NET_SPRITE = {
  snowball: 'snowball',
  egg: 'egg',
  blue_egg: 'blue_egg',
  brown_egg: 'brown_egg',
  ender_pearl: 'ender_pearl',
  eye_of_ender: 'ender_eye',

  lingering_potion: 'lingering_potion',

  small_fireball: 'fire_charge',

  wind_charge: 'wind_charge',
  breeze_wind_charge: 'wind_charge',
  firework_rocket: 'firework_rocket',
  llama_spit: null,
  ominous_item_spawner: null
};
const NET_QUIET = new Set(['marker', 'interaction', 'area_effect_cloud', 'item_display', 'block_display', 'text_display', 'lightning_bolt']);
// a projectile the server moves: flies on between updates the way vanilla's client does
function netShotTick() {
  this.savePrev();
  this.age++;
  if (this.lerpN > 0) {
    const k = 1 / this.lerpN;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += (this.netPos[i] - this.pos[i]) * k;
    this.lerpN--;
  } else if (this.netVel && !this.inGround) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += this.netVel[i];
    this.netVel[1] -= this.netGrav || 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.netVel[i] *= 0.99;
  }
  if (this.updateRot && this.netVel && !this.inGround) {
    const v = this.netVel;
    if (Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) > 1e-3) {
      this.vel = [...v];
      this.updateRot();
    }
  }
}
