<script>
/* ==== js/cmdblock.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Command blocks and the command block minecart, as vanilla's CommandBlock, CommandBlockEntity, BaseCommandBlock,
// MinecartCommandBlock and the two edit screens: impulse (脉冲) / chain (连锁) / repeat (循环), conditional (条件制约),
// needs redstone (红石控制) / always active (保持开启); a chain runs along the blocks' facing in the same tick; the
// success count is what a comparator reads (through a detector rail for the minecart); the last output with the
// time; /say from one says [@]. Game master blocks: only a creative player with cheats on (an operator on a
// server) places, breaks or opens them. Commands run as cmdrun.js's cmdExec with the block as the source.
// On a server the server runs them: the screens send set_command_block / set_command_minecart, the block's data
// comes when it is opened (ServerPlayer.openCommandBlock), the minecart's command in its entity data.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const CMD_MODE = {}; // block id -> its mode (CommandBlockEntity.Mode)
for (const [k, m] of [['command_block', 'redstone'], ['chain_command_block', 'sequence'], ['repeating_command_block', 'auto']]) if (BID[k] !== undefined) CMD_MODE[BID[k]] = m;
const CMD_BLOCK_OF = {
  redstone: 'command_block',
  sequence: 'chain_command_block',
  auto: 'repeating_command_block'
};
const CMD_MODE_CN = {
  sequence: '连锁',
  auto: '循环',
  redstone: '脉冲'
};
const GM_BLOCKS = new Set(['command_block', 'chain_command_block', 'repeating_command_block', 'structure_block', 'jigsaw', 'test_block', 'test_instance_block'].filter(k => BID[k] !== undefined).map(k => BID[k]));
for (const id in CMD_MODE) RS_IDS.add(+id);

// Player.canUseGameMasterBlocks: creative, and permission level 2 (cheats in single player)
Game.prototype.canUseGameMasterBlocks = function () {
  return this.mode === 'creative' && (this.net ? (this.net.opLevel | 0) >= 2 : !!this.cheats);
};
const cmdKey = (x, y, z) => x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
const cmdProp = (g, x, y, z, k) => Features.propOf(g.world.getBlock(x, y, z), g.world.getMeta(x, y, z), k);
const cmdConditional = (g, x, y, z) => cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'conditional') === 'true';
// the block entity (made like newBlockEntity: a chain command block starts always active)
Game.prototype.cmdEntity = function (x, y, z) {
  const k = cmdKey(x, y, z);
  let be = this.blockEntities.get(k);
  if (!be || be.type !== 'command_block') {
    be = {
      type: 'command_block',
      pos: [x, y, z],
      command: '',
      success: 0,
      output: '',
      track: true,
      auto: CMD_MODE[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] === 'sequence',
      powered: RS.neighborSignal(this, x, y, z),
      met: false
    };
    this.blockEntities.set(k, be);
  }
  return be;
};
// markConditionMet: a conditional one runs only when the command block behind it succeeded last time
function cmdMarkMet(g, be) {
  const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
  be.met = true;
  if (cmdConditional(g, x, y, z)) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'facing')],
      bx = x - v[0],
      by = y - v[1],
      bz = z - v[2];
    const o = CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(bx, by, bz)] !== undefined ? g.blockEntities.get(cmdKey(bx, by, bz)) : null;
    be.met = !!o && o.type === 'command_block' && o.success > 0;
  }
  return be.met;
}
const cmdStamp = () => {
  const d = new Date(),
    t = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `[${t(d.getHours())}:${t(d.getMinutes())}:${t(d.getSeconds())}] `;
};
// BaseCommandBlock.performCommand: once a tick at most; the source keeps the last output when it tracks output,
// and tells the operators in chat ([@: …], command_block_output)
const CMD_LAST = new WeakMap();
function cmdPerform(g, cb, where) {
  if (CMD_LAST.get(cb) === g.tickCount) return false;
  if (/^searge$/i.test(cb.command)) {
    cb.output = '#itzlipofutzli';
    cb.success = 1;
    return true;
  }
  cb.success = 0;
  if (g.rule('command_blocks_work') && cb.command) {
    cb.output = '';
    const src = {
      ...where,
      name: '@',
      say(m, always) {
        if (!cb.track) return;
        if (g.rule('send_command_feedback')) cb.output = cmdStamp() + m;
        if (!always && g.rule('command_block_output') && g.rule('send_command_feedback') && g.cheats) g.ui.message(`[@: ${m}]`, '#AAAAAA');
      },
      fail(m) {
        if (cb.track) cb.output = cmdStamp() + m;
      }
    };
    if (cmdExec(g, cb.command, src)) cb.success = 1;
  }
  CMD_LAST.set(cb, g.tickCount);
  return true;
}
const cmdBlockSource = (g, x, y, z) => ({
  pos: [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5],
  rot: [{
    north: Math.PI,
    south: 0,
    west: Math.PI / 2,
    east: -Math.PI / 2
  }[cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'facing')] || 0, 0]
});
// CommandBlock.execute and executeChain: the chain command blocks in front, each turning the way it faces
function cmdExecute(g, x, y, z, be) {
  if (be.command) cmdPerform(g, be, cmdBlockSource(g, x, y, z));else be.success = 0;
  let dir = cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'facing'),
    n = g.rule('max_command_sequence_length');
  while (n-- > 0) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[dir];
    x += v[0];
    y += v[1];
    z += v[2];
    if (CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] !== 'sequence') break;
    const c = g.blockEntities.get(cmdKey(x, y, z));
    if (!c || c.type !== 'command_block') break;
    if (c.powered || c.auto) {
      if (cmdMarkMet(g, c)) {
        if (!cmdPerform(g, c, cmdBlockSource(g, x, y, z))) break;
        RS.wake(x, y, z);
      } else if (cmdConditional(g, x, y, z)) c.success = 0;
    }
    dir = cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'facing');
  }
}
// setPoweredAndUpdate: power coming on starts an impulse or repeating block that needs redstone (next tick)
function cmdSetPowered(g, x, y, z, be, p) {
  if (p === be.powered) return;
  be.powered = p;
  if (!p || be.auto || CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] === 'sequence') return;
  cmdMarkMet(g, be);
  g.world.schedule(x, y, z, 1);
}
// setAutomatic / onModeSwitch: switched to always active, or made a repeating one that is on, it starts
function cmdSetAuto(g, be, auto) {
  const was = be.auto,
    [x, y, z] = be.pos;
  be.auto = auto;
  if (!was && auto && !be.powered && CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] !== 'sequence') {
    cmdMarkMet(g, be);
    g.world.schedule(x, y, z, 1);
  }
}
function cmdModeSwitch(g, be) {
  const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
  if (CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] === 'auto' && (be.powered || be.auto)) {
    cmdMarkMet(g, be);
    g.world.schedule(x, y, z, 1);
  }
}

// ---- the redstone side: neighbours, the scheduled tick, what a comparator reads ----
const _cmdRsUpdate = RS.update;
RS.update = function (g, x, y, z) {
  if (CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] === undefined || !g.world.isLoaded(x, z)) return _cmdRsUpdate.call(this, g, x, y, z);
  const fresh = !g.blockEntities.has(cmdKey(x, y, z)),
    be = g.cmdEntity(x, y, z);
  if (!fresh) cmdSetPowered(g, x, y, z, be, RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z));
};
const _cmdRsTick = RS.tick;
RS.tick = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const mode = CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)];
  if (mode === undefined) return _cmdRsTick.call(this, g, x, y, z);
  const be = g.blockEntities.get(cmdKey(x, y, z));
  if (!be || be.type !== 'command_block') return true;
  const was = be.met;
  if (mode === 'auto') {
    cmdMarkMet(g, be);
    if (was) cmdExecute(g, x, y, z, be);else if (cmdConditional(g, x, y, z)) be.success = 0;
    if (be.powered || be.auto) g.world.schedule(x, y, z, 1);
  } else if (mode === 'redstone') {
    if (was) cmdExecute(g, x, y, z, be);else if (cmdConditional(g, x, y, z)) be.success = 0;
  }
  RS.wake(x, y, z); // (updateNeighbourForOutputSignal: comparators look again)
  return true;
};
const _cmdRsAnalog = RS.analog;
RS.analog = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (CMD_MODE[id] !== undefined) {
    const be = g.blockEntities.get(cmdKey(x, y, z));
    return be && be.type === 'command_block' ? Math.min(15, be.success) : 0;
  }
  // a detector rail reads a command block minecart on it first (DetectorRailBlock.getAnalogOutputSignal)
  if (BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].key === 'detector_rail' && Features.propOf(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'powered') === 'true') {
    const carts = RS.entitiesIn(g, [x + 0.2, y, z + 0.2, x + 0.8, y + 0.8, z + 0.8], e => e instanceof Minecart && e.kind === 'command_block');
    if (carts.length) return Math.min(15, cartCmd(carts[0]).success);
  }
  return _cmdRsAnalog.call(this, g, x, y, z);
};

// ---- placing, breaking, using (game master blocks) ----
// setPlacedBy: placed by a player it starts afresh (tracking output as send_command_feedback says) and looks at
// the power it has; a game master block only goes down for someone who can use it
const _cmdPlaceAt = Game.prototype.placeAt;
Game.prototype.placeAt = function (x, y, z, id, ...rest) {
  if (GM_BLOCKS.has(id) && !this.canUseGameMasterBlocks()) return;
  const r = _cmdPlaceAt.call(this, x, y, z, id, ...rest);
  if (!this.net && CMD_MODE[id] !== undefined && this.world.getBlock(x, y, z) === id) {
    this.blockEntities.delete(cmdKey(x, y, z));
    const be = this.cmdEntity(x, y, z);
    be.powered = false;
    be.track = !!this.rule('send_command_feedback');
    cmdSetPowered(this, x, y, z, be, RS.neighborSignal(this, x, y, z));
  }
  return r;
};
const _cmdBreak = Game.prototype.breakBlock;
Game.prototype.breakBlock = function (x, y, z, natural, ...rest) {
  if (!natural && this.mode === 'creative' && GM_BLOCKS.has(this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)) && !this.canUseGameMasterBlocks()) return false;
  return _cmdBreak.call(this, x, y, z, natural, ...rest);
};
for (const id in CMD_MODE) BLOCKS[id].onUse = (g, x, y, z) => {
  if (!g.canUseGameMasterBlocks()) return false;
  g.ui.open(cmdBlockScreen(g, x, y, z));
  return true;
};

// handleSetCommandBlock: the mode picks the block (facing kept), then the command, output, trigger
function cmdApply(g, x, y, z, d) {
  var _BID$CMD_BLOCK_OF$d$m;
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (CMD_MODE[id] === undefined) return;
  const be = g.cmdEntity(x, y, z),
    old = CMD_MODE[id],
    nid = (_BID$CMD_BLOCK_OF$d$m = BID[CMD_BLOCK_OF[d.mode]]) !== null && _BID$CMD_BLOCK_OF$d$m !== void 0 ? _BID$CMD_BLOCK_OF$d$m : id;
  let nm = Features.withProp(nid, 0, 'facing', cmdProp(g, x, y, z, 'facing'));
  nm = Features.withProp(nid, nm, 'conditional', d.cond ? 'true' : 'false');
  if (nid !== id || nm !== w.getMeta(x, y, z)) {
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, nid, nm);
    g.blockEntities.set(cmdKey(x, y, z), be);
    g.flushMesh && g.flushMesh();
  }
  be.command = d.command;
  be.success = 0;
  be.track = d.track;
  if (!d.track) be.output = '';
  cmdSetAuto(g, be, d.auto);
  if (old !== d.mode) cmdModeSwitch(g, be);
  if (d.command) g.ui.message(g.rule('command_blocks_work') ? `成功设置命令：${d.command}` : `成功设置命令：${d.command}，但命令方块仍被禁用`);
}
function cmdBlockScreen(g, x, y, z) {
  const be = g.cmdEntity(x, y, z),
    id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
  return new CommandBlockScreen(g, {
    command: be.command,
    output: be.output,
    track: be.track,
    mode: CMD_MODE[id],
    cond: cmdConditional(g, x, y, z),
    auto: be.auto,
    valid: () => CMD_MODE[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] !== undefined,
    apply: d => cmdApply(g, x, y, z, d)
  });
}

// ---- the command block minecart: runs on a powered activator rail (every 4 ticks at most), drops a minecart ----
function cartCmd(c) {
  return c.cmd || (c.cmd = {
    command: '',
    success: 0,
    output: '',
    track: true
  });
}
const _cmdOnRail = Minecart.prototype.moveOnRail;
Minecart.prototype.moveOnRail = function (bx, by, bz, id) {
  const r = _cmdOnRail.call(this, bx, by, bz, id);
  if (this.kind === 'command_block' && !this.game.net && !this.dead && BLOCKS[id].key === 'activator_rail' && Features.propOf(id, this.world.getMeta(bx, by, bz), 'powered') === 'true' && this.age - (this.cmdAt || 0) >= 4) {
    cmdPerform(this.game, cartCmd(this), {
      pos: [...this.pos],
      rot: [this.yaw, this.pitch || 0],
      entity: this
    });
    this.cmdAt = this.age;
  }
  return r;
};
const _cmdCartUse = Minecart.prototype.interact;
Minecart.prototype.interact = function (p, held) {
  if (this.kind !== 'command_block') return _cmdCartUse.call(this, p, held);
  if (!this.game.canUseGameMasterBlocks()) return false;
  this.game.ui.open(cartScreen(this.game, this));
  return true;
};
const _cmdCartDrop = Minecart.prototype.dropSelf;
Minecart.prototype.dropSelf = function () {
  if (this.kind !== 'command_block') return _cmdCartDrop.call(this);
  this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], makeStack('minecart'));
};
const _cmdCartSave = Minecart.prototype.saveData,
  _cmdCartLoad = Minecart.prototype.loadData;
Minecart.prototype.saveData = function () {
  const d = _cmdCartSave.call(this);
  if (this.kind === 'command_block') d.cmd = cartCmd(this);
  return d;
};
Minecart.prototype.loadData = function (d) {
  _cmdCartLoad.call(this, d);
  if (d && d.cmd) this.cmd = {
    ...cartCmd(this),
    ...d.cmd
  };
};
function cartScreen(g, cart) {
  const cb = cartCmd(cart);
  return new CommandBlockScreen(g, {
    cart: true,
    command: cb.command,
    output: cb.output,
    track: cb.track,
    valid: () => !cart.dead,
    apply: d => {
      if (g.net) {
        g.net.send({
          t: 'cmdcart',
          id: cart.netId,
          command: d.command,
          track: d.track
        });
        return;
      }
      cb.command = d.command;
      cb.success = 0;
      cb.track = d.track;
      if (!d.track) cb.output = '';
      if (d.command) g.ui.message(`成功设置命令：${d.command}`);
    }
  });
}

// ---- the edit screen (AbstractCommandBlockEditScreen / CommandBlockEditScreen / MinecartCommandBlockEditScreen) ----
// view: { command, output, track, mode, cond, auto, cart, ready (false: waiting for the server's data), valid(), apply(d) }
class CommandBlockScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, view) {
    super(game, null);
    this.v = view;
    this.pauses = !game.net;
    this.command = view.command || '';
    this.output = view.output || '';
    this.track = view.track !== false;
    this.mode = view.mode || 'redstone';
    this.cond = !!view.cond;
    this.auto = !!view.auto;
    this.ready = view.ready !== false;
  }
  // updateGui: the server's data came
  fill(d) {
    Object.assign(this, d);
    this.ready = true;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  get prevY() {
    return this.v.cart ? 150 : 135;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = Math.floor(u.w / 2),
      on = this.ready,
      by = Math.floor(u.h / 4) + 132;
    this.field = {
      x: cx - 150,
      y: 50,
      w: 300,
      h: 20
    };
    this.prev = {
      x: cx - 150,
      y: this.prevY,
      w: 276,
      h: 20
    };
    const W = [{
      x: cx + 130,
      y: this.prevY,
      w: 20,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.track ? 'O' : 'X',
      enabled: on,
      onClick: () => {
        this.track = !this.track;
      }
    }];
    if (!this.v.cart) {
      const NEXT = {
        sequence: 'auto',
        auto: 'redstone',
        redstone: 'sequence'
      };
      W.push({
        x: cx - 154,
        y: 165,
        w: 100,
        h: 20,
        label: () => CMD_MODE_CN[this.mode],
        enabled: on,
        onClick: () => {
          this.mode = NEXT[this.mode];
        }
      });
      W.push({
        x: cx - 50,
        y: 165,
        w: 100,
        h: 20,
        label: () => this.cond ? '条件制约' : '不受制约',
        enabled: on,
        onClick: () => {
          this.cond = !this.cond;
        }
      });
      W.push({
        x: cx + 54,
        y: 165,
        w: 100,
        h: 20,
        label: () => this.auto ? '保持开启' : '红石控制',
        enabled: on,
        onClick: () => {
          this.auto = !this.auto;
        }
      });
    }
    W.push({
      x: cx - 154,
      y: by,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      enabled: on,
      onClick: () => this.done()
    });
    W.push({
      x: cx + 4,
      y: by,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '取消',
      onClick: () => this.cancel()
    });
    this.widgets = W;
    u.showInput(this.field.x + 4, this.field.y + 6, this.field.w - 8, 10, this.command, () => this.done(), {
      onInput: v => {
        this.command = v;
      },
      onEsc: () => this.cancel(),
      max: 32500
    });
  }
  done() {
    if (!this.ready) return;
    this.v.apply({
      command: this.command,
      mode: this.mode,
      track: this.track,
      cond: this.cond,
      auto: this.auto
    });
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
  cancel() {
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.cancel();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    if (this.v.valid && !this.v.valid()) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (ui.screen === this) ui.close();
      }, 0);
      return;
    }
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = Math.floor(ui.w / 2);
    Font.center(c, '设置此方块的控制台命令', cx, 20, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.draw(c, '控制台命令', cx - 149, 40, '#A0A0A0');
    ui.nine('text_field_hl', this.field.x, this.field.y, this.field.w, this.field.h, 1);
    // the previous output (shown only when there is one; "-" while output isn't tracked)
    const out = this.track ? this.output : '-';
    if (out) {
      Font.draw(c, '上一个输出', cx - 149, 75 + 46 + this.prevY - 135 + 4, '#A0A0A0');
      const r = this.prev;
      ui.nine('text_field', r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 1);
      let s = out;
      while (s && Font.width(s) > r.w - 8) s = s.slice(0, -1);
      Font.draw(c, s, r.x + 4, r.y + 6, '#707070');
    }
  }
}

// ---- /setblock with the block's data: command_block{Command:"say hi",auto:1b} ----
// a small SNBT reader: compounds, lists, quoted or plain strings, numbers with their suffixes, true / false
function cmdSnbt(s) {
  let i = 0;
  const ws = () => {
    while (/\s/.test(s[i] || '')) i++;
  };
  const val = () => {
    ws();
    const ch = s[i];
    if (ch === '{') {
      i++;
      const o = {};
      for (ws(); s[i] !== '}'; ws()) {
        const k = key();
        ws();
        if (s[i++] !== ':') cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
        o[k] = val();
        ws();
        if (s[i] === ',') i++;else if (s[i] !== '}') cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
      }
      i++;
      return o;
    }
    if (ch === '[') {
      i++;
      const a = [];
      ws();
      if (/^[BIL];/.test(s.slice(i, i + 2))) i += 2;
      for (ws(); s[i] !== ']'; ws()) {
        a.push(val());
        ws();
        if (s[i] === ',') i++;else if (s[i] !== ']') cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
      }
      i++;
      return a;
    }
    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") return str();
    const m = /^[^,}\]\s]+/.exec(s.slice(i));
    if (!m) cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
    i += m[0].length;
    const t = m[0];
    if (t === 'true') return 1;
    if (t === 'false') return 0;
    const n = /^(-?\d*\.?\d+(?:e-?\d+)?)[bslfdBSLFD]?$/.exec(t);
    return n ? Number(n[1]) : t;
  };
  const key = () => {
    if (s[i] === '"' || s[i] === "'") return str();
    const m = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+/.exec(s.slice(i));
    if (!m) cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
    i += m[0].length;
    return m[0];
  };
  const str = () => {
    const q = s[i++];
    let r = '';
    while (i < s.length && s[i] !== q) {
      if (s[i] === '\\') i++;
      r += s[i++];
    }
    i++;
    return r;
  };
  const v = val();
  return v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : cmdFail('无效的数据标签');
}
const _cmdSetblockRun = CMD_RUN.setblock;
CMD_RUN.setblock = function (ctx, a) {
  const m = a[3] && /^([^{]*)(\{[\s\S]*\})$/.exec(a[3]);
  if (!m) return _cmdSetblockRun.call(this, ctx, a);
  const data = cmdSnbt(m[2]),
    b = [...a];
  b[3] = m[1];
  _cmdSetblockRun.call(this, ctx, b);
  const [x, y, z] = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2]);
  if (CMD_MODE[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)] === undefined) return;
  // (CommandBlockEntity.loadAdditional; setAutomatic starts an always-active impulse or repeating one)
  const be = this.cmdEntity(x, y, z);
  if (typeof data.Command === 'string') be.command = data.Command;
  if (data.SuccessCount !== undefined) be.success = data.SuccessCount | 0;
  if (data.TrackOutput !== undefined) be.track = !!data.TrackOutput;
  if (typeof data.LastOutput === 'string') be.output = data.LastOutput;
  if (data.powered !== undefined) be.powered = !!data.powered;
  if (data.conditionMet !== undefined) be.met = !!data.conditionMet;
  if (data.auto !== undefined) cmdSetAuto(this, be, !!data.auto);
};

// ---- on a server ----
// the permission level comes as entity events 24-28 for the player (op levels 0-4)
const _cmdNetMsg = NetClient.prototype.onMessage;
NetClient.prototype.onMessage = function (m) {
  if (m.t === 'status' && m.id === this.eid && m.s >= 24 && m.s <= 28) this.opLevel = m.s - 24;
  const r = _cmdNetMsg.call(this, m);
  // a command block's data, sent when it is opened: it fills the waiting screen
  if (m.t === 'be') for (const [x, y, z, b] of m.list) {
    const sc = this.g.ui.screen;
    if (!b.cmd || !(sc instanceof CommandBlockScreen) || !sc.v.at || sc.v.at.join() !== [x, y - this.minY, z].join()) continue;
    const w = this.g.world,
      by = y - this.minY;
    sc.fill({
      command: b.cmd.command,
      output: b.cmd.output,
      track: b.cmd.track,
      auto: b.cmd.auto,
      mode: CMD_MODE[w.getBlock(x, by, z)] || 'redstone',
      cond: cmdConditional(this.g, x, by, z)
    });
  }
  return r;
};
// the minecart's command and last output are entity data
const _cmdNetMeta = netApplyMeta;
netApplyMeta = function (net, e, m) {
  const r = _cmdNetMeta(net, e, m);
  if (e instanceof Minecart && e.kind === 'command_block') {
    const cb = cartCmd(e);
    if (m.command_name !== undefined) cb.command = m.command_name || '';
    if (m.last_output !== undefined) cb.output = m.last_output || '';
  }
  return r;
};
// using one opens the screen here, like vanilla's client (the server sends the block's data back)
const _cmdNetUse = Game.prototype.netUse;
Game.prototype.netUse = function () {
  const t = this.target,
    e = this.targetEntity,
    p = this.player,
    n = this.net;
  const r = _cmdNetUse.call(this);
  if (!this.canUseGameMasterBlocks()) return r;
  if (e && e instanceof Minecart && e.kind === 'command_block') this.ui.open(cartScreen(this, e));else if (!e && t && CMD_MODE[t.id] !== undefined && !(p.sneaking && p.inv.held)) {
    const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
      w = this.world;
    this.ui.open(new CommandBlockScreen(this, {
      at: [x, y, z],
      ready: false,
      mode: CMD_MODE[t.id],
      cond: cmdConditional(this, x, y, z),
      valid: () => CMD_MODE[w.getBlock(x, y, z)] !== undefined,
      apply: d => n.send({
        t: 'cmdblock',
        x,
        y: y + n.minY,
        z,
        command: d.command,
        mode: d.mode,
        track: d.track,
        cond: d.cond,
        auto: d.auto
      })
    }));
  }
  return r;
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/telemetry.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Statistics and feedback (multiplayer/TELEMETRY_PLAN.md). Anonymous play and performance data goes to the room
// service (POST /api/telemetry) every few minutes and when the page closes; nothing about who the player is (an
// install id that is a random number, no names, no chat, no IP - the service keeps only a salted hash of it).
// On by default; Options -> 遥测数据 turns it off. Kept cheap: one fixed histogram of frame times a minute, a
// handful of counters, no work in a frame beyond a few additions.
// What is sent: the device (GPU, cores, memory, screen, refresh, browser, touch, inside the bilibili app), load
// times, a point a minute (frame time median / 95th / 99th, 1% low, main thread / chunk / render / GPU time,
// memory, entities, chunks, view distance, dynamic resolution, preset, single player or a room, dimension),
// stalls over 100 ms and what was going on, errors (message and file:line, no addresses), the screens opened
// and commands used (by name), deaths, worlds loaded; on a server the round trip times, disconnects and how long
// the room took to start.
// Feedback (FeedbackScreen): a kind, a description, optionally a screenshot, with the same device and recent
// performance data, to POST /api/feedback (the service limits it per IP).
// A page served from this machine (localhost) sends nothing unless ?rooms= points at a test service - testing
// here must not mix into the real data.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const TELEMETRY_V = 1;
const GAME_BUILD = '2026.11.13s';
const Telemetry = {
  g: null,
  sid: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10),
  seq: 0,
  t0: performance.now(),
  hist: new Uint16Array(201),
  frames: 0,
  sum: {
    cpu: 0,
    chunk: 0,
    render: 0,
    gpu: 0,
    gpuN: 0
  },
  minuteAt: 0,
  playMs: 0,
  afkMs: 0,
  points: [],
  stalls: [],
  errors: new Map(),
  counts: {},
  events: [],
  rtt: [],
  lastFlush: performance.now(),
  pings: new Map(),
  pingSeq: 0,
  lastPing: 0,
  prevState: null,
  loadStart: 0,
  // where the data goes, and whether it may go there
  base() {
    return typeof RoomService !== 'undefined' ? RoomService.base() : '';
  },
  on() {
    const g = this.g;
    if (!g || g.settings.telemetry === false || typeof Live !== 'undefined' && Live.get('client.telemetry', true) === false || !/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) || !this.base()) return false;
    // (*.localhost / *.test too: test pages on per-test origins sent their numbers to the live service, and its origin
    // check banned the developer's own address, 2026-11-03)
    const local = /^(localhost|127\.|\[::1\]|192\.168\.|10\.)/.test(location.hostname) || /\.(localhost|test)$/.test(location.hostname);
    return !local || new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('rooms');
  },
  // this browser's anonymous id (a random number kept in the page's storage), and whether it is new here
  install() {
    if (this._id) return this._id;
    let id = null,
      fresh = false;
    try {
      id = localStorage.getItem('mcjs-tid');
      if (!id) {
        id = [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(8))].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
        localStorage.setItem('mcjs-tid', id);
        fresh = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      id = 'nostore-' + this.sid;
    }
    this._fresh = fresh;
    return this._id = id;
  },
  device() {
    const g = this.g,
      ua = navigator.userAgent;
    const browser = /Edg\//.test(ua) ? 'edge' : /OPR\//.test(ua) ? 'opera' : /Firefox\//.test(ua) ? 'firefox' : /Chrome\//.test(ua) ? 'chrome' : /Safari\//.test(ua) ? 'safari' : 'other';
    const os = /Android/.test(ua) ? 'android' : /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) ? 'ios' : /Windows/.test(ua) ? 'windows' : /Mac OS/.test(ua) ? 'mac' : /Linux/.test(ua) ? 'linux' : 'other';
    let gpu = '';
    try {
      gpu = PerfMon.gpuName(g.renderer.gl);
    } catch (e) {}
    return {
      gpu: String(gpu).slice(0, 120),
      cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0,
      mem: navigator.deviceMemory || 0,
      sw: screen.width,
      sh: screen.height,
      dpr: Math.round((window.devicePixelRatio || 1) * 100) / 100,
      hz: g.pacer ? Math.round(1000 / g.pacer.refresh) : 0,
      browser,
      bver: (ua.match(/(?:Chrome|Firefox|Version)\/(\d+)/) || [])[1] || '',
      os,
      touch: typeof TouchDevice !== 'undefined' ? TouchDevice.kind : '',
      bili: /BiliApp|bili-/i.test(ua),
      lang: navigator.language || ''
    };
  },
  count(k, n = 1) {
    if (Object.keys(this.counts).length < 300 || this.counts[k] !== undefined) this.counts[k] = (this.counts[k] || 0) + n;
  },
  event(type, data) {
    if (this.events.length < 200) this.events.push({
      t: Math.round((performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000),
      type,
      ...data
    });
  },
  error(where, msg, stack) {
    // (just the message and the first file:line - no page address, nothing typed by the player)
    const at = String(stack || '').split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).find(s => /\.js:\d+/.test(s)) || '';
    const loc = (at.match(/([\w.-]+\.js):(\d+)/) || []).slice(1, 3).join(':');
    const k = (where ? where + ': ' : '') + String(msg || '').replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/g, '<url>').slice(0, 200) + (loc ? ' @' + loc : '');
    const e = this.errors.get(k);
    if (e) e.n++;else if (this.errors.size < 50) this.errors.set(k, {
      n: 1,
      first: Math.round((performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000)
    });
  },
  // every frame (perf.js PerfMon.frame): a few additions while playing
  frame(dt, cpu, chunk, render) {
    const g = this.g;
    if (!g) return;
    if (g.state !== this.prevState) this.stateChanged(this.prevState, g.state);
    if (document.hidden) {
      this.away = true;
      return;
    }
    // the first frame back from a hidden tab carries the whole time away (a 36 s "stall" in the first real data);
    // a frame of more than 10 s is a suspended page, not a stall either
    if (this.away || dt > 10000) {
      this.away = false;
      return;
    }
    if (g.state !== 'play' || g.ui.screen && g.ui.screen.pauses) return;
    // (nor a frame held to 30 / 10 by the inactivity limit, or the one after: perf.js FramePacer.cappedFrame. Its time
    // still counts as played - the session's play time meant that before the limit came)
    if (g.pacer && g.pacer.cappedFrame) {
      this.afkMs += dt;
      return;
    }
    this.hist[Math.min(200, dt | 0)]++;
    this.frames++;
    this.playMs += dt;
    this.sum.cpu += cpu;
    this.sum.chunk += chunk;
    this.sum.render += render;
    if (PerfMon.gpuOn && PerfMon.lastGpu != null) {
      this.sum.gpu += PerfMon.lastGpu;
      this.sum.gpuN++;
    }
    if (dt > 100 && this.stalls.length < 100) this.stalls.push({
      t: Math.round((performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000),
      ms: Math.round(dt),
      cpu: Math.round(cpu),
      chunk: Math.round(chunk),
      ents: g.entities ? g.entities.length : 0,
      dim: g.dim,
      net: !!g.net,
      screen: g.ui.screen ? g.ui.screen.constructor.name : ''
    });
    if (this.playMs - this.minuteAt >= 60000) {
      this.minuteAt = this.playMs;
      this.point();
    }
  },
  stateChanged(from, to) {
    const now = performance.now();
    this.prevState = to;
    Crumbs.mark('s:' + to);
    if (to === 'title' && !this.titleAt) {
      this.titleAt = now;
      this.event('title', {
        ms: Math.round(now)
      });
    }
    if (to === 'loading' || to === 'switching') this.loadStart = now;
    if (to === 'play' && this.loadStart) {
      this.event('enter', {
        ms: Math.round(now - this.loadStart),
        net: !!this.g.net,
        dim: this.g.dim
      });
      this.loadStart = 0;
    }
  },
  // one minute of play: the frame time distribution and what the game was doing
  point() {
    const g = this.g,
      h = this.hist,
      n = this.frames;
    if (!n) return;
    const pct = q => {
      let k = Math.ceil(n * q),
        i = 0;
      for (; i < 201; i++) {
        k -= h[i];
        if (k <= 0) break;
      }
      return i;
    };
    const mem = performance.memory ? Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576) : null;
    const s = g.settings;
    this.points.push({
      m: Math.round(this.playMs / 60000),
      fps: Math.round(n / (this.playMs - (this.lastPointMs || 0)) * 1000 * 10) / 10,
      p50: pct(0.5),
      p95: pct(0.95),
      p99: pct(0.99),
      cpu: +(this.sum.cpu / n).toFixed(2),
      chunk: +(this.sum.chunk / n).toFixed(2),
      render: +(this.sum.render / n).toFixed(2),
      gpu: this.sum.gpuN ? +(this.sum.gpu / this.sum.gpuN).toFixed(2) : null,
      mem,
      ents: g.entities ? g.entities.length : 0,
      chunks: g.world && g.world.chunks ? g.world.chunks.size : 0,
      rd: s.renderDist,
      dyn: typeof DynRes !== 'undefined' ? DynRes.scale : 1,
      res: s.resScale,
      preset: s.preset || '',
      shaders: s.shaders || 0,
      maxFps: s.maxFps || 0,
      vsync: s.vsync !== false,
      lim: g.pacer ? g.pacer.playLimit : 0,
      // (the limit in effect: maxFps 0 is 60 on a 90/120 Hz phone, -1 跟随屏幕; 0 = the screen's rate)
      mode: g.net ? 'room' : 'single',
      dim: g.dim,
      gm: g.mode
    });
    this.lastPointMs = this.playMs;
    h.fill(0);
    this.frames = 0;
    this.sum = {
      cpu: 0,
      chunk: 0,
      render: 0,
      gpu: 0,
      gpuN: 0
    };
    if (this.points.length > 60) this.points.shift();
  },
  packet(final) {
    const net = this.rtt.length ? {
      rtt: this.rttSummary()
    } : null;
    const p = {
      v: TELEMETRY_V,
      kind: 'session',
      id: this.install(),
      sid: this.sid,
      seq: this.seq++,
      build: GAME_BUILD,
      final: !!final,
      fresh: !!this._fresh,
      dur: Math.round((performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000),
      play: Math.round((this.playMs + this.afkMs) / 1000),
      dev: this.seq === 1 ? this.device() : undefined,
      points: this.points,
      stalls: this.stalls,
      errors: [...this.errors].map(([k, e]) => ({
        k,
        ...e
      })),
      counts: this.counts,
      events: this.events,
      net
    };
    this.points = [];
    this.stalls = [];
    this.errors = new Map();
    this.counts = {};
    this.events = [];
    this.rtt = [];
    return p;
  },
  rttSummary() {
    const s = [...this.rtt].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return {
      n: s.length,
      p50: s[s.length >> 1],
      p95: s[Math.floor(s.length * 0.95)],
      max: s[s.length - 1]
    };
  },
  hasData() {
    return this.points.length || this.stalls.length || this.errors.size || this.events.length || Object.keys(this.counts).length || this.rtt.length;
  },
  // a packet every 5 minutes (a minute's point is made first if one is half done); the last one as the page goes
  flush(final) {
    if (!this.on()) return;
    if (final && this.frames > 600) this.point();
    if (!this.hasData() && this.seq > 0 && !final) return;
    const body = JSON.stringify(this.packet(final)),
      url = this.base() + '/api/telemetry';
    if (body.length > 120000) return;
    try {
      if (final && navigator.sendBeacon) navigator.sendBeacon(url, new Blob([body], {
        type: 'text/plain'
      }));else fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        body,
        keepalive: body.length < 60000,
        mode: 'cors'
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {}
    this.lastFlush = performance.now();
  },
  // a second's upkeep: pings on a server, the five-minute packet
  tick() {
    const g = this.g,
      now = performance.now();
    if (g && g.net && now - this.lastPing > 10000 && g.net.ws && g.net.ws.readyState === 1) {
      this.lastPing = now;
      const i = ++this.pingSeq;
      this.pings.set(i, now);
      g.net.send({
        t: 'ping',
        i
      });
      if (this.pings.size > 20) this.pings.delete(this.pings.keys().next().value);
    }
    if (now - this.lastFlush > 300000) this.flush(false);
  },
  init(g) {
    this.g = g;
    this.prevState = g.state;
    setInterval(() => {
      try {
        this.tick();
      } catch (e) {}
    }, 1000);
    addEventListener('pagehide', () => this.flush(true));
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) this.flush(false);
    });
    addEventListener('error', e => this.error('page', e.message, e.error && e.error.stack || (e.filename ? `${e.filename}:${e.lineno}` : '')));
    addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => this.error('promise', e.reason && e.reason.message || String(e.reason), e.reason && e.reason.stack));
    try {
      g.renderer.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => {
        this.event('contextlost', {});
        Crumbs.mark('ctx');
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    this.install();
    if (this._fresh) this.event('firstrun', {});
    try {
      Crumbs.init(g);
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      Instances.init(g);
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      SensorProbe.init();
    } catch (e) {}
    // (the title screen was already up when this started: the time it took from opening the page)
    if (g.state === 'title' && !this.titleAt) {
      this.titleAt = performance.now();
      this.event('title', {
        ms: Math.round(this.titleAt)
      });
    }
  }
};

// ---- the hooks ----
(() => {
  const _init = Game.prototype.init;
  Game.prototype.init = async function (...a) {
    const r = await _init.apply(this, a);
    try {
      Telemetry.init(this);
    } catch (e) {}
    return r;
  };
  const _frame = PerfMon.frame;
  PerfMon.frame = function (dt, cpu, chunk, g) {
    const r = _frame.call(this, dt, cpu, chunk, g);
    try {
      Telemetry.frame(dt, cpu, chunk, this.renderMs || 0);
    } catch (e) {}
    return r;
  };
  // the renderer's side of a frame (render.js): nothing is drawn while the WebGL context is lost (its notice is up and a
  // tap reloads); inFrame - a canvas resize asked for between frames waits for the next one (it showed a black frame)
  const _render = Game.prototype.render;
  Game.prototype.render = function (a, now) {
    const r = this.renderer;
    if (r && r.lost) {
      if (r.lostFrame) r.lostFrame(this);
      return;
    }
    if (r) r.inFrame = true;
    try {
      return _render.call(this, a, now);
    } finally {
      if (r) r.inFrame = false;
    }
  };
  const _err = Game.prototype.reportError;
  Game.prototype.reportError = function (where, e, quiet) {
    Telemetry.error(where, e && e.message || e, e && e.stack);
    return _err.call(this, where, e, quiet);
  };
  const _open = UI.prototype.open;
  UI.prototype.open = function (screen) {
    if (screen && screen.constructor) {
      Telemetry.count('screen:' + screen.constructor.name);
      Crumbs.mark('o:' + screen.constructor.name.replace(/Screen$/, ''));
    }
    return _open.call(this, screen);
  };
  const _death = Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath;
  Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath = function (src) {
    Telemetry.count('death:' + (src && src.type || 'other'));
    return _death.call(this, src);
  };
  const _load = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = function (...a) {
    Telemetry.count('world:load');
    return _load.apply(this, a);
  };
  const _create = Game.prototype.createWorld;
  Game.prototype.createWorld = function (...a) {
    Telemetry.count('world:create:' + (a[2] || ''));
    return _create.apply(this, a);
  };
  if (typeof cmdExec === 'function') {
    const _cmd = cmdExec;
    // (a command block's commands aren't counted: a repeating one would run 20 a second)
    cmdExec = function (g, text, src) {
      if (!src) Telemetry.count('cmd:' + String(text).slice(1).split(/\s+/)[0].replace(/^minecraft:/, '').slice(0, 20));
      return _cmd(g, text, src);
    };
  }
  if (typeof NetClient !== 'undefined') {
    const _om = NetClient.prototype.onMessage;
    NetClient.prototype.onMessage = function (m) {
      if (m && m.t === 'pong') {
        const t = Telemetry.pings.get(m.i);
        if (t) {
          Telemetry.pings.delete(m.i);
          if (Telemetry.rtt.length < 500) Telemetry.rtt.push(Math.round(performance.now() - t));
        }
        return;
      }
      if (m && m.t === 'notice' && !this.roomWaitAt) this.roomWaitAt = performance.now();
      if (m && m.t === 'room') {
        Telemetry.event('room', {
          wait: this.roomWaitAt ? Math.round(performance.now() - this.roomWaitAt) : 0
        });
        Telemetry.count('net:room');
      }
      return _om.call(this, m);
    };
    const _fail = NetClient.prototype.fail;
    NetClient.prototype.fail = function (reason) {
      Telemetry.count('net:fail');
      Telemetry.event('netfail', {
        why: String(reason || '').slice(0, 80)
      });
      return _fail.call(this, reason);
    };
  }
  // (the last things done, for Crumbs: the window's size, the on-screen keyboard's field, errors)
  const _rs = Game.prototype.resize;
  Game.prototype.resize = function (...a) {
    try {
      Crumbs.mark('rs:' + innerWidth + 'x' + innerHeight);
    } catch (e) {}
    return _rs.apply(this, a);
  };
  const _si = UI.prototype.showInput,
    _hi = UI.prototype.hideInput;
  UI.prototype.showInput = function (...a) {
    try {
      if (this.input.style.display !== 'block') Crumbs.mark('kb+');
    } catch (e) {}
    return _si.apply(this, a);
  };
  UI.prototype.hideInput = function (...a) {
    try {
      if (this.input.style.display === 'block') Crumbs.mark('kb-');
    } catch (e) {}
    return _hi.apply(this, a);
  };
  const _err2 = Game.prototype.reportError;
  Game.prototype.reportError = function (where, e, quiet) {
    try {
      Crumbs.mark('e:' + String(where || '').slice(0, 14));
    } catch (x) {}
    return _err2.call(this, where, e, quiet);
  };
})();

// ---- the last moments of a page that died (11-07: a page killed on Apple devices sends nothing, and the reopened one
// can't say what it was doing - one in five iPhone sessions in the Bilibili app since the 11-06 version). Every 2 s and
// at each mark, a few words about this page go into the page's storage (what state and screen, the canvases' sizes,
// the last 10 things done); leaving the page properly marks it ended. The next page to start sends any that never
// ended, as a 'died' event: how long it lived, whether it was hidden (killed in the background) or on screen. Nothing
// about the player - the same kind of facts as the rest of the statistics ----
const Crumbs = {
  KEY: 'mcjs-crumbs',
  marks: [],
  g: null,
  lastW: 0,
  mark(k) {
    this.marks.push(Math.round((performance.now() - Telemetry.t0) / 1000) + ':' + k);
    if (this.marks.length > 10) this.marks.shift();
    if (this.g && performance.now() - this.lastW > 200) this.save();
  },
  read() {
    try {
      const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.KEY) || '{}');
      return o && typeof o === 'object' ? o : {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  },
  save(end) {
    const g = this.g;
    if (!g) return;
    this.lastW = performance.now();
    try {
      const r = g.renderer,
        u = g.ui,
        sc = u && u.screen,
        inp = u && u.input;
      const rec = {
        at: Date.now(),
        up: Math.round((performance.now() - Telemetry.t0) / 1000),
        v: GAME_BUILD,
        st: g.state,
        sc: sc ? sc.constructor.name : '',
        hid: !!document.hidden,
        gl: r ? r.canvas.width + 'x' + r.canvas.height : '',
        ui: u && u.canvas ? u.canvas.width + 'x' + u.canvas.height : '',
        rs: r ? r.resScale : 0,
        sec: r && r.sections ? r.sections.size : 0,
        mb: r && r.arena ? Math.round(r.arena.total / 1048576) : 0,
        ent: g.entities ? g.entities.length : 0,
        net: !!g.net,
        kb: !!(inp && document.activeElement === inp),
        lost: !!(r && r.lost),
        old: !!Instances.stale,
        mk: this.marks.join(' '),
        end: end ? 1 : 0
      };
      const all = this.read();
      all[Telemetry.sid] = rec;
      const ids = Object.keys(all);
      if (ids.length > 4) for (const k of ids.sort((a, b) => all[a].at - all[b].at).slice(0, ids.length - 4)) delete all[k];
      localStorage.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  init(g) {
    this.g = g;
    // (the pages before this one that never ended: each sent once, then forgotten. One written in the last 5 s may be
    // a page still open - a second one: Instances - and is left)
    const all = this.read(),
      now = Date.now();
    for (const [sid, r] of Object.entries(all)) {
      if (sid === Telemetry.sid || !r || typeof r !== 'object') continue;
      if (!r.end && now - r.at < 5000) continue;
      if (!r.end && now - r.at < 6 * 3600e3) Telemetry.event('died', {
        ago: Math.round((now - r.at) / 1000),
        up: r.up,
        v: r.v,
        st: r.st,
        sc: r.sc,
        hid: r.hid,
        gl: r.gl,
        ui: r.ui,
        rs: r.rs,
        sec: r.sec,
        mb: r.mb,
        ent: r.ent,
        net: r.net,
        kb: r.kb,
        lost: r.lost,
        old: r.old,
        mk: String(r.mk || '').slice(0, 260)
      });
      delete all[sid];
    }
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    } catch (e) {}
    if (Telemetry.events.some(e => e.type === 'died')) setTimeout(() => Telemetry.flush(false), 4000);
    setInterval(() => this.save(), 2000);
    addEventListener('pagehide', () => this.save(true));
    // (back from the background: not ended after all - a page hidden and shown again fires no pagehide on some phones)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      this.mark(document.hidden ? 'hid' : 'vis');
    });
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => this.mark('fs'));
    document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', () => this.mark('fs'));
    this.save();
  }
};

// ---- one game page at a time (11-07). In the Bilibili app 去三连 opens the video's own page, and that page has the
// game's entry on it: players came back by it and had a second game page open, the first behind it (telemetry: new
// sessions started while the old one was still sending - and the old one, gone back to, would save its older world over
// the new page's). A page on screen says so (at start, and each time it comes back on screen); a page that hears of a
// newer one saves once if it is on screen (two tabs on a computer), then writes nothing more - the saves are refused -
// pauses, and shows a notice whose button reloads it (and so makes it the newest). A page opened out of sight (a preload)
// says nothing until it is shown ----
const Instances = {
  stale: false,
  leaving: false,
  at: 0,
  ch: null,
  g: null,
  key() {
    return 'mcjs-inst:' + location.pathname;
  },
  init(g) {
    this.g = g;
    try {
      this.ch = new BroadcastChannel(this.key());
      this.ch.onmessage = e => this.heard(e.data);
    } catch (e) {}
    addEventListener('storage', e => {
      if (e.key === this.key() && e.newValue) {
        try {
          this.heard(JSON.parse(e.newValue));
        } catch (x) {}
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (!document.hidden) this.shown();
    });
    // (the saves: refused once stale - wrapped here, after every file has wrapped them its own way: cloudsave.js, p2p.js)
    if (typeof DB !== 'undefined') for (const k of ['putChunks', 'putWorld']) {
      const f = DB[k];
      if (typeof f !== 'function') continue;
      DB[k] = function (...a) {
        return Instances.stale ? Promise.resolve() : f.apply(this, a);
      };
    }
    if (!document.hidden) this.announce();
  },
  announce() {
    this.at = Date.now();
    const m = {
      t: 'hello',
      id: Telemetry.sid,
      at: this.at
    };
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.key(), JSON.stringify(m));
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (this.ch) this.ch.postMessage(m);
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  // on screen again: a newer page said hello meanwhile (its message may not have reached this one, asleep behind it)
  shown() {
    if (this.stale || this.leaving) return;
    let m = null;
    try {
      m = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.key()) || 'null');
    } catch (e) {}
    if (m && m.id !== Telemetry.sid && m.at > this.at && this.at) {
      this.goStale();
      return;
    }
    this.announce();
  },
  heard(m) {
    if (!m || m.t !== 'hello' || m.id === Telemetry.sid || this.stale || this.leaving) return;
    if (this.at && (m.at > this.at || m.at === this.at && m.id > Telemetry.sid)) this.goStale();
  },
  async goStale() {
    if (this.stale || this.leaving) return;
    this.leaving = true;
    const g = this.g;
    try {
      Crumbs.mark('old');
      Telemetry.count('inst_old');
      Telemetry.event('inst_old', {
        st: g.state,
        hid: !!document.hidden
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    // (on screen - two tabs: what it has is the newest, saved; out of sight it was saved when it was hidden: main.js)
    try {
      if (g.state === 'play' && !g.net && !document.hidden && g.saveWorld) await Promise.race([g.saveWorld(true), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000))]);
    } catch (e) {}
    this.stale = true;
    try {
      if (g.state === 'play' && !g.net && g.ui && !(g.ui.screen && g.ui.screen.pauses) && typeof PauseScreen !== 'undefined') g.ui.open(new PauseScreen(g));
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (g.net && g.net.close) g.net.close();
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (g.releasePointer) g.releasePointer();
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (Sound.sleep) Sound.sleep('old');
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      this.notice();
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  notice() {
    if (this.el || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const d = this.el = document.createElement('div');
    d.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:60;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9);color:#fff;font:15px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;text-align:center';
    const line = (text, css) => {
      const e = document.createElement('div');
      e.textContent = text;
      if (css) e.style.cssText = css;
      d.appendChild(e);
      return e;
    };
    line('游戏在另一个页面里打开了', 'font-size:22px;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px');
    line('这个页面已经停下，不会再存档，免得覆盖另一个页面的进度');
    const btn = line('点这里在这个页面继续（会重新载入）', 'margin-top:14px;padding:10px 28px;border:2px solid #fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
    let going = false;
    d.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (going) return;
      going = true;
      btn.textContent = '正在重新载入…';
      try {
        Telemetry.count('inst_reload');
        Telemetry.flush(false);
      } catch (x) {}
      // (not 'play': the page's "leave?" prompt asks only then - nothing here is left to save)
      try {
        this.g.state = 'boot';
      } catch (x) {}
      location.reload();
    });
    for (const k of ['touchstart', 'touchmove', 'touchend', 'pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'wheel', 'keydown']) d.addEventListener(k, e => e.stopPropagation(), {
      passive: true
    });
    (document.getElementById('stage') || document.body).appendChild(d);
  }
};

// ---- #A1 陀螺仪, step one: can this device's page hear the gyroscope at all? Out of sight, once per install and build:
// listens 3 s for deviceorientation / devicemotion, reads the frame's permissions policy, and asks iOS's requestPermission
// with no tap behind it - WebKit then answers without a prompt: 'denied' when the frame may not have them, a
// NotAllowedError when only a tap is missing. (The game runs in a cross-origin iframe whose allow= names only pointer-lock:
// bilibili.com's Toy shell, 11-10; voxpool asks the same way, and gives up after 2 s without an event) ----
const SensorProbe = {
  key: 'mcjs-sensor',
  lastInput: 0,
  tries: 0,
  init() {
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem(this.key) === GAME_BUILD) return;
    } catch (e) {}
    for (const k of ['pointerdown', 'touchstart', 'mousedown', 'keydown']) addEventListener(k, () => {
      this.lastInput = performance.now();
    }, {
      capture: true,
      passive: true
    });
    setTimeout(() => this.attempt(), 8000);
  },
  // never near a tap: a requestPermission with one behind it puts up iOS's prompt. (Each wait here is over a second, so
  // WebKit carries no tap into it, and 6 s is longer than a tap's activation lasts)
  attempt() {
    if (this.done) return;
    const quiet = performance.now() - this.lastInput > 6000 && !(navigator.userActivation && navigator.userActivation.isActive);
    if (!quiet || document.hidden || !Telemetry.on()) {
      if (++this.tries < 45) setTimeout(() => this.attempt(), 4000);
      return;
    }
    this.run().then(r => Telemetry.event('sensor', r), () => {});
  },
  async run(ms = 3000) {
    this.done = true;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.key, GAME_BUILD);
    } catch (e) {}
    const W = window,
      DOE = W.DeviceOrientationEvent,
      DME = W.DeviceMotionEvent;
    const wait = t => new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, t));
    const r = {
      fr: W.top !== W.self ? 1 : 0,
      sec: W.isSecureContext ? 1 : 0,
      api: ''
    };
    [['o', !!DOE], ['m', !!DME], ['r', DOE && typeof DOE.requestPermission === 'function'], ['R', DME && typeof DME.requestPermission === 'function'], ['a', 'ondeviceorientationabsolute' in W], ['s', typeof W.Gyroscope === 'function']].forEach(([k, c]) => {
      if (c) r.api += k;
    });
    const pol = document.permissionsPolicy || document.featurePolicy;
    if (pol && typeof pol.allowsFeature === 'function') r.fp = ['gyroscope', 'accelerometer', 'magnetometer'].map(f => {
      try {
        return pol.allowsFeature(f) ? 1 : 0;
      } catch (e) {
        return 'x';
      }
    }).join('');
    // the events: when the first came (ms, -1 none), how many, and whether they carried numbers (null: no sensor)
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let hid = !!document.hidden;
    const o = {
        at: -1,
        n: 0,
        v: 0
      },
      m = {
        at: -1,
        n: 0,
        v: 0,
        iv: 0
      };
    const onO = e => {
      if (o.at < 0) o.at = Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
      o.n++;
      if (e.alpha != null || e.beta != null || e.gamma != null) o.v = 1;
    };
    const onM = e => {
      if (m.at < 0) {
        m.at = Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
        m.iv = Math.round(+e.interval || 0);
      }
      m.n++;
      const a = e.accelerationIncludingGravity,
        rr = e.rotationRate;
      if (a && a.x != null || rr && rr.alpha != null) m.v = 1;
    };
    const onV = () => {
      if (document.hidden) hid = true;
    };
    addEventListener('deviceorientation', onO, {
      passive: true
    });
    addEventListener('devicemotion', onM, {
      passive: true
    });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onV);
    try {
      if (navigator.permissions && navigator.permissions.query) {
        const q = async name => {
          try {
            const s = await Promise.race([navigator.permissions.query({
              name
            }), wait(1500)]);
            return s ? s.state : 'slow';
          } catch (e) {
            return 'x';
          }
        };
        r.pq = (await q('gyroscope')) + '/' + (await q('accelerometer'));
      }
      const ask = async C => {
        if (!C || typeof C.requestPermission !== 'function') return undefined;
        try {
          return String(await Promise.race([C.requestPermission(), wait(3000).then(() => 'slow')]));
        } catch (e) {
          return 'err:' + (e && e.name || '') + ':' + String(e && e.message || '').slice(0, 100);
        }
      };
      r.rp = await ask(DOE);
      r.rpm = await ask(DME);
      await wait(Math.max(ms - (performance.now() - t0), r.rp === 'granted' || r.rpm === 'granted' ? 1500 : 0));
    } finally {
      removeEventListener('deviceorientation', onO);
      removeEventListener('devicemotion', onM);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onV);
    }
    return Object.assign(r, {
      oe: o.at,
      on: o.n,
      ov: o.v,
      me: m.at,
      mn: m.n,
      mv: m.v,
      mi: m.iv,
      hid: hid ? 1 : 0
    });
  }
};

// ---- feedback (Options -> 遥测数据 -> 反馈问题, the pause menu, the title screen) ----
const FEEDBACK_KINDS = [['bug', '错误（bug）'], ['lag', '卡顿 / 性能'], ['idea', '建议'], ['other', '其他']];
// a feedback sent (FeedbackScreen, and the AI companion for the player - companion.js), with what the game is like now
// -> null, or what went wrong
async function postFeedback(g, kind, text, shot) {
  if (!Telemetry.base()) return '没有设置联机服务器，无法发送';
  // the recent performance: the points not yet sent and the minute going on
  if (Telemetry.frames > 120) Telemetry.point();
  const ctx = {
    build: GAME_BUILD,
    id: Telemetry.install(),
    dev: Telemetry.device(),
    perf: Telemetry.points.slice(-5),
    stalls: Telemetry.stalls.slice(-10),
    errors: [...Telemetry.errors].slice(-10).map(([k, e]) => ({
      k,
      ...e
    })),
    mode: g.net ? 'room' : g.state === 'play' ? 'single' : g.state,
    room: g.net && g.net.room ? g.net.room.code : null,
    dim: g.dim,
    settings: {
      rd: g.settings.renderDist,
      preset: g.settings.preset,
      shaders: g.settings.shaders,
      dyn: g.settings.dynRes
    }
  };
  try {
    const res = await fetch(Telemetry.base() + '/api/feedback', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        v: 1,
        kind,
        text,
        shot,
        ctx
      })
    });
    const r = await res.json().catch(() => ({
      error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
    }));
    return !res.ok || r.error ? r.error || 'HTTP ' + res.status : null;
  } catch (e) {
    return '游戏正在更新中…请稍后';
  }
}
class FeedbackScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, shot) {
    super(game, '反馈问题', parent);
    // the world stands still while the report is written, in single player (players' feedback 2026-10-31)
    this.pauses = game.state === 'play' && !game.net;
    this.kind = 0;
    this.text = '';
    this.withShot = !!shot;
    this.shot = shot || null;
    this.sending = false;
    this.done = false;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = Math.max(40, Math.floor(u.h / 2) - 80);
    this.addField('text', cx - 150, y + 36, 300, '描述（最多 500 字）', 500);
    this.widgets = this.done ? [{
      text: this.note,
      x: cx,
      y: y + 60,
      color: this.noteColor
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: y + 90,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }] : [{
      x: cx - 150,
      y: y,
      w: 300,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '类型：' + FEEDBACK_KINDS[this.kind][1],
      onClick: () => {
        this.kind = (this.kind + 1) % FEEDBACK_KINDS.length;
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 150,
      y: y + 64,
      w: 300,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '附带截图：' + (this.withShot ? '是' : '否'),
      enabled: !!this.shot,
      tip: this.shot ? ['打开这个界面之前的游戏画面'] : ['没有可用的画面'],
      onClick: () => {
        this.withShot = !this.withShot;
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 150,
      y: y + 126,
      w: 145,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.sending ? '发送中…' : '发送',
      enabled: !this.sending,
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx + 5,
      y: y + 126,
      w: 145,
      h: 20,
      label: '取消',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    if (!this.done) this.focus('text');
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    if (this.done) return;
    this.drawFields(ui);
    const y = Math.max(40, Math.floor(ui.h / 2) - 80);
    Font.center(ui.ctx, '会一起发送：游戏版本、设备和显卡、最近几分钟的帧率、', ui.w / 2, y + 90, '#A0A0A0');
    Font.center(ui.ctx, '单机还是房间、最近的报错', ui.w / 2, y + 100, '#A0A0A0');
    Font.center(ui.ctx, '不会发送你的名字、聊天记录或存档', ui.w / 2, y + 110, '#A0A0A0');
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  async submit() {
    const g = this.game,
      text = String(this.text || '').trim();
    if (text.length < 2) {
      this.note = '请先写几句描述';
      this.noteColor = '#FF5555';
      return;
    }
    if (!Telemetry.base()) {
      this.note = '没有设置联机服务器，无法发送';
      this.noteColor = '#FF5555';
      return;
    }
    this.sending = true;
    this.note = '';
    g.ui.hideInput();
    const err = await postFeedback(g, FEEDBACK_KINDS[this.kind][0], text, this.withShot ? this.shot : null);
    this.sending = false;
    this.done = true;
    this.note = err ? '发送失败：' + err : '已发送，谢谢你的反馈！';
    this.noteColor = err ? '#FF5555' : '#55FF55';
    if (!err) this.text = '';
    this.layout();
  }
}
// the game's picture right now, made smaller (a JPEG of at most 960 pixels across), for a feedback
function feedbackShot(g) {
  try {
    // (drawn again now without the menu over it: the canvas keeps no picture between frames)
    if (g.state === 'play') {
      const sc = g.ui.screen;
      g.ui.screen = null;
      try {
        g.render(g.lastA || 0, performance.now());
      } finally {
        g.ui.screen = sc;
      }
    }
    const c = g.renderer.canvas,
      k = Math.min(1, 960 / c.width),
      o = document.createElement('canvas');
    o.width = Math.round(c.width * k);
    o.height = Math.round(c.height * k);
    o.getContext('2d').drawImage(c, 0, 0, o.width, o.height);
    const url = o.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
    return url.length > 30 && url.length < 900000 ? url : null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---- Options -> 遥测数据: the switch, what is collected, the feedback button ----
class TelemetryScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {

      h: 20,

        s.telemetry = s.telemetry === false;
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 155,
      y: u.h - 55,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,

      y: u.h - 55,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(this.parent)
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const lines = ['为了让游戏更流畅、少出错，游戏会把匿名的统计数据发到我们的服务器：', '', '• 设备：显卡型号、处理器线程数、内存档位、屏幕和刷新率、浏览器和系统', '• 性能：每分钟的帧率和卡顿、内存、实体和区块数量、画质设置', '• 出错：报错信息（只有出错的代码位置）', '• 使用：打开过哪些界面、用过哪些命令（只有名字）、联机延迟和掉线', '', '不收集：你的名字、聊天内容、存档、IP 地址（服务器只保存打乱后的编号）。', '数据只用来改进游戏和写研究报告，原始数据保存 180 天。'];
    lines.forEach((t, i) => Font.draw(ui.ctx, t, Math.round(ui.w / 2 - 155), 34 + i * 11, t.startsWith('不收集') ? '#FFFF55' : '#E0E0E0'));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}

'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The Toy SDK (Bilibili Toy pages): the game runs in an iframe of www.bilibilitoy.com inside bilibili.com/toy/<slug>/,
// and asks the host page for the user's profile, whether they follow the UP, their 三连 on the bound video, content
// checks, sharing, the container mode (landscape / immersive) and the page-close event. The host's protocol (read
// from toy-host.js, see game/TOY_SDK.md): {ns:'toy-sdk-rpc', type:'ready'} -> 'hello'; {type:'request', id, payload:
// {kind, ...}} -> {type:'response', id, payload:{ok, data} | {ok:false, error, errorType, code}}; events
// {type:'event', payload:{event:'containerChange' | 'pageClose', state}}.
// Outside Toy (plain browser, localhost) every call fails with type 'unsupported'. ?toymock=1 (or localStorage
// 'toymock') pretends to be inside Toy with a small panel to switch login / follow / 三连 / environment, for testing
// (localhost and Toy preview pages only).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ToyError extends Error {
  constructor(type, message, code) {
    super(message || type);
    this.type = type;
    this.code = code;
  }
}
const Toy = (() => {
  const NS = 'toy-sdk-rpc';

  // (the video: the room service's now - /api/gate, Account.loadGate - the user, 11-13: the update's new video for every
  // 三连 and the old ones dropped, changed there without a new version of the game; none here)
  const AUTHOR_MID = 1987439458;
  const VIDEOS = [];

    inIframe = window.parent && window.parent !== window;
  } catch (e) {
    inIframe = true;
  }

  }
  const saveMock = () => {

      localStorage.setItem('toymock', JSON.stringify(mock));
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  function onMessage(e) {
    const d = e.data;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || d.ns !== NS || e.source !== window.parent) return;
    if (d.type === 'hello') {
      meta = d.meta || {};
      if (hello) hello.res(true);
      return;
    }
    if (d.type === 'response') {
      const w = wait.get(d.id);
      if (!w) return;
      wait.delete(d.id);
      clearTimeout(w.t);
      const p = d.payload || {};
      if (p.ok) w.res(p.data);else w.rej(new ToyError(p.errorType || 'unknown', p.error, p.code));
      return;
    }
    if (d.type === 'event' && d.payload) for (const f of listeners[d.payload.event] || []) {
      try {
        f(d.payload.state);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('toy event', err);
      }
    }
  }
  if (inIframe && !mock) window.addEventListener('message', onMessage);

  // in Toy? (the host answers the hello within a second or two; a plain page never does)
  function ready() {
    if (mock) return Promise.resolve(mock.env !== 'none');
    if (!inIframe) return Promise.resolve(false);
    if (!hello) {
      let res;
      const p = new Promise(r => {
        res = r;
      });
      hello = {
        p,
        res
      };
      const send = () => {
        try {
          window.parent.postMessage({
            ns: NS,
            type: 'ready'
          }, '*');
        } catch (e) {}
      };
      send();
      setTimeout(send, 500);
      setTimeout(send, 1500);
      setTimeout(() => res(false), 4000);
    }
    return hello.p;
  }
  async function call(kind, payload = {}, timeout = 15000) {
    if (mock) return mockCall(kind, payload);
    if (!(await ready())) throw new ToyError('unsupported', '不在 B站 Toy 页面里');
    const id = 'g' + nextId++;
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => {
        wait.delete(id);
        rej(new ToyError('timeout', '宿主没有回应'));
      }, timeout);
      wait.set(id, {
        res,
        rej,
        t
      });
      window.parent.postMessage({
        ns: NS,
        type: 'request',
        id,
        payload: {
          kind,
          ...payload
        }
      }, '*');
    });
  }
  const jsb = (method, params) => call('jsb', {
    method,
    params: params || {}
  });
  // 307044: the shared rate limit - wait and try again (doubling), a few times
  async function withBackoff(f) {
    let d = 1000;
    for (let i = 0;; i++) {
      try {
        return await f();
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e && e.code === 307044) || i >= 3) throw e;
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, d + Math.random() * 500));
        d *= 2;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- reading the answers (the field names of relation / video actions aren't in the host code: several spellings) ----
  const yes = v => v === true || v === 1 || v === '1' || v === 'true' || typeof v === 'number' && v > 0;
  function pick(o, keys) {
    if (!o || typeof o !== 'object') return undefined;
    for (const k of keys) if (o[k] !== undefined && o[k] !== null) return o[k];
    // (not "stat": a video's own totals - its like count is not this user's like)
    for (const k of ['data', 'relation', 'result', 'actions', 'action', 'user_action', 'userAction', 'status_info']) if (o[k] && typeof o[k] === 'object') {
      const v = pick(o[k], keys);
      if (v !== undefined) return v;
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  function followingOf(d) {
    if (!d || d.status === 'unsupported') return null;
    const v = pick(d, ['following', 'is_following', 'isFollowing', 'followed', 'is_followed', 'is_follow', 'isFollow', 'follow', 'subscribed', 'attention']);
    if (v !== undefined) return yes(v) || v === 'following' || v === 'followed';
    const a = pick(d, ['attribute', 'relation_type', 'relationType']); // bilibili's relation codes: 2 following, 6 both
    if (a !== undefined) return a === 2 || a === 6 || a === '2' || a === '6';
    if (typeof d.status === 'string' && /^(following|followed|mutual)$/.test(d.status)) return true;
    if (typeof d.relation === 'string') return /follow|mutual/.test(d.relation);
    return false;
  }
  // BV -> av (Bilibili's published scheme: base 58 in a fixed alphabet, two pairs of places swapped, a xor mask)
  const BV_T = 'FcwAPNKTMug3GV5Lj7EJnHpWsx4tb8haYeviqBz6rkCy12mUSDQX9RdoZf';
  function bvToAv(bv) {
    try {
      const s = [...String(bv)];
      if (s.length !== 12) return null;
      [s[3], s[9]] = [s[9], s[3]];
      [s[4], s[7]] = [s[7], s[4]];
      let r = 0n;
      for (const c of s.slice(3)) {
        const i = BV_T.indexOf(c);
        if (i < 0) return null;
        r = r * 58n + BigInt(i);
      }
      return Number(r & 2251799813685247n ^ 23442827791579n);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }
  const LIKE = ['like', 'liked', 'is_like', 'isLike', 'is_liked', 'isLiked', 'has_like', 'hasLike', 'thumb_up', 'thumbUp'];
  // (Bilibili's answer, 2026-10-31: {liked, coinCount, favorited} - the coins this user put in)
  const COIN = ['coinCount', 'coin_count', 'coin', 'coined', 'coins', 'is_coin', 'isCoin', 'is_coined', 'isCoined', 'has_coin', 'hasCoin', 'coin_number', 'coinNumber', 'multiply'];
  const FAV = ['favorite', 'favorited', 'favourite', 'fav', 'favored', 'favoured', 'is_fav', 'isFav', 'is_favorite', 'isFavorite', 'has_fav', 'hasFav', 'collect', 'collected', 'is_collect'];
  // done or not: the known field names first, then any field whose name says it (a video's own totals - "stat" and
  // "*count*" - left out); a value that is an object is looked into (status / value / count / number / done)
  const yesVal = v => v && typeof v === 'object' ? ['status', 'value', 'count', 'number', 'num', 'done', 'state', 'is', 'has'].some(k => v[k] !== undefined && yes(v[k])) : yes(v);
  function yesOf(it, keys, re, depth = 0) {
    const v = pick(it, keys);
    if (v !== undefined && yesVal(v)) return true;
    if (!it || typeof it !== 'object' || depth > 2) return false;
    for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(it)) {
      if (/^(stat|stats)$/i.test(k) || /count|total/i.test(k)) continue;
      if (re.test(k) && yesVal(x)) return true;
      if (x && typeof x === 'object' && yesOf(x, keys, re, depth + 1)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  // the per-video records in Bilibili's answer, whatever its shape: an array (at the top or a level or two down), an
  // object keyed by video (BV… / an av number)
  function itemsOf(d, depth = 0) {
    if (Array.isArray(d)) return d.filter(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || depth > 2) return [];
    const ks = Object.keys(d);
    // (keyed by video: the key kept on each, as __k - which video it is)
    if (ks.length && ks.every(k => /^(BV\w+|\d+)$/i.test(k))) return ks.map(k => {
      const x = d[k];
      if (x && typeof x === 'object') x.__k = k;
      return x;
    }).filter(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    for (const k of ['items', 'list', 'videos', 'data', 'result', 'actions']) if (d[k] && typeof d[k] === 'object') {
      const r = itemsOf(d[k], depth + 1);
      if (r.length) return r;
    }
    return [];
  }
  // which video a record is: its own BV / av field, the key it came under, else its place among the ones asked (order:
  // the BVs asked, in order; avOf: av number -> BV)
  function videoOf(it, i, order, avOf) {
    const b = pick(it, ['bvid', 'bv_id', 'bvId', 'bv']);
    if (b && /^BV/i.test(String(b))) return String(b);
    const k = it.__k,
      a = pick(it, ['aid', 'avid', 'av_id', 'avId', 'oid']);
    if (k && /^BV/i.test(k)) return k;
    if (k && avOf[k]) return avOf[k];
    if (a !== undefined && avOf[String(a)]) return avOf[String(a)];
    return order[i] || null;
  }
  // 三连 on ANY one of the videos (the user 11-14: a pool of videos, one is enough - all three on the same video, not a
  // like on one and a coin on another): { like, coin, fav } of the video nearest done (for 还差), all, video: the one
  // done (or the nearest), per: each video's
  function tripleOf(d, order = [], avOf = {}) {
    if (!d || d.status === 'unsupported') return null;
    let items = itemsOf(d);
    if (!items.length && (pick(d, LIKE) !== undefined || pick(d, COIN) !== undefined || pick(d, FAV) !== undefined)) items = [d]; // (one video, at the top)
    // (nothing readable is "don't know", not "none of the three": the page says so instead of "all done")
    if (!items.length) return null;
    const per = items.map((it, i) => {
      const r = {
        video: videoOf(it, i, order, avOf),
        like: yesOf(it, LIKE, /like|thumb/i),
        coin: yesOf(it, COIN, /coin|multiply/i),
        fav: yesOf(it, FAV, /fav|collect/i)
      };
      r.all = r.like && r.coin && r.fav;
      r.n = (r.like ? 1 : 0) + (r.coin ? 1 : 0) + (r.fav ? 1 : 0);
      return r;
    });
    const done = per.find(r => r.all),
      best = done || per.slice().sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n)[0];
    return {
      like: best.like,
      coin: best.coin,
      fav: best.fav,
      all: !!done,
      video: best.video,
      per
    };
  }

        av = videos.filter(v => /^\d+$/.test(String(v))).map(Number).concat(bv.map(bvToAv).filter(Boolean));

        videos: bv
      })]);

        aids: av
      })]);

        videos: bv
      })]);
      if (av.length) tries.push(['app-av', () => jsb('toy.getVideoUserActions', {
        aids: av
      })]);
      let err = null;
      for (const [how, f] of tries) {
        try {
          let d = await withBackoff(f);
          if (d && d.code === 0 && d.data) d = d.data; // (the app's own call: the HTTP answer as it came)
          last.videoActions = d;
          last.videoActionsHow = how;
          const t = tripleOf(d, bv, avOf);
          if (t !== null) {
            // (read, but not all three: what Bilibili answered goes along, to see its field names)
            let raw = '';
            if (!t.all) {
              try {
                raw = JSON.stringify(d).slice(0, 600);
              } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) {
              Telemetry.event('triple_ok', {

              });
              if (!t.all && Telemetry.flush) Telemetry.flush(false);
            }
            return t;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          err = err || e;
          last.videoActionsErrs = (last.videoActionsErrs || []).concat([`${how}: ${e.code || ''} ${e.message}`]).slice(-8);
        }
      }
      if (err) throw err;
      return null;
    },
    // the platform's content check: {passed, status}; outside Toy (or when its check is unavailable) passed is true
    async checkText(text, scene) {
      try {
        const d = await call('inputSafety', {
          text: String(text).slice(0, 500),
          scene
        });
        return {
          passed: d.status === 'unavailable' ? true : !!d.passed,
          status: d.status
        };
      } catch (e) {
        return {
          passed: true,
          status: 'unavailable'
        };
      }
    },
    navigate(type, id) {
      return call('navigate', {
        req: {
          type,
          id: String(id)
        }
      });
    },
    // inside the Bilibili app its own pages (bilibili://video/<av>, bilibili://space/<mid>) - the host's navigate opens
    // the web page in a separate window there; if the page isn't left within a moment (the app didn't take it), the
    // web page after all
    async openNative(url, type, id) {
