      // account.js. Back on this page the mark goes - the screen here checks)
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('mcjs-nav', JSON.stringify({
          t: Date.now(),
          type
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
      if (!this._navBack) {
        this._navBack = true;
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
          if (!document.hidden) setTimeout(() => {
            try {
              localStorage.removeItem('mcjs-nav');
            } catch (e) {}
          }, 1500);
        });
      }
      try {
        const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' ? game : null;
        if (g && g.state === 'play' && !g.net && g.saveWorld) await Promise.race([g.saveWorld(true), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000))]);
      } catch (e) {}
      if (typeof Crumbs !== 'undefined') Crumbs.mark('nav:' + type);
      if (/BiliApp|BiliHarmony/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
        // (the app's navigate, each form given a moment to take the page away - hidden, or the window losing focus):
        // first the official SDK's (toy-sdk.js 3.3: a number for the type - video 1, space 2 - and extra; the id a BV
        // number or a mid. Our string type and the bilibili:// address were not taken: the app opened the web page in a
        // browser window instead, players 11-06, TOY_SDK.md), then those two as before
        const NAV = {
          video: 1,
          space: 2,
          search: 3,
          opus: 4,
          tribee: 5,
          toy: 6
        };
        const left = () => new Promise(res => {
          if (document.hidden) return res(true);
          let done = false;
          const end = v => {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', vis);
            window.removeEventListener('blur', end1);
            res(v);
          };
          const vis = () => {
              if (document.hidden) end(true);
            },
            end1 = () => end(true);
          document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', vis);
          window.addEventListener('blur', end1);
          setTimeout(() => end(document.hidden), 1500);
        });
        const forms = [{
          type: NAV[type],
          id: String(id),
          extra: {}
        }, {
          type,
          id: String(id)
        }, {
          url
        }].filter(p => p.type !== undefined || p.url);
        for (const p of forms) {
          try {
            await jsb('toy.navigate', p);
            if (await left()) {
              if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) Telemetry.event('nav_native', {
                form: p.url ? 'url' : typeof p.type === 'number' ? 'sdk' : 'type'
              });
              return;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) {
          Telemetry.event('nav_web', {
            type
          });
          if (Telemetry.flush) Telemetry.flush(false);
        }
      }
      return this.navigate(type, id);
    },
    openVideo(bv) {
      const av = /^BV/i.test(bv) ? bvToAv(bv) : Number(bv);
      return av ? this.openNative('bilibili://video/' + av, 'video', bv) : this.navigate('video', bv);
    },
    openAuthor() {
      return this.openNative('bilibili://space/' + AUTHOR_MID, 'space', AUTHOR_MID);
    },
    // what to do there and how to come back (in the app: its back button, not the game's entry on the video's page -
    // that opens a second game page, 11-07)
    backHint(kind) {
      const app = /BiliApp|BiliHarmony/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
      if (kind === 'triple') return app ? '三连后按返回键回来（别点视频里的游戏入口）' : '完成三连后回到这里，会自动检查';
      return app ? '关注后按返回键回来，会自动检查' : '关注后回到这里，会自动检查';
    },
    share(path) {
      return call('share', {
        req: {
          path: path || '/'
        }
      });
    },
    qrCode(path, size) {
      return call('qrCode', {
        req: {
          path: path || '/',
          size: size || 240
        }
      });
    },
    sharePicture(params) {
      return jsb('toy.sharePicture', params);
    },
    saveImage(params) {
      return jsb('toy.saveImageToAlbum', params);
    },
    setContainerMode(params) {
      return jsb('toy.setContainerMode', params);
    },
    containerState() {
      return jsb('toy.getContainerState');
    },
    abilities() {
      return jsb('toy.getAbilities');
    },
    closeBrowser() {
      return jsb('toy.closeBrowser');
    },
    report(action, extra) {
      return jsb('toy.reportAction', {
        action,
        ...(extra || {})
      }).catch(() => {});
    },
    async onContainerChange(f) {
      listeners.containerChange.push(f);
      try {
        await call('containerSubscribe', {
          op: 'add'
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    },
    async onPageClose(f) {
      listeners.pageClose.push(f);
      try {
        await call('playerSubscribe', {
          op: 'add',
          channel: 'pageClose'
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    },
    // a short Chinese line for an error, for the screens
    explain(e) {
      const t = e && e.type;
      return t === 'not_logged_in' ? 'B站说你还没登录：在 B站 App 里登录后重新打开，或者用识别码登录' : t === 'user_denied' ? '你拒绝了授权，可以再试一次' : t === 'unsupported' ? '这里用不了：请在 B站 App 或电脑网页上打开'
      // (the host page not answering is not the player's network - 3115 times on 2026-11-02, players with full
      // Wi-Fi told "网络不太好"; and "unauthorized" is a Bilibili page nobody is logged in on)
      : t === 'timeout' ? 'B站页面没回应（不是网络问题）：请点同意授权，或重开游戏、用识别码登录' : t === 'network_error' ? '连 B站 时网络出错，请稍后再试' : /unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(e && e.message || '') ? '这个页面没登录 B站：先登录 B站 再打开游戏，或者用识别码登录' : e && e.code === 307044 ? '请求太频繁，请稍后再试' : '出错了：' + (e && e.message || '未知错误');
    }
  };

  // ---- the mock: the same answers the host gives, from the panel's switches ----
  async function mockCall(kind, p) {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
    const unsup = mock.env === 'mobileweb' || mock.env === 'none';
    if (mock.env === 'none') throw new ToyError('unsupported', 'mock: 不在 Toy');
    switch (kind) {
      case 'getUserProfile':
        if (unsup) throw new ToyError('unsupported', 'mock: 外部浏览器');
        if (!mock.login) throw new ToyError('not_logged_in', 'mock: 未登录');
        if (mock.deny) throw new ToyError('user_denied', 'mock: 拒绝授权');
        return {
          face: '',
          uname: mock.nickname,
          toyOpenId: mock.openId
        };
      case 'authorRelation':
        if (unsup) return {
          status: 'unsupported'
        };
        if (!mock.login) throw new ToyError('not_logged_in', 'mock: 未登录');
        return {
          following: !!mock.follow
        };
      case 'videoUserActions':
        if (unsup) return {
          status: 'unsupported',
          items: []
        };
        if (!mock.login) throw new ToyError('not_logged_in', 'mock: 未登录');
        // (mock.videos: { BV: {like, coin, fav} } - a video of its own; the others as the 三连 switch says)
        return {
          items: (p.videos || p.aids || []).map(v => {
            const o = mock.videos && mock.videos[v];
            return o ? {
              bvid: v,
              like: !!o.like,
              coin: o.coin ? 1 : 0,
              favorite: !!o.fav
            } : {
              bvid: v,
              like: !!mock.triple,
              coin: mock.triple ? 1 : 0,
              favorite: !!mock.triple
            };
          })
        };
      case 'inputSafety':
        return {
          status: /违规|测试违禁/.test(p.text) ? 'risky' : 'ok',
          passed: !/违规|测试违禁/.test(p.text)
        };
      case 'navigate':
        // the user goes and does it: the next check sees it
        if (p.req.type === 'video') mock.pendingTriple = true;
        if (p.req.type === 'space') mock.pendingFollow = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (mock.pendingTriple) mock.triple = true;
          if (mock.pendingFollow) mock.follow = true;
          mock.pendingTriple = mock.pendingFollow = false;
          saveMock();
          panel();
        }, 1500);
        return null;
      case 'share':
        return null;
      case 'qrCode':
        return {
          base64: '',
          url: location.href
        };
      case 'jsb':
        if (p.method === 'toy.getContainerState') return {
          deviceType: 'phone',
          orientation: 'landscape',
          immersive: true,
          safeArea: {
            top: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            left: 0
          },
          viewport: {
            width: innerWidth,
            height: innerHeight
          }
        };
        if (p.method === 'toy.getAbilities') return {
          abilities: unsup ? [] : ['getUserProfile', 'getAuthorRelation', 'getVideoUserActions', 'setContainerMode', 'sharePicture']
        };
        return null;
      case 'containerSubscribe':
      case 'playerSubscribe':
        return null;
    }
    throw new ToyError('unsupported', 'mock: ' + kind);
  }
  // the panel (top right): environment, logged in, refuse, following, 三连
  function panel() {
    if (!mock) return;
    let el = document.getElementById('toymock');
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = 'toymock';
      el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:4px;right:4px;z-index:99;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);color:#fff;font:12px sans-serif;padding:6px;border:1px solid #fb7299;border-radius:4px';
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.addEventListener('change', e => {
        const t = e.target;
        mock[t.name] = t.type === 'checkbox' ? t.checked : t.value;
        saveMock();
      });
      // a brand-new Bilibili user: nothing followed, the game's account logged out, then the page again
      // or a whole new player: also this browser's settings, first run, room key, skin choices and statistics id
      // forgotten (the worlds on this device stay)
      el.addEventListener('click', async e => {
        const n = e.target.name;
        if (n !== 'fresh' && n !== 'newbie') return;
        const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' ? game : null;
        if (n === 'newbie' && g && g.state === 'play') {
          e.target.textContent = '请先退回标题界面';
          return;
        }
        Object.assign(mock, {
          openId: newMockId(),
          login: true,
          follow: false,
          triple: false,
          deny: false
        });
        saveMock();
        try {
          if (typeof Account !== 'undefined') await Account.logout();
        } catch (err) {}
        if (n === 'newbie') {
          // (nothing may write them back while the page goes)
          if (g) g.saveSettings = () => {};
          if (typeof Account !== 'undefined') Account.save = () => {};
          for (const k of Object.keys(localStorage)) if (/^mcjs-(settings|account|room-key|tid|skin-)/.test(k)) localStorage.removeItem(k);
        }
        location.reload();
      });
    }
    const cb = (k, t) => `<label style="display:block"><input type="checkbox" name="${k}" ${mock[k] ? 'checked' : ''}> ${t}</label>`;
    el.innerHTML = '<b style="color:#fb7299">Toy 模拟</b>' + `<select name="env" style="display:block;margin:3px 0">${[['app', 'B站 App'], ['web', '电脑网页'], ['mobileweb', '手机外部浏览器'], ['none', '不在 Toy']].map(([v, t]) => `<option value="${v}" ${mock.env === v ? 'selected' : ''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select>` + cb('login', '已登录 B站') + cb('deny', '拒绝授权') + cb('follow', '已关注') + cb('triple', '已三连') + '<button name="fresh" style="display:block;width:100%;margin-top:4px;font:12px sans-serif" title="换一个从没玩过的 B站 用户（退出游戏账号并刷新；设置不变）">换新 B站 用户</button>' + '<button name="newbie" style="display:block;width:100%;margin-top:3px;font:12px sans-serif" title="模拟第一次打开游戏的新玩家：新 B站 用户、清空设置和首次进入记录（这台设备上的世界保留）">新玩家进入</button>';
  }
  if (mock) {
    if (document.body) panel();else addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', panel);
  }
  api.panel = panel;
  return api;
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/account.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The player's account (game/ACCOUNT_PLAN.md): log in with Bilibili inside Toy, or with the personal identity code
// anywhere, or play offline (single player only). The room service keeps the accounts (multiplayer/rooms/accounts.js);
// the browser keeps the login token. What an account unlocks (the rules the user set):
//   三连 on the Toy's video  -> the static capes + custom skins
//   following the UP         -> the animated capes
//   both                     -> playing online, 鲸鲸 (companion.js; the user, 2026-11-07)
// The video is the room service's (its gate, /api/gate - the user, 11-13: the update's new video, the old ones no longer
// count), and so is whether 三连 / following are asked for. (Without a video, following alone unlocks what 三连 would.)
// The 模组 screen asks the same as playing online (mods_ui.js modsGate).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// a request by XMLHttpRequest (a string body goes as text/plain: no preflight), as {status, ok, text}
function xhr(method, url, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
    x.open(method, url);
    x.timeout = 15000;
    x.onload = () => resolve({
      status: x.status,
      ok: x.status >= 200 && x.status < 300,
      text: x.responseText
    });
    x.onerror = () => reject(new Error('XHR 出错'));
    x.ontimeout = () => reject(new Error('XHR 超时'));
    x.send(body === undefined ? null : body);
  });
}
const Account = {
  // bili: the Bilibili openId this device logged in with ('' = by identity code, undefined = logged in before it was kept)
  token: '',
  data: null,
  offline: false,
  gate: null,
  checking: false,
  lastCheck: 0,
  codeShown: null,
  bili: undefined,
  load() {
    try {
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-account') || '{}');
      this.token = s.token || '';
      this.data = s.account || null;
      this.offline = !!s.offline;
      this.bili = s.bili;
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  save() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mcjs-account', JSON.stringify({
        token: this.token,
        account: this.data,
        offline: this.offline,
        bili: this.bili
      }));
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  get loggedIn() {
    return !!(this.token && this.data);
  },
  get name() {
    return this.data ? this.data.name : '';
  },
  device() {
    const u = navigator.userAgent;
    return (/Android/.test(u) ? 'Android' : /iPhone|iPad/.test(u) ? 'iOS' : /Windows/.test(u) ? 'Windows' : /Mac/.test(u) ? 'Mac' : '其他') + ' · ' + (/BiliApp/i.test(u) ? 'B站App' : /Edg\//.test(u) ? 'Edge' : /Chrome/.test(u) ? 'Chrome' : /Safari/.test(u) ? 'Safari' : /Firefox/.test(u) ? 'Firefox' : '浏览器');
  },
  async api(path, body) {
    if (!RoomService.base()) throw new Error('还没有配置游戏服务器地址');
    let r;
    // (plain text, the token in the body, no headers: some phone app web views drop every request the browser must
    // ask the server about first - a JSON content type or an Authorization header - so logging in never got there)
    const send = body || this.token ? JSON.stringify(this.token ? {
      ...(body || {}),
      _t: this.token
    } : body) : undefined;
    const url = RoomService.base() + path,
      method = send ? 'POST' : 'GET';
    // a request that never comes back is tried once more with XMLHttpRequest (some app web views fail one and not the
    // other); if that fails too, what the browser said is shown and sent with the statistics (the phones that can't
    // log in never reach the service, so this is the only way to see why)
    try {
      const f = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        body: send
      });
      r = {
        status: f.status,
        ok: f.ok,
        text: await f.text()
      };
    } catch (e1) {
      try {
        r = await xhr(method, url, send);
      } catch (e2) {
        const why = `${e1 && e1.message || e1} / ${e2 && e2.message || e2}${navigator.onLine === false ? ' / 离线' : ''}`.slice(0, 80);
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) {
          Telemetry.event('net_fail', {
            path: path.replace(/\/w[a-z0-9]+/, '/w'),
            why,
            dev: this.device()
          });
          Telemetry.flush(false);
        }
        throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
      }
    }
    let j;
    try {
      j = JSON.parse(r.text);
    } catch (e) {
      j = {
        error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
      };
    }
    if (r.status === 401 && this.token) {
      this.token = '';
      this.data = null;
      this.save();
    }
    if (!r.ok || j.error) throw Object.assign(new Error(j.error || 'HTTP ' + r.status), {
      status: r.status,
      body: j
    });
    return j;
  },
  took(j) {
    if (j.token) this.token = j.token;
    if (j.account) this.data = j.account;
    this.offline = false;
    this.save();
    this.applySettings();
    return j;
  },
  // Bilibili inside Toy: the profile, then the service's account for it (new: with the identity code to show once)
  async loginBili() {
    // ("not logged in" once more after a moment: a page opened from another app may get Bilibili's login late)
    let p;
    try {
      p = await Toy.profile();
    } catch (e) {
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) Telemetry.event('toy_fail', {
        err: e && e.type,
        code: e && e.code,
        msg: String(e && e.message || '').slice(0, 60),
        dev: this.device()
      });
      if (!(e instanceof ToyError && e.type === 'not_logged_in')) throw e;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));
      p = await Toy.profile();
    }
    if (!p.toyOpenId) throw new Error('B站没有给出身份信息，请再试一次');
    const j = this.took(await this.api('/api/account/bili', {
      openId: p.toyOpenId,
      nickname: p.nickname,
      avatar: p.avatar,
      device: this.device()
    }));
    this.bili = p.toyOpenId;
    this.save();
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('login_bili');
    this.checkUnlocks(true).catch(() => {});
    return j;
  },
  async loginCode(code) {
    const j = this.took(await this.api('/api/account/code', {
      code,
      device: this.device()
    }));
    this.bili = '';
    this.save();
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('login_code');
    return j;
  },
  async refresh() {
    if (!this.token) return null;
    try {
      this.took(await this.api('/api/account/me'));
    } catch (e) {}
    return this.data;
  },
  async update(fields) {
    this.took(await this.api('/api/account/update', fields));
    return this.data;
  },
  async logout() {
    try {
      await this.api('/api/account/logout', {});
    } catch (e) {}
    this.token = '';
    this.data = null;
    this.bili = undefined;
    this.save();
  },
  async resetCode() {
    const p = await Toy.profile();
    const j = await this.api('/api/account/reset-code', {
      openId: p.toyOpenId
    });
    return j.code;
  },
  async remove(confirmName) {
    let openId = '';
    try {
      openId = (await Toy.profile()).toyOpenId;
    } catch (e) {}
    await this.api('/api/account/delete', {
      openId,
      confirm: confirmName
    });
    this.token = '';
    this.data = null;
    this.save();
  },
  chooseOffline() {
    this.offline = true;
    this.save();
  },
  async loadGate(force) {
    if (this.gate && !force) return this.gate;
    // (the videos the service's: changed there, the game follows - 11-13)
    // (jump: the share of 去三连 each video gets, in % - the others split what is left; 11-14)
    try {
      const g = await this.api('/api/gate'),
        jump = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(g && g.jump || {})) if (/^BV[0-9A-Za-z]{10}$/.test(k) && v > 0) jump[k] = Math.min(100, +v);
      this.gate = Object.assign({}, g, {
        videos: (g.videos || []).filter(v => /^BV[0-9A-Za-z]{10}$/.test(v)),
        aiVideos: [],
        jump
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.gate = this.gate || {
        follow: true,
        triple: true,
        videos: [],
        aiVideos: [],
        requireAccount: true
      };
    }
    return this.gate;
  },
  // the video 去三连 opens (the user 11-14: several videos, 三连 on any one is enough): one at random by the service's
  // shares (gate.jump, e.g. the newest 30%; the others split the rest), drawn again on every tap. (13r went back to a
  // video already liked first and kept the same one for the page: nearly everyone had liked the old video, so it was
  // the old one every time - "跳转的一直是老视频", the user 11-14)
  pickVideo() {
    const g = this.gate || {},
      v = g.videos || [];
    if (!v.length) return null;
    const J = g.jump || {},
      set = v.filter(b => J[b] > 0),
      used = Math.min(100, set.reduce((s, b) => s + J[b], 0)),
      rest = v.length - set.length;
    const each = rest ? (100 - used) / rest : 0,
      total = set.reduce((s, b) => s + J[b], 0) + each * rest;
    let r = Math.random() * (total || 1),
      pick = v[v.length - 1];
    for (const b of v) {
      r -= J[b] > 0 ? J[b] : each;
      if (r < 0) {
        pick = b;
        break;
      }
    }
    return pick;
  },
  // what is unlocked (anything needs an account)
  get unlocks() {
    return this.data && this.data.unlocks || {
      follow: false,
      triple: false
    };
  },
  tripleOk() {
    const g = this.gate;
    return this.loggedIn && (this.unlocks.triple || !!g && !g.triple && this.unlocks.follow);
  },
  has(what) {
    if (!this.loggedIn) return false;
    const u = this.unlocks,
      g = this.gate || {};
    // (a super administrator wears every cape and skin without 三连 / following - the user, 2026-11-02)
    if ((what === 'anim' || what === 'static' || what === 'skin') && this.data && this.data.super) return true;
    if (what === 'anim') return !!u.follow;
    if (what === 'static' || what === 'skin') return this.tripleOk();
    if (what === 'online') return (!g.follow || u.follow) && (!g.triple || u.triple);
    // 鲸鲸: following the UP and 三连 on the video (the user, 2026-11-07; the service itself only asks for following)
    if (what === 'jing') return this.data && this.data.super || !!u.follow && this.tripleOk();
    return false;
  },
  allUnlocked() {
    return this.has('anim') && this.has('static') && this.has('online');
  },
  // 三连 / follow as Bilibili says now (only inside Toy); what changed is returned, the account keeps what was seen
  async checkUnlocks(quiet) {
    if (!this.loggedIn || this.checking) return null;
    this.checking = true;
    try {
      const g = await this.loadGate();
      // (not in a phone's own browser: it can't be read there, and asking made Bilibili's page put up a window to open
      // the app that came back on every visit and every way into multiplayer - logged in by identity code, 11-04/05)
      if (Toy.phoneWeb || !(await Toy.ready())) return {
        inToy: false
      };
      const before = {
        follow: this.unlocks.follow,
        stat: this.has('static'),
        online: this.has('online'),
        jing: this.has('jing')
      };
      let follow = null,
        triple = null,
        err = null;
      try {
        follow = await Toy.following();
      } catch (e) {
        err = e;
      }
      if (g.videos && g.videos.length) {
        let te = null;
        try {
          const t = await Toy.triple(g.videos);
          triple = t ? t.all : null;
          this.tripleParts = t;
        } catch (e) {
          te = e;
          err = err || e;
          this.tripleParts = null;
        }
        // (what Bilibili answered when it can't be read, to the statistics: the only way to see it from here)
        if (triple === null && typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.event) {
          let raw = '';
          try {
            raw = JSON.stringify({
              d: Toy.last.videoActions === undefined ? null : Toy.last.videoActions,
              how: Toy.last.videoActionsHow,
              errs: Toy.last.videoActionsErrs
            }).slice(0, 600);
          } catch (e) {}
          Telemetry.event('triple_check', {
            err: te && te.type,
            code: te && te.code,
            msg: String(te && te.message || '').slice(0, 120),
            raw,
            dev: this.device()
          });
          Telemetry.flush(false);
        }
      }
      // the AI companion's own unlock (the service's ai.videos, empty now): the same video's 三连 since 2026-11-07, kept
      // in step for the day the service asks for it
      let ai = triple;
      this.lastCheck = Date.now();
      // only the account's own Bilibili user can take an unlock back: logged in by identity code on a computer whose
      // Bilibili page has nobody (or someone else) logged in, "not following" came back and wiped the follow the
      // account had (feedback 2026-11-01/02: "关注了，换设备用识别码登录显示没关注"). A yes still counts from anyone.
      const own = await this.ownBili();
      if (!own) {
        if (follow !== true) follow = null;
        if (triple !== true) triple = null;
        if (ai !== true) ai = null;
      }
      // (videos: which ones were checked - the service counts a 三连 on its videos of now only)
      // (tv: the video the 三连 is on; any: this page counts one video as enough - the service takes a "no" from it)
      const tv = triple === true && this.tripleParts ? this.tripleParts.video : null;
      if (follow !== null || triple !== null || ai !== null) this.took(await this.api('/api/account/unlocks', {
        follow,
        triple,
        ai,
        videos: g.videos || [],
        tv,
        any: true
      }));
      const got = [];
      if (!before.stat && this.has('static')) got.push('triple');
      if (!before.follow && this.unlocks.follow) got.push('follow');
      if (!before.online && this.has('online')) got.push('online');
      if (!before.jing && this.has('jing')) got.push('jing');
      if (got.length && !quiet && typeof game !== 'undefined') unlockCelebrate(game, got);
      // taken back (unfollowed, 三连 undone): locked again; the others in a room see the cape go
      const lost = before.follow && !this.unlocks.follow || before.stat && !this.has('static') || before.online && !this.has('online');
      // (三连 taken back: most often the 三连 on the old video, which no longer counts - 2026-11-07)
      const lostT = before.stat && !this.has('static');
      if (lost && typeof game !== 'undefined') {
        if (game.net && game.net.sendLook) game.net.sendLook();
        if (game.ui && game.ui.toast) game.ui.toast('解锁已收回', lostT ? '三连换成了新视频：给新视频三连就能恢复' : '重新关注/三连就能恢复');
      }
      return {
        inToy: true,
        follow,
        triple,
        got,
        lost,
        error: err,
        own
      };
    } finally {
      this.checking = false;
    }
  },
  // the Bilibili user on this page is the account's own (logged in from here; before that was kept: the same nickname)
  async ownBili() {
    let p = null;
    try {
      p = await Toy.profile();
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!p || !p.toyOpenId) return false;
    if (this.bili === undefined && this.data && this.data.nick && p.nickname === this.data.nick) {
      this.bili = p.toyOpenId;
      this.save();
    }
    return !!this.bili && p.toyOpenId === this.bili;
  },
  // settings follow the account (changed ones go up a few seconds later)
  applySettings() {
    const s = this.data && this.data.settings;
    if (!s || typeof game === 'undefined' || !game.settings || this.appliedFor === this.data.id) return;
    this.appliedFor = this.data.id;
    for (const k of ACCOUNT_SETTINGS) if (s[k] !== undefined) game.settings[k] = s[k];
    game.saveSettings();
  },
  settingsChanged() {
    if (!this.loggedIn || typeof game === 'undefined') return;
    clearTimeout(this.setT);
    this.setT = setTimeout(() => {
      const s = {};
      for (const k of ACCOUNT_SETTINGS) if (game.settings[k] !== undefined) s[k] = game.settings[k];
      this.update({
        settings: s
      }).catch(() => {});
    }, 4000);
  }
};
// the settings that follow the account to other devices (not the ones about this device's screen or speed)
// (not the touch buttons' layout: kept in screen pixels of one device, a tablet's put a phone's off the screen -
// feedback 11-01; each device keeps its own)
const ACCOUNT_SETTINGS = ['fov', 'sens', 'volume', 'gamma', 'bobbing', 'advTooltips', 'keys', 'autoJump', 'invertY', 'subtitles', 'chatOpacity', 'tutorialOff', 'minimap', 'deathMarker', 'recipeHints', 'vibrate', 'quickChat'];
Account.load();
// (each visit: follow / 三连 checked again once the page is up, quietly - unless it was a moment ago)
// A page opened fresh within 15 minutes of 去三连 / 去关注 (toy.js openNative's mark: the page before was killed behind
// the video's page, or this is a second one from its game entry - 11-07): checked aloud, so what was done there shows
setTimeout(() => {
  if (!Account.loggedIn) return;
  let nav = null;
  try {
    nav = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-nav') || 'null');
    localStorage.removeItem('mcjs-nav');
  } catch (e) {}
  const back = !!(nav && Date.now() - nav.t < 15 * 60e3);
  if (back && typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('nav_reopen');
  // (a check already going - the login's own, quiet - is waited out first)
  const go = n => {
    if (Account.checking && n < 6) {
      setTimeout(() => go(n + 1), 2000);
      return;
    }
    Account.checkUnlocks(false).catch(() => {});
  };
  if (back) go(0);else if (Date.now() - Account.lastCheck > 5000) Account.checkUnlocks(true).catch(() => {});
}, 3000);
// the rooms: this account's room key and token instead of the browser's own key
(() => {
  const key = RoomService.key.bind(RoomService);
  RoomService.key = () => Account.loggedIn && Account.data.roomKey ? Account.data.roomKey : key();
  const api = RoomService.api.bind(RoomService);
  RoomService.api = async function (path, body) {
    if (!Account.token || !body) return api(path, body); // (what is only looked at needs no token)
    let r;
    try {
      r = await fetch(this.base() + path, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...body,
          _t: Account.token
        })
      });
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
    }
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({
      error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
    }));
    if (!r.ok || j && j.error) throw Object.assign(new Error(j && j.error || 'HTTP ' + r.status), {
      gate: !!(j && j.gate)
    });
    return j;
  };
  const save = Game.prototype.saveSettings;
  Game.prototype.saveSettings = function () {
    save.call(this);
    Account.settingsChanged();
  };
})();

// ---- drawing helpers for the account screens ----
// a rounded dark card with a gold or grey edge
function drawCard(c, x, y, w, h, gold) {
  c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  c.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  c.strokeStyle = gold ? '#E8B830' : '#555555';
  c.lineWidth = 1;
  c.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, h - 1);
  if (gold) {
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,184,48,0.10)';
    c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2);
  }
}
// little pixel icons: thumb up, coin, star (三连), heart-plus (follow), check, lock
const ICON_PIX = {
  like: ['..##....', '..##....', '.###....', '########', '#.######', '#.######', '#.#####.', '#.####..'],
  coin: ['..####..', '.#....#.', '#..##..#', '#.#..#.#', '#.#..#.#', '#..##..#', '.#....#.', '..####..'],
  star: ['...##...', '...##...', '########', '.######.', '..####..', '.##..##.', '.#....#.', '........'],
  follow: ['.##..##.', '########', '########', '########', '.######.', '..####..', '...##...', '........'],
  check: ['.......#', '......##', '.....##.', '#...##..', '##.##...', '.###....', '..#.....', '........'],
  lock: ['..####..', '.#....#.', '.#....#.', '########', '###..###', '###..###', '########', '########']
};
function drawIcon(c, name, x, y, s, col) {
  const p = ICON_PIX[name];
  if (!p) return;
  c.fillStyle = col;
  for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (p[j][i] === '#') c.fillRect(x + i * s, y + j * s, s, s);
}
// a short burst on screen when something is unlocked (a sound, a gold toast, sparks)
function unlockCelebrate(g, got) {
  const names = {
    triple: '静态披风和自定义皮肤',
    follow: '动态披风',
    online: '联机',
    jing: 'AI 伙伴' + (typeof Companion !== 'undefined' && Companion.name || '鲸鲸')
  };
  Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1);
  g.ui.message && g.ui.message('解锁了：' + got.map(k => names[k]).join('、') + '！', '#FFD24A');
  UnlockSparks.start(got);
}
const UnlockSparks = {
  t0: 0,
  list: [],
  text: '',
  start(got) {
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.list = [];
    this.text = '解锁：' + got.map(k => ({
      triple: '静态披风 + 自定义皮肤',
      follow: '动态披风',
      online: '联机',
      jing: '鲸鲸'
    })[k]).join(' · ');
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) this.list.push({
      a: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      v: 40 + Math.random() * 90,
      c: ['#FFD24A', '#FFF2B0', '#FB7299', '#7FD8FF'][i % 4]
    });
  },
  draw(ui) {
    const t = (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000;
    if (!this.t0 || t > 2.6) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      cy = ui.h / 2 - 20,
      f = Math.min(1, t * 4) * Math.min(1, (2.6 - t) * 2);
    c.save();
    c.globalAlpha = f;
    for (const p of this.list) {
      const r = p.v * t,
        y = cy + Math.sin(p.a) * r + 30 * t * t;
      c.fillStyle = p.c;
      c.fillRect(Math.round(cx + Math.cos(p.a) * r), Math.round(y), 2, 2);
    }
    const w = Font.width(this.text) + 24;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,28,0,0.85)';
    c.fillRect(cx - w / 2, cy - 12, w, 22);
    c.strokeStyle = '#E8B830';
    c.strokeRect(cx - w / 2 + 0.5, cy - 11.5, w - 1, 21);
    Font.center(c, this.text, cx, cy - 4, '#FFD24A');
    c.restore();
  }
};

// ---- 登录: Bilibili (gold, recommended) / identity code / offline ----
// offline: where 离线游玩 goes when it is not next - from the way into multiplayer, back where the player came from
// (next would ask for the login again, and the same screen came back as if the button did nothing)
class LoginScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next, offline) {
    super(game, '登录');
    this.next = next;
    this.offline = offline;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 22;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    this.busy = false;
    this.inToy = null;
    Toy.ready().then(v => {
      this.inToy = v;
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
    });
    this.mobileOutside = /Android|iPhone|iPad|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent) && !/BiliApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0';
  }
  done() {
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    if (n) n();else this.game.ui.open(new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = Math.max(70, Math.floor(u.h / 2 - 40));
    const bili = this.inToy !== false;
    this.widgets = [];
    if (bili) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 110,
      y,
      w: 220,
      h: 24,
      gold: true,
      label: () => this.busy ? '正在登录…' : this.inToy === null ? '正在连接 B站…' : 'B站一键登录（推荐）',
      enabled: !this.busy && this.inToy === true,
      onClick: () => this.bili()
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 110,
      y: y + (bili ? 30 : 0),
      w: 220,
      h: 20,
      label: '用识别码登录',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: ['第一次用 B站登录时会给你一个识别码', '在别的设备、别的浏览器里用它登录同一个账号'],
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new CodeLoginScreen(this.game, this))
    }, {
      x: cx - 60,
      y: y + (bili ? 62 : 32),
      w: 120,
      h: 16,
      label: '离线游玩',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: ['只能玩单人游戏，存档只在这台设备上', '之后随时可以在 选项 → 账号 里登录'],
      onClick: () => {
        Account.chooseOffline();
        if (this.offline) {
          this.next = null;
          this.offline();
        } else this.done();
      }
    });
  }
  async bili() {
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在向 B站 请求授权…');
    this.layout();
    try {
      const j = await Account.loginBili();
      if (j.code) {
        this.game.ui.open(new CodeShowScreen(this.game, j.code, () => this.done(), true));
        return;
      }
      this.done();
      this.game.ui.message && this.game.ui.message('欢迎回来，' + Account.name, '#55FF55');
    } catch (e) {
      this.busy = false;
      this.say(e instanceof ToyError ? Toy.explain(e) : e.message, true);
      this.layout();
      if (e instanceof ToyError && typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.flush) Telemetry.flush(false);
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      y = Math.max(70, Math.floor(ui.h / 2 - 40));
    const lines = ['登录后可以：和朋友联机、存档同步到云端、换皮肤和披风', '账号和存档换设备也在'];
    lines.forEach((t, i) => Font.center(c, fitText(t, ui.w - 8), cx, y - 34 + i * 11, i ? '#A0A0A0' : '#FFFFFF'));
    if (this.inToy === false) Font.center(c, fitText(this.mobileOutside ? '手机浏览器里不能用 B站登录：可以用识别码，或者在 B站 App 里打开' : '不在 B站 Toy 页面里：可以用识别码登录', ui.w - 8), cx, y - 12, '#FFD24A');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, y + 96, this.noteColor);
    if (typeof GAME_BUILD !== 'undefined') Font.center(c, '版本 ' + GAME_BUILD, cx, ui.h - 12, '#707070'); // (which build a screenshot is from)
  }
  onEsc() {}
}
// the identity code, the one time it is shown
class CodeShowScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, code, next, fresh) {
    super(game, fresh ? '这是你的个人识别码' : '新的个人识别码');
    this.code = code;
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.copied = null;
  }
  base() {
    return Math.max(0, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 150) / 2));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = this.base() + 110;
    this.titleY = this.base() + 10;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 110,
      y,
      w: 108,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.copied ? '已复制' : this.copied === false ? '复制不了，请抄下来' : '复制识别码',
      onClick: async () => {
        this.copied = await copyText(this.code);
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y,
      w: 108,
      h: 20,
      label: () => {
        const s = Math.ceil(3 - (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000);
        return s > 0 ? `我记下了（${s}）` : '我记下了';
      },
      enabled: true,
      onClick: () => {
        if (performance.now() - this.t0 < 3000) return;
        const n = this.next;
        this.next = null;
        n && n();
      }
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      y = this.base() + 76;
    const w = Font.width(this.code) * 2 + 24;
    drawCard(c, Math.floor(cx - w / 2), y - 8, w, 30, true);
    c.save();
    c.translate(cx, y);
    c.scale(2, 2);
    Font.center(c, this.code, 0, 0, '#FFD24A');
    c.restore();
    const lines = [['只显示这一次，请抄下来或复制保存', '#FFFFFF'], ['用它可以在任何设备上登录你的账号：请保密，别发给别人', '#FF8080'], ['忘了可以在 B站 里登录后，到 选项 → 账号 重新生成', '#A0A0A0']];
    lines.forEach(([t, col], i) => Font.center(c, fitText(t, ui.w - 8), cx, this.base() + 26 + i * 11, col));
  }
  onEsc() {}
}
class CodeLoginScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '用识别码登录', parent);
    this.code = '';
    this.busy = false;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.fields = {};
    this.addField('code', cx - 110, 80, 220, '个人识别码（XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX）', 19, v => {
      const s = v.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
      return s.replace(/(.{4})(?=.)/g, '$1-');
    });
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 110,
      y: 110,
      w: 108,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.busy ? '正在登录…' : '登录',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: 110,
      w: 108,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    this.focus('code');
  }
  async submit() {
    if (this.busy) return;
    if (this.code.replace(/-/g, '').length !== 16) {
      this.say('识别码是 16 位（4 组，每组 4 位）', true);
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在登录…');
    this.layout();
    try {
      await Account.loginCode(this.code);
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      this.game.ui.message && this.game.ui.message('已登录：' + Account.name, '#55FF55');
      const p = this.parent;
      if (p instanceof LoginScreen) p.done();else this.game.ui.open(new AccountScreen(this.game, new OptionsScreen(this.game, new TitleScreen(this.game))));
    } catch (e) {
      this.busy = false;
      this.say(e.message, true);
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    this.drawFields(ui);
    Font.center(ui.ctx, fitText('第一次用 B站登录时，游戏给过你识别码', ui.w - 8), ui.w / 2, 140, '#808080');
  }
}

      label: '诊断',
      tip: ['显示 B站 返回的原始数据（排查问题用）'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new ToyDiagScreen(g, this))
    }, ...(Account.data.super ? [{
      x: cx + 2,
      y: 160,
      w: 148,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '管理员…',
      tip: ['临时昵称、全服公告、昵称颜色、管理员披风'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new AdminScreen(g, this))
    }] : []), {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
  }
  async reset() {
    try {
      const code = await Account.resetCode();
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      this.game.ui.open(new CodeShowScreen(this.game, code, () => this.game.ui.open(this), false));
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e instanceof ToyError ? Toy.explain(e) : e.message, true);
    }
  }
  async del() {
    if (this.confirm !== 'del') {
      this.confirm = 'del';
      this.layout();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await Account.remove(Account.name);
      this.say('账号已删除');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.confirm = null;
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      Font.center(c, Account.offline ? '现在是离线游玩：只能玩单人游戏' : '还没有登录', cx, 40, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    this.drawFields(ui);
    const d = Account.data,
      u = Account.unlocks;
    Font.draw(c, '游戏名：' + Account.name, cx - 150, 52, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.draw(c, '就是 B站名，B站改名后会跟着变', cx - 150, 64, '#808080');
    Font.draw(c, `B站：${d.nick || '（识别码登录）'}　　注册于 ${new Date(d.created).toLocaleDateString()}`, cx - 150, 80, '#A0A0A0');
    const st = (ok, t) => (ok ? '✓ ' : '✗ ') + t;
    Font.draw(c, [st(Account.tripleOk(), '三连'), st(u.follow, '关注'), st(Account.has('online'), '联机')].join('　'), cx - 150, 94, '#E0E0E0');
  }
}
// ---- 管理员 (the highest permissions, rooms/accounts.js): a temporary nickname to play under online, an announcement
// to everyone playing, the colour of the name, the administrators' cape ----
const ADMIN_COLORS = ['', '#FFAA00', '#FFFF55', '#55FF55', '#55FFFF', '#5555FF', '#FF55FF', '#FF5555', '#AA00AA', '#00AAAA', '#AAAAAA', '#E8B830', '#FF7EB6', '#7FD4FF'];
// 冻结名单 (administrators): the accounts the service froze for a severe word (moderation.js) - who, when, where, the
// words - each with 解冻 (the account, its address and its network let back in)
class FrozenScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '冻结名单');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.list = null;
    this.page = 0;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#80FF80';
    this.load();
  }
  async load() {
    try {
      const j = await Account.api('/api/account/admin/frozen', {});
      this.list = j.list || [];
      this.hours = j.hours;
    } catch (e) {
      this.list = [];
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#80FF80';
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 90) / 30));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      L = this.list || [],
      n = this.rows(),
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L.length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    this.widgets = L.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).map((f, i) => ({
      x: cx + 116,
      y: 34 + i * 30,
      w: 44,
      h: 18,
      label: '解冻',
      onClick: () => this.unfreeze(f)
    }));
    if (pages > 1) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 160,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 50,
      h: 20,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 110,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 50,
      h: 20,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 96,
      y: 6,
      w: 64,
      h: 18,
      label: '封禁玩家…',
      gold: true,
      tip: ['按游戏名全服封禁一个玩家（不在线也可以）'],
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(new BanNameScreen(this.game, this))
    });
  }
  async unfreeze(f) {
    try {
      const j = await Account.api('/api/account/admin/unfreeze', {
        id: f.id
      });
      this.list = j.list || [];
      this.say('已解冻 ' + f.name + '（账号和 IP 都放开了）');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      L = this.list,
      n = this.rows();
    if (!L) {
      Font.center(c, '正在读取…', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    if (!L.length) Font.center(c, '没有被冻结的账号', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
    const t2 = ms => {
      const d = new Date(ms);
      return `${d.getMonth() + 1}-${d.getDate()} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    };
    L.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((f, i) => {
      const y = 34 + i * 30;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(cx - 160, y - 2, 320, 28);
      Font.draw(c, fitText(f.name || f.id, 140), cx - 157, y + 1, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, fitText(`${t2(f.at)} · ${f.why}${f.banned ? ' · IP 封禁中' : ''}`, 270), cx - 157, y + 12, '#A0A0A0');
      if (f.text) Font.draw(c, fitText('原话：' + f.text, 270), cx - 157, y + 21, '#FF8080');
    });
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 42, this.noteColor);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
// 封禁玩家 (from 冻结名单, the user 11-08): anyone by their game name, online or not - the account frozen, its address
// banned too when it is online; lifted with 解冻
class BanNameScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '全服封禁玩家', parent);
    this.who = '';
    this.why = '';
    this.busy = false;
    this.sure = false;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.fields = {};
    this.addField('who', cx - 100, 60, 200, '玩家的游戏名（和游戏里显示的一样）', 32, v => {
      this.sure = false;
      return v.replace(/[\s"'\\§]/g, '').slice(0, 32);
    });
    this.addField('why', cx - 100, 104, 200, '原因（可以不写，只有管理员看得到）', 60, v => v.slice(0, 60));
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 134,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: () => this.busy ? '…' : this.sure ? '确定封禁「' + this.who + '」？' : '封禁',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.submit()
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
  }
  async submit() {
    const name = this.who.trim();
    if (!name) {
      this.say('先写玩家的游戏名', true);
      this.focus('who');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.sure) {
      this.sure = true;
      this.say('账号会被冻结、请出所有房间，再点一次确定', false);
      this.layout();
      return;
    }
    this.sure = false;
    this.busy = true;
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.layout();
    try {
      const j = await Account.api('/api/account/admin/freeze', {
        name,
        why: this.why.trim()
      });
      this.say(`已封禁 ${j.name}：账号冻结${j.ip ? `，IP 封禁 ${j.hours} 小时` : '（现在不在线，没有封 IP）'}`);
      this.who = '';
      this.why = '';
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    this.drawFields(ui);
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    if (this.parent && this.parent.load) this.parent.load();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
class AdminScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '管理员', parent);
    this.nick = Account.data.tempNick || '';
    this.notice = '';
    this.busy = null;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game;
    this.fields = {};
    this.widgets = [];
    this.addField('nick', cx - 150, 52, 196, '临时昵称（联机时用这个名字；留空：用 B站名）', 16, v => v.replace(/[\s"'\\§]/g, '').slice(0, 16));
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 50,
      y: 52,
      w: 48,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: () => this.busy === 'nick' ? '…' : '使用',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.setNick(this.nick)
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 102,
      y: 52,
      w: 48,
      h: 20,
      label: '清除',
      enabled: !this.busy && !!Account.data.tempNick,
      onClick: () => this.setNick('')
    });
    this.addField('notice', cx - 150, 96, 248, '全服公告（单人和联机的所有人都会在聊天框看到）', 100, v => v.slice(0, 100));
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 102,
      y: 96,
      w: 48,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: () => this.busy === 'notice' ? '…' : '发布',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.announce()
    });
    // the name's colour: a row of swatches (the first: none)
    this.swatches = ADMIN_COLORS.map((col, i) => ({
      x: cx - 150 + i * 21,
      y: 136,
      w: 19,
      h: 19,
      label: '',
      col,
      tip: [col ? '昵称颜色 ' + col : '不用颜色（白色）'],
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.setColor(col)
    }));
    this.widgets.push(...this.swatches);
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 150,
      y: 166,
      w: 300,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '管理员披风（动态）…',
      tip: ['在 皮肤和装饰 里选「管理员」'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new WardrobeScreen(g, this))
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 150,
      y: 190,
      w: 300,
      h: 20,
      label: '冻结名单…',
      tip: ['写了严重违规内容被自动冻结的账号', '可以看原话和时间，误伤了可以解冻'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new FrozenScreen(g, this))
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
  }
  async run(k, f, ok) {
    this.busy = k;
    this.layout();
    try {
      await f();
      this.say(ok);
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = null;
    this.layout();
  }
  setNick(n) {
    return this.run('nick', async () => {
      await Account.update({
        tempNick: n
      });
      this.nick = Account.data.tempNick || '';
    }, n ? `之后进联机房间时叫「${n}」（已经在房间里的话，重新进入后生效）` : '已改回 B站名（重新进入房间后生效）');
  }
  setColor(c) {
    return this.run('color', () => Account.update({
      nameColor: c
    }), c ? '昵称颜色已设置，房间里的人马上能看到' : '已取消昵称颜色');
  }
  announce() {
    const text = this.notice.trim();
    if (!text) {
      this.say('先写公告内容', true);
      return;
    }
    return this.run('notice', async () => {
      if (typeof textOk === 'function' && !(await textOk(this.game, text, 'chat'))) throw new Error('这段文字没有通过 B站 的内容检查');
      await Account.api('/api/account/announce', {
        text
      });
      this.notice = '';
    }, '公告已发布');
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    this.drawFields(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      cur = Account.data.nameColor || '';
    Font.draw(c, '昵称颜色', cx - 150, 125, '#A0A0A0');
    Font.draw(c, '现在：' + (Account.data.tempNick || Account.name), cx + 50, 125, cur || '#FFFFFF');
  }
  draw(ui) {
    super.draw(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cur = Account.data.nameColor || '';
    for (const s of this.swatches || []) {
      c.fillStyle = s.col || '#FFFFFF';
      c.fillRect(s.x + 3, s.y + 3, s.w - 6, s.h - 6);
      if (!s.col) {
        c.strokeStyle = '#FF5555';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(s.x + 4, s.y + s.h - 4);
        c.lineTo(s.x + s.w - 4, s.y + 4);
        c.stroke();
      }
      if (s.col === cur) {
        c.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        c.lineWidth = 1;
        c.strokeRect(s.x + 0.5, s.y + 0.5, s.w - 1, s.h - 1);
      }
    }
  }
}
const g_netName = g => {
  if (Account.loggedIn) {
    g.settings.netName = Account.name;
    g.saveSettings();
  }
};

// ---- 解锁: 三连 and following, with what each gives (the user wants this done well) ----
class UnlockScreen extends MenuScreen {
  // then: where 开始联机 goes (the gate's next step; none: the multiplayer screen from the title)
  constructor(game, parent, reason, then) {
    super(game, '解锁');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.reason = reason || '';
    this.then = then || null;
    this.startOn = Account.has('online');
    this.goldFrom = 0;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    this.inToy = null;
    this.went = null;
    Account.loadGate().then(() => {
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
    });
    Toy.ready().then(v => {
      this.inToy = v;
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
      if (v && Account.loggedIn && Date.now() - Account.lastCheck > 15000) this.check(true);
    });
    // back from the video / the UP's page: look again
    // (B站 may take a few seconds to count a new follow or coin: looked at a few more times while this is open)
    this.onBack = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && this.went && this.game.ui.screen === this) {
        this.went = null;
        this.retries = 3;
        setTimeout(() => this.check(), 600);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onBack);
    window.addEventListener('focus', this.onBack);
  }
  // (close() is the UI's: called whenever another screen takes this one's place - opening one from it recursed)
  close() {
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onBack);
    window.removeEventListener('focus', this.onBack);
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0';
  }
  cards() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      w = Math.min(170, Math.floor((u.w - 24) / 2)),
      h = 132,
      y = 46;
    const g = Account.gate || {},
      hasVideo = !!(g.videos && g.videos.length);
    return [{
      x: cx - w - 4,
      y,
      w,
      h,
      kind: 'triple',
      on: hasVideo,
      done: Account.tripleOk(),
      title: '给新视频三连',
      sub: hasVideo ? g.videos.length > 1 ? '任意一个新视频点赞+投币+收藏' : '点赞+投币+收藏（老视频不算）' : '视频发布后开放',
      gives: ['4 款静态披风', '自定义皮肤（正版玩家皮肤）']
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y,
      w,
      h,
      kind: 'follow',
      on: true,
      done: !!Account.unlocks.follow,
      title: '关注 UP 主',
      sub: '土豆味小哲',
      gives: ['3 款动态披风', hasVideo ? '' : '（视频发布前也解锁静态披风和皮肤）'].filter(Boolean)
    }];
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game;
    this.widgets = [];
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 100,
        y: 196,
        w: 200,
        h: 24,
        gold: true,
        label: '先登录',
        onClick: () => g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => g.ui.open(new UnlockScreen(g, this.parent, this.reason, this.then)), () => offlineBack(g, this.parent)))
      });
    } else for (const k of this.cards()) {
      if (k.done || !k.on) continue;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: k.x + 10,
        y: k.y + k.h - 28,
        w: k.w - 20,
        h: 20,
        gold: true,
        enabled: this.inToy === true,
        label: k.kind === 'triple' ? '去三连' : '去关注',
        tip: this.inToy === false ? ['请在 B站 App 或电脑网页的游戏页面里操作'] : [k.kind === 'triple' ? '打开视频页，点赞、投币、收藏后回来' : '打开 UP 主的空间，关注后回来'],
        onClick: () => this.go(k.kind)
      });
    }
    // online unlocked: the check button turns gold into 开始联机 (at once if it already was when this opened)
    const canStart = Account.has('online') && (this.then || g.state !== 'play');
    if (!canStart) {
      this.goldFrom = 0;
      this.startOn = false;
    } else if (!this.startOn && !this.goldFrom) this.goldFrom = performance.now();
    if (canStart) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 196,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      goldFrom: this.goldFrom,
      fromLabel: '我完成了，检查',
      label: '开始联机',
      onClick: () => this.start()
    });else if (Account.loggedIn) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 196,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => Account.checking ? '正在检查…' : '我完成了，检查',
      enabled: this.inToy === true && !Account.checking,
      onClick: () => this.check()
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: Account.loggedIn ? cx + 2 : cx - 100,
      y: Account.loggedIn ? 196 : 224,
      w: Account.loggedIn ? 98 : 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
  }
  start() {
    const g = this.game,
      t = this.then;
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('unlock_start');
    if (t) {
      this.then = null;
      return t();
    }
    g.ui.open(new MultiplayerScreen(g, this.parent instanceof TitleScreen ? this.parent : new TitleScreen(g)));
  }
  async go(kind) {
    const g = Account.gate || {};
    this.went = kind;
    try {
      if (kind === 'triple') await Toy.openVideo(Account.pickVideo());else await Toy.openAuthor();
      this.say(Toy.backHint(kind));
      // (some hosts open it inside the same view: check again a little later too)
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.went === kind && this.game.ui.screen === this) {
          this.went = null;
          this.retries = 3;
          this.check(true);
        }
      }, 8000);
    } catch (e) {
      this.went = null;
      this.say(Toy.explain(e), true);
    }
    this.layout();
  }
  async check(quiet) {
    this.layout();
    try {
      const r = await Account.checkUnlocks();
      if (!r) return;
      const missing = !Account.allUnlocked();
      if (missing && this.retries > 0 && r.inToy) {
        this.retries--;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.check(this.retries > 0);
        }, 4000);
      }
      if (!r.inToy) this.say('请在 B站 App 或电脑网页的游戏页面里检查', true);else if (!r.own && missing && !(r.got && r.got.length)) this.say('这里没登录你自己的 B站：用你的 B站 关注、三连后，在那台设备打开一次游戏就会同步', true);else if (r.error && r.follow === null && r.triple === null) this.say(Toy.explain(r.error), true);else if (r.got && r.got.length) this.say('解锁成功！', false);
      // (三连 asked for but not readable: said, not "all done")
      else if (Account.gate && Account.gate.videos && Account.gate.videos.length && r.triple === null && !Account.unlocks.triple) {
        this.say('没查到三连状态（' + (r.error ? Toy.explain(r.error) : 'B站没有返回能看懂的数据') + '），过一会儿再点检查', true);
      } else if (!quiet) {
        const t = Account.tripleParts,
          miss = [];
        if (t && !t.all) {
          if (!t.like) miss.push('点赞');
          if (!t.coin) miss.push('投币');
          if (!t.fav) miss.push('收藏');
        }
        if (!Account.unlocks.follow) miss.push('关注');
        // (several videos: the three on the same one)
        const many = Account.gate && Account.gate.videos && Account.gate.videos.length > 1 && t && !t.all;
        this.say(miss.length ? '还差：' + miss.join('、') + (many ? '（要在同一个视频上）' : '（刚操作完可能要等几秒）') : '都完成了', !!miss.length);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    if (this.reason) Font.center(c, fitText(this.reason, ui.w - 8), cx, 26, '#FFD24A');else Font.center(c, fitText('支持一下 UP 主，就能解锁披风、皮肤和联机', ui.w - 8), cx, 26, '#E0E0E0');
    for (const k of this.cards()) {
      drawCard(c, k.x, k.y, k.w, k.h, !k.done && k.on);
      if (k.kind === 'triple') {
        drawIcon(c, 'like', k.x + 8, k.y + 8, 1, '#FB7299');
        drawIcon(c, 'coin', k.x + 18, k.y + 8, 1, '#FFD24A');
        drawIcon(c, 'star', k.x + 28, k.y + 8, 1, '#FFD24A');
      } else drawIcon(c, 'follow', k.x + 8, k.y + 8, 1, '#FB7299');
      Font.draw(c, k.title, k.x + (k.kind === 'triple' ? 40 : 20), k.y + 8, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, fitText(k.sub, k.w - 16), k.x + 8, k.y + 22, '#A0A0A0');
      Font.draw(c, '解锁：', k.x + 8, k.y + 38, '#FFD24A');
      k.gives.forEach((t, i) => Font.draw(c, fitText(t, k.w - 16), k.x + 8, k.y + 50 + i * 10, '#E0E0E0'));
      // the capes it gives
      if (typeof Capes !== 'undefined') {
        const list = Capes.list.filter(p => k.kind === 'triple' ? !p.anim : p.anim).slice(0, 4);
        list.forEach((p, i) => Capes.drawFlat(c, p.id, k.x + 8 + i * 26, k.y + 72, 2, !k.done));
      }
      if (k.done) {
        drawIcon(c, 'check', k.x + k.w - 30, k.y + k.h - 26, 2, '#55FF55');
        Font.draw(c, '已完成', k.x + 10, k.y + k.h - 22, '#55FF55');
      } else if (!k.on) Font.draw(c, '敬请期待', k.x + 10, k.y + k.h - 22, '#808080');
    }
    const on = Account.has('online');
    const y = 46 + 132 + 5;
    if (Account.loggedIn) Font.center(c, fitText(on ? Account.has('jing') ? '✓ 联机、模组和鲸鲸已解锁' : '✓ 联机和模组已解锁' : Account.gate && Account.gate.triple ? '三连 + 关注 = 解锁联机、模组和鲸鲸' : '关注 = 解锁联机和模组', ui.w - 8), cx, y - 1, on ? '#55FF55' : '#FFD24A');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 22 + (Account.loggedIn ? 0 : -6), this.noteColor);else if (this.inToy === false && Account.loggedIn) Font.center(c, fitText('在 B站 App 或电脑网页上打开游戏才能三连和关注；在别处用识别码登录时，按最后一次在 B站 检查到的状态', ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 22, '#A0A0A0');
  }
}

// ---- 诊断: the raw answers Bilibili gave (the field names of follow / 三连 are not documented) ----
class ToyDiagScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, 'B站 接口诊断');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.lines = ['正在读取…'];
    this.run();
  }
  async run() {
    const L = [],
      j = v => {
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(v);
        } catch (e) {
          return String(v);
        }
      };
    L.push('在 Toy 里：' + (await Toy.ready()) + (Toy.mock ? '（模拟）' : ''));
    const g = await Account.loadGate(true);
    L.push('联机门槛：' + j(g));
    try {
      const p = await Toy.profile();
      L.push('用户：' + p.nickname + (p.toyOpenId ? '（有 toyOpenId）' : '（没有 toyOpenId）'));
    } catch (e) {
      L.push('用户：' + e.type + ' ' + e.message);
    }
    try {
      L.push('关注 → ' + (await Toy.following()));
      L.push('  原始：' + j(Toy.last.relation));
    } catch (e) {
      L.push('关注：' + e.type + ' ' + e.message);
    }
    if (g.videos && g.videos.length) {
      try {
        L.push('三连 → ' + j(await Toy.triple(g.videos)));
        L.push('  原始：' + j(Toy.last.videoActions));
      } catch (e) {
        L.push('三连：' + e.type + ' ' + e.message);
      }
    }
    try {
      L.push('能力：' + j(await Toy.abilities()));
    } catch (e) {
      L.push('能力：' + e.type);
    }
    this.lines = L;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: u.w / 2 - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    let y = 30;
    for (const t of this.lines) for (let s = String(t); s.length && y < ui.h - 36; y += 10) {
      let n = s.length;
      while (n > 1 && Font.width(s.slice(0, n)) > ui.w - 16) n--;
      Font.draw(ui.ctx, s.slice(0, n), 8, y, '#E0E0E0');
      s = s.slice(n);
    }
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}

// 离线游玩 chosen on the way into multiplayer: back where the player came from, and why online stays shut
function offlineBack(g, parent) {
  g.ui.open(parent || (g.state === 'play' ? null : new TitleScreen(g)));
  if (g.ui.toast) g.ui.toast('离线游玩', '只能玩单人游戏，联机要先登录（选项 → 账号）');
}
// ---- the way into multiplayer: an account, then the unlock (the service checks it again when joining) ----
// single player (the user, 2026-10-31): following the UP first, asked of Bilibili inside Toy each time. Only Bilibili's
// "not following" (or not logged in there) stops it - where it can't be asked (a phone's own browser, outside Toy) or
// the asking fails, the game opens as before, so a broken answer never locks everyone out
const SINGLE_OPEN = true;
async function singleGate(g, then, parent) {
  // single player is open to everyone, following or not (the user, 2026-11-03); the follow check below is kept for
  // if it ever comes back - multiplayer still asks for the account and its unlock
  if (SINGLE_OPEN) return then();
  // a super administrator (pinned by account id on the server, super.json) never waits here: the UP can't follow
  // themselves, and was kept out of single player (2026-11-01)
  if (Account.loggedIn && Account.data && Account.data.super) return then();
  // an account that has followed already (seen by the service): in by its identity code on another device, or with
  // another Bilibili user on this page, Bilibili said "not following" - multiplayer let it in, single player didn't
  // (feedback 2026-11-03)
  if (Account.loggedIn && Account.unlocks.follow) return then();
  if (!(await Promise.race([Toy.ready(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(false), 2500))]))) return then();
  let f = null,
    err = null;
  try {
    f = await Toy.following();
  } catch (e) {
    err = e;
  }
  // only one Bilibili says isn't following is asked; not logged in (a guest account, a browser not logged in to
  // Bilibili) the follow can't be seen at all - following changed nothing, a dead end (players' feedback 2026-10-31)
  if (f !== false || err) {
    if (err && err.type === 'not_logged_in') Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_single_guest');
    return then();
  }
  Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_single');
  g.ui.open(new FollowGateScreen(g, parent, then));
}
class FollowGateScreen extends MenuScreen {
  // (msg: what following opens - the single-player game's by default; 股东名单's, shareholders.js)
  constructor(game, parent, then, msg) {
    super(game, '关注 UP 主');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.then = then;
    this.msg = msg;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    this.titleY = 40;
    // back from the UP's page: look again (a new follow can take a few seconds to show)
    this.onBack = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && this.went && this.game.ui.screen === this) {
        this.went = false;
        this.retries = 3;
        setTimeout(() => this.check(true), 600);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onBack);
    window.addEventListener('focus', this.onBack);
  }
  close() {
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onBack);
    window.removeEventListener('focus', this.onBack);
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 2) + 10;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '去关注',
      onClick: () => this.go()
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.checking ? '正在检查…' : '我关注了，检查',
      enabled: !this.checking,
      onClick: () => this.check(false)
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
  }
  async go() {
    this.went = true;
    try {
      await Toy.openAuthor();
      this.note = Toy.backHint('follow');
      this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    } catch (e) {
      this.went = false;
      this.note = Toy.explain(e);
      this.noteColor = '#FF6060';
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.went && this.game.ui.screen === this) {
        this.went = false;
        this.retries = 3;
        this.check(true);
      }
    }, 8000);
  }
  async check(quiet) {
    if (this.checking) return;
    this.checking = true;
    let f = null,
      err = null;
    try {
      f = await Toy.following();
    } catch (e) {
      err = e;
    }
    this.checking = false;
    if (this.game.ui.screen !== this) return;
    if (f === true || f === null && !err) {
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_single_ok');
      const t = this.then;
      this.then = null;
      if (t) t();
      return;
    }
    if (this.retries > 0) {
      this.retries--;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.check(true);
      }, 4000);
    }
    if (!quiet || !this.retries) {
      this.note = err ? Toy.explain(err) : '还没查到关注（刚关注完可能要等几秒，再点一次检查）';
      this.noteColor = '#FF6060';
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      y = Math.floor(ui.h / 2) - 40;
    Font.center(c, fitText(this.msg || '关注 UP 主「土豆味小哲」后就能玩单人游戏', ui.w - 8), cx, y, '#FFD24A');
    Font.center(c, fitText('在 B站 里关注完回到这里，会自动检查', ui.w - 8), cx, y + 14, '#E0E0E0');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, y + 30, this.noteColor);
  }
}
async function onlineGate(g, then, parent) {
  if (!RoomService.base()) return then();
  const gate = await Account.loadGate();
  if (!gate.requireAccount && !gate.follow && !gate.triple) return then();
  if (!Account.loggedIn) {
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_login');
    return g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => onlineGate(g, then, parent), () => offlineBack(g, parent)));
  }
  // (in Bilibili: checked again now - unfollowing locks it again)
  try {
    await Account.checkUnlocks(true);
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!Account.has('online')) {
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_unlock');
    return g.ui.open(new UnlockScreen(g, parent, gate.triple ? '联机需要关注 UP 主并给新视频三连（老视频的三连不算了）' : '联机需要关注 UP 主（取消关注后会重新锁上）', then));
  }
  then();
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/capes.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Capes (game/ACCOUNT_PLAN.md「披风设计」): all original designs, none of Mojang's or Bilibili's. Four static ones
// (三连) drawn pixel by pixel, three animated ones (following the UP) worked out frame by frame. Each is a texture in
// vanilla's cape layout (64 x 32: the cape 10 x 16 x 1 at 0,0; the elytra 10 x 20 x 2 at 22,0), so a player wearing
// an elytra wears the design's wings, as in vanilla - each design has its own (outline and picture, WINGS), they are
// not the cape stretched. Animated capes are 16 frames made once; the current
// one is copied into the cape's texture only when it changes (8 a second), nothing is made per frame.
// The cape hangs from the top of the back and swings like vanilla's (CapeLayer): it trails a lagging point that
// follows the player, swings more when moving forward or falling, sways while walking, and moves out over a
// chestplate. Not drawn in first person.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Capes = (() => {

    }

  // (the same penguin as a sprite for the animated one: '.' is the sky behind it; its feet are drawn on their own)
  const PENGUIN = ['...kkkk...', '..kkkkkk..', '..kekkek..', '..kkookk..', '..kkWWkk..', '.kkWWWWkk.', '.kkWWWWkk.', '.kkWWWWkk.', '..kWWWWk..', '..kWWWWk..', '..kkWWkk..', '...kkkk...'];

  const GOLDAPPLE = ['....b...', '...bgG..', '.yy.byy.', 'yWYyyyyy', 'yYYyyyyo', 'yYyyyyyo', 'yyyyyyoo', '.yyyyoo.', '..yo.oo.'];
  // ---- the animated designs: colour at (u, v) of the cape (0-1 across, 0-1 down) at time t (0-1, one loop) ----
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const mix = (a, b, f) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * f];
  const STAR = (u, v, seed) => {
    const h = Math.sin(Math.floor(u * 10) * 12.9898 + Math.floor(v * 16) * 78.233 + seed) * 43758.5453;
    return h - Math.floor(h);
  };
  const ANIM = {
    // a summer sunset by the sea: the sun low in an orange sky, its light glittering on the water, waves running up the sand
    sunset(u, v, t) {
      const x = Math.min(9, Math.floor(u * 10)),
        y = Math.min(15, Math.floor(v * 16));
      const rnd = s => {
        const h = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233 + s) * 43758.5453;
        return h - Math.floor(h);
      };
      if (y < 8) {
        let c = mix(hex('#FF7A59'), hex('#FFD27A'), y / 7);
        const r = Math.hypot(x - 4.5, (y - 6.2) * 1.1);
        if (r < 2.4) c = hex(r < 1.4 ? '#FFF6C8' : '#FFE27A');
        if (y < 3 && rnd(2) > 0.86) c = mix(c, hex('#FFB8A0'), 0.6); // a few pink clouds
        return c;
      }
      if (y < 13) {
        // the sun's path on the water: glints that change every frame
        let c = y === 8 ? hex('#4AA3E0') : hex(y < 11 ? '#2B7FD1' : '#1F64B0');
        if (Math.abs(x - 4.5) < 1.6 - (y - 8) * 0.15 && rnd(Math.floor(t * 16)) > 0.4) c = hex(y === 8 ? '#FFF2B0' : '#FFD27A');
        return c;
      }
      const foam = 13 + Math.round(0.9 * Math.sin(t * TAU + x * 0.4));
      if (y === foam) return hex('#F5FBFF');
      if (y < foam) return hex('#5BB7E8');
      return hex(y === 15 ? '#E8C77E' : '#F2D79B');
    },
    lava(u, v, t) {
      const flow = Math.sin(u * 7 + Math.sin(v * 5 + t * TAU) * 1.5) * Math.cos(v * 6 - t * TAU * 2) + 0.6 * Math.sin((u + v) * 9 + t * TAU);
      let c = flow > 0.9 ? hex('#FFE27A') : flow > 0.35 ? hex('#FF9A2A') : flow > -0.3 ? hex('#E0461A') : flow > -0.9 ? hex('#7A1A0A') : hex('#2E0A04');
      return c;
    },
    nebula(u, v, t) {
      const a = Math.sin(u * 4 + t * TAU) + Math.sin(v * 5 - t * TAU) + Math.sin((u - v) * 6 + 1.3) * 0.7 + Math.sin(u * 9 + v * 3 + t * TAU * 2) * 0.4;
      const f = (a + 3) / 6;
      let c = f < 0.4 ? mix(hex('#0A0420'), hex('#2A1060'), f / 0.4) : f < 0.7 ? mix(hex('#2A1060'), hex('#7A3AB8'), (f - 0.4) / 0.3) : mix(hex('#7A3AB8'), hex('#F08AD8'), Math.min(1, (f - 0.7) / 0.3));
      const s = STAR(u, v, 7);
      if (s > 0.9) c = mix(c, [255, 255, 255], Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * TAU * 3 + s * 60)));
      return c;
    }
  };
  // the administrators' crown (选项 → 账号 → 管理员), in eight colourings they pick from: a diamond weave, a border
  // with a light running round it, a crown set with two jewels that glint, a star below that breathes, sparks, and a
  // sheen sweeping across now and then. A colouring: background top / bottom, weave, border and its light, crown
  // light / mid / dark, the two jewels, the star's light, the sparks
  const CROWN = ['#.##.#', '######', '#R##B#', '######'];
  const STARP = ['.##.', '####', '.##.'];
  const GOLDS = {
    rim: '#E8B830',
    rimL: '#FFF6C0',
    crL: '#FFE27A',
    cr: '#F2C94C',
    crD: '#C8961E',
    star: '#FFF0A0'
  };
  const SILVER = {
    rim: '#B8C0CC',
    rimL: '#FFFFFF',
    crL: '#F2F5FA',
    cr: '#C8D0DC',
    crD: '#8A94A4',
    star: '#FFFFFF'

  const crownCape = P => (u, v, t) => {
    const x = Math.min(9, Math.floor(u * 10)),
      y = Math.min(15, Math.floor(v * 16));
    const RIM = hex(P.rim),
      LIGHT = hex(P.rimL);
    if (x === 0 || x === 9 || y === 0 || y === 15) {
      // (48 pixels round the edge; the light goes round once a loop)
      const k = y === 0 ? x : x === 9 ? 9 + y : y === 15 ? 24 + (9 - x) : 33 + (15 - y);
      const d = Math.abs(((k - t * 48) % 48 + 48) % 48),
        near = Math.min(d, 48 - d);
      return near < 1.5 ? LIGHT : near < 3.5 ? mix(RIM, LIGHT, 0.45) : RIM;
    }
    const sheen = c => {
      const s = (x + y * 0.6) / 15,
        p = t * 1.6 % 1.6 - 0.2;
      return Math.abs(s - p) < 0.07 ? mix(c, [255, 255, 255], 0.3) : c;
    };
    const cr = y >= 2 && y <= 5 && x >= 2 && x <= 7 ? CROWN[y - 2][x - 2] : '.';
    if (cr === 'R' || cr === 'B') return mix(hex(cr === 'R' ? P.j1 : P.j2), [255, 255, 255], Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * TAU * 2 + (cr === 'R' ? 0 : 2))) * 0.5);
    if (cr === '#') return sheen(hex(y === 2 ? P.crL : y === 5 ? P.crD : P.cr));
    const st = y >= 9 && y <= 11 && x >= 3 && x <= 6 ? STARP[y - 9][x - 3] : '.';
    if (st === '#') return mix(hex(P.crD), hex(P.star), 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * TAU));
    let c = mix(hex(P.bg1), hex(P.bg2), y / 15);
    if ((x + y) % 4 === 0 && ((x - y) % 4 + 4) % 4 === 0) c = mix(c, hex(P.weave), 0.55);
    const sp = STAR(u, v, 11);
    if (sp > 0.92) c = mix(c, hex(P.spark), Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * TAU * 3 + sp * 60)) * 0.9);
    return sheen(c);
  };

      return blink ? hex('#1A0826') : mix(hex('#CC33FF'), hex('#FFD0FF'), 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * TAU * 2));

  // the aurora: a night sky, two ribbons of light waving (green to cyan, violet below), stars, snowy mountains

  // lifts the other foot and rises a pixel - while snow falls past it (16 frames: two steps each way)
  ANIM.penguinwalk = (u, v, t) => {
    const [x, y] = px(u, v),
      f = Math.floor(t * 16) % 16,
      step = (f >> 1) % 4;
    const dx = [0, 1, 0, -1][step],
      lift = step === 1 ? 0 : step === 3 ? 1 : -1,
      dy = lift >= 0 ? -1 : 0;
    if (y >= 14) return hex(y === 15 && x % 4 === 1 ? '#D6ECFA' : '#F4FAFF');
    const sy = y - 1 - dy,
      sx = x - dx;
    const ch = sy >= 0 && sy < 12 && sx >= 0 && sx < 10 ? PENGUIN[sy][sx] : '.';
    if (ch !== '.') return hex({
      k: '#1E1E26',
      e: '#FFFFFF',
      o: '#F29A2E',
      W: '#F7F7F2'
    }[ch]);
    // the feet, each under its side of the body (s 0 the left): the lifted one a row up, the other on the snow
    for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
      const fx = (s ? 6 : 2) + dx,
        top = lift === s || dy ? 12 : 13,
        bot = lift === s ? 12 : 13;
      if ((x === fx || x === fx + 1) && y >= top && y <= bot) return hex('#F29A2E');
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
      const fy = (k * 7 + f) % 16,
        fx = ((k * 3 + 1) % 10 + ((fy >> 2) + k & 1)) % 10;
      if (x === fx && y === fy) return hex('#FFFFFF');
    }
    return hex(y < 7 ? '#BFE6FF' : '#C8EAFF');
  };

      g.push(w.color(i, j, t, rim));
    }
    return g;
  }
  const LIST = [{

  // the colours an administrator's wings throw off as sparks (wingFx): the crowns' sparks, border light and jewels
  const fx = id => {
