  const FRAMES = 16,
    FPS = 8;
  // (designs with a longer loop: the smeltery's colours turn slowly - 48 frames, 6 s)
  const NFRAMES = {
    smeltery: 48
  };
  // the texture of one design (one frame): colour at (u, v) painted over the cape's and the elytra's faces
  // inset: the edges (the cape's 1-pixel thickness, the elytra's sides) take the colour a pixel in from the border -
  // an animated design's outer row can be its darkest and read as a black strip along the top
  function paint(colorAt, inset, wing, t) {
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = 64;
    cv.height = 32;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d'),
      id = x.createImageData(64, 32),
      d = id.data;
    const put = (px, py, c, dim = 1) => {
      const i = (py * 64 + px) * 4;
      d[i] = c[0] * dim;
      d[i + 1] = c[1] * dim;
      d[i + 2] = c[2] * dim;
      d[i + 3] = 255;
    };
    const rect = (x0, y0, w, h, f) => {
      for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) f(x0 + i, y0 + j, (i + 0.5) / w, (j + 0.5) / h);
    };
    const e0 = inset ? 0.15 : 0,
      e1 = 1 - e0,
      rim = (u, v) => colorAt(Math.min(e1, Math.max(e0, u)), Math.min(e1, Math.max(e0, v)));
    const edge = rim(0.5, 0.97);
    rect(1, 1, 10, 16, (px, py, u, v) => put(px, py, colorAt(u, v))); // outside
    rect(12, 1, 10, 16, (px, py, u, v) => put(px, py, colorAt(1 - u, v), 0.62)); // inside (against the back)
    rect(0, 1, 1, 16, (px, py, u, v) => put(px, py, rim(0, v), 0.8));
    rect(11, 1, 1, 16, (px, py, u, v) => put(px, py, rim(1, v), 0.8));
    rect(1, 0, 10, 1, (px, py, u) => put(px, py, rim(u, 0), 0.9));
    rect(11, 0, 10, 1, (px, py, u) => put(px, py, edge, 0.8));
    // the elytra (vanilla's box 10 x 20 x 2 at 22, 0; the left wing, the right one mirrored): this design's own wing.
    // The outside (seen from behind) is the face at 36 (u 36 the outer edge, 45 the spine), the inside the face at 24
    // (the other way round, darker); the sides, top and bottom only where the outline reaches them
    const W = wingGrid(wing, t),
      at = (i, j) => W[j * 10 + i];
    for (let j = 0; j < 20; j++) for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const c = at(i, j);
      if (!c) continue;
      put(45 - i, 2 + j, c);
      put(24 + i, 2 + j, c, 0.7);
      if (i === 0) {
        put(22, 2 + j, c, 0.8);
        put(23, 2 + j, c, 0.8);
      }
      if (i === 9) {
        put(34, 2 + j, c, 0.8);
        put(35, 2 + j, c, 0.8);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      if (at(i, 0)) {
        put(24 + i, 0, at(i, 0), 0.9);
        put(24 + i, 1, at(i, 0), 0.9);
      }
      if (at(i, 19)) {
        put(34 + i, 0, at(i, 19), 0.8);
        put(34 + i, 1, at(i, 19), 0.8);
      }
    }
    x.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
    return cv;
  }
  const artAt = a => (u, v) => {
    const r = a.rows[Math.min(15, Math.floor(v * 16))],
      ch = r[Math.min(9, Math.floor(u * 10))];
    return hex(a.pal[ch] || '#FF00FF');
  };
  const made = new Map(); // id -> { frames: [canvas], tex, shown }
  // (a design replaced by another: whoever wore it wears the new one)
  const ALIAS = {
      aurora: 'sunset'
    },
    norm = id => ALIAS[id] || id;
  function get(id) {
    id = norm(id);
    let c = made.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    if (ART[id]) c = {
      frames: [paint(artAt(ART[id]), false, WINGS[id], 0)]
    };else if (ANIM[id]) {
      const n = NFRAMES[id] || FRAMES;
      c = {
        frames: Array.from({
          length: n
        }, (_, f) => paint((u, v) => ANIM[id](u, v, f / n), true, WINGS[id], f / n))
      };
    } else return null;
    made.set(id, c);
    return c;
  }
  const frameNow = c => c.frames.length > 1 ? Math.floor(performance.now() / 1000 * FPS) % c.frames.length : 0;
  // the renderer's texture key of a cape, its current frame uploaded
  function texKey(r, id) {
    id = norm(id);
    const c = get(id);
    if (!c) return null;
    const key = 'cape_' + id,
      gl = r.gl,
      f = frameNow(c);
    if (!r.entityTex[key]) {
      r.entityTex[key] = r.tex2D(c.frames[f], false);
      c.shown = f;
    } else if (c.shown !== f) {
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex[key]);
      gl.texSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, c.frames[f]);
      c.shown = f;
    }
    return key;
  }
  // the model: an empty part that follows the body, and the cape (vanilla PlayerCapeModel: the box turned around)
  function initModel(r) {
    if (r.models.cape) return;
    const parts = [{
      name: 'body',
      pivot: [0, 12, 0],
      boxes: []
    }, {
      name: 'cape',
      parent: 'body',
      pivot: [0, 12, 2],
      boxes: [[0, 0, -5, -16, -1, 10, 16, 1]],
      rotY: Math.PI
    }];
    for (const p of parts) p.mesh = r.makeModelPart(p.boxes, 64, 32);
    r.models.cape = {
      parts
    };
  }
  // a design's wings: vanilla's elytra boxes (the same texture layout, equip.js eq_elytra) pressed to one pixel thick,
  // half a pixel off the back. Vanilla's are four thick (2, inflated 1 each way) - with a design's own outline they
  // read as slabs
  function initWings(r) {
    if (r.models.cape_wings) return;
    const thin = data => {
      for (let k = 2; k < data.length; k += 8) data[k] = (1 + (data[k] * 16 - 1) * 0.25) / 16;
    };
    const parts = [{
      name: 'lw',
      pivot: [-5, 24, 2],
      boxes: [[22, 0, 0, -20, 0, 10, 20, 2, 1]]
    }, {
      name: 'rw',
      pivot: [5, 24, 2],
      boxes: [[22, 0, -10, -20, 0, 10, 20, 2, 1, true]]
    }];
    for (const p of parts) p.mesh = r.makeModelPart(p.boxes, 64, 32, thin);
    r.models.cape_wings = {
      parts
    };
  }
  // the swing (vanilla CapeLayer / Player cloak): a point trailing the player, eased per frame (0.25 a tick). It
  // trails where the model is drawn (ip, between two ticks) and turns with the drawn body: the tick position jumps
  // 20 times a second, and trailing that made the cape twitch on every tick while moving
  function swing(g, e, a, sneaking, ip) {
    var _ref, _e$bodyYaw;
    const now = performance.now(),
      p = ip || e.pos;
    if (!e.cloak || now - (e.cloakT || 0) > 1000) {
      e.cloak = [p[0], p[1], p[2]];
      e.cloakT = now;
    }
    const dt = Math.min(0.25, (now - e.cloakT) / 1000);
    e.cloakT = now;
    const k = 1 - Math.pow(0.75, dt * 20);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      if (Math.abs(p[i] - e.cloak[i]) > 10) e.cloak[i] = p[i];
      e.cloak[i] += (p[i] - e.cloak[i]) * k;
    }
    let by = (_ref = (_e$bodyYaw = e.bodyYaw) !== null && _e$bodyYaw !== void 0 ? _e$bodyYaw : e.yaw) !== null && _ref !== void 0 ? _ref : 0;
    if (e === g.player && g.playerBodyYaw) by = g.playerBodyYaw(a);else if (e.prevBodyYaw !== undefined) {
      let d = by - e.prevBodyYaw;
      while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
      by = e.prevBodyYaw + d * a;
    }
    const dx = e.cloak[0] - p[0],
      dy = e.cloak[1] - p[1],
      dz = e.cloak[2] - p[2];
    // behind the body (this game's yaw 0 faces -z): how far back and to the side the trailing point is
    const back = dx * Math.sin(by) + dz * Math.cos(by),
      side = dx * Math.cos(by) - dz * Math.sin(by);
    let up = clamp(dy * 10, -6, 32);
    const f2 = clamp(back * 100, 0, 150),
      f3 = clamp(side * 100, -20, 20);
    // the sway while walking: vanilla sin(walkDist * 6) * 32 * bob, walkDist 0.6 a block walked and bob the eased
    // ground speed (at most 0.1). This player keeps both (the view bobbing's bob / bobAmt); another player only its
    // legs' swing, which goes on 4 a block (walkDist about 0.15 of it, bob about a quarter of the swing speed)
    let walk, bob;
    if (e.bobAmt !== undefined) {
      walk = lerp(e.prevBob || 0, e.bob || 0, a) * 0.6;
      bob = lerp(e.prevBobAmt || 0, e.bobAmt, a);
    } else {
      walk = ((e.limbSwing || 0) - (e.limbAmt || 0) * (1 - a)) * 0.15;
      bob = e.flying ? 0 : Math.min(0.1, (e.limbAmt || 0) / 4);
    }
    up += Math.sin(walk * 6) * 32 * bob;
    if (sneaking) up += 25;
    const D = Math.PI / 180;
    return {
      rx: -(6 + f2 / 2 + up) * D,
      rz: f3 / 2 * D,
      ry: -f3 / 2 * D
    };
  }
  // which cape a player wears: this player's from the account (if unlocked), another player's from what the room sent
  function of(g, e) {
    let id = null;
    if (e === g.player) {
      const pv = typeof Skins !== 'undefined' && Skins.preview(),
        s = pv || Account.data && Account.data.skin;
      id = s && s.cape;
      if (id && !unlocked(id)) id = null;
    } else if (e.look) id = e.look.cape;
    return id && get(id) ? norm(id) : null;
  }
  const info = id => LIST.find(c => c.id === norm(id));
  // (the event's capes: owned by the account - a super administrator owns them all, the room service says so)
  const evOwned = id => !!(Account.loggedIn && (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics.owned() : Account.data && Account.data.owned || []).includes('cape:' + id));
  const unlocked = id => {
    const c = info(id);
    return !!c && (c.ev ? evOwned(c.id) : c.admin ? !!(Account.data && Account.data.super) : Account.has(c.anim ? 'anim' : 'static'));
  };
  // the display setting (选项 → 皮肤与装饰, cosmetics.js): whose capes are drawn. The wardrobe's and the inventory's
  // previews always show this player's
  const shown = (g, e, opts) => typeof Cosmetics === 'undefined' || Cosmetics.shown(g, e, opts);
  // drawn with the player model (game.js drawMob, the inventory preview): m is the model matrix, poses the player's.
  // The decorations worn on the model (a hat; a pet in the wardrobe's preview) come with it
  function draw(g, e, m, poses, lt, env, opts) {
    if (shown(g, e, opts)) drawCape(g, e, m, poses, lt, env, opts);
    if (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined') Cosmetics.drawOn(g, e, m, poses, lt, env, opts);
  }
  function drawCape(g, e, m, poses, lt, env, opts) {
    const id = of(g, e);
    if (!id) return;
    const r = g.renderer;
    initModel(r);
    const key = texKey(r, id);
    if (!key) return;
    const chest = e.inv ? e.inv.slots[38 - 1] : (e.armorItems || [])[1];
    const elytra = chest && keyOfStack(chest) === 'elytra';
    if (elytra) return; // (the design is on the wings instead)
    const s = opts && opts.still ? {
      rx: -6 * Math.PI / 180,
      rz: 0,
      ry: 0
    } : swing(g, e, opts && opts.a != null ? opts.a : g.frameA || 1, e.sneaking && !e.flying, opts && opts.ip);
    const armoured = !!(chest && ITEMS[chest.id].armor && ITEMS[chest.id].armor.mat !== 'elytra');
    const P = {
      body: poses && poses.body ? poses.body : undefined,
      cape: {
        rx: s.rx,
        rz: s.rz,
        ry: s.ry,
        t: armoured ? [0, 0, 1 / 16] : undefined
      }
    };
    const gl = r.gl,
      cull = gl.isEnabled(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    r.drawModel('cape', key, m, P, lt, env, opts || {});
    if (cull) gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  }
  // a cape flat on a menu: its outside, s screen pixels a texel, greyed when locked
  function drawFlat(c, id, x, y, s, locked) {
    const cp = get(id);
    if (!cp) return;
    const f = frameNow(cp);
    c.drawImage(cp.frames[f], 1, 1, 10, 16, x, y, 10 * s, 16 * s);
    if (locked) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      c.fillRect(x, y, 10 * s, 16 * s);
    }
  }
  return {
    list: LIST,
    get,
    texKey,
    draw,
    drawFlat,
    of,
    info,
    unlocked,
    shown,
    initModel,
    initWings,
    fx
  };
})();

// the player models draw their capes; an elytra worn by a caped player shows the cape (vanilla WingsLayer)
(() => {
  const dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
    if ((e === this.player || e.type === 'player') && !e.dead && !(e.invisible || e.hasEffect && e.hasEffect('invisibility')) && this.lastPlayerModel) {
      try {
        Capes.draw(this, e, this.lastPlayerModel.m, this.lastPlayerModel.poses, this.lastPlayerModel.lt, env, {
          ip,
          a
        });
      } catch (err) {
        this.reportError('cape', err, true);
      }
    }
    this.lastPlayerModel = null;
  };
  // (drawMob keeps the matrix and poses of the player model it drew: game.js)
  const dw = Game.prototype.drawWings;
  if (dw) Game.prototype.drawWings = function (e, m, lt, env, overlay, vp) {
    // (a design hidden by the display setting: vanilla's elytra; the previews pass vp and always show it)
    const id = Capes.shown(this, e, vp ? {
        inv: true
      } : null) ? Capes.of(this, e) : null,
      r = this.renderer;
    if (!id) return dw.call(this, e, m, lt, env, overlay, vp);
    // the design's texture on its own thin wings (the vanilla ones stay for an elytra without a cape)
    const k = Capes.texKey(r, id),
      bt = r.beTex;
    r.initEquipModels();
    Capes.initWings(r);
    const em = r.models.eq_elytra;
    // (an administrator's: 1.3 times as large, grown out from the shoulders, and glowing - lit in the dark too)
    const adm = !!(Capes.info(id) && Capes.info(id).admin),
      rdm = r.drawModel;
    if (adm) {
      m = new Float32Array(m);
      M4.translate(m, 0, 1.5, 0.125);
      M4.scale(m, 1.3, 1.3, 1.3);
      M4.translate(m, 0, -1.5, -0.125);
      r.drawModel = function (n, t, mm, ps, l2, e2, o) {
        return rdm.call(this, n, t, mm, ps, l2, e2, {
          ...(o || {}),
          bright: true
        });
      };
    }
    r.beTex = n => n === 'elytra_wings' ? k : bt.call(r, n);
    r.models.eq_elytra = r.models.cape_wings;
    try {
      dw.call(this, e, m, lt, env, overlay, vp);
    } finally {
      r.beTex = bt;
      r.models.eq_elytra = em;
      r.drawModel = rdm;
    }
  };
  // an administrator's elytra throws off sparks in its design's colours: a trail from both wing tips while gliding,
  // thicker with bursts in the jewels' colours under a rocket's boost, now and then one while standing (anyone wearing
  // one: this player, and others in a room)
  // (white particles, coloured: the critical-hit star, floating instead of falling; the potion swirl)
  const spark = (g, type, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, col) => {
    const L = g.particles.list,
      n = L.length;
    g.particles.spawn(type, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, {
      col
    });
    if (L.length > n) {
      const q = L[L.length - 1];
      q.col = col;
      q.bright = true;
      if (type === 'crit') {
        q.grav = 0;
        q.life = 14 + Math.random() * 8;
      }
    }
  };
  function wingFx(g, e, cols) {
    var _ref2, _e$bodyYaw2;
    const by = (_ref2 = (_e$bodyYaw2 = e.bodyYaw) !== null && _e$bodyYaw2 !== void 0 ? _e$bodyYaw2 : e.yaw) !== null && _ref2 !== void 0 ? _ref2 : 0,
      bk = [Math.sin(by), Math.cos(by)],
      sd = [Math.cos(by), -Math.sin(by)],
      R = Math.random;
    const v = e === g.player ? e.vel : e.netVel || [0, 0, 0],
      pick = () => cols[R() * cols.length | 0];
    if (e.gliding) {
      const boost = e === g.player ? e.boostT > 0 : Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) > 1.2;
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        // (the tips of the spread wings: out to the sides and a little up and back; somewhere along the outer edge)
        const f = 0.8 + R() * 0.2,
          x = e.pos[0] + sd[0] * s * 1.75 * f + bk[0] * 0.5,
          y = e.pos[1] + 0.75 * f,
          z = e.pos[2] + sd[1] * s * 1.75 * f + bk[1] * 0.5;
        spark(g, 'crit', x, y, z, -v[0] * 0.15 + (R() - 0.5) * 0.02, -v[1] * 0.15 + (R() - 0.5) * 0.02, -v[2] * 0.15 + (R() - 0.5) * 0.02, pick());
        if (boost) for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) spark(g, 'effect', x, y, z, (R() - 0.5) * 0.2, (R() - 0.5) * 0.2, (R() - 0.5) * 0.2, cols[2 + (R() * (cols.length - 2) | 0)] || pick());
      }
    } else if (g.tickCount % 7 === 0) {
      const s = R() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1,
        up = 0.6 + R() * 0.8;
      spark(g, 'crit', e.pos[0] + sd[0] * s * 0.45 + bk[0] * 0.35, e.pos[1] + up, e.pos[2] + sd[1] * s * 0.45 + bk[1] * 0.35, 0, 0.01, 0, pick());
    }
  }
  const tk = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const r = tk.apply(this, arguments);
    if (this.state !== 'play' || !this.world || this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses && !this.net) return r;
    for (const e of [this.player, ...this.entities]) {
      if (!e || e.dead || e !== this.player && e.type !== 'player') continue;
      const id = Capes.shown(this, e) && Capes.of(this, e),
        cols = id && Capes.info(id) && Capes.info(id).admin && Capes.fx(id);
      if (!cols) continue;
      if (keyOfStack(e.inv ? e.inv.slots[37] : (e.armorItems || [])[1]) !== 'elytra') continue;
      wingFx(this, e, cols);
    }
    return r;
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/skins.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skins (game/ACCOUNT_PLAN.md「皮肤系统」): preset skins (skins_data.js, loaded when needed) and a premium player's
// skin looked up by name (the room service asks Mojang: skin and arm model, never their cape). Classic (4 px) or slim
// (3 px) arms, the second layer, old 64 x 32 skins turned into 64 x 64 like vanilla; the first-person arm uses the
// skin too. In a room the web players tell each other what they wear (a 'look' message the room service passes on).
// Presets are free; a premium player's skin needs 三连 (Account.has('skin')); keeping a choice needs an account.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Skins = (() => {
  const canv = new Map(); // id -> 64 x 64 canvas
  const loading = new Map();
  let presetsP = null;
  function presets() {
    if (self.SKIN_PRESETS) return Promise.resolve(self.SKIN_PRESETS);
    if (!presetsP) presetsP = new Promise(res => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'js/skins_data.js';
      s.onload = () => res(self.SKIN_PRESETS || []);
      s.onerror = () => res([]);
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return presetsP;
  }
  // an image -> a 64 x 64 skin canvas (vanilla SkinTextureDownloader.processLegacySkin for 64 x 32 ones)
  function normalize(img) {
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = 64;
    cv.height = 64;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d');
    x.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    if (img.height === 32) {
      const copy = (sx, sy, dx, dy, w, h) => {
        const d = x.getImageData(sx, sy, w, h),
          o = x.createImageData(w, h);
        for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) o.data[(j * w + i) * 4 + k] = d.data[(j * w + (w - 1 - i)) * 4 + k];
        x.putImageData(o, sx + dx, sy + dy);
      };
      copy(4, 16, 16, 32, 4, 4);
      copy(8, 16, 16, 32, 4, 4);
      copy(0, 20, 24, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(4, 20, 16, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(8, 20, 8, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(12, 20, 16, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(44, 16, -8, 32, 4, 4);
      copy(48, 16, -8, 32, 4, 4);
      copy(40, 20, 0, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(44, 20, -8, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(48, 20, -16, 32, 4, 12);
      copy(52, 20, -8, 32, 4, 12);
    }
    // the base layer has no see-through pixels; a hat drawn fully opaque (old skins) is no hat at all
    const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, 64, 64),
      p = d.data,
      A = (i, j) => p[(j * 64 + i) * 4 + 3];
    const opaque = (x0, y0, x1, y1) => {
      for (let j = y0; j < y1; j++) for (let i = x0; i < x1; i++) p[(j * 64 + i) * 4 + 3] = 255;
    };
    opaque(0, 0, 32, 16);
    opaque(0, 16, 64, 32);
    opaque(16, 48, 48, 64);
    let full = true;
    for (let j = 0; j < 16 && full; j++) for (let i = 32; i < 64; i++) if (A(i, j) < 128) {
      full = false;
      break;
    }
    if (full) for (let j = 0; j < 16; j++) for (let i = 32; i < 64; i++) p[(j * 64 + i) * 4 + 3] = 0;
    x.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
    return cv;
  }
  const loadImg = src => new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const im = new Image();
    im.onload = () => res(im);
    im.onerror = () => rej(new Error('皮肤图片读不出来'));
    im.src = src;
  });
  // a skin's canvas: 'p:<preset id>' or 'm:<premium name>' (loaded once, then from memory)
  function load(id) {
    if (canv.has(id)) return Promise.resolve(canv.get(id));
    if (loading.has(id)) return loading.get(id);
    const p = (async () => {
      let src,
        slim = false;
      if (id.startsWith('p:')) {
        const s = (await presets()).find(q => q.id === id.slice(2));
        if (!s) throw new Error('没有这个皮肤');
        src = s.png;
        slim = s.slim;
      } else if (id.startsWith('m:')) {
        let v = null;
        try {
          v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-skin-' + id.slice(2).toLowerCase()) || 'null');
        } catch (e) {}
        if (!v || Date.now() - v.at > 86400e3) {
          v = await RoomService.api('/api/skin?name=' + encodeURIComponent(id.slice(2)));
          v.at = Date.now();
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('mcjs-skin-' + id.slice(2).toLowerCase(), JSON.stringify(v));
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        src = 'data:image/png;base64,' + v.png;
        slim = v.slim;
      } else throw new Error('皮肤编号不对');
      const cv = normalize(await loadImg(src));
      cv.slim = slim;
      canv.set(id, cv);
      return cv;
    })();
    loading.set(id, p);
    p.catch(() => loading.delete(id));
    return p;
  }
  // a look ({skin: id, slim, cape}) -> what to draw; skins still loading show Steve meanwhile
  const keyOf = id => 'skin_' + id.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_:]/g, '_');
  function tex(r, id) {
    if (!id) return 'steve';
    const k = keyOf(id);
    if (r.entityTex[k]) return k;
    const cv = canv.get(id);
    if (cv) {
      r.entityTex[k] = r.tex2D(cv, false);
      return k;
    }
    load(id).catch(() => {});
    return 'steve';
  }
  // this player's look: the preview being chosen, else the account's (a premium skin only once 三连 is done)
  let preview = null;
  function lookOf(g, e) {
    if (e === g.player) {
      if (preview) return preview;
      const s = Account.data && Account.data.skin;
      if (!s) return null;
      if (s.skin && s.skin.startsWith('m:') && !Account.has('skin')) return {
        skin: null,
        slim: false,
        cape: s.cape
      };
      return s;
    }
    return e.look || null;
  }
  function initModels(r) {
    if (r.models.steve_slim) return;
    const P = parts => {
      for (const p of parts) p.mesh = r.makeModelPart(p.boxes, 64, 64);
      return {
        parts
      };
    };
    // slim arms (vanilla PlayerModel slim: 3 px wide, the pivot in the same place)
    r.models.steve_slim = P(r.models.steve.parts.map(p => {
      if (p.name === 'rarm') return {
        name: 'rarm',
        pivot: [5.5, 22, 0],
        boxes: [[40, 16, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4], [40, 32, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4, 0.25]]
      };
      if (p.name === 'larm') return {
        name: 'larm',
        pivot: [-5.5, 22, 0],
        boxes: [[32, 48, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4], [48, 48, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4, 0.25]]
      };
      return {
        name: p.name,
        pivot: p.pivot,
        boxes: p.boxes,
        rotX: p.rotX,
        rotY: p.rotY,
        parent: p.parent
      };
    }));
    r.models.arm_slim = P([{
      name: 'arm',
      pivot: [0, 0, 0],
      boxes: [[40, 16, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4], [40, 32, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4, 0.25]]
    }]);
    r.models.arm_left_slim = P([{
      name: 'arm',
      pivot: [0, 0, 0],
      boxes: [[32, 48, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4], [48, 48, -1.5, -10, -2, 3, 12, 4, 0.25]]
    }]);
  }
  const api = {
    presets,
    load,
    normalize,
    modelOf(g, e) {
      const l = lookOf(g, e);
      if (l && l.slim) {
        initModels(g.renderer);
        return 'steve_slim';
      }
      return 'steve';
    },
    texOf(g, e) {
      const l = lookOf(g, e);
      return tex(g.renderer, l && l.skin);
    },
    armOf(g, left) {
      const l = lookOf(g, g.player);
      if (l && l.slim) {
        initModels(g.renderer);
        return left ? 'arm_left_slim' : 'arm_slim';
      }
      return left ? 'arm_left' : 'arm';
    },
    setPreview(l) {
      preview = l;
    },
    preview() {
      return preview;
    },
    // what this player wears, for the others in a room (and the decorations it owns: cosmetics.js)
    mine(g) {
      const l = lookOf(g, g.player) || {};
      return {
        skin: l.skin || null,
        slim: !!l.slim,
        cape: Capes.of(g, g.player),
        ...(typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics.mine(g) : {})
      };
    }
  };
  return api;
})();

// ---- in a room: tell the others what this player wears, and take theirs ----
(() => {
  // (hat, pet, pre: the decorations' names, cosmetics.js - the room service checked they are owned)
  const word = v => !v || /^[a-z]{3,16}$/.test(String(v));
  const ok = l => l && typeof l === 'object' && (l.skin === null || /^(p:[a-z_]{3,20}|m:[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,16})$/.test(l.skin || '')) && (!l.cape || Capes.info(l.cape)) && word(l.hat) && word(l.pet) && word(l.pre);
  const om = NetClient.prototype.onMessage;
  NetClient.prototype.onMessage = function (m) {
    if (m && m.t === 'look') {
      if (!ok(m.look)) return;
      (this.looks || (this.looks = new Map())).set(String(m.name), {
        skin: m.look.skin || null,
        slim: !!m.look.slim,
        cape: m.look.cape || null,
        hat: m.look.hat || null,
        pet: m.look.pet || null,
        pre: m.look.pre || null
      });
      for (const e of this.g.entities) if (e.type === 'player' && e.name === m.name) e.look = this.looks.get(m.name);
      return;
    }
    const r = om.call(this, m);
    if (m && m.t === 'room') this.sendLook();
    return r;
  };
  NetClient.prototype.sendLook = function () {
    try {
      this.send({
        t: 'look',
        look: Skins.mine(this.g)
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  // a player who appears gets the look already known for its name
  const dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    if (e.type === 'player' && e !== this.player && !e.look && this.net && this.net.looks) e.look = this.net.looks.get(e.name) || null;
    return dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
  };
})();

// ---- 皮肤和装饰: a turning 3D preview, the skins, the capes, the hats, pets and name prefixes (cosmetics.js);
// locked ones say how to get them ----
class WardrobeScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '皮肤和装饰', parent);
    this.titleY = 8;
    const s = Account.data && Account.data.skin || {};
    this.look = {
      skin: s.skin || null,
      slim: !!s.slim,
      cape: s.cape || null,
      hat: s.hat || null,
      pet: s.pet || null,
      pre: s.pre || null
    };
    this.tab = 'skin';
    this.page = 0;
    this.mojang = s.skin && s.skin.startsWith('m:') ? s.skin.slice(2) : '';
    this.list = [];
    this.yaw = 0.5;
    this.drag = null;
    this.busy = false;
    Skins.presets().then(l => {
      this.list = l;
      for (const p of l) Skins.load('p:' + p.id).catch(() => {});
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
    });
    Account.loadGate();
  }
  get dirty() {
    const s = Account.data && Account.data.skin || {};
    return (s.skin || null) !== this.look.skin || !!s.slim !== this.look.slim || ['cape', 'hat', 'pet', 'pre'].some(k => (s[k] || null) !== (this.look[k] || null));
  }
  // a sign-in reward not owned yet: to the sign-in card (checkin.js), else a line saying how
  toCheckin(id) {
    if (this.giftOf(id) && typeof NewsBoard !== 'undefined') {
      NewsBoard.open(this.game, this, false);
      return;
    }
    const inf = typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.info(id);
    if (inf && inf.go === 'mods' && typeof openModsScreen === 'function') {
      openModsScreen(this.game, this);
      return;
    }
    if (inf && inf.how) {
      this.say(inf.how[0]);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof CheckinScreen !== 'undefined' && typeof Checkin !== 'undefined' && Checkin.shown()) this.game.ui.open(new CheckinScreen(this.game, this));else this.say('签到活动奖励：活动期间每天登录签到，累计签到就能领');
  }
  // how a locked sign-in reward is got: its day in the event's rewards as last read (checkin.js keeps it, also
  // across reloads; the server may change the order, so never hardcoded), else just that it's a reward
  // an announcement's gift (news.js): the published announcement that gives it
  giftOf(id) {
    return !!id && typeof NewsBoard !== 'undefined' && (NewsBoard.list || []).some(x => x.gift === id && !x.draft);
  }
  evHow(id) {
    if (this.giftOf(id)) return ['公告里的礼物', '点一下去领取'];
    // (one given some other way - cosmetics.js LIST: how)
    const inf = typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.info(id);
    if (inf && inf.how) return inf.how;
    const st = typeof Checkin !== 'undefined' && Checkin.st,
      R = st && st.event && Array.isArray(st.event.rewards) ? st.event.rewards : [];
    const i = R.indexOf(id);
    return [i >= 0 ? '签到第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 天' : '签到活动奖励', ...(typeof Checkin !== 'undefined' && Checkin.shown() ? ['点一下去签到'] : [])];
  }
  pv() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    return {
      x: Math.max(8, Math.floor(u.w / 2 - 190)),
      y: 26,
      w: 110,
      h: 170
    };
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      g = this.game,
      P = this.pv(),
      x0 = P.x + P.w + 10,
      W = Math.min(270, u.w - x0 - 8);
    this.fields = {};
    this.widgets = [];
    const TABS = [['skin', '皮肤'], ['cape', '披风'], ['hat', '帽子'], ['pet', '宠物'], ['pre', '前缀']],
      tw = W / TABS.length;
    TABS.forEach(([k, cn], i) => this.widgets.push({
      x: Math.round(x0 + i * tw),
      y: 24,
      w: Math.round(x0 + (i + 1) * tw) - Math.round(x0 + i * tw) - 2,
      h: 18,
      label: cn,
      color: this.tab === k ? '#FFFF55' : undefined,
      onClick: () => {
        this.tab = k;
        this.page = 0;
        this.layout();
      }
    }));
    const cell = 30,
      cols = Math.max(3, Math.floor(W / cell)),
      y0 = 48;
    if (this.tab === 'skin') {
      const items = [{
        id: null,
        name: '默认（史蒂夫）'
      }, ...this.list.filter(p => p.own)];
      items.forEach((p, i) => {
        const cx = x0 + i % cols * cell,
          cy = y0 + Math.floor(i / cols) * (cell + 2);
        this.widgets.push({
          x: cx,
          y: cy,
          w: cell - 2,
          h: cell - 2,
          label: '',
          skinIcon: p.id,
          sel: (p.id ? 'p:' + p.id : null) === this.look.skin,
          tip: [p.name + (p.id ? p.slim ? '（纤细）' : '（经典）' : '')],
          onClick: () => {
            this.look.skin = p.id ? 'p:' + p.id : null;
            this.look.slim = !!p.slim;
            this.layout();
          }
        });
      });
      const yy = y0 + Math.ceil(items.length / cols) * (cell + 2) + 6;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: x0,
        y: yy,
        w: W,
        h: 18,
        label: () => '手臂：' + (this.look.slim ? '纤细（3 像素，Alex）' : '经典（4 像素，Steve）'),
        onClick: () => {
          this.look.slim = !this.look.slim;
        }
      });
      if (Account.has('skin')) {
        this.addField('mojang', x0, yy + 36, W - 54, '正版玩家的皮肤（输入玩家名）', 16, nameOnly);
        this.widgets.push({
          x: x0 + W - 50,
          y: yy + 36,
          w: 50,
          h: 20,
          label: () => this.busy ? '…' : '使用',
          enabled: !this.busy,
          onClick: () => this.useMojang()
        });
      } else this.widgets.push({
        x: x0,
        y: yy + 26,
        w: W,
        h: 20,
        gold: true,
        label: '三连解锁：用正版玩家的皮肤',
        onClick: () => g.ui.open(new UnlockScreen(g, this))
      });
    } else if (this.tab === 'cape') {
      const items = [{
        id: null,
        name: '不穿披风'
      }, ...Capes.list.filter(c => !c.admin || Capes.unlocked(c.id))];
      items.forEach((c, i) => {
        const cx = x0 + i % cols * cell,
          cy = y0 + Math.floor(i / cols) * (cell + 12);
        const locked = c.id && !Capes.unlocked(c.id);
        // (the sign-in event's capes: owned once signed for, not unlocked by 三连 / following)
        const how = c.ev ? this.evHow('cape:' + c.id) : [c.anim ? '关注 UP 主解锁' : '给视频三连解锁', '点一下去解锁'];
        this.widgets.push({
          x: cx,
          y: cy,
          w: cell - 2,
          h: cell + 8,
          label: '',
          capeIcon: c.id,
          locked,
          sel: c.id === this.look.cape,
          tip: [c.name + (c.anim ? '（动态）' : ''), ...(locked ? how : [])],
          onClick: () => {
            if (locked && c.ev) this.toCheckin('cape:' + c.id);else if (locked) g.ui.open(new UnlockScreen(g, this, c.anim ? '关注 UP 主就能穿上动态披风' : '给视频三连就能穿上静态披风'));else {
              this.look.cape = c.id;
              this.layout();
            }
          }
        });
      });
    } else {
      // hats, pets, name prefixes (cosmetics.js): 'none' first, then each with its icon; all sign-in rewards for now
      const k = this.tab,
        C = typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics : null;
      const items = [{
        id: null,
        name: {
          hat: '不戴帽子',
          pet: '不带宠物',
          pre: '不用前缀'
        }[k]
      }, ...(C ? C.LIST.filter(d => d.kind === k) : [])];
      items.forEach((d, i) => {
        const cx = x0 + i % cols * cell,
          cy = y0 + Math.floor(i / cols) * (cell + 2);
        const v = d.id ? d.id.split(':')[1] : null,
          locked = !!d.id && !C.has(d.id);
        this.widgets.push({
          x: cx,
          y: cy,
          w: cell - 2,
          h: cell - 2,
          label: '',
          cosIcon: d.id,
          locked,
          sel: v === (this.look[k] || null),
          tip: [d.name, ...(locked ? this.evHow(d.id) : [])],
          onClick: () => {
            if (locked) this.toCheckin(d.id);else {
              this.look[k] = v;
              this.layout();
            }
          }
        });
      });
    }
    this.widgets.push({
      x: P.x,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 110,
      h: 20,
      label: () => this.busy ? '正在保存…' : this.dirty ? '保存' : '已保存',
      gold: this.dirty,
      enabled: !this.busy && this.dirty,
      onClick: () => this.saveLook()
    }, {
      x: P.x + 116,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 110,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
  }
  async useMojang() {
    const n = nameOnly(this.mojang || '');
    if (n.length < 3) {
      this.say('输入正版玩家名（3–16 个英文字母、数字或下划线）', true);
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在查找 ' + n + ' 的皮肤…');
    this.layout();
    try {
      const cv = await Skins.load('m:' + n);
      this.look.skin = 'm:' + n;
      this.look.slim = !!cv.slim;
      this.say('找到了：' + n + (cv.slim ? '（纤细手臂）' : '（经典手臂）'));
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  async saveLook() {
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      this.game.ui.open(new LoginScreen(this.game, () => this.game.ui.open(this)));
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.layout();
    try {
      await Account.update({
        skin: {
          ...this.look
        }
      });
      this.say('已保存');
      if (this.game.net) this.game.net.sendLook();
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    this.layout();
  }
  back() {
    Skins.setPreview(null);
    super.back();
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    const P = this.pv();
    if (mx >= P.x && mx < P.x + P.w && my >= P.y && my < P.y + P.h) {
      this.drag = {
        x: mx,
        yaw: this.yaw
      };
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (this.drag && ui.mouse.down) this.yaw = this.drag.yaw + (mx - this.drag.x) * 0.03;else super.mouseMove(ui, mx, my);
  }
  mouseUp(ui) {
    this.drag = null;
    super.mouseUp(ui);
  }
  draw(ui) {
    // the widgets with pictures (skins' faces, capes) are drawn here; the rest as usual
    // (the tooltips last, over the pictures: FormScreen.draw puts them right after the buttons)
    const pics = this.widgets.filter(w => w.skinIcon !== undefined || w.capeIcon !== undefined || w.cosIcon !== undefined);
    const tips = this.widgets.filter(w => w.tip);
    for (const w of tips) {
      w.tip0 = w.tip;
      w.tip = null;
    }
    try {
      super.draw(ui);
    } finally {
      for (const w of tips) {
        w.tip = w.tip0;
        delete w.tip0;
      }
    }
    const c = ui.ctx;
    for (const w of pics) {
      c.strokeStyle = w.sel ? '#FFFFFF' : '#555555';
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.strokeRect(w.x + 0.5, w.y + 0.5, w.w - 1, w.h - 1);
      if (w.skinIcon !== undefined) {
        const img = w.skinIcon ? this.faceOf('p:' + w.skinIcon) : this.game.renderer.images.steve;
        if (img) {
          c.drawImage(img, 8, 8, 8, 8, w.x + 4, w.y + 4, w.w - 8, w.h - 8);
          c.drawImage(img, 40, 8, 8, 8, w.x + 3, w.y + 3, w.w - 6, w.h - 6);
        }
      } else if (w.capeIcon) {
        Capes.drawFlat(c, w.capeIcon, w.x + 4, w.y + 3, 2, w.locked);
        if (w.locked) drawIcon(c, 'lock', w.x + w.w - 11, w.y + w.h - 11, 1, '#FFD24A');
      } else if (w.cosIcon) {
        Cosmetics.drawIcon(c, w.cosIcon, w.x + 2, w.y + 2, w.w - 4, w.locked);
        if (w.locked) drawIcon(c, 'lock', w.x + w.w - 11, w.y + w.h - 11, 1, '#FFD24A');
      } else Font.center(c, '无', w.x + w.w / 2, w.y + w.h / 2 - 4, '#A0A0A0');
    }
    for (const w of tips) if (ui.hit(w)) ui.tooltip(w.tip.map(t => ({
      text: t
    })), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  faceOf(id) {
    const s = this.faceCache || (this.faceCache = new Map());
    if (s.has(id)) return s.get(id);
    Skins.load(id).then(cv => s.set(id, cv)).catch(() => {});
    return null;
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      P = this.pv(),
      g = this.game;
    drawCard(c, P.x - 2, P.y - 2, P.w + 4, P.h + 4, false);
    // the turning preview (it turns by itself unless dragged)
    if (!this.drag) this.yaw += 0.01;
    Skins.setPreview(this.look);
    const cv = g.renderer.playerPreview(g, ui, P.x, P.y, P.w, P.h, {
      yaw: this.yaw
    });
    Skins.setPreview(null);
    if (cv) {
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      c.drawImage(cv, P.x, P.y, P.w, P.h);
    }
    // (on the prefix page: the name as others will see it)
    if (this.tab === 'pre' && typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined') Font.center(c, fitText(Cosmetics.preChar(this.look.pre) + (Account.loggedIn && Account.name || '玩家'), P.w - 4), P.x + P.w / 2, P.y + 4, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.center(c, '拖动可以转动', P.x + P.w / 2, P.y + P.h + 4, '#808080');
    this.drawFields(ui);
    if (!Account.loggedIn) Font.center(c, fitText('登录后才能保存（换设备、联机时别人也能看到）', ui.w - 8), ui.w / 2, ui.h - 42, '#FFD24A');
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/cloudsave.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Cloud saves (game/ACCOUNT_PLAN.md「云存档」, the service's cloud.js): a logged-in player's single-player worlds kept
// on the service too, so another device can carry on. Only what changed goes up: the chunks the game saved since the
// last sync (noted as they are written, per world) and the world's record, deflated, in batches. It syncs on leaving
// a world, every 10 minutes while playing, and when the page closes (as far as a closing page allows). A world
// changed both here and on another device is not merged: the player picks which copy stays. All of an account's
// cloud worlds together at most 100 MB; one nobody opened for 7 days is deleted from the cloud (not from here).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const CloudSave = (() => {
  const BATCH = 6 << 20;
  // chunks saved since the last sync: world id -> Set of 'o:cx:cz' / 'n:..' / 'e:..' (kept in localStorage)
  const dirty = new Map();
  let quiet = 0;
  const lsKey = wid => 'mcjs-cloud-dirty-' + wid;
  function dirtyOf(wid) {
    let s = dirty.get(wid);
    if (!s) {
      s = new Set();
      try {
        for (const k of JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(lsKey(wid)) || '[]')) s.add(k);
      } catch (e) {}
      dirty.set(wid, s);
    }
    return s;
  }
  let saveT = null;
  const persist = () => {
    clearTimeout(saveT);
    saveT = setTimeout(() => {
      for (const [wid, s] of dirty) {
        try {
          if (s.size) localStorage.setItem(lsKey(wid), JSON.stringify([...s]));else localStorage.removeItem(lsKey(wid));
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }, 500);
  };
  const split = sid => {
    const i = sid.indexOf('~');
    return i < 0 ? [sid, 'o'] : [sid.slice(0, i), sid.slice(i + 1) === 'nether' ? 'n' : 'e'];
  };
  const sidOf = (wid, d) => d === 'o' ? wid : wid + '~' + (d === 'n' ? 'nether' : 'end');
  // every chunk the game writes is noted (not the ones a download writes)
  const put = DB.putChunks.bind(DB);
  DB.putChunks = async function (id, list) {
    const r = await put(id, list);
    if (!quiet && list.length) {
      const [wid, d] = split(id),
        s = dirtyOf(wid);
      for (const [cx, cz] of list) s.add(`${d}:${cx}:${cz}`);
      persist();
    }
    return r;
  };
  // a chunk record <-> bytes: three lengths, then the RLE blocks, metas and waterlogged cells, deflated
  async function encode(rec) {
    const b = new Uint8Array(rec.b.buffer, rec.b.byteOffset, rec.b.byteLength),
      m = new Uint8Array(rec.m.buffer, rec.m.byteOffset, rec.m.byteLength);
    const w = rec.w ? new Uint8Array(rec.w.buffer, rec.w.byteOffset, rec.w.byteLength) : new Uint8Array(0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(12 + b.length + m.length + w.length),
      dv = new DataView(out.buffer);
    dv.setUint32(0, rec.b.length);
    dv.setUint32(4, rec.m.length);
    dv.setUint32(8, rec.w ? rec.w.length : 0);
    out.set(b, 12);
    out.set(m, 12 + b.length);
    out.set(w, 12 + b.length + m.length);
    return NBT.deflate(out, 'deflate');
  }
  async function decode(bytes) {
    const raw = await NBT.inflate(bytes, 'deflate'),
      dv = new DataView(raw.buffer, raw.byteOffset, raw.byteLength);
    const nb = dv.getUint32(0),
      nm = dv.getUint32(4),
      nw = dv.getUint32(8);
    const copy = (o, n, T, sz) => {
      const a = new T(n);
      new Uint8Array(a.buffer).set(raw.subarray(o, o + n * sz));
      return a;
    };
    const rec = {
      b: copy(12, nb, Uint16Array, 2),
      m: copy(12 + nb * 2, nm, Uint16Array, 2)
    };
    if (nw) rec.w = copy(12 + nb * 2 + nm * 2, nw, Uint32Array, 4);
    return rec;
  }
  // the service's file: "OMCC", the header, then each chunk (key, data)
  function pack(head, chunks) {
    const te = new TextEncoder(),
      h = te.encode(JSON.stringify(head));
    let n = 12 + h.length;
    for (const [k, d] of chunks) n += 6 + k.length + d.length;
    const out = new Uint8Array(n),
      dv = new DataView(out.buffer);
    out.set(te.encode('OMCC'));
    dv.setUint32(4, h.length);
    out.set(h, 8);
    dv.setUint32(8 + h.length, chunks.length);
    let o = 12 + h.length;
    for (const [k, d] of chunks) {
      dv.setUint16(o, k.length);
      out.set(te.encode(k), o + 2);
      o += 2 + k.length;
      dv.setUint32(o, d.length);
      out.set(d, o + 4);
      o += 4 + d.length;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function unpack(buf) {
    const dv = new DataView(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.byteLength),
      td = new TextDecoder();
    if (td.decode(buf.subarray(0, 4)) !== 'OMCC') throw new Error('云端数据不对');
    const hl = dv.getUint32(4),
      head = JSON.parse(td.decode(buf.subarray(8, 8 + hl)));
    let o = 8 + hl;
    const n = dv.getUint32(o);
    o += 4;
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const kl = dv.getUint16(o),
        k = td.decode(buf.subarray(o + 2, o + 2 + kl));
      o += 2 + kl;
      const dl = dv.getUint32(o);
      chunks.push([k, buf.subarray(o + 4, o + 4 + dl)]);
      o += 4 + dl;
    }
    return {
      head,
      chunks
    };
  }
  async function post(path, bytes) {
    let r;
    // (no headers - account.js: "OPMCT" and the token go before the bytes)
    const t = new TextEncoder().encode('OPMCT' + Account.token),
      all = new Uint8Array(t.length + bytes.length);
    all.set(t);
    all.set(bytes, t.length);
    try {
      r = await fetch(RoomService.base() + path, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: all
      });
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后（云存档暂时没有同步）');
    }
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({
      error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
    }));
    return {
      status: r.status,
      j
    };
  }
  // the world record as it goes up (without its cloud bookkeeping)
  const metaOut = m => {
    const o = {
      ...m
    };
    delete o.cloud;
    return o;
  };
  let busy = false;
  const api = {
    get busy() {
      return busy;
    },
    dirtyCount(wid) {
      return dirtyOf(wid).size;
    },
    // send what changed (opts.force: this device's copy wins - the whole world goes up again)
    async sync(meta, opts = {}) {
      if (!Account.loggedIn || !meta || !RoomService.base()) return {
        skipped: true
      };
      if (busy) return {
        busy: true
      };
      busy = true;
      try {
        const cl = meta.cloud || {},
          whole = !cl.rev || opts.force,
          set = dirtyOf(meta.id);
        let keys;
        if (whole) {
          keys = [];
          for (const d of ['o', 'n', 'e']) for (const k of await DB.chunkKeys(sidOf(meta.id, d))) keys.push(`${d}:${Math.floor(k / 65536) - 32768}:${k % 65536 - 32768}`);
        } else keys = [...set];
        if (!whole && !keys.length && cl.played === meta.lastPlayed) return {
          upToDate: true
        };
        let rev = cl.rev || 0,
          first = true,
          res = null,
          i = 0,
          sent = 0;
        do {
          const batch = [];
          let size = 0;
          for (; i < keys.length && size < BATCH; i++) {
            const [d, cx, cz] = keys[i].split(':'),
              rec = await DB.getChunk(sidOf(meta.id, d), +cx, +cz);
            if (!rec) continue;
            const b = await encode(rec);
            batch.push([keys[i], b]);
            size += b.length;
          }
          const head = {
            wid: meta.id,
            meta: metaOut(meta),
            base: rev,
            device: Account.device(),
            force: !!opts.force && first,
            replace: !!opts.force && first
          };
          const {
            status,
            j
          } = await post('/api/cloud/push', pack(head, batch));
          if (j.conflict) return {
            conflict: true,
            cloud: j
          };
          if (j.full) return {
            full: true,
            used: j.used,
            quota: j.quota
          };
          if (status !== 200) throw new Error(j.error || '云存档同步失败');
          rev = j.rev;
          res = j;
          first = false;
          sent += batch.length;
          opts.progress && opts.progress(keys.length ? i / keys.length : 1);
        } while (i < keys.length);
        for (const k of keys) set.delete(k);
        persist();
        meta.cloud = {
          rev,
          at: Date.now(),
          played: meta.lastPlayed,
          size: res.size,
          expires: res.expires
        };
        await DB.putWorld(meta);
        if (typeof game !== 'undefined' && game.worldMeta && game.worldMeta.id === meta.id && game.worldMeta !== meta) game.worldMeta.cloud = meta.cloud;
        return {
          ok: true,
          sent,
          rev,
          used: res.used,
          quota: res.quota
        };
      } finally {
        busy = false;
      }
    },
    async list() {
      return Account.api('/api/cloud');
    },
    // the cloud's copy of a world onto this device (chunks after the revision this device has, or all of it)
    async download(wid, progress) {
      const local = await DB.getWorld(wid),
        since = local && local.cloud && !dirtyOf(wid).size ? local.cloud.rev || 0 : 0;
      const r = await fetch(RoomService.base() + '/api/cloud/' + wid, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          _t: Account.token,
          since
        })
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('下载失败');
      const {
        head,
        chunks
      } = unpack(new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()));
      quiet++;
      try {
        if (!since) await DB.deleteWorld(wid);
        const byDim = {
          o: [],
          n: [],
          e: []
        };
        let n = 0;
        for (const [k, b] of chunks) {
          const [d, cx, cz] = k.split(':');
          byDim[d].push([+cx, +cz, await decode(b)]);
          if (++n % 50 === 0) {
            progress && progress(n / chunks.length);
            await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 0));
          }
        }
        for (const d of ['o', 'n', 'e']) for (let i = 0; i < byDim[d].length; i += 64) await DB.putChunks(sidOf(wid, d), byDim[d].slice(i, i + 64));
        const meta = Object.assign({}, head.meta, {
          id: wid,
          cloud: {
            rev: head.rev,
            at: Date.now(),
            played: head.meta.lastPlayed
          }
        });
        await DB.putWorld(meta);
        dirtyOf(wid).clear();
        persist();
        return meta;
      } finally {
        quiet--;
      }
    },
    async remove(wid) {
      await Account.api('/api/cloud/' + wid + '/delete', {});
      const m = await DB.getWorld(wid);
      if (m && m.cloud) {
        delete m.cloud;
        await DB.putWorld(m);
      }
    },
    touch(wid) {
      if (Account.loggedIn && RoomService.base()) Account.api('/api/cloud/' + wid + '/touch', {}).catch(() => {});
    }
  };
  return api;
})();

// ---- when it syncs: leaving a world, every 10 minutes of play, the page closing ----
(() => {
  const say = (g, r) => {
    if (!r || r.skipped || r.upToDate || r.busy) return;
    if (r.ok) g.ui.message('云存档已同步', '#AAAAAA');else if (r.full) g.ui.message(`云存档空间满了（${(r.used / 1048576).toFixed(0)} / ${(r.quota / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB）：存档列表 → 云端存档 里删掉不要的`, '#FFAA00');else if (r.conflict) g.ui.message('这个世界在别的设备上也改过：下次进入时选择保留哪一份', '#FFAA00');
  };
  const q = Game.prototype.quitToTitle;
  Game.prototype.quitToTitle = async function () {
    const meta = !this.net && this.worldMeta ? this.worldMeta : null;
    const r = await q.call(this);
    // (a failed read of the record used to throw out of here after the title was up: an unhandled rejection, no sync)
    if (meta) DB.getWorld(meta.id).catch(() => null).then(m => CloudSave.sync(m || meta)).then(x => say(this, x), e => this.ui.message(e.message, '#FF5555'));
    return r;
  };
  setInterval(() => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    if (!g || g.state !== 'play' || g.net || !g.worldMeta || !Account.loggedIn) return;
    if (Date.now() - (g.cloudAt || g.worldMeta.lastPlayed || 0) < 600e3) return;
    g.cloudAt = Date.now();
    g.saveWorld(true).then(() => CloudSave.sync(g.worldMeta)).then(x => say(g, x), () => {});
  }, 60e3);
  // the page closing (Toy tells it; a plain page: hidden): save, and send what fits
  const closing = () => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    if (!g || g.state !== 'play' || g.net || !g.worldMeta) return;
    g.saveWorld(true).then(() => CloudSave.sync(g.worldMeta)).catch(() => {});
  };
  Toy.onPageClose(closing).catch(() => {});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) closing();
  });
})();

// ---- 云端存档: what is in the cloud, download / delete, the space used ----
class CloudScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '云端存档');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.data = null;
    this.local = new Map();
    this.note = '';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    this.confirm = null;
    this.load();
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteColor = bad ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0';
  }
  async load() {
    try {
      this.data = await CloudSave.list();
      for (const w of await DB.listWorlds()) this.local.set(w.id, w);
    } catch (e) {
      this.data = {
        worlds: [],
        used: 0,
        quota: 0
      };
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 40 - 64) / 26));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      W = this.data && this.data.worlds || [],
      n = this.rows();
    this.widgets = [];
    W.slice(0, n).forEach((w, i) => {
      const y = 36 + i * 26,
        l = this.local.get(w.wid),
        newer = !l || !l.cloud || l.cloud.rev < w.rev;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 62,
        y,
        w: 48,
        h: 20,
        label: l ? newer ? '更新' : '已同步' : '下载',
        enabled: newer,
        tip: [l ? '用云端的版本替换这台设备上的' : '下载到这台设备'],
        onClick: () => this.down(w)
      }, {
        x: cx + 112,
        y,
        w: 48,
        h: 20,
        label: this.confirm === w.wid ? '确定？' : '删除',
        tip: ['只删云端的这一份，这台设备上的不动'],
        onClick: () => this.del(w)
      });
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    });
  }
  // back to the world list, read again: it was read once when it opened, so a world just downloaded wasn't in it
  back() {
    const p = this.parent;
    if (p instanceof WorldListScreen) DB.listWorlds().then(w => {
      p.worlds = w;
      p.sel = -1;
      if (this.game.ui.screen === p) p.layout();
    }).catch(() => {});
    this.game.ui.open(p);
  }
  async down(w) {
    const l = this.local.get(w.wid);
    const go = async () => {
      this.say('正在下载 ' + w.name + '…');
      this.layout();
      try {
        await CloudSave.download(w.wid, f => this.say(`正在下载 ${w.name}… ${Math.round(f * 100)}%`));
        this.say('已下载：' + w.name);
        await this.load();
      } catch (e) {
        this.say(e.message, true);
      }
      this.game.ui.open(this);
    };
    if (l && CloudSave.dirtyCount(w.wid)) this.game.ui.open(new ConfirmScreen(this.game, '用云端的版本替换？', `这台设备上的“${l.name}”有还没上传的改动，替换后会丢失`, '替换', yes => yes ? go() : this.game.ui.open(this)));else go();
  }
  async del(w) {
    if (this.confirm !== w.wid) {
      this.confirm = w.wid;
      this.layout();
      return;
    }
    this.confirm = null;
    try {
      await CloudSave.remove(w.wid);
      this.say('已从云端删除：' + w.name);
      await this.load();
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      D = this.data;
    if (!D) {
      Font.center(c, '正在读取…', cx, 50, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    Font.center(c, `已用 ${(D.used / 1048576).toFixed(1)} / ${(D.quota / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB　·　${D.expireDays} 天没打开的云端存档会自动删除（设备上的不受影响）`, cx, 20, '#A0A0A0');
    if (!D.worlds.length) Font.center(c, '云端还没有存档：登录后玩单人世界，退出时会自动上传', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
    D.worlds.slice(0, this.rows()).forEach((w, i) => {
      const y = 36 + i * 26,
        days = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((w.expires - Date.now()) / 86400e3));
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(cx - 160, y, 220, 20);
      Font.draw(c, fitText(w.name, 150), cx - 157, y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, fitText(`${(w.size / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB · ${new Date(w.updated).toLocaleDateString()} · ${w.device || ''}`, 214), cx - 157, y + 11, '#909090');
      Font.draw(c, `${days}天`, cx + 34, y + 2, days <= 2 ? '#FF8080' : '#80FF80');
    });
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 40, this.noteColor);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
}
// a world changed here and on another device: which copy stays
class CloudConflictScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, meta, cloud, then) {
    super(game, '存档在两台设备上都改过');
    this.meta = meta;
    this.cloud = cloud;
    this.then = then;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.busy = false;
    this.note = '';
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 2);
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 152,
      y,
      w: 148,
      h: 20,
      label: '用云端的',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: ['这台设备上没上传的改动会丢失'],
      onClick: () => this.pick(true)
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y,
      w: 148,
      h: 20,
      label: '用这台设备的',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: ['云端的那份会被这台设备上的替换'],
      onClick: () => this.pick(false)
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: y + 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '先不管（只玩这台设备上的）',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.then(false)
    }];
  }
  async pick(cloud) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.note = cloud ? '正在下载云端的版本…' : '正在上传这台设备上的版本…';
    this.layout();
    try {
      if (cloud) await CloudSave.download(this.meta.id);else {
        const r = await CloudSave.sync(this.meta, {
          force: true
        });
        if (r.full) throw new Error('云存档空间不够了');
      }
      this.then(true);
    } catch (e) {
      this.busy = false;
      this.note = e.message;
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      y = Math.floor(ui.h / 2) - 44,
      cl = this.cloud || {};
    Font.center(c, `“${this.meta.name}”`, cx, y, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.center(c, fitText(`云端：${cl.updated ? new Date(cl.updated).toLocaleString() : '?'}，来自 ${cl.device || '另一台设备'}`, ui.w - 8), cx, y + 14, '#A0A0A0');
    Font.center(c, fitText(`这台设备：${new Date(this.meta.lastPlayed).toLocaleString()}`, ui.w - 8), cx, y + 26, '#A0A0A0');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, cx, y + 92, '#FFD24A');
  }
  onEsc() {}
}
// opening a world: the cloud may have a newer copy of it (another device played since)
(() => {
  const load = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = async function (id, ...rest) {
    if (Account.loggedIn && RoomService.base() && !this.cloudChecked) {
      try {
        const meta = await DB.getWorld(id),
          list = await CloudSave.list(),
          cw = list.worlds.find(w => w.wid === id);
        if (meta && cw && (!meta.cloud || cw.rev > meta.cloud.rev)) {
          const g = this;
          if (!meta.cloud || CloudSave.dirtyCount(id)) {
            return g.ui.open(new CloudConflictScreen(g, meta, cw, () => {
              g.cloudChecked = true;
              g.loadWorld(id, ...rest);
            }));
          }
          g.ui.open(new LoadingScreen(g, '正在下载云端的新版本…'));
          await CloudSave.download(id);
        }
        CloudSave.touch(id);
      } catch (e) {/* (offline: play what is here) */}
    }
    this.cloudChecked = false;
    return load.call(this, id, ...rest);
  };
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/social.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The platform around the game (Toy SDK, account.js): the name a new account plays under, Bilibili's content check
// on what players type for others (chat, room names, feedback, reports), the invite card (share, QR code), and the
// page closing (leave the room, last statistics).

// (a new account plays under its Bilibili name - the room service makes the game name from the nickname, and it
// follows a rename there; no name to pick)

// ---- Bilibili's content check on what others will read ----
async function textOk(g, text, scene) {
  const r = await Toy.checkText(text, scene);
  if (!r.passed) {
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('text_blocked_' + scene);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}
(() => {
  // chat in a room (commands are the server's own business)
  const chat = NetClient.prototype.chat;
  NetClient.prototype.chat = async function (text) {
    if (!String(text).startsWith('/') && !(await textOk(this.g, text, 'chat'))) {
      this.g.ui.message('这条消息包含不合适的内容，没有发出', '#FF5555');
      return;
    }
    return chat.call(this, text);
  };
  // a room's name (shown to everyone in the public list)
  const cr = CreateRoomScreen.prototype.submit;
  CreateRoomScreen.prototype.submit = async function () {
    if (this.busy) return;
    if (!(await textOk(this.game, this.roomName, 'room_name'))) {
      this.say('房间名包含不合适的内容，换一个吧', true);
      return;
    }
    return cr.call(this);
  };
  for (const Cls of [FeedbackScreen, ReportScreen]) {
    const sub = Cls.prototype.submit;
    Cls.prototype.submit = async function () {
      if (this.text && String(this.text).trim() && !(await textOk(this.game, this.text, Cls === FeedbackScreen ? 'feedback' : 'report'))) {
        this.note = '内容包含不合适的词，请修改后再发送';
        this.noteColor = '#FF5555';
        if (this.say) this.say(this.note, true);
        return;
      }
      return sub.call(this);
    };
  }
})();

// ---- 邀请卡片: the room's name and code, a QR code to scan, share it on Bilibili ----
class InviteCardScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '邀请朋友');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.qr = null;
    this.note = '';
    this.inToy = null;
    const R = this.R;
    Toy.ready().then(v => {
      this.inToy = v;
      if (v && R) Toy.qrCode('index.html?room=' + R.code, 240).then(q => {
        if (q && q.base64) {
          const im = new Image();
          im.onload = () => {
            this.qr = im;
          };
          im.src = q.base64.startsWith('data:') ? q.base64 : 'data:image/png;base64,' + q.base64;
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
    });
  }
  get R() {
    return this.game.net && this.game.net.room;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      R = this.R,
      y = u.h - 52;

  async share() {
    try {
      await Toy.share('index.html?room=' + this.R.code);
      this.note = '已打开分享';
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('invite_share');

      this.note = Toy.explain(e);
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,

    if (!R) {
      Font.center(c, '不在房间里', cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');

    const w = 230,
      h = ui.h - 92,

    Font.center(c, fitText(R.name, w - 16), cx, y + 8, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.center(c, '房主 ' + R.owner, cx, y + 20, '#A0A0A0');

      Font.center(c, this.inToy === false ? '用邀请码加入' : '二维码…', cx, y + 30 + qs / 2, '#808080');

    c.translate(cx, y + qs + 44);
    c.scale(2, 2);
    Font.center(c, R.code, 0, 0, '#FFD24A');

  onEsc() {

  }
}
(() => {

// ---- the page closing inside Toy: leave the room cleanly, send the last statistics ----
Toy.onPageClose(() => {
  const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
  try {
    if (g && g.net) g.net.close && g.net.close();
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    Telemetry.flush && Telemetry.flush(true);
  } catch (e) {}
}).catch(() => {});

// ---- announcements from the administrators (rooms/server.js announce): in the chat in gold and over the hotbar, for
// everyone playing - in a room they come at once, otherwise the page asks every 5 minutes (it was every minute: a
// request waking the phone's radio 60 times an hour, for a few announcements a week), not while the page is hidden;
// each shown once (the last one seen kept in this browser), and on a page just opened only those of the last 10
// minutes ----
function showAnnounce(g, a) {
  let seen = 0;
  try {
    seen = +localStorage.getItem('mcjs-announce') || 0;
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!a || a.id <= seen) return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('mcjs-announce', String(a.id));
  } catch (e) {}
  g.ui.message('[公告] ' + a.text, '#FFAA00');
  g.ui.actionBar = {
    text: '公告：' + a.text,
    t: performance.now(),
    color: '#FFAA00'
  };
  Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.note_block.bell', null, 0.6, 1.2);
}
// (how often: the admin panel's client.announceMin - js/live.js; the answer also says which live settings are out, so
// a change made there reaches a player in single player at this pace too)
(() => {
  const opened = Date.now();
  const every = () => Math.max(1, Math.min(60, typeof Live !== 'undefined' && +Live.get('client.announceMin', 5) || 5)) * 60e3;
  const tick = async () => {
    setTimeout(tick, every());
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    if (!g || g.state !== 'play' || g.net || document.hidden || typeof RoomService === 'undefined' || !RoomService.base()) return;
    let seen = 0;
    try {
      seen = +localStorage.getItem('mcjs-announce') || 0;
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      const r = await RoomService.api('/api/announce?after=' + Math.max(seen, opened - 10 * 60e3));
      for (const a of r.list || []) showAnnounce(g, a);
      if (r.live !== undefined && typeof Live !== 'undefined' && r.live !== Live.v) Live.fetch(r.live);
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  setTimeout(tick, every());
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/mobile.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Phones (game/UX_IDEAS.md「手机端适配」), on top of the touch layer (touch.js):
//   - landscape: inside the Bilibili app the Toy container turns landscape and immersive (toy.setContainerMode); a
//     page held upright anywhere else (the Toy iframe may not go fullscreen, iPhones never lock the orientation) gets
//     the whole game turned on its side with CSS, touches turned with it - the player turns the phone and plays
//   - Bedrock's controls: a floating joystick (where the thumb lands is its centre; pushed all the way forward
//     sprints), a sneak button by it, drag the rest of the screen to look; Bedrock's "split" controls - a crosshair
//     with attack / use buttons (the only ones since 10-30; a tap on the world does nothing); jump (double tap in
//     creative flies, up / down while flying, swim up in water), hotbar tap / hold to
//     drop, the inventory button; pause, chat, quick chat and the view at the top
//   - vibration when a block breaks or the player is hurt; the buttons' layout edited by dragging
//   - 60 fps on high refresh phones unless 90 / 120 / 跟随屏幕 is chosen, back to 60 when the phone heats up and cannot
//     keep up (the gyroscope view taken down 11-05: the Toy page does not let the game read the motion sensors)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Stage = {
  rot: false,
  el: null,
  inset: {
    top: 0,
    right: 0,
    bottom: 0,
    left: 0
  },
  toyLandscape: false,
  init() {
    if (this.el) return;
    const el = this.el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'stage';
    el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden';
    document.body.insertBefore(el, document.body.firstChild);
    for (const id of ['yymc-bg', 'gl', 'ui', 'textinput']) {
      const c = document.getElementById(id);
      if (c) el.appendChild(c);
    }
    // (once a frame however many come: an on-screen keyboard sliding up sends a resize for each step of it, and each
    // was a new size for both canvases and a layout - 11-07, iPhones in the Bilibili app: "一打开输入法就闪白")
    // (the next frame, or 120 ms on if frames don't come - a web view drawing nothing for the moment)
    addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (this.pend) return;
      this.pend = true;
      const run = () => {
        if (!this.pend) return;
        this.pend = false;
        this.update();
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(run);
      setTimeout(run, 120);
    });
    // (the 3D canvas keeps its size while a field is typed in on an Apple device - Renderer.resize below: the size it
    // missed, once the keyboard is gone)
    const inp = document.getElementById('textinput');
    if (inp) inp.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(() => this.update(), 50));
    addEventListener('orientationchange', () => setTimeout(() => this.update(), 200));
    this.update();
  },
  want() {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    return !!g && TouchDevice.kind === 'phone' && g.settings.rotatePortrait !== false && innerHeight > innerWidth * 1.05;
  },
  update() {
    if (!this.el) return;
    const rot = this.want(),
      s = this.el.style,
      I = this.inset;
    if (rot) {
      s.left = '0px';
      s.top = '0px';
      s.width = innerHeight + 'px';
      s.height = innerWidth + 'px';
      s.transformOrigin = '0 0';
      s.transform = `translateX(${innerWidth}px) rotate(90deg)`;
    } else {
      // (the whole screen: the safe area - the Toy capsule, a notch - only keeps the controls and the HUD clear,
      // UI.safe; leaving it all black put a long black bar along the top)
      s.transform = '';
      s.left = '0px';
      s.top = '0px';
      s.width = '100%';
      s.height = '100%';
    }
    const was = this.rot;
    this.rot = rot;
    if (was !== rot || true) {
      const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
      if (g && g.renderer) g.resize();
    }
  },
  w() {
    return this.el ? this.el.clientWidth : innerWidth;
  },
  h() {
    return this.el ? this.el.clientHeight : innerHeight;
  },
  // a point on the page -> the stage's own (unturned) pixels
  toStage(cx, cy) {
    return this.rot ? [cy, innerWidth - cx] : [cx, cy];
  }
};
// the safe area in interface pixels (none while the page is turned by CSS: the turned stage is all safe)
UI.prototype.safe = function () {
  const I = Stage.inset,
    k = this.dpr / this.scale;
  if (Stage.rot || !I) return {
    t: 0,
    l: 0,
    r: 0,
    b: 0
  };
  return {
    t: Math.ceil(I.top * k),
    l: Math.ceil(I.left * k),
    r: Math.ceil(I.right * k),
    b: Math.ceil(I.bottom * k)
  };
};
(() => {
  // the HUD up off the bottom edge, the chat in from the left one
  const hud = UI.prototype.drawHUD,
    chat = UI.prototype.drawChat;
  UI.prototype.drawHUD = function () {
    const s = this.safe();
    if (!s.b) return hud.call(this);
    const c = this.ctx;
    c.save();
    c.translate(0, -s.b);
    try {
      return hud.call(this);
    } finally {
      c.restore();
    }
  };
  UI.prototype.drawChat = function () {
    const s = this.safe();
    if (!s.l) return chat.call(this);
    const c = this.ctx;
    c.save();
    c.translate(s.l, 0);
    try {
      return chat.call(this);
    } finally {
      c.restore();
    }
  };
})();
// the renderer and the interface size themselves from the stage
Renderer.prototype.resize = function () {
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  let w = Math.floor(Stage.w() * dpr * this.resScale),
    h = Math.floor(Stage.h() * dpr * this.resScale);
  if (this.forceSize) [w, h] = this.forceSize; // panorama capture
  w = Math.max(1, w);
  h = Math.max(1, h);
  // typing on an Apple device's on-screen keyboard (the field focused): the 3D picture keeps its size, stretched for
  // the moment - a new size is a new drawing buffer (and the shader pack's), and the keyboard coming and going asked
  // for several; on iPhones in the Bilibili app the page died at it (feedback 11-07: "一打开输入法就崩了…几乎必现").
  // Stage's blur listener sizes it after
  if (typeof WEBKIT_GL !== 'undefined' && WEBKIT_GL && this.canvas.width > 1 && !this.forceSize && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0) {
    const inp = document.getElementById('textinput');
    if (inp && document.activeElement === inp) return;
  }
  if (this.canvas.width !== w || this.canvas.height !== h) {
    this.canvas.width = w;
    this.canvas.height = h;
  }
};
UI.prototype.resize = function () {
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  // (only a new size is set: setting the same one still made the canvas over - a resize event that changed nothing)
  const cw = Math.floor(Stage.w() * dpr),
    ch = Math.floor(Stage.h() * dpr);
  if (this.canvas.width !== cw) this.canvas.width = cw;
  if (this.canvas.height !== ch) this.canvas.height = ch;
  const auto = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(this.canvas.width / 320), Math.floor(this.canvas.height / 240)));
  const pref = this.game.settings.guiScale;
  this.scale = pref ? Math.min(pref * dpr, auto) : Math.min(auto, Math.round(3 * dpr));
  this.scale = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.scale));
  // (needW: a screen wider than vanilla's 320 - a mod's station with panels on both sides - gets a smaller scale while
  // it is open; ui.open / close size again around it)
  const need = this.screen && this.screen.needW;
  if (need) while (this.scale > 1 && this.canvas.width / this.scale < need) this.scale--;
  this.w = Math.ceil(this.canvas.width / this.scale);
  this.h = Math.ceil(this.canvas.height / this.scale);
  this.dpr = dpr;
  if (this.screen && this.screen.layout) this.screen.layout();
};
// page points -> the stage's: mouse events here; touches once, as they come in (the touch layer and the clicks it
// makes up then work in stage pixels, marked so they are not turned again)
UI.prototype.toGui = function (ev) {
  const [x, y] = ev.stage ? [ev.clientX, ev.clientY] : Stage.toStage(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
  return [x * this.dpr / this.scale, y * this.dpr / this.scale];
};
(() => {
  const P = TouchControls.prototype;
  P.gui = function (cx, cy) {
    const k = this.ui.dpr / this.ui.scale;
    return [cx * k, cy * k];
  };
  // (touches: the ids of all the fingers down - touch.js prune)
  const turn = e => ({
    target: e.target,
    preventDefault: () => e.preventDefault(),
    touches: e.touches ? [...e.touches].map(t => ({
      identifier: t.identifier
    })) : null,
    changedTouches: [...e.changedTouches].map(t => {
      const [x, y] = Stage.toStage(t.clientX, t.clientY);
      return {
        identifier: t.identifier,
        clientX: x,
        clientY: y
      };
    })
  });
  for (const k of ['onStart', 'onMove']) {
    const f = P[k];
    P[k] = function (e) {
      return f.call(this, turn(e));
    };
  }
  const oe = P.onEnd;
  P.onEnd = function (e, cancel) {
    return oe.call(this, turn(e), cancel);
  };
  const sy = P.synth;
  P.synth = function (type, s, button, atStart) {
    const ev = {
      clientX: atStart ? s.sx : s.cx,
      clientY: atStart ? s.sy : s.cy,
      button,
      shiftKey: false,
      stage: true
    };
    if (type === 'down') this.ui.mouseDown(ev);else if (type === 'up') this.ui.mouseUp(ev);else this.ui.mouseMove(ev);
  };
  void sy;
})();
// inside Bilibili: the container turned landscape and immersive; its safe area kept clear
(async () => {
  if (TouchDevice.kind !== 'phone' && TouchDevice.kind !== 'tablet') return;
  if (!(await Toy.ready())) return;
  Stage.inToy = true;
  const apply = st => {
    if (!st) return;
    const a = st.safeArea || {};
    Stage.inset = {
      top: a.top || 0,
      right: a.right || 0,
      bottom: a.bottom || 0,
      left: a.left || 0
    };
    Stage.toyLandscape = st.orientation === 'landscape';
    Stage.update();
  };
  try {
    await Toy.setContainerMode({
      orientation: 'landscape',
      immersive: true
    });
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    apply(await Toy.containerState());
  } catch (e) {}
  Toy.onContainerChange(apply);
})();

// ---- the controls ----
Object.assign(TOUCH_ICONS, {
  // (redrawn 11-03 - the user: 图标怪怪的: a sword with its guard and grip; the hand
  // is the first one again - the user liked it best)
  attack: ['...........###', '..........####', '.........####.', '........####..', '.......####...', '......####....', '.##..####.....', '.###.###......', '..#####.......', '...###........', '..#####.......', '.###..##......', '###...........', '##............'],
  use: ['..#.#.#..', '..#.#.#..', '..#.#.#.#', '..#######', '.########', '.########', '..#######', '...#####.', '....###..'],
  emote: ['..#####..', '.#.....#.', '#..#.#..#', '#.......#', '#.#...#.#', '#..###..#', '.#.....#.', '..#####..', '.........']
