// the D-pad's buttons: [row, column] in its 3 x 3
const DPAD_RC = {
  ul: [0, 0],
  up: [0, 1],
  ur: [0, 2],
  left: [1, 0],
  sneak: [1, 1],
  right: [1, 2],
  down: [2, 1]
};
// the fly-down button follows jump unless given a place or a size of its own (an offset saved before the editor marked
// it as the player's own - touchDescOwn - is the copy of jump's older versions made, stale once jump moved)
const touchDescFollows = st => {
  const d = (st.touchLayout || {}).descend,
    k = (st.touchScale || {}).descend;
  return !(k && k !== 1) && (!d || !st.touchDescOwn);
};
(() => {
  const P = TouchControls.prototype;
  const stickOn = g => g.settings.touchStick !== false;
  // (11-03, from the players' feedback: a joystick that stays put; pushing it all the way not sprinting; the old taps -
  // tap to place, hold to mine - beside the attack / use buttons)
  // (fixed by default; 动态摇杆 - the centre where the thumb lands - is the setting: the user, 11-03)
  const stickFixed = g => g.settings.touchStickDyn !== true,
    pushSprint = g => g.settings.touchPushSprint !== false;
  const classic = g => g.settings.touchClassic === true;
  // inside Bilibili the container's capsule (分享 / ✕) floats over the top right corner whatever the safe area says: it
  // covered 聊天 and 暂停 (a new player's screenshot, 11-13), and buttons moved under it in 触控设置 could not be dragged
  // back - the touches went to the capsule. Its box in interface pixels: CSS 100 x 48 (the capsule ~87 x 32 with its
  // margins); none outside Bilibili or while the page is turned by CSS (the turned stage is all safe - UI.safe)
  const toyCapsule = ui => {
    if (!Stage.inToy || Stage.rot) return null;
    const k = ui.dpr / ui.scale;
    return {
      w: Math.ceil(100 * k),
      h: Math.ceil(48 * k)
    };
  };
  const lay = P.layout;
  P.layout = function () {
    const L = lay.call(this),
      g = this.g,
      {
        W,
        H
      } = this.metrics(),
      {
        B,
        gp
      } = L,
      m = Math.max(3, Math.round(B * 0.3)),
      st = g.settings;
    L.W = W;
    L.H = H;
    if (stickOn(g)) {
      // the joystick replaces the D-pad: the left part of the screen, above the hotbar
      L.cells = {};
      L.dpad = null;
      L.x0 = L.y0 = -1e4; // (no D-pad cells left to hit)
      L.stickR = Math.round(B * 1.25);
      L.stickHome = {
        x: m + L.stickR,
        y: H - m - L.stickR
      };
      L.stickZone = {
        x: 0,
        y: Math.round(H * 0.28),
        w: Math.round(W * 0.42),
        h: H - Math.round(H * 0.28)
      };
      if (!g.player.flying || this.editAll) L.sneak = {
        x: Math.min(m + 2 * L.stickR + gp * 2, Math.floor(W / 2 - 91 - B - 4)),
        y: H - m - B,
        w: B,
        h: B
      };
    }
    const top = L.pause.y,
      ts = L.pause.w;
    L.emote = {
      x: L.view.x - ts - gp,
      y: top,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
    // vanilla's F3 screen (coordinates, facing, biome...): a button of its own (the user, 11-03)
    L.f3 = {
      x: L.emote.x - ts - gp,
      y: top,
      w: ts,
      h: ts
    };
    if (g.mode !== 'spectator') {
      L.attack = {
        x: L.jump.x - B - gp,
        y: L.jump.y - B - gp,
        w: B,
        h: B
      };
      L.use = {
        x: L.jump.x,
        y: L.jump.y - B - gp,
        w: B,
        h: B
      };
      if (L.interact) L.interact.y = L.use.y - L.interact.h - gp;
    }
    // kept clear of the safe area (the Toy capsule top right, a notch, the home bar)
    const sf = this.ui.safe();
    for (const id of ['pause', 'chat', 'view', 'emote', 'f3']) if (L[id]) {
      L[id].x -= sf.r;
      L[id].y += sf.t;
    }
    for (const id of ['jump', 'descend', 'sprint', 'attack', 'use', 'interact']) if (L[id]) {
      L[id].x -= sf.r;
      L[id].y -= sf.b;
    }
    if (L.stickHome) {
      L.stickHome.x += sf.l;
      L.stickHome.y -= sf.b;
      L.stickZone.x += sf.l;
    }
    if (L.sneak) {
      L.sneak.x += sf.l;
      L.sneak.y -= sf.b;
    }
    if (L.hotbar) {
      L.hotbar.y -= sf.b;
      L.inv.y -= sf.b;
    }
    // (the top row starts left of the capsule)
    const cap = toyCapsule(this.ui);
    if (cap && sf.t < cap.h) {
      const dx = Math.max(0, cap.w - sf.r - 4);
      for (const id of ['pause', 'chat', 'view', 'emote', 'f3']) if (L[id] && L[id].y < cap.h) L[id].x = Math.max(0, L[id].x - dx);
    }
    // the player's own arrangement (the layout editor): offsets per control
    const off = st.touchLayout || {};
    const dp0 = L.dpad && L.x0 > -1e3 ? {
      x: L.dpad.x,
      y: L.dpad.y
    } : null;
    if (L.descend) L.descBase = {
      ...L.descend
    }; // (where it is before the player's offset: the editor's starting point)
    for (const id in off) {
      const r = L[id],
        o = off[id];
      if (r && o && r.x !== undefined) {
        r.x = clamp(r.x + o[0], 0, W - r.w);
        r.y = clamp(r.y + o[1], 0, H - r.h);
      }
    }
    if (dp0 && (L.dpad.x !== dp0.x || L.dpad.y !== dp0.y)) {
      // (the D-pad moved: its cells and corner with it)
      const dx = L.dpad.x - dp0.x,
        dy = L.dpad.y - dp0.y;
      L.x0 += dx;
      L.y0 += dy;
      for (const k in L.cells) {
        L.cells[k].x += dx;
        L.cells[k].y += dy;
      }
    }
    if (off.stick && L.stickHome) {
      L.stickHome = {
        x: clamp(L.stickHome.x + off.stick[0], L.stickR, W - L.stickR),
        y: clamp(L.stickHome.y + off.stick[1], L.stickR, H - L.stickR)
      };
    }
    // each control's own size (the layout editor: 50%-400%, the user 2026-11-01), grown about its centre
    const sc = st.touchScale || {};
    for (const id in sc) {
      const k = clamp(+sc[id] || 1, 0.5, 4);
      if (k === 1) continue;
      if (id === 'stick') {
        if (L.stickHome) {
          L.stickR = Math.round(L.stickR * k);
          L.stickHome = {
            x: clamp(L.stickHome.x, L.stickR, W - L.stickR),
            y: clamp(L.stickHome.y, L.stickR, H - L.stickR)
          };
        }
        continue;
      }
      const r = L[id];
      if (!r || r.x === undefined) continue;
      const cx = r.x + r.w / 2,
        cy = r.y + r.h / 2;
      r.w = Math.min(W, Math.round(r.w * k));
      r.h = Math.min(H, Math.round(r.h * k));
      r.x = clamp(Math.round(cx - r.w / 2), 0, W - r.w);
      r.y = clamp(Math.round(cy - r.h / 2), 0, H - r.h);
    }
    // the D-pad resized: its buttons and where they answer with it (only the frame grew - the buttons stayed as they were)
    if (L.dpad && L.x0 > -1e3 && (+sc.dpad || 1) !== 1) {
      const d = L.dpad,
        b = Math.min(d.w, d.h) / 3,
        q = Math.max(1, Math.round(gp * b / B));
      L.x0 = d.x;
      L.y0 = d.y;
      L.dB = b;
      for (const k in L.cells) {
        const [r, c] = DPAD_RC[k];
        L.cells[k] = {
          x: d.x + c * b + q,
          y: d.y + r * b + q,
          w: b - 2 * q,
          h: b - 2 * q
        };
      }
    }
    // the fly-down button sits under jump and goes with it, moved or resized, unless the player placed or sized it: a jump
    // moved alone left it behind (feedback 11-01), an enlarged one covered it (11-08). No room under: beside it, where
    // no other button is if it can
    if (L.descend && touchDescFollows(st)) {
      const j = L.jump,
        d = L.descend,
        w = d.w,
        h = d.h,
        cx = Math.round(j.x + (j.w - w) / 2);
      const others = ['jump', 'sprint', 'attack', 'use', 'interact', 'sneak', 'hotbar', 'inv'].map(k => L[k]).filter(Boolean);
      const hit = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.w && b.x < a.x + a.w && a.y < b.y + b.h && b.y < a.y + a.h;
      const fits = (r, all) => r.x >= 0 && r.y >= 0 && r.x + w <= W && r.y + h <= H - sf.b && !(all ? others : [j]).some(o => hit(o, {
        ...r,
        w,
        h
      }));
      const spots = [{
        x: cx,
        y: j.y + j.h + gp
      }, {
        x: j.x - gp - w,
        y: j.y + j.h - h
      }, {
        x: j.x - gp - w,
        y: j.y
      }, {
        x: j.x + j.w + gp,
        y: j.y + j.h - h
      }];
      const side = spots.slice(1),
        at = fits(spots[0], false) && spots[0] || side.find(r => fits(r, true)) || side.find(r => fits(r, false));
      if (at) {
        d.x = at.x;
        d.y = at.y;
      } else {
        d.x = clamp(cx, 0, W - w);
        d.y = clamp(j.y + j.h + gp, 0, H - h);
      }
    }
    // a joystick moved or resized: where a thumb starts it goes with it (it stayed the bottom left - the stick drawn
    // somewhere else answered nothing, the player could not walk: players' feedback 2026-11-01)
    if (L.stickHome && (off.stick && (off.stick[0] || off.stick[1]) || sc.stick && sc.stick !== 1)) {
      const R2 = L.stickR * 2,
        x0 = Math.max(0, L.stickHome.x - R2),
        y0 = Math.max(0, L.stickHome.y - R2);
      L.stickZone = {
        x: x0,
        y: y0,
        w: Math.min(W, L.stickHome.x + R2) - x0,
        h: Math.min(H, L.stickHome.y + R2) - y0
      };
    }
    // (a button the player moved or sized under the capsule: down below it, where a finger reaches it again)
    if (cap) for (const id of ['pause', 'chat', 'view', 'emote', 'f3', 'jump', 'descend', 'sprint', 'attack', 'use', 'interact', 'sneak', 'inv']) {
      const r = L[id];
      if (r && r.x + r.w > W - cap.w && r.y < cap.h) r.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - r.h, cap.h + 2));
    }
    return L;
  };
  // (what the HUD puts at the top - status effects, the ping bars - below the capsule too)
  const ti = P.topInset;
  P.topInset = function () {
    const t = ti.call(this),
      cap = t ? toyCapsule(this.ui) : null;
    return cap ? Math.max(t, cap.h + 2) : t;
  };
  // a screen's close button: kept clear of the safe area; inside Bilibili top left, as the container's capsule
  // (… and ✕) floats over the top right corner whatever the safe area says
  const cr = P.closeRect;
  P.closeRect = function () {
    const r = cr.call(this);
    if (!r) return r;
    const sf = this.ui.safe();
    if (Stage.inToy) {
      r.x = 4 + sf.l;
      r.y = 4 + sf.t;
      if (typeof Minimap !== 'undefined' && Minimap.on(this.g)) {
        const m = Minimap.rect(this.ui);
        r.x = m.x + m.w + 4;
      } // (beside the minimap)
    } else {
      r.x -= sf.r;
      r.y += sf.t;
    }
    return r;
  };
  const sp = P.startPlay;
  P.startPlay = function (s) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld,
      L = this.layout(),
      x = s.x,
      y = s.y;
    if (this.hitL(L.emote, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'button';
      s.btn = 'emote';
      return;
    }
    if (this.hitL(L.f3, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'button';
      s.btn = 'f3';
      return;
    }
    if (L.attack && this.hitL(L.attack, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'abtn';
      s.holdBtn = 0;
      g.mouseBtn[0] = true;
      g.mouseClicked0 = true;
      g.attackCd = Math.min(g.attackCd, 0);
      if (!g.target && !g.targetEntity) g.player.swing();
      s.holding = true;
      return;
    }
    if (L.use && this.hitL(L.use, x, y)) {
      s.kind = 'abtn';
      s.holdBtn = 2;
      g.mouseBtn[2] = true;
      g.useCd = 0;
      s.holding = true;
      return;
    }
    if (stickOn(g)) {
      if (L.sneak && this.hitL(L.sneak, x, y)) {
        s.kind = 'none';
        th.sneak = !th.sneak;
        return;
      }
      for (const id of ['pause', 'chat', 'view', 'inv', 'interact']) if (this.hitL(L[id], x, y)) return sp.call(this, s);
      if (L.hotbar && this.hitL(L.hotbar, x, y, 0)) return sp.call(this, s);
      if (this.hitL(L.jump, x, y) || L.descend && this.hitL(L.descend, x, y) || L.sprint && this.hitL(L.sprint, x, y)) return sp.call(this, s);
      const z = L.stickZone;
      if (x >= z.x && x < z.x + z.w && y >= z.y && y < z.y + z.h && ![...this.t.values()].some(o => o !== s && o.kind === 'stick')) {
        // the stick's centre where the thumb lands (kept whole on the screen)
        s.kind = 'stick';
        if (stickFixed(g)) {
          s.bx = L.stickHome.x;
          s.by = L.stickHome.y;
        } else {
          s.bx = clamp(x, L.stickR, L.W - L.stickR);
          s.by = clamp(y, L.stickR, L.H - L.stickR);
        }
        this.stick(s);
        return;
      }
    }
    sp.call(this, s);
  };
  P.stick = function (s) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld,
      L = this.L,
      R = L.stickR;
    let dx = (s.x - s.bx) / R,
      dy = (s.y - s.by) / R;
    const l = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (l > 1) {
      dx /= l;
      dy /= l;
    }
    // (thumbs drift: past the rim the centre follows, so the stick never goes dead)
    if (l > 1.4 && !stickFixed(g)) {
      s.bx = s.x - dx * R;
      s.by = s.y - dy * R;
    }
    const m = Math.min(1, l),
      dead = 0.18,
      k = m < dead ? 0 : (m - dead) / (1 - dead);
    th.joy = k ? {
      x: dx / Math.max(1e-6, Math.min(1, l)) * k,
      y: dy / Math.max(1e-6, Math.min(1, l)) * k
    } : null;
    const fwd = th.joy && -th.joy.y > 0.35;
    if (fwd && !th.forward) {
      th.forward = true;
      pressAction(g, 'forward');
    }
    if (!fwd && th.forward) {
      th.forward = false;
      releaseAction(g, 'forward');
    }
    // pushed all the way forward: sprint - and it stays on until let go or pulled back under a third (as Bedrock: it
    // flickered on and off at the rim, "想疾跑的时候走路")
    if (!pushSprint(g)) th.joySprint = false;else if (th.joy && m > 0.96 && -dy > 0.8) th.joySprint = true;else if (!th.joy || m < 0.35 || -dy < 0.3) th.joySprint = false;
  };
  const mp = P.movePlay;
  P.movePlay = function (s, dx, dy) {
    if (s.kind === 'stick') {
      this.stick(s);
      return;
    }
    // a finger on the attack / use button that moves turns the view as it goes (Bedrock), still mining / using
    // (only once it has moved 8 px: a thumb pressing the button wobbles - "按按键挖掘的时候容易乱动视角")
    if (s.kind === 'abtn') {
      if (!s.turning) {
        s.turning = Math.hypot(s.cx - s.sx, s.cy - s.sy) > 8;
        if (!s.turning) return;
      }
      s.kind = 'look';
      try {
        mp.call(this, s, dx, dy);
      } finally {
        s.kind = 'abtn';
      }
      return;
    }
    mp.call(this, s, dx, dy);
  };
  const ep = P.endPlay;
  P.endPlay = function (s, cancel) {
    const g = this.g,
      th = g.touchHeld;
    if (s.kind === 'stick') {
      th.joy = null;
      th.joySprint = false;
      if (th.forward) {
        th.forward = false;
        releaseAction(g, 'forward');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (s.kind === 'abtn') {
      g.mouseBtn[s.holdBtn] = false;
      return;
    }
    if (s.kind === 'button' && s.btn === 'f3') {
      if (!cancel && this.hitL(this.L.f3, s.x, s.y)) {
        g.ui.debug = !g.ui.debug;
        if (typeof PerfMon !== 'undefined') PerfMon.gpuOn = g.ui.debug;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (s.kind === 'button' && s.btn === 'emote') {
      if (!cancel && this.hitL(this.L.emote, s.x, s.y)) g.ui.open(new QuickChatScreen(g));
      return;
    }
    // a tap on the world does nothing: the attack / use buttons act, at the crosshair
    if (s.kind === 'look' && !classic(g)) {
      if (s.holding) g.mouseBtn[s.holdBtn] = false;
      return;
    }
    ep.call(this, s, cancel);
  };
  // holding the screen does not mine either (the attack button does)
  const up = P.update;
  P.update = function (now) {
    if (classic(this.g)) return up.call(this, now);
    for (const s of this.t.values()) if (s.kind === 'look') s.holding = s.holding || 'none';
    up.call(this, now);
    for (const s of this.t.values()) if (s.holding === 'none') s.holding = false;
  };
  // a disc in whole pixels (the joystick): 'base' a see-through dark disc with a black edge, a light bevel top left and a
  // dark one bottom right, four arrows; 'knob' / 'knobOn' a grey (lighter) knob shaded the same way. Made once a size
  const discs = new Map();
  const pixDisc = (R, kind) => {
    const key = kind + R;
    if (discs.has(key)) return discs.get(key);
    const p = Math.max(2, Math.round(R / 13)),
      n = Math.ceil(2 * R / p),
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = cv.height = n * p;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d'),
      base = kind === 'base';
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dx = (i + 0.5) * p - R,
        dy = (j + 0.5) * p - R,
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (d > R) continue;
      let col;
      if (d > R - p) col = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';else if (d > R - 2 * p) col = dx + dy < 0 ? base ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' : '#D8D8D8' : base ? 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' : '#5E5E5E';else col = base ? 'rgba(40,40,40,0.42)' : kind === 'knobOn' ? '#C8C8C8' : '#9C9C9C';
      x.fillStyle = col;
      x.fillRect(i * p, j * p, p, p);
    }
    if (base) {
      // (the arrows: three pixels wide, two deep, pointing out)
      x.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      const c0 = Math.floor(n / 2),
        d = Math.round(R * 0.74 / p);
      for (const [ux, uy] of [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]) {
        const ax = c0 + ux * d,
          ay = c0 + uy * d;
        for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
          const px = ax + (uy ? k : 0) - ux,
            py = ay + (ux ? k : 0) - uy;
          x.fillRect(px * p, py * p, p, p);
        }
        x.fillRect(ax * p, ay * p, p, p);
      }
    }
    discs.set(key, cv);
    return cv;
  };
  // drawing: the joystick, sneak, the attack / use buttons, quick chat
  const dr = P.draw;
  P.draw = function (ui) {
    var _g$settings$touchOpac;
    dr.call(this, ui);
    const g = this.g;
    if (!this.on() || g.state !== 'play' || ui.screen || !this.L) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      L = this.L,
      th = g.touchHeld;
    c.save();
    c.globalAlpha = (_g$settings$touchOpac = g.settings.touchOpacity) !== null && _g$settings$touchOpac !== void 0 ? _g$settings$touchOpac : 0.7;
    if (L.stickHome) {
      // (pixel art like the buttons - the user 11-03: 原版的像素风，不要花哨颜色: a stepped disc with a black edge and a
      // bevel, four little arrows, a grey knob lit from the top left; sprinting it is a lighter grey)
      const s = [...this.t.values()].find(q => q.kind === 'stick'),
        bx = s ? s.bx : L.stickHome.x,
        by = s ? s.by : L.stickHome.y,
        R = L.stickR;
      const kx = s ? bx + clamp(s.x - bx, -R, R) : bx,
        ky = s ? by + clamp(s.y - by, -R, R) : by,
        kl = Math.hypot(kx - bx, ky - by),
        kk = kl > R ? R / kl : 1;
      const nx = bx + (kx - bx) * kk,
        ny = by + (ky - by) * kk,
        sm = c.imageSmoothingEnabled;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      const B = pixDisc(R, 'base'),
        K = pixDisc(Math.round(R * 0.42), th.joySprint ? 'knobOn' : 'knob');
      c.drawImage(B, Math.round(bx - R), Math.round(by - R));
      c.drawImage(K, Math.round(nx - K.width / 2), Math.round(ny - K.height / 2));
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = sm;
      if (L.sneak) this.btn(c, L.sneak, th.sneak ? 'sneakOn' : 'sneak', !!th.sneak);
    }
    this.btn(c, L.emote, 'emote', false);
    this.btn(c, L.f3, null, !!ui.debug, 'F3');
    if (L.attack) {
      this.btn(c, L.attack, 'attack', g.mouseBtn[0]);
      this.btn(c, L.use, 'use', g.mouseBtn[2]);
    }
    c.restore();
  };
  // the joystick moves analogue (half pushed = slower), like Bedrock's
  const ri = Game.prototype.readInput;
  Game.prototype.readInput = function () {
    const r = ri.call(this),
      th = this.touchHeld;
    if (th && th.joy) {
      r.fwd = clamp(-th.joy.y, -1, 1);
      r.strafe = clamp(th.joy.x, -1, 1);
      // (a boat turns at full speed for any sideways push: a thumb a little off straight made it sway - "开船一直晃")
      if (typeof Boat !== 'undefined' && this.player && this.player.vehicle instanceof Boat && Math.abs(r.strafe) < 0.35) r.strafe = 0;
    }
    if (th && th.joySprint) r.sprint = true;
    return r;
  };
})();

// the pause menu: the touch settings one tap away (they were four deep - players could not find the sensitivity)
(() => {
  const pl = PauseScreen.prototype.layout;
  PauseScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    pl.call(this);
    const g = this.game,
      u = g.ui;
    if (touchOn(g)) this.widgets.push({
      x: 4,
      y: u.h - 22,
      w: 64,
      h: 18,
      label: '触控设置',

    });
  };
})();

// ---- vibration: a block broken, being hurt ----
const buzz = (g, ms) => {
  if (touchOn(g) && g.settings.vibrate !== false && navigator.vibrate) try {
    navigator.vibrate(ms);
  } catch (e) {}
};
(() => {
  const bb = Game.prototype.breakBlock;
  Game.prototype.breakBlock = function (x, y, z, natural, silent) {
    const r = bb.call(this, x, y, z, natural, silent);
    if (!natural && !silent) buzz(this, 15);
    return r;
  };
  const h = Player.prototype.hurt;
  Player.prototype.hurt = function (a, src) {
    const r = h.call(this, a, src);
    if (r) buzz(this.game, 40);
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- quick chat: a phrase or an emoticon in one tap (typing on a phone is slow) ----
const QUICK_PHRASES = ['过来！', '救命！', '这里有钻石', '跟我来', '等等我', '谢谢！', '好的', '天黑了，回家', '小心苦力怕！', '我去挖矿', '我饿了', '晚安'];
const QUICK_EMOTES = ['(^_^)', '(T_T)', '(o_O)', '(>_<)', '(*^▽^*)', '(╯°□°)╯', '♥', '233'];
class QuickChatScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, '快捷聊天');
    this.pauses = false;
    this.bgDim = 0.3;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.titleY = 10;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      cols = 3,
      w = Math.min(110, Math.floor((u.w - 24) / cols) - 4);
    this.widgets = [];
    QUICK_PHRASES.forEach((t, i) => this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - cols * (w + 4) / 2 + i % cols * (w + 4),
      y: 24 + Math.floor(i / cols) * 24,
      w,
      h: 20,
      label: t,
      onClick: () => this.send(t)
    }));
    const ew = 46,
      n = QUICK_EMOTES.length,
      y = 24 + Math.ceil(QUICK_PHRASES.length / cols) * 24 + 6;
    QUICK_EMOTES.forEach((t, i) => this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - Math.min(n, 6) * (ew + 4) / 2 + i % 6 * (ew + 4),
      y: y + Math.floor(i / 6) * 24,
      w: ew,
      h: 20,
      label: t,
      onClick: () => this.send(t)
    }));
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 60,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 120,
      h: 20,
      label: '关闭',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.close()
    });
  }
  send(t) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (g.net) g.net.chat(t);else g.ui.message('<' + (typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.name || g.settings.netName || '我') + '> ' + t);
    g.ui.close();
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
}

// ---- 编辑按钮布局: drag the controls where the thumbs want them ----
// a control touched is chosen: its size goes 50%-400% with - / +; 重置布局 puts every place and size back, 保存布局
// keeps them (done: what comes next - the first-start setup goes on from here), 不保存返回 puts back what was before
class TouchLayoutScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, done) {
    super(game, null);
    this.parent = parent;
    this.done = done || null;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0.35;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.drag = null;
    this.touchDrag = true;
    this.sel = null;
    const s = game.settings;
    this.was = {
      layout: JSON.stringify(s.touchLayout || {}),
      scale: JSON.stringify(s.touchScale || {}),
      descOwn: s.touchDescOwn
    };
  }
  scaleOf(id) {
    return (this.game.settings.touchScale || {})[id] || 1;
  }
  setScale(id, k) {
    const s = this.game.settings;
    if (id === 'descend') {
      if (touchDescFollows(s)) s.touchLayout = Object.assign({}, s.touchLayout || {}, {
        descend: this.descOffset()
      });
      s.touchDescOwn = true;
    } // (stays where it is)
    s.touchScale = Object.assign({}, s.touchScale || {}, {
      [id]: Math.round(clamp(k, 0.5, 4) * 100) / 100
    });
  }
  // the fly-down button's place now as an offset of its own (while it follows jump its offset says nothing)
  descOffset() {
    const L = this.game.ui.touch.L,
      r = L && L.descend,
      b = L && L.descBase;
    return r && b ? [Math.round(r.x + r.w / 2 - b.x - b.w / 2), Math.round(r.y + r.h / 2 - b.y - b.h / 2)] : [0, 0];
  }
  save() {
    this.game.saveSettings();
    if (this.done) {
      const d = this.done;
      this.done = null;
      d();
    } else this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  discard() {
    const s = this.game.settings;
    s.touchLayout = JSON.parse(this.was.layout);
    s.touchScale = JSON.parse(this.was.scale);
    s.touchDescOwn = this.was.descOwn;
    this.game.saveSettings();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  ids() {
    return ['stick', 'dpad', 'sneak', 'jump', 'descend', 'sprint', 'attack', 'use', 'interact', 'inv', 'pause', 'chat', 'emote', 'f3', 'view'];
  }
  rects() {
    // (editAll: fly-down, interact and the stick's sneak too, which the game only shows now and then - touch.js layout)
    const tc = this.game.ui.touch,
      out = {};
    let L;
    tc.editAll = true;
    try {
      L = tc.layout();
    } finally {
      tc.editAll = false;
    }
    for (const id of this.ids()) {
      if (id === 'stick') {
        if (L.stickHome) out.stick = {
          x: L.stickHome.x - L.stickR,
          y: L.stickHome.y - L.stickR,
          w: 2 * L.stickR,
          h: 2 * L.stickR
        };
      } else if (L[id]) out[id] = L[id];
    }
    return out;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 154,
      y: 6,
      w: 100,
      h: 18,
      label: '重置布局',
      tip: ['所有按钮回到默认的位置和大小'],
      onClick: () => {
        g.settings.touchLayout = {};
        g.settings.touchScale = {};
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 50,
      y: 6,
      w: 100,
      h: 18,
      label: '保存布局',
      gold: true,
      onClick: () => this.save()
    }];
    if (!this.done) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx + 54,
      y: 6,
      w: 100,
      h: 18,
      label: '不保存返回',
      onClick: () => this.discard()
    });
    // the chosen control's size
    if (this.sel) {
      const id = this.sel,
        y = 44;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 92,
        y,
        w: 30,
        h: 18,
        label: '－',
        enabled: this.scaleOf(id) > 0.5,
        onClick: () => {
          this.setScale(id, this.scaleOf(id) - 0.1);
          this.layout();
        }
      }, {
        x: cx - 60,
        y,
        w: 120,
        h: 18,
        label: () => '大小：' + Math.round(this.scaleOf(this.sel) * 100) + '%',
        enabled: false
      }, {
        x: cx + 62,
        y,
        w: 30,
        h: 18,
        label: '＋',
        enabled: this.scaleOf(id) < 4,
        onClick: () => {
          this.setScale(id, this.scaleOf(id) + 0.1);
          this.layout();
        }
      });
    }
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (ui.hit(w, mx, my)) return super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
    const R = this.rects();
    for (const id in R) {
      const r = R[id];
      if (mx >= r.x && mx < r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my < r.y + r.h) {
        const s = this.game.settings,
          o = id === 'descend' && touchDescFollows(s) ? this.descOffset() : (s.touchLayout || {})[id] || [0, 0];
        this.drag = {
          id,
          mx,
          my,
          o: [...o]
        };
        if (this.sel !== id) {
          this.sel = id;
          this.layout();
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (!this.drag || !ui.mouse.down) return;
    const s = this.game.settings,
      d = this.drag,
      follows = d.id === 'jump' && touchDescFollows(s);
    s.touchLayout = Object.assign({}, s.touchLayout || {}, {
      [d.id]: [Math.round(d.o[0] + mx - d.mx), Math.round(d.o[1] + my - d.my)]
    });
    if (follows) delete s.touchLayout.descend; // (an old copy of jump's offset: fly-down keeps following it)
    if (d.id === 'descend') s.touchDescOwn = true;
  }
  mouseUp() {
    if (this.drag) this.drag = null;
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      R = this.rects(),
      names = {
        stick: '摇杆',
        dpad: '方向键',
        sneak: '潜行',
        jump: '跳跃',
        descend: '下降',
        sprint: '疾跑',
        attack: '攻击',
        use: '使用',
        interact: '互动',
        inv: '背包',
        pause: '暂停',
        chat: '聊天',
        emote: '快捷聊天',
        f3: 'F3',
        view: '视角'
      };
    Font.center(c, this.sel ? '拖动按钮换位置；用 － ＋ 调这个按钮的大小' : '拖动按钮到顺手的位置；点一个按钮可以调它的大小', ui.w / 2, 30, '#FFFFFF');
    for (const id in R) {
      const r = R[id];
      c.fillStyle = this.drag && this.drag.id === id ? 'rgba(255,210,74,0.5)' : this.sel === id ? 'rgba(255,210,74,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      c.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
      c.strokeStyle = '#FFD24A';
      c.strokeRect(r.x + 0.5, r.y + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1);
      Font.center(c, names[id], r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2 - 4, '#FFFFFF');
    }
  }
  onEsc() {
    if (this.done) this.save();else this.discard();
  }
}

// ---- the frame-rate choice (触控设置, the first-run quality screen: onboard.js) ----
// A phone or tablet with a 90/120 Hz screen (FramePacer.auto60): 自动 (0, the default: 60) -> 90 -> 120 (what the screen
// has) -> 跟随屏幕 (-1) - the user, 11-03: 60 unless the player wants more. A 60 there before (an older version, the heat
// fallback) reads as 60 and goes on to 90. Anything else (a 60 Hz screen, a touchscreen PC): 60 ... -> the screen's rate
// (0), as before
const FpsChoice = {
  list(g) {
    const P = g.pacer,
      up = [90, 120].filter(r => r <= (P ? P.hz : 60) + 5);
    return P && P.auto60 ? [0, ...up, -1] : [60, ...up, 0];
  },
  label(g, v) {
    const P = g.pacer,
      hz = P ? P.hz : 60;
    return v > 0 ? v + ' 帧' : v === -1 || !(P && P.auto60) ? '跟随屏幕（' + hz + ' 帧）' : '自动（60 帧）';
  },
  next(g) {
    const s = g.settings,
      L = this.list(g),
      v = s.maxFps > 0 || s.maxFps === -1 ? s.maxFps : 0;
    s.maxFps = L[(L.indexOf(v === 60 && L[0] === 0 ? 0 : v) + 1) % L.length];
  }
};

// ---- the touch options: joystick, vibration, layout, frame rate, turning the screen ----
(() => {
  const opts = OptionsListScreen.prototype.options;
  OptionsListScreen.prototype.options = function () {
    const list = opts.call(this);
    if (this.page !== 'touch') return list;
    const s = this.game.settings,
      g = this.game;
    const bt = (label, fn, extra) => ({
      label,
      onClick: () => {
        fn();
        g.applySettings();
        g.saveSettings();
      },
      ...extra
    });
    return [bt(() => '移动：' + (s.touchStick === false ? '方向键' : '摇杆'), () => {
      s.touchStick = s.touchStick === false;
    }), ...(s.touchStick === false ? [] : [Object.assign(bt(() => '动态摇杆：' + (s.touchStickDyn ? '开' : '关'), () => {
      s.touchStickDyn = !s.touchStickDyn;
    }), {
      tip: ['关：摇杆固定在原地，按在它附近都以它为中心', '开：手指按下的地方就是摇杆中心，手指拉远时摇杆跟着走']
    }), bt(() => '摇杆推满疾跑：' + (s.touchPushSprint === false ? '关' : '开'), () => {
      s.touchPushSprint = s.touchPushSprint === false;
    })]), ...list, Object.assign(bt(() => '操作方式：' + (s.touchClassic ? '经典（点屏幕放置，长按挖）' : '准星 + 按钮'), () => {
      s.touchClassic = !s.touchClassic;
    }), {
      tip: ['准星 + 按钮：用攻击、使用按钮对着屏幕中间的准星操作', '经典：直接点屏幕放置、长按屏幕挖掘，按钮也还在']
    }), bt(() => '震动：' + (s.vibrate === false ? '关' : '开'), () => {
      s.vibrate = s.vibrate === false;
    }), bt('编辑按钮布局…', () => g.ui.open(new TouchLayoutScreen(g, this))), Object.assign(bt(() => '帧率上限：' + FpsChoice.label(g, s.maxFps), () => FpsChoice.next(g)), {
      tip: ['越高越流畅，但更耗电、手机更热', '自动：90 / 120 Hz 的屏幕上是 60 帧', '手机热到跟不上时会自动降回 60 帧']
    }), bt(() => '竖着拿手机时旋转画面：' + (s.rotatePortrait === false ? '关' : '开'), () => {
      s.rotatePortrait = s.rotatePortrait === false;
      Stage.update();
    })];
  };
})();

// ---- a phone that cannot keep a frame rate above 60 (heat): back to 60, once ----
// (the limit in effect - FramePacer.playLimit, 0 = the screen's rate; the time between two checks counts only while
// this applies: 'last' stayed behind on the other paths and a pause menu of minutes came back as minutes of "too slow".
// Not under a pausing screen or the inactivity limit, nor for 2.5 s after - g.fps counts whole seconds)
(() => {
  let low = 0,
    last = performance.now();
  setInterval(() => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game,
      P = g && g.pacer,
      now = performance.now(),
      dt = now - last;
    last = now;
    const lim = P ? P.playLimit || P.hz : 0;
    if (!P || g.state !== 'play' || !touchOn(g) || lim <= 65) {
      low = 0;
      return;
    }
    if (document.hidden || now - P.cappedT < 2500 || !g.fps) return;
    if (g.fps < lim * 0.7) low += dt;else low = Math.max(0, low - dt / 2);
    if (low > 30000) {
      g.settings.maxFps = P.auto60 ? 0 : 60;
      g.saveSettings();
      g.ui.message('手机有点热，帧率上限降到 60 帧（触控设置里可以改回来）', '#FFAA00');
      low = 0;
    }
  }, 2000);
})();
addEventListener('load', () => Stage.init());
</script>
<script>

// ---- step 0: the agreement: a window in the middle ("I have read and agree to 《用户协议》 and 《隐私说明》", the two
// names links to the whole text); viewOnly: the whole text (from those links, or 选项), at: which part to start at ----
class AgreementScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next, viewOnly, at) {
    super(game, viewOnly ? '用户协议和隐私说明' : null);
    this.next = next;
    this.viewOnly = viewOnly;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.agree = false;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.updated = !viewOnly && (game.settings.legalV || 0) > 0 && game.settings.legalV < LEGAL.v;
    if (viewOnly && at === 'privacy') {
      const L = this.lines(),
        i = L.findIndex(t => t.startsWith('《隐私说明》'));
      this.scroll = clamp(i, 0, Math.max(0, L.length - this.rows()));
    }
  }
  // the window and its pieces: the check row's parts (box, words, the two links) and the button
  box() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      w = Math.min(290, u.w - 16),
      h = 132;
    return {
      x: Math.floor(u.w / 2 - w / 2),
      y: Math.floor(u.h / 2 - h / 2),
      w,
      h
    };
  }
  rowParts() {
    const B = this.box(),
      parts = [['check', '我已阅读并同意'], ['agreement', '《用户协议》'], ['and', '和'], ['privacy', '《隐私说明》']];
    const total = 12 + parts.reduce((s, p) => s + Font.width(p[1]), 0);
    let x = Math.floor(B.x + B.w / 2 - total / 2) + 12;
    const y = B.y + 70,
      out = [{
        k: 'box',
        x: x - 12,
        y: y - 1,
        w: 9,
        h: 9
      }];
    for (const [k, t] of parts) {
      const w = Font.width(t);
      out.push({
        k,
        t,
        x,
        y,
        w,
        h: 9
      });
      x += w;
    }
    return out;
  }
  rowHit(mx, my) {
    return this.rowParts().find(p => mx >= p.x - 1 && mx < p.x + p.w + 1 && my >= p.y - 2 && my < p.y + p.h + 2);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button) {
    if (!this.viewOnly && button === 0) {
      const p = this.rowHit(mx, my);
      if (p && (p.k === 'agreement' || p.k === 'privacy')) {
        Sound.click();
        return this.game.ui.open(new AgreementScreen(this.game, () => this.game.ui.open(this), true, p.k));
      }
      if (p) {
        Sound.click();
        this.agree = !this.agree;
        this.warn = 0;
        return;
      }
    }
    return super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button);
  }
  lines() {
    const out = [],
      max = this.game.ui.w - 40;
    for (const t of [...LEGAL.agreement, '', ...LEGAL.privacy]) {
      if (!t) {
        out.push('');
        continue;
      }
      let s = t;
      while (s.length) {
        let n = s.length;
        while (n > 1 && Font.width(s.slice(0, n)) > max) n--;
        out.push(s.slice(0, n));
        s = s.slice(n);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    if (this.viewOnly) {
      this.widgets = [{
        x: cx - 100,
        y: u.h - 26,
        w: 200,
        h: 20,
        label: '返回',
        onClick: () => this.done()
      }];
      return;
    }
    const B = this.box();
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 70,
      y: B.y + B.h - 32,
      w: 140,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '同意并继续',
      onClick: () => {
        if (!this.agree) {
          this.warn = performance.now();
          return;
        }
        this.game.settings.legalV = LEGAL.v;
        this.game.saveSettings();
        this.done();
      }
    }];
  }
  drawWindow(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      B = this.box(),
      cx = B.x + B.w / 2,
      m = ui.mouse;
    ui.dim(0.35);
    drawCard(c, B.x, B.y, B.w, B.h, false);
    Font.center(c, this.updated ? '用户协议有更新' : '欢迎来到 OpusMC', cx, B.y + 10, '#FFFFFF');
    const intro = this.updated ? ['协议内容有调整，请重新阅读并同意后继续游戏。'] : ['这是 UP 主「土豆味小哲」制作的 Minecraft 粉丝二创作品，非官方、永久免费。', '开始之前，请阅读并同意下面的协议。'];
    intro.forEach((t, i) => Font.center(c, fitText(t, B.w - 16), cx, B.y + 28 + i * 11, '#A0A0A0'));
    // the check row: the box, the words, the two links (blue, underlined; lighter under the pointer)
    const hit = this.rowHit(m.x, m.y);
    for (const p of this.rowParts()) {
      if (p.k === 'box') {
        c.fillStyle = '#000000';
        c.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
        c.strokeStyle = hit && (hit.k === 'box' || hit.k === 'check') ? '#FFFFFF' : this.warn && performance.now() - this.warn < 1500 ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0';
        c.lineWidth = 1;
        c.strokeRect(p.x + 0.5, p.y + 0.5, p.w - 1, p.h - 1);
        if (this.agree) {
          c.fillStyle = '#55FF55';
          c.fillRect(p.x + 2, p.y + 4, 2, 2);
          c.fillRect(p.x + 3, p.y + 5, 2, 2);
          c.fillRect(p.x + 5, p.y + 3, 1, 2);
          c.fillRect(p.x + 6, p.y + 2, 1, 2);
        }
        continue;
      }
      const link = p.k === 'agreement' || p.k === 'privacy',
        on = hit === p || hit && hit.k === p.k;
      const col = link ? on ? '#9FD0FF' : '#55AAFF' : '#E0E0E0';
      Font.draw(c, p.t, p.x, p.y, col);
      if (link) {
        c.fillStyle = col;
        c.fillRect(p.x, p.y + 9, p.w, 1);
      }
    }
    if (this.warn && performance.now() - this.warn < 1500) Font.center(c, '请先勾选「我已阅读并同意」', cx, B.y + 84, '#FF6060');else Font.center(c, '点蓝色的名字可以查看全文', cx, B.y + 84, '#707070');
  }
  done() {
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    n && n();
  }
  wheel(d) {
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll - d * 3, 0, Math.max(0, this.lines().length - this.rows()));
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 24 - 34) / 10);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    if (!this.viewOnly) return this.drawWindow(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      L = this.lines(),
      n = this.rows();
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    c.fillRect(12, 20, ui.w - 24, n * 10 + 6);
    L.slice(this.scroll, this.scroll + n).forEach((t, i) => Font.draw(c, t, 18, 24 + i * 10, /^《/.test(t) ? '#FFD24A' : '#E0E0E0'));
    if (L.length > n) Font.draw(c, `${this.scroll + n < L.length ? '↓ 滑动或滚动查看更多' : '— 完 —'}`, ui.w - 120, 24 + n * 10 - 9, '#808080');
  }
  onEsc() {
    if (this.viewOnly) this.done();
  }
}
// (touch: dragging scrolls it - the touch layer scrolls screens that have wheel())

// ---- step 1: which kind of player ----
const PLAYER_KINDS = [{
  id: 'new',
  title: '第一次玩 Minecraft',
  sub: '从头教我怎么玩',
  icon: 'grass_block'
}, {
  id: 'mc',
  title: '玩过 Minecraft',
  sub: '看看这个网页版有什么不一样',
  icon: 'crafting_table'
}, {
  id: 'vet',
  title: '这个版本我玩过',
  sub: '直接开始',
  icon: 'diamond_pickaxe'
}];
class PlayerKindScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next) {
    super(game, '你是哪种玩家？');
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 14;
  }
  cards() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      w = Math.min(130, Math.floor((u.w - 24) / 3) - 6),
      h = Math.min(120, u.h - 80),
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 2 - h / 2) + 6;
    return PLAYER_KINDS.map((k, i) => ({
      ...k,
      x: Math.floor(u.w / 2 - (3 * w + 12) / 2) + i * (w + 6),
      y,
      w,
      h
    }));
  }
  layout() {
    this.widgets = this.cards().map(k => ({
      x: k.x,
      y: k.y,
      w: k.w,
      h: k.h,
      label: '',
      card: k,
      onClick: () => this.pick(k.id)
    }));
  }
  pick(id) {
    const s = this.game.settings;
    s.playerKind = id;
    // what each kind starts with (UX_IDEAS.md 各类玩家得到什么)
    if (id === 'new') Object.assign(s, {
      tutorial: true,
      tips: true,
      recipeHints: true,
      minimap: true,
      deathMarker: true
    });
    if (id === 'mc') Object.assign(s, {
      tutorial: false,
      tips: false,
      recipeHints: true,
      minimap: false,
      deathMarker: false
    });
    if (id === 'vet') Object.assign(s, {
      tutorial: false,
      tips: false
    });
    this.game.saveSettings();
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('kind_' + id);
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    n && n();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    super.draw(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx;
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      const k = w.card,
        hover = ui.hit(w);
      drawCard(c, k.x, k.y, k.w, k.h, hover);
      ui.drawItem && ui.drawItem(makeStack(k.icon, 1), Math.floor(k.x + k.w / 2 - 8), k.y + 14);
      Font.center(c, fitText(k.title, k.w - 8), k.x + k.w / 2, k.y + 44, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.center(c, fitText(k.sub, k.w - 8), k.x + k.w / 2, k.y + 58, '#A0A0A0');
    }
  }
  onEsc() {}
}

// ---- step 2: quality and shaders, on the live title world ----
const QUALITY_CARDS = [{
  id: 'low',
  name: '流畅',
  sub: '近处清楚、远处少',
  cost: 0.45
}, {
  id: 'medium',
  name: '均衡',
  sub: '大多数设备',
  cost: 0.65
}, {
  id: 'high',
  name: '高',
  sub: '看得更远',
  cost: 1
}, {
  id: 'ultra',
  name: '极致',
  sub: '最远视距',
  cost: 1.6
}];
const SHADER_CARDS = [{
  lv: 0,
  name: '关闭',
  sub: '原版画面',
  cost: 1
}, {
  lv: 1,
  name: '柔和',
  sub: '轻微阴影和雾',
  cost: 1.25
}, {
  lv: 2,
  name: '原版光影',
  sub: '阴影、水面反射',
  cost: 1.6
}, {
  lv: 3,
  name: '增强',
  sub: '更强的光影效果',
  cost: 2.2
}, {
  lv: 4,
  name: '极限',
  sub: '体积光，最吃显卡',
  cost: 3
}];
class QualityScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next) {
    super(game, null);
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.phase = 'detect';
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.rec = null;
    const g = game,
      gl = g.renderer.gl;
    this.hw = {
      gpu: PerfMon.gpuName(gl) || '未知显卡',
      cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0,
      mem: navigator.deviceMemory || 0,
      phone: TouchDevice.kind === 'phone' || TouchDevice.kind === 'tablet'
    };
    this.q = g.settings.preset && QUALITY_CARDS.some(c => c.id === g.settings.preset) ? g.settings.preset : detectPreset(gl);
    // (a level the cards don't have - an older setting - becomes the nearest one)
    this.sh = Math.max(0, Math.min(SHADER_CARDS.length - 1, Math.round(g.settings.shaders) || 0));
    applyPreset(g, this.q);
    g.applySettings();
    this.fxOk = !!(g.renderer.fx && g.renderer.fx.ok);
    this.startBench();
  }
  get hz() {
    const p = this.game.pacer;
    return p && p.refresh ? Math.round(1000 / p.refresh) : 60;
  }
  // the frame rate a game gets here (60 on a 90/120 Hz phone unless the player chose more: perf.js playLimit)
  get gameFps() {
    const p = this.game.pacer;
    return Math.min(this.hz, p && p.playLimit || 1000);
  }
  // the measurement: how long the device really works on a frame of the live world, for each shader level in
  // turn. Not the time between frames - with VSync that is only the display's rate, whatever the card could do;
  // reading a pixel back after the frame waits until the graphics card has finished it
  startBench() {
    const g = this.game,
      gl = g.renderer.gl,
      px = new Uint8Array(4),
      self = this;
    this.levels = this.fxOk && !this.hw.phone ? SHADER_CARDS.map(c => c.lv) : [0];
    this.li = 0;
    this.got = [];
    this.skip = 6;
    this.ms = {};
    this.lt0 = performance.now();
    this.benchFrom = 0;
    this.setLevel(this.levels[0]);
    const own = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g, 'render') ? g.render : null,
      orig = g.render;
    g.render = function (...a) {
      const t = performance.now(),
        r = orig.apply(this, a);
      if (self.phase === 'detect' && !document.hidden && self.loaded()) {
        gl.readPixels(0, 0, 1, 1, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
        self.sample(performance.now() - t);
      }
      return r;
    };
    this.unhook = () => {
      if (own) g.render = own;else delete g.render;
      this.unhook = null;
    };
  }
  // measured only once the title world is built: nothing generating or waiting to be meshed and as many sections for
  // 1 s (at most 10 s). It used to start at once - frames building the world and uploading its meshes measured
  // light on a fresh page, and phones were recommended 高 / 极致 they could not keep up with
  loaded() {
    if (this.benchFrom) return true;
    const g = this.game,
      now = performance.now(),
      n = g.renderer.sections ? g.renderer.sections.size : 0;
    const busy = g.titleGround || g.genQueue && g.genQueue.length || g.meshPending || g.genPending && g.genPending.size || g.finalQ && g.finalQ.length;
    if (busy || n !== this.secN) {
      this.secN = n;
      this.secT = now;
    }
    if (!busy && n && now - this.secT >= 1000 || now - this.t0 > 10000) {
      this.benchFrom = this.lt0 = now;
      this.skip = 6;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setLevel(lv) {
    const g = this.game;
    g.settings.shaders = lv;
    g.applySettings();
  }
  sample(ms) {
    // (the first frames after a change build the shaders; a stall says nothing about the device)
    if (this.skip > 0) {
      this.skip--;
      return;
    }
    if (ms < 250) this.got.push(ms);
    // (at least 48 frames over at least 2 s - 24 in 1.2 s was a moment, often a lucky one; a level slower than that
    // gets 5 s and goes by what it has)
    const now = performance.now();
    if ((this.got.length < 48 || now - this.lt0 < 2000) && now - this.lt0 < 5000) return;
    const v = this.got.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    if (v.length >= 5) this.ms[this.levels[this.li]] = v[Math.floor(v.length / 2)];
    if (++this.li < this.levels.length) {
      this.got = [];
      this.skip = 6;
      this.lt0 = now;
      this.setLevel(this.levels[this.li]);
    } else this.finish();
  }
  tick() {
    // (a page in the background draws nothing: it goes on with what it has - 12 s without the world built, or the
    // levels' time once measuring)
    if (this.phase !== 'detect') return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (this.benchFrom ? now - this.benchFrom > this.levels.length * 5500 + 1500 : now - this.t0 > 12000) this.finish();
  }
  finish() {
    if (this.phase !== 'detect') return;
    this.unhook && this.unhook();
    const s = this.game.settings,
      phone = this.hw.phone,
      measured = Object.keys(this.ms).length > 0;
    // phones and tablets: a margin - they slow down as they warm up, and a game's world (mobs, particles, the HUD, chunks
    // loading) costs more than the title's
    if (phone) for (const k in this.ms) this.ms[k] *= 1.4;
    // a level that could not be measured: from the measured ones by the cards' rough cost (nothing measured: a guess
    // from the hardware)
    const m0 = this.ms[0] || (this.q === 'low' ? 12 : this.q === 'medium' ? 8 : 5);
    for (const c of SHADER_CARDS) if (!this.ms[c.lv]) this.ms[c.lv] = m0 * c.cost;
    this.base = {
      ms: this.ms,
      rd: s.renderDist || 8,
      res: s.resScale || 1
    };
    // recommended: the best pair still at least ~55 fps (or the rate a game gets if lower), shaders only on capable
    // devices; never 极致 on a phone. Nothing measured: the hardware's guess stays
    const goal = Math.min(55, this.gameFps * 0.9);
    let best = {
      q: 'low',
      sh: 0
    };
    if (!measured) best = {
      q: phone && this.q === 'ultra' ? 'high' : this.q,
      sh: 0
    };else for (const qc of QUALITY_CARDS) for (const sc of SHADER_CARDS) {
      if (sc.lv && (!this.fxOk || phone) || phone && qc.id === 'ultra') continue;
      if (this.estimate(qc, sc) >= goal && qc.cost * sc.cost >= QUALITY_CARDS.find(x => x.id === best.q).cost * SHADER_CARDS[best.sh].cost) best = {
        q: qc.id,
        sh: sc.lv
      };
    }
    this.rec = best;
    this.q = best.q;
    this.sh = best.sh;
    this.apply();
    this.phase = 'pick';
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  // a pair's frame rate from the measured times: the world without shaders grows with the chunks in view (the
  // render distance squared) and the pixels; what the shaders add grows with the pixels and, for the shadows, the
  // chunks. In a game the world's own work comes on top (a margin and a millisecond); never above the display's rate
  estimate(qc, sc) {
    const b = this.base;
    if (!b) return 0;
    const p = PRESETS[qc.id] || {},
      rdR = ((p.renderDist || b.rd) / b.rd) ** 2,
      pxR = ((p.resScale || 1) / b.res) ** 2;
    const m0 = b.ms[0],
      extra = Math.max(0, (b.ms[sc.lv] || m0 * sc.cost) - m0);
    const ms = m0 * (0.6 * rdR + 0.4 * pxR) + extra * (0.5 * rdR + 0.5 * pxR);
    return Math.min(this.gameFps, Math.round(1000 / (ms * 1.15 + 1)));
  }
  apply() {
    const g = this.game,
      s = g.settings;
    applyPreset(g, this.q);
    s.shaders = this.fxOk ? this.sh : 0;
    g.applySettings();
    g.saveSettings();
  }
  cardRects() {
    // (both rows as wide as the longer one; each row centred)
    const u = this.game.ui,
      n = Math.max(QUALITY_CARDS.length, SHADER_CARDS.length),
      w = Math.min(90, Math.floor((u.w - 20) / n) - 4),
      h = 36;
    const x0 = k => Math.floor(u.w / 2 - (k * w + (k - 1) * 4) / 2);
    const y1 = u.h - 2 * h - 54,
      y2 = y1 + h + 14;
    return {
      q: QUALITY_CARDS.map((c, i) => ({
        ...c,
        x: x0(QUALITY_CARDS.length) + i * (w + 4),
        y: y1,
        w,
        h
      })),
      s: SHADER_CARDS.map((c, i) => ({
        ...c,
        x: x0(SHADER_CARDS.length) + i * (w + 4),
        y: y2,
        w,
        h
      }))
    };
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      R = this.cardRects();
    this.widgets = [];
    if (this.phase !== 'pick') return;
    for (const c of R.q) this.widgets.push({
      x: c.x,
      y: c.y,
      w: c.w,
      h: c.h,
      label: '',
      card: c,
      kind: 'q',
      onClick: () => {
        this.q = c.id;
        this.apply();
      }
    });
    for (const c of R.s) this.widgets.push({
      x: c.x,
      y: c.y,
      w: c.w,
      h: c.h,
      label: '',
      card: c,
      kind: 's',
      enabled: this.fxOk || c.lv === 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.sh = c.lv;
        this.apply();
      }
    });
    // (the frame rate: the frame-rate test right after this decides it - FpsTestScreen)
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 49,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '就这样',
      onClick: () => {
        const n = this.next;
        this.next = null;
        n && n();
      }
    });
  }
  draw(ui) {
    this.tick();
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      R = this.cardRects();
    // the top: what was found
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, 42);
    Font.center(c, '选择画质和光影（上面就是实时画面）', cx, 4, '#FFFFFF');
    const hw = this.hw,
      info = `${hw.gpu.replace(/^ANGLE \(|\)$/g, '').slice(0, 48)}${hw.cores ? ' · ' + hw.cores + ' 线程' : ''}${hw.mem ? ' · ' + hw.mem + ' GB 内存' : ''}`;
    if (this.phase === 'detect') {
      const lv = this.levels[this.li],
        what = this.levels.length > 1 && lv !== undefined ? `（光影「${SHADER_CARDS[lv].name}」）` : '';
      Font.center(c, fitText('正在测试你的设备' + what + '… ' + info, ui.w - 8), cx, 18, '#A0A0A0');
      const f = Math.min(1, (this.li + Math.min(1, this.got.length / 48)) / this.levels.length);
      c.fillStyle = '#555555';
      c.fillRect(cx - 80, 29, 160, 2);
      c.fillStyle = '#80FF80';
      c.fillRect(cx - 80, 29, Math.round(160 * f), 2);
    } else {
      Font.center(c, fitText('检测到：' + info, ui.w - 8), cx, 16, '#A0A0A0');
      Font.center(c, `推荐：${QUALITY_CARDS.find(q => q.id === this.rec.q).name}画质 + ${SHADER_CARDS[this.rec.sh].name}光影（已经帮你选好）`, cx, 28, '#80FF80');
    }
    // the bottom: the cards
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    c.fillRect(0, R.q[0].y - 14, ui.w, ui.h - R.q[0].y + 14);
    if (this.phase === 'pick') {
      Font.draw(c, '画质', R.q[0].x, R.q[0].y - 11, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, '光影', R.s[0].x, R.s[0].y - 11, '#FFFFFF');
      for (const w of this.widgets) {
        if (!w.card) continue;
        const k = w.card,
          sel = w.kind === 'q' ? this.q === k.id : this.sh === k.lv,
          rec = w.kind === 'q' ? this.rec.q === k.id : this.rec.sh === k.lv,
          off = w.enabled === false;
        c.fillStyle = sel ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        c.fillRect(k.x, k.y, k.w, k.h);
        c.strokeStyle = sel ? '#FFFFFF' : ui.hit(w) ? '#A0A0A0' : '#555555';
        c.lineWidth = sel ? 2 : 1;
        c.strokeRect(k.x + 0.5, k.y + 0.5, k.w - 1, k.h - 1);
        Font.draw(c, k.name, k.x + 4, k.y + 4, off ? '#707070' : '#FFFFFF');
        Font.draw(c, fitText(off ? '设备不支持' : k.sub, k.w - 8), k.x + 4, k.y + 15, '#A0A0A0');
        if (!off) {
          const e = w.kind === 'q' ? this.estimate(k, SHADER_CARDS[this.sh]) : this.estimate(QUALITY_CARDS.find(q => q.id === this.q), k);
          Font.draw(c, `预计 ${e} 帧`, k.x + 4, k.y + 26, e >= 55 ? '#80FF80' : e >= 30 ? '#FFFF55' : '#FF8080');
        }
        if (rec) {
          c.fillStyle = '#E8B830';
          c.fillRect(k.x + k.w - 26, k.y, 26, 10);
          Font.draw(c, '推荐', k.x + k.w - 25, k.y + 1, '#3A2A00');
        }
      }
      Font.center(c, fitText('之后可以在 选项 → 视频设置 里改；帧率太低时会自动降低分辨率', ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 40, '#808080');
    } else Font.center(c, '马上就好…', cx, R.q[0].y + 20, '#A0A0A0');
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (!w.card) ui.button(w);
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.tip && ui.hit(w)) ui.tooltip(w.tip.map(t => ({
      text: t
    })), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  onEsc() {}
}

// ---- the frame-rate test (the user, 11-06: every player once after this update, new players after the quality): the
// live title world at the display's own rate for 4 s, then the highest limit it keeps up with - 120 / 90 / 60 of what
// the screen has, 30 where it cannot hold ~40. The frames' own work counts too, with a margin (a game's world - mobs,
// particles, chunks loading - costs more than the title's, and a phone slows down as it warms up); a phone that cannot
// keep the limit in play still drops to 60 by itself (mobile.js). The player may pick another ----
const FPS_TEST_V = 1;
const FPS_SUB = {
  120: '最流畅，最耗电',
  90: '很流畅，较耗电',
  60: '流畅，省电',
  30: '最省电，低配设备'
};
class FpsTestScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next) {
    super(game, null);
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0.3;
    this.phase = 'wait';
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.from = 0;
    this.ts = [];
    this.cpu = [];
    this.skip = 10;
    const P = game.pacer;
    this.phone = !!(P && P.touch);
    if (P) P.free = this;
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('fpstest_start');
  }
  get hz() {
    const P = this.game.pacer;
    return P ? P.hz : 60;
  }
  // the choices: 120 / 90 / 60 / 30 of what the screen has; a PC's screen above 125 Hz gets its own rate too
  options() {
    const hz = this.hz,
      L = [120, 90, 60, 30].filter(r => r <= hz + 5);
    if (!this.phone && hz > 125) L.unshift(hz);
    return L;
  }
  // the setting for a choice: 60 is the default (0: 自动 60 on a 90/120 Hz phone, the screen's rate on a 60 Hz one),
  // a PC's own rate 0 (跟随屏幕), the others the number
  value(f) {
    const hz = this.hz;
    return f === 60 ? this.phone || hz <= 65 ? 0 : 60 : !this.phone && f >= hz - 5 && f > 125 ? 0 : f;
  }
  label(f) {
    return !this.phone && f > 125 ? `跟随屏幕 ${f}` : f + ' 帧';
  }
  // measured once the title world is built (as the quality test: nothing generating or meshing and as many sections
  // for 1 s, at most 10 s)
  loaded() {
    if (this.from) return true;
    const g = this.game,
      now = performance.now(),
      n = g.renderer.sections ? g.renderer.sections.size : 0;
    const busy = g.titleGround || g.genQueue && g.genQueue.length || g.meshPending || g.genPending && g.genPending.size || g.finalQ && g.finalQ.length;
    if (busy || n !== this.secN) {
      this.secN = n;
      this.secT = now;
    }
    if (!busy && n && now - this.secT >= 1000 || now - this.t0 > 10000) {
      this.from = now;
      this.phase = 'test';
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  // one frame (from draw): its start and the last frame's own work (PerfMon)
  sample() {
    // (no frames for a while - the page in the background, the phone's screen off: the time starts again, and frames
    // measured before the gap are dropped)
    const t = performance.now(),
      gap = this.lastDraw ? t - this.lastDraw : 0;
    this.lastDraw = t;
    if (gap > 1000 && this.phase !== 'pick') {
      this.t0 += gap;
      if (this.from) {
        this.from = t;
        this.ts = [];
        this.cpu = [];
        this.skip = 10;
      }
    }
    if (this.phase === 'pick' || document.hidden || !this.loaded()) return;
    if (this.skip > 0) {
      this.skip--;
      this.from = performance.now();
      return;
    }
    const now = performance.now(),
      N = PerfMon.N;
    this.ts.push(now);
    this.cpu.push(PerfMon.cpu[(PerfMon.i + N - 1) % N]);
    if (now - this.from >= 4000 && this.ts.length >= 20) this.finish();
  }
  tick() {
    // (a page in the background draws nothing: it goes by what it has after 20 s)
    if (this.phase !== 'pick' && performance.now() - this.t0 > 20000) this.finish();
  }
  finish() {
    if (this.phase === 'pick') return;
    const ts = this.ts,
      n = ts.length,
      hz = this.hz,
      L = this.options();
    let fps = 0,
      work = 0,
      sustain = 0;
    if (n >= 20) {
      fps = (n - 1) * 1000 / (ts[n - 1] - ts[0]);
      const c = [...this.cpu].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      work = c[Math.floor(c.length * 0.75)];
      // the rate the frames' own work allows in a game: a margin on the title's (phones more), a millisecond on top
      const byWork = 1000 / (work * (this.phone ? 1.6 : 1.25) + 1);
      sustain = Math.min(fps, byWork);
    }
    // the highest choice it keeps up with (8 % short still counts: a frame now and then); 60 down to ~40 still 60 -
    // dynamic resolution takes it the rest of the way; below that 30. Nothing measured: 60
    let rec = 60;
    if (n >= 20) {
      rec = 30;
      for (const f of L) if (f >= 60 && sustain >= f * 0.92) {
        rec = f;
        break;
      }
      if (rec === 30 && sustain >= 40) rec = 60;
    }
    this.res = {
      fps: Math.round(fps),
      work: Math.round(work * 10) / 10,
      sustain: Math.round(sustain),
      hz,
      measured: n >= 20
    };
    this.rec = rec;
    this.sel = rec;
    this.phase = 'pick';
    const P = this.game.pacer;
    if (P && P.free === this) P.free = null;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  cardRects() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      L = this.options(),
      w = Math.min(100, Math.floor((u.w - 20) / L.length) - 6),
      h = 40;
    const x0 = Math.floor(u.w / 2 - (L.length * w + (L.length - 1) * 6) / 2),
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 2) - 6;
    return L.map((f, i) => ({
      f,
      x: x0 + i * (w + 6),
      y,
      w,
      h
    }));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = [];
    if (this.phase !== 'pick') {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 50,
        y: u.h - 28,
        w: 100,
        h: 20,
        label: '跳过',
        onClick: () => this.skipTest()
      });
      return;
    }
    for (const k of this.cardRects()) this.widgets.push({
      x: k.x,
      y: k.y,
      w: k.w,
      h: k.h,
      label: '',
      card: k,
      onClick: () => {
        this.sel = k.f;
      }
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '确定',
      onClick: () => this.done()
    });
  }
  // skipped: the setting stays as it was (the test comes no more)
  skipTest() {
    const P = this.game.pacer;
    if (P && P.free === this) P.free = null;
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('fpstest_skip');
    this.game.settings.fpsTestV = FPS_TEST_V;
    this.game.saveSettings();
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    n && n();
  }
  done() {
    const g = this.game,
      s = g.settings;
    s.maxFps = this.value(this.sel);
    s.fpsTestV = FPS_TEST_V;
    s.fpsTest = {
      ...this.res,
      rec: this.rec,
      pick: this.sel,
      at: Date.now()
    };
    g.saveSettings();
    g.applySettings && g.applySettings();
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('fpstest_' + this.rec + (this.sel === this.rec ? '' : '_pick' + this.sel));
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    n && n();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    this.sample();
    this.tick();
    super.draw(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      cy = Math.floor(ui.h / 2);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, 44);
    Font.center(c, '帧率检测', cx, 6, '#FFFFFF');
    if (this.phase !== 'pick') {
      Font.center(c, fitText('正在测试你的设备能跑多少帧，找出最合适的帧率上限（约 5 秒）…', ui.w - 8), cx, 20, '#A0A0A0');
      const f = this.phase === 'test' ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - this.from) / 4000) : 0;
      c.fillStyle = '#555555';
      c.fillRect(cx - 80, 33, 160, 2);
      c.fillStyle = '#80FF80';
      c.fillRect(cx - 80, 33, Math.round(160 * f), 2);
      const ts = this.ts,
        k = ts.length,
        live = k > 10 ? Math.round(10 * 1000 / (ts[k - 1] - ts[k - 11])) : 0;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      c.fillRect(cx - 90, cy - 22, 180, 44);
      Font.center(c, this.phase === 'test' ? `当前 ${live || '…'} 帧` : '正在准备画面…', cx, cy - 12, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.center(c, `屏幕刷新率 ${this.hz} Hz`, cx, cy + 4, '#A0A0A0');
    } else {
      const r = this.res;
      Font.center(c, fitText(r.measured ? `屏幕刷新率 ${r.hz} Hz，测试中每秒 ${r.fps} 帧，游戏里预计能稳定 ${r.sustain} 帧` : `屏幕刷新率 ${r.hz} Hz（没有测出来，先用 60 帧）`, ui.w - 8), cx, 19, '#A0A0A0');
      Font.center(c, `推荐帧率上限：${this.label(this.rec)}（已经帮你选好）`, cx, 31, '#80FF80');
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      c.fillRect(0, cy - 26, ui.w, 72);
      Font.center(c, '帧率上限', cx, cy - 20, '#FFFFFF');
      for (const w of this.widgets) {
        const k = w.card;
        if (!k) continue;
        const sel = this.sel === k.f;
        c.fillStyle = sel ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        c.fillRect(k.x, k.y, k.w, k.h);
        c.strokeStyle = sel ? '#FFFFFF' : ui.hit(w) ? '#A0A0A0' : '#555555';
        c.lineWidth = sel ? 2 : 1;
        c.strokeRect(k.x + 0.5, k.y + 0.5, k.w - 1, k.h - 1);
        c.lineWidth = 1;
        Font.draw(c, this.label(k.f), k.x + 4, k.y + 5, '#FFFFFF');
        Font.draw(c, fitText(FPS_SUB[k.f] || '跟屏幕一样快，最耗电', k.w - 8), k.x + 4, k.y + 17, '#A0A0A0');
        if (r.measured && k.f > this.rec) Font.draw(c, fitText('可能跟不上', k.w - 8), k.x + 4, k.y + 28, '#FFAA55');
        if (this.rec === k.f) {
          c.fillStyle = '#E8B830';
          c.fillRect(k.x + k.w - 26, k.y, 26, 10);
          Font.draw(c, '推荐', k.x + k.w - 25, k.y + 1, '#3A2A00');
        }
      }
      Font.center(c, fitText(this.phone ? '之后可以在 选项 → 控制 → 触屏操作 里改；手机发热跟不上时会自动降到 60 帧' : '之后可以在 选项 → 视频设置 → 最大帧率 里改', ui.w - 8), cx, ui.h - 44, '#808080');
    }
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (!w.card) ui.button(w);
  }
  onEsc() {
    if (this.phase === 'pick') this.done();
  }
}

// ---- step 2b (after the quality): which device - the detected one chosen already, the player may pick the other.
// A phone goes on to the button layout editor; the setup goes on once the layout is saved (the user, 2026-11-01) ----
class DeviceScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next) {
    super(game, '你用什么设备玩？');
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.titleY = 14;
    this.detected = TouchDevice.defaultOn ? 'phone' : 'pc';
    this.pick = this.detected;
  }
  cards() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      w = Math.min(150, Math.floor((u.w - 30) / 2)),
      h = Math.min(100, u.h - 110),
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 2 - h / 2) - 4;
    return [{
      id: 'pc',
      title: '用电脑玩',
      sub: '键盘 + 鼠标',
      icon: 'comparator'
    }, {
      id: 'phone',
      title: '用手机玩',
      sub: '触屏操作（平板也选这个）',
      icon: 'compass'
    }].map((k, i) => ({
      ...k,
      x: Math.floor(u.w / 2 - (2 * w + 8) / 2) + i * (w + 8),
      y,
      w,
      h
    }));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = this.cards().map(k => ({
      x: k.x,
      y: k.y,
      w: k.w,
      h: k.h,
      label: '',
      card: k,
      onClick: () => {
        this.pick = k.id;
      }
    }));
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 34,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: () => this.pick === 'phone' ? '继续：设置触控按钮' : '继续',
      onClick: () => this.go()
    });
  }
  go() {
    const g = this.game,
      s = g.settings,
      phone = this.pick === 'phone';
    // phone: the buttons on (the option). PC: no buttons to start with, but not switched off - a finger on the screen
    // still brings them (a phone chosen as PC by mistake, feedback 2026-11-01), the mouse takes them away again
    if (phone) s.touch = true;else delete s.touch;
    s.touchPick = this.pick;
    g.touchAuto = undefined;
    g.saveSettings();
    g.applySettings && g.applySettings();
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('device_' + this.pick + (this.pick === this.detected ? '' : '_changed'));
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    if (phone) g.ui.open(new TouchLayoutScreen(g, this, () => n && n()));else n && n();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    super.draw(ui);
    const c = ui.ctx;
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      const k = w.card;
      if (!k) {
        ui.button(w);
        continue;
      }
      drawCard(c, k.x, k.y, k.w, k.h, ui.hit(w) || this.pick === k.id);
      if (this.pick === k.id) {
        c.strokeStyle = '#FFD24A';
        c.lineWidth = 2;
        c.strokeRect(k.x + 1, k.y + 1, k.w - 2, k.h - 2);
        c.lineWidth = 1;
      }
      ui.drawItem && ui.drawItem(makeStack(k.icon, 1), Math.floor(k.x + k.w / 2 - 8), k.y + 12);
      Font.center(c, k.title, k.x + k.w / 2, k.y + 40, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.center(c, fitText(k.sub, k.w - 8), k.x + k.w / 2, k.y + 54, '#A0A0A0');
      if (this.detected === k.id) Font.center(c, '检测到的设备', k.x + k.w / 2, k.y + k.h - 14, '#E8B830');
    }
    Font.center(c, fitText(this.pick === 'pc' ? '选错了也没关系：用手指点屏幕会自动出现触控按钮' : '之后可以在 选项 → 控制 → 触屏操作 里改', ui.w - 8), ui.w / 2, ui.h - 46, '#808080');
  }
  onEsc() {}
}

// ---- the whole first run, and the agreement again when it changes ----
const Onboarding = {
  start(g) {
    const s = g.settings;
    const login = () => {
      const after = () => this.afterLogin(g);
      if (Account.loggedIn || !RoomService.base()) return after();
      g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, after));
    };
    const device = () => g.ui.open(new DeviceScreen(g, login));
    const fps = () => g.ui.open(new FpsTestScreen(g, device));
    const quality = () => g.ui.open(new QualityScreen(g, fps));
    const kind = () => g.ui.open(new PlayerKindScreen(g, quality));
    if (s.onboarded) {
      if ((s.legalV || 0) < LEGAL.v) g.ui.open(new AgreementScreen(g, () => g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g))));
      return;
    }
    g.ui.open(new AgreementScreen(g, kind));
  },
  afterLogin(g) {
    const s = g.settings;
    s.onboarded = true;
    s.seenBuild = GAME_BUILD;
    g.saveSettings();
    if (Account.loggedIn) Account.update({
      onboard: {
        kind: s.playerKind
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    if (s.playerKind === 'new' || s.playerKind === 'mc') g.ui.open(new DifferencesScreen(g, () => g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g))));else g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g));
  }
};
// on the title: the first run, or what changed since the last visit (players of this version)
(() => {
  const st = Game.prototype.startTitle;
  Game.prototype.startTitle = function (...a) {
    const r = st.apply(this, a);
    const s = this.settings;
    if (!this.onboardChecked) {
      this.onboardChecked = true;
      // (an invite link goes straight to the room; the agreement still comes first)
      if (!s.onboarded || (s.legalV || 0) < LEGAL.v) setTimeout(() => Onboarding.start(this), 50);else {
        // the frame-rate test once (players from before it: FpsTestScreen), then what changed. Not when an invite link
        // opens the join screen (net.js): the next start
        const title = () => this.ui.open(new TitleScreen(this)),
          news = s.seenBuild !== GAME_BUILD && WHATS_NEW[GAME_BUILD];
        const after = news ? () => this.ui.open(new WhatsNewScreen(this, title)) : title;
        if ((s.fpsTestV || 0) < FPS_TEST_V && !(typeof RoomService !== 'undefined' && RoomService.fromUrl())) setTimeout(() => {
          if (this.state === 'title') this.ui.open(new FpsTestScreen(this, after));
        }, 50);else if (news) setTimeout(after, 50);
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

const DIFF_PAGES = [['网页里的操作', '电脑：和原版一样（WASD、鼠标、E 背包、T 聊天）；点一下画面锁定鼠标，Esc 释放', '手机：左下摇杆走路，右边滑动转视角；屏幕中间是准星，右下的攻击按钮挖掘 / 攻击、使用按钮放置 / 使用'], ['和朋友联机', '多人游戏 → 创建房间，把邀请码或邀请卡片发给朋友；也可以进公开房间', '房主能踢人、禁言、设成员；也可以用自己的单人存档开房间'], ['存档和账号', '登录后存档会同步到云端，换设备接着玩；7 天没玩的云端存档会自动删除（设备上的不动）', '识别码能在任何设备上登录你的账号，请保密'], ['皮肤、披风、帮助', '标题界面「皮肤和装饰」：预设皮肤、正版玩家皮肤、原创披风，签到活动的帽子、宠物和前缀', '按 F1 或 暂停 → 游戏说明 查看操作；物品图鉴（背包里的书本按钮）查合成方法']];
class DifferencesScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, next) {
    super(game, '这个版本有什么不一样');
    this.next = next;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.page = 0;
    this.titleY = 16;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      last = this.page >= DIFF_PAGES.length - 1;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 152,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '跳过',
      onClick: () => this.done()
    }, {
      x: cx - 50,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '上一页',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 52,
      y: u.h - 30,
      w: 100,
      h: 20,
      gold: last,
      label: last ? '开始玩' : '下一页',
      onClick: () => {
        if (last) this.done();else {
          this.page++;
          this.layout();
        }
      }
    }];
  }
  done() {
    const n = this.next;
    this.next = null;
    n && n();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      [t, ...lines] = DIFF_PAGES[this.page],
      w = Math.min(320, ui.w - 20),
      x = Math.floor(cx - w / 2),
      y = 36;
    drawCard(c, x, y, w, ui.h - y - 44, false);
    Font.center(c, `${this.page + 1} / ${DIFF_PAGES.length}　${t}`, cx, y + 8, '#FFD24A');
    let yy = y + 26;
    for (const l of lines) {
      let s = l;
      while (s.length) {
        let n = s.length;
        while (n > 1 && Font.width(s.slice(0, n)) > w - 16) n--;
        Font.draw(c, s.slice(0, n), x + 8, yy, '#E0E0E0');
        s = s.slice(n);
        yy += 11;
      }
      yy += 6;
    }
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.done();
  }
}

// ---- situational tips (first-time players; any player can turn them on) ----
const Tips = {
  shown: new Set(),
  tick(g) {
    if (!g.settings.tips || g.net || g.tickCount % 20) return;
    const p = g.player,
      t = (g.worldTime % 24000 + 24000) % 24000,
      seen = g.settings.tipsSeen || (g.settings.tipsSeen = {});
    const tip = (id, text) => {
      if (seen[id] || this.shown.has(id)) return;
      this.shown.add(id);
      seen[id] = 1;
      g.saveSettings();
      g.ui.pinMessage(text, 7000, '#FFFF80');
    };
    if (g.mode === 'survival') {
      if (t > 11000 && t < 13000) tip('dusk', '天快黑了：怪物晚上会出现，找个地方躲起来或者造个房子');
      if (p.food <= 6) tip('hungry', '饿了：吃点东西（选中食物，按住右键 / 按住屏幕）。饥饿值太低不能疾跑、不能回血');
      if (p.health <= 6) tip('lowhp', '血量很低：先躲开怪物，吃饱了会慢慢回血');
      if (obHas(g, /^cobblestone$/)) tip('stone', '有了圆石：可以在工作台上做石镐、石剑，比木头的更好用');
      if (obHas(g, /^raw_iron$/)) tip('iron', '挖到了铁：用熔炉把粗铁烧成铁锭，可以做铁工具和盔甲');
    }
  }
};
(() => {
  // the first death
  const dd = Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath;
  Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath = function (src) {
    const r = dd.call(this, src);
    if (this.settings.tips && !(this.settings.tipsSeen || {}).death) {
      (this.settings.tipsSeen || (this.settings.tipsSeen = {})).death = 1;
      this.saveSettings();
      setTimeout(() => this.ui.pinMessage('死亡后东西会掉在原地：重生后屏幕上的标记会带你回去捡（5 分钟内）', 9000, '#FFFF80'), 1500);
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The AI companion (the user, 2026-11-01: a friendly companion like the Verity mod's, on DeepSeek). Everyone talks on
