const COMPANION_OFF = false;
const Companion = {
  status: null,
  history: [],
  busy: false,
  sinceRemember: 0,
  lastEvent: 0,
  events: 0,
  watch: null,
  get name() {
    return this.status && this.status.name || '伙伴';
  },
  // (the service's shared key - status.shared, with status.freeLeft lines left today; status.key: one's own, off now)
  get ready() {
    return !COMPANION_OFF && !!(this.status && this.status.on && this.unlocked && (this.status.key || this.status.shared));
  },
  // the service's unlock (following) and the 三连 the game asks for too (Account.has('jing'))
  get unlocked() {
    return !!(this.status && this.status.unlocked) && Account.has('jing');
  },
  // (whether it shows at all: the service says - not released to everyone yet)
  get shown() {
    return !COMPANION_OFF && !!(this.status && this.status.on);
  },
  async load() {
    if (COMPANION_OFF || !Account.loggedIn) {
      this.status = null;
      return null;
    }
    try {
      this.status = await Account.api('/api/ai/status', {});
    } catch (e) {}
    return this.status;
  },
  // ---- what is going on (plain words for the model) ----
  context(g) {
    const p = g.player,
      o = {};
    if (g.state !== 'play' || !p || !g.world) return {
      场景: '在游戏主菜单'
    };
    const x = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(p.pos[1] + (g.world.minY || 0)),
      z = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
    o['游戏'] = g.net && g.net.room ? `联机房间（${g.net.players && g.net.players.size || '几'} 人）` : '单人游戏';
    o['模式'] = typeof MODE_NAMES !== 'undefined' && MODE_NAMES[g.mode] || g.mode;
    o['维度'] = typeof DIM_CN !== 'undefined' && DIM_CN[g.dim] || g.dim || '主世界';
    o['坐标'] = `${x}, ${y}, ${z}`;
    try {
      o['生物群系'] = biomeName(g, x, z);
    } catch (e) {}
    const t = g.dayTime(),
      hh = Math.floor((t / 1000 + 6) % 24);
    o['时间'] = `第 ${Math.floor(g.worldTime / 24000) + 1} 天 ${String(hh).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor(t % 1000 * 0.06)).padStart(2, '0')}${t > 12500 && t < 23500 ? '（夜晚）' : ''}`;
    if (g.dim === 'overworld' || !g.dim) o['天气'] = g.weather > 0.5 ? '下雨' : '晴';
    if (g.mode === 'survival') {
      o['生命值'] = `${Math.ceil(p.health)}/${p.maxHealth}`;
      o['饥饿值'] = `${p.food}/20`;
    }
    const nm = s => s && ITEMS[s.id] ? ITEMS[s.id].cn : '';
    const held = p.inv && p.inv.held;
    o['手上'] = held ? `${nm(held)}${held.count > 1 ? ' ×' + held.count : ''}` : '空手';
    if (p.inv) {
      const cnt = new Map();
      for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
        const s = p.inv.slots[i];
        if (s) cnt.set(nm(s), (cnt.get(nm(s)) || 0) + s.count);
      }
      o['背包'] = [...cnt].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 24).map(([n, c]) => `${n}×${c}`);
      const arm = [36, 37, 38, 39].map(i => nm(p.inv.slots[i])).filter(Boolean);
      if (arm.length) o['盔甲'] = arm;
    }
    const near = new Map();
    for (const e of g.entities || []) {
      if (!e.T || !e.T.cn || e.dead || !e.pos) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - p.pos[0], e.pos[1] - p.pos[1], e.pos[2] - p.pos[2]) > 24) continue;
      near.set(e.T.cn, (near.get(e.T.cn) || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (near.size) o['附近的生物'] = [...near].slice(0, 12).map(([n, c]) => c > 1 ? `${n}×${c}` : n);
    if (g.adv) o['已完成进度'] = Object.keys(g.adv).length + ' 个';
    // the settings it can change for the player (ai.js SETTINGS), as they are now
    const st = g.settings,
      pc = v => Math.round(v * 100) + '%',
      oo = v => v ? '开' : '关';
    o['当前设置'] = `光影 ${FX_NAMES[st.shaders || 0]}，画质预设 ${PRESET_NAMES[st.preset] || '自定义'}，图形品质 ${st.graphics === 'fast' ? '流畅' : '高品质'}，渲染距离 ${st.renderDist}，亮度 ${pc(st.gamma)}，视场角 ${Math.round(st.fov)}，主音量 ${pc(st.volume)}，鼠标灵敏度 ${Math.round(st.sens * 200)}%，渲染分辨率 ${pc(st.resScale)}，最大帧率 ${st.maxFps || '无限制'}，字幕 ${oo(st.subtitles)}，视角摇晃 ${oo(st.bobbing)}，云 ${oo(st.clouds)}，自动跳跃 ${oo(st.autoJump)}，动态分辨率 ${oo(st.dynRes)}`;
    o['设备'] = typeof touchOn === 'function' && touchOn(g) ? '手机 / 平板（触屏）' : '电脑';
    const said = (g.ui.chat || []).filter(m => !m.ai && m.text).slice(-4).map(m => m.text);
    if (said.length) o['聊天栏最近几行'] = said;
    return o;
  },
  // ---- talking ----
  show(g, who, text, color) {
    // (one message a line, each up to the chat box's width, indented under the name)
    const lines = [],
      max = 312;
    let cur = who;
    for (const ch of String(text)) {
      if (Font.width(cur + ch) > max) {
        lines.push(cur);
        cur = '  ';
      }
      cur += ch;
    }
    lines.push(cur);
    for (const l of lines) {
      g.ui.message(l, color);
      g.ui.chat[g.ui.chat.length - 1].ai = true;
    }
  },
  // quick mode (the user, 2026-11-01): what the player writes in the chat is said to it too - every line alone in a
  // world, in a room only a line with its name in it (the friends' talk would use up the player's lines of the day)
  // on at all (the user, 11-13: off for everyone by default - not shown, no hello, no lines of its own, the chat not
  // answered - until the player turns it on in its screen; settings.jingOn, a new setting so everyone starts off. V
  // and 和鲸鲸聊天 still talk to it: that is asking it on purpose)
  // (never switched by the player: what the admin panel says - js/live.js jing.default, off unless set)
  on(g) {
    if (!g || !g.settings) return false;
    const v = g.settings.jingOn;
    return v === true || v === undefined && typeof Live !== 'undefined' && Live.get('jing.default', false) === true;
  },
  quick(g, text) {
    if (!this.ready || g.settings.aiQuick === false || !this.on(g)) return false;
    return text === undefined || !(g.net && g.net.room) || String(text).includes(this.name);
  },
  // quiet: a reaction of its own (to a command) - a refusal (too fast, no money) isn't shown
  async say(g, text, echo = true, quiet = false) {
    if (this.busy) return;
    if (!this.status) await this.load();
    if (!this.ready) {
      g.ui.open(new CompanionScreen(g, null));
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    Jing.call(1500);
    if (echo) this.show(g, '[对' + this.name + '说] ', text, '#AAAAAA');
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/ai/chat', {
        said: text,
        history: this.history.slice(-10),
        ctx: this.context(g)
      });
      this.history.push({
        r: 'u',
        t: text
      }, {
        r: 'a',
        t: r.reply
      });
      this.history = this.history.slice(-24);
      this.show(g, '<' + this.name + '> ', r.reply, '#7FE3FF');
      Jing.pulse = performance.now();
      Jing.call(Math.min(20000, Math.max(6000, 4000 + r.reply.length * 120)));
      if (r.actions && r.actions.length) this.applyActions(g, r.actions);
      if (r.freeLeft !== undefined && this.status) this.status.freeLeft = r.freeLeft;
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('ai_chat');
      if (++this.sinceRemember >= 8) this.remember();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!quiet) this.show(g, '<' + this.name + '> ', e.message, '#FF8080');
    } finally {
      this.busy = false;
    }
  },
  // settings it changes for the player once they said yes (ai.js takeActions): only these, in their ranges
  applyActions(g, acts) {
    const s = g.settings,
      done = [],
      cmds = [];
    const fb = acts.find(a => a && a.k === 'feedback' && a.v && typeof a.v.text === 'string');
    if (fb) this.feedback(g, fb.v);
    const ok = {
      shaders: v => [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].includes(v),
      preset: v => ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'ultra'].includes(v),
      graphics: v => v === 'fast' || v === 'fancy',
      renderDist: v => v >= 2 && v <= 16,
      gamma: v => v >= 0 && v <= 1,
      fov: v => v >= 30 && v <= 110,
      volume: v => v >= 0 && v <= 1,
      sens: v => v > 0 && v <= 1,
      resScale: v => [0.5, 0.75, 1].includes(v),
      maxFps: v => v === 0 || v >= 10 && v <= 250,
      subtitles: v => typeof v === 'boolean',
      bobbing: v => typeof v === 'boolean',
      clouds: v => typeof v === 'boolean',
      autoJump: v => typeof v === 'boolean',
      dynRes: v => typeof v === 'boolean'
    };
    for (const a of acts) {
      if (a && a.k === 'cmd' && typeof a.v === 'string' && /^\/[^\n]{1,200}$/.test(a.v)) {
        cmds.push(a.v);
        continue;
      }
      if (!a || !ok[a.k] || !ok[a.k](a.v)) continue;
      if (a.k === 'shaders' && !(g.renderer.fx && g.renderer.fx.ok)) {
        this.show(g, '<' + this.name + '> ', '诶，你的设备好像不支持光影…', '#FF8080');
        continue;
      }
      if (a.k === 'preset') applyPreset(g, a.v);else {
        if (['graphics', 'renderDist', 'resScale', 'clouds', 'dynRes'].includes(a.k)) s.preset = 'custom';
        s[a.k] = a.v;
        if (a.k === 'graphics') g.graphicsChanged();
      }
      done.push(a.name + '：' + a.label);
    }
    // a command typed for the player (they said yes): run as if typed, without a reaction to it
    for (const cmd of cmds) {
      g.ui.message('[' + this.name + '帮你输入了] ' + cmd, '#FFFF55');
      g.ui.chat[g.ui.chat.length - 1].ai = true;
      (this.runRaw || runCommand)(g, cmd);
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('ai_cmd');
    }
    if (!done.length) return;
    g.applySettings();
    g.saveSettings();
    g.ui.message('[' + this.name + '帮你调整了] ' + done.join('，'), '#FFFF55');
    g.ui.chat[g.ui.chat.length - 1].ai = true;
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('ai_adjust');
  },
  // a problem told to it, sent as the player's feedback (with the picture now and the game's state, like 反馈问题)
  async feedback(g, f) {
    const kind = ['bug', 'lag', 'idea', 'other'].includes(f.kind) ? f.kind : 'other',
      text = String(f.text).slice(0, 800);
    const err = await postFeedback(g, kind, '[' + this.name + '整理] ' + text, typeof feedbackShot === 'function' ? feedbackShot(g) : null);
    g.ui.message(err ? '[' + this.name + '没能帮你反馈] ' + err : '[' + this.name + '帮你反馈了] 作者会看到的，谢谢你！', err ? '#FF5555' : '#55FF55');
    g.ui.chat[g.ui.chat.length - 1].ai = true;
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count(err ? 'ai_feedback_fail' : 'ai_feedback');
  },
  // something just happened: a line of its own, now and then (the player's lines: at most every 2 minutes, 10 a visit)
  async event(g, what) {
    const s = g.settings;
    if (!this.ready || this.busy || s.aiTalk === false || !this.on(g) || g.state !== 'play' || !(typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('jing.chatty'))) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - this.lastEvent < 120e3 || this.events >= 10) return;
    this.lastEvent = now;
    this.events++;
    this.busy = true;
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/ai/chat', {
        event: what,
        history: this.history.slice(-6),
        ctx: this.context(g)
      });
      this.history.push({
        r: 'a',
        t: r.reply
      });
      this.history = this.history.slice(-24);
      this.show(g, '<' + this.name + '> ', r.reply, '#7FE3FF');
      Jing.pulse = performance.now();
      Jing.call(Math.min(20000, Math.max(6000, 4000 + r.reply.length * 120)));
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('ai_event');
    } catch (e) {} finally {
      this.busy = false;
    }
  },
  async remember() {
    this.sinceRemember = 0;
    try {
      this.status = await Account.api('/api/ai/remember', {
        history: this.history.slice(-20)
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  // ---- the first time it is unlocked (each account, on this device): called in front of the player in the world, with
  // a hello of its own - not the model's, no line of the day used (the user, 2026-11-07: "通过后首次进入界面就会召唤鲸鲸")
  hiDone: null,
  hiWait: 0,
  greeted() {
    const id = Account.data && Account.data.id;
    if (!id) return true;
    if (!this.hiDone) {
      try {
        this.hiDone = new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-jing-hi') || '[]'));
      } catch (e) {
        this.hiDone = new Set();
      }
    }
    return this.hiDone.has(id);
  },
  greet(g) {
    const id = Account.data && Account.data.id;
    if (!id) return;
    this.greeted();
    this.hiDone.add(id);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mcjs-jing-hi', JSON.stringify([...this.hiDone].slice(-20)));
    } catch (e) {}
    const how = typeof touchOn === 'function' && touchOn(g) ? g.net && g.net.room ? `在聊天里叫一声「${this.name}」我就会回你` : '点开聊天直接跟我说话就行' : '按 V 就能和我聊天';
    this.show(g, '<' + this.name + '> ', `你好呀～我是${this.name}！以后我就陪着你啦 (≧▽≦) ${how}，游戏里有什么不会的都可以问我哦～`, '#7FE3FF');
    Jing.pulse = performance.now();
    Jing.call(10000);
    Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.experience_orb.pickup', null, 0.35, 1.3);
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('jing_hi');
  },
  // the game watched once a second: advancements, death, another dimension
  start(g) {
    if (this.watch) return;
    let adv = null,
      dim = null,
      dead = false,
      world = null;
    this.watch = setInterval(() => {
      // (the hello: two seconds into the world with nothing open, once it is unlocked)
      if (g.state === 'play' && g.player && !g.player.dead && !g.ui.screen && this.ready && this.on(g) && (typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('jing.greet')) && !this.greeted()) {
        if (++this.hiWait >= 2) {
          this.hiWait = 0;
          this.greet(g);
        }
      } else this.hiWait = 0;
      if (g.state !== 'play' || !g.player) {
        adv = null;
        dim = null;
        world = null;
        return;
      }
      if (world !== g.world) {
        world = g.world;
        adv = new Set(Object.keys(g.adv || {}));
        dim = g.dim;
        dead = false;
        return;
      }
      const now = new Set(Object.keys(g.adv || {}));
      for (const k of now) if (!adv.has(k) && typeof ADVANCEMENTS !== 'undefined' && ADVANCEMENTS[k]) {
        this.event(g, `玩家取得了进度「${ADVANCEMENTS[k][0]}」`);
        break;
      }
      adv = now;
      if (g.dim !== dim) {
        if (dim) this.event(g, `玩家进入了${typeof DIM_CN !== 'undefined' && DIM_CN[g.dim] || g.dim}`);
        dim = g.dim;
      }
      const d = !!g.player.dead;
      if (d && !dead) this.event(g, String(g.deathMsg || '玩家死了').replace(/^玩家/, '玩家刚刚'));
      dead = d;
    }, 1000);
  }
};

// a text in lines at most w wide
function wrapText(text, w) {
  const out = [];
  let line = '';
  for (const ch of String(text)) {
    if (Font.width(line + ch) > w) {
      out.push(line);
      line = '';
    }
    line += ch;
  }
  if (line) out.push(line);
  return out;
}

// ---- talking to it: a line at the bottom like the chat's (the chat box shows the talk) ----
class CompanionChatScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, null);
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.isChat = true;
    game.ui.chatOff = 0;
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    ui.chatOff = clamp((ui.chatOff || 0) - Math.sign(dy) * 7, 0, Math.max(0, ui.chatRowCount() - 20));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      lw = Font.width('对' + Companion.name + '说：') + 6;
    u.showInput(2 + lw, u.h - 14, u.w - 4 - lw, 12, '', v => {
      u.close();
      v = v.trim();
      if (v) Companion.say(this.game, v);
    }, {
      onEsc: () => u.close(),
      max: 200
    });
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      t = '对' + Companion.name + '说：';
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    c.fillRect(2, ui.h - 14, ui.w - 4, 12);
    Font.draw(c, t, 4, ui.h - 12, '#7FE3FF');
    if (Companion.busy) Font.draw(c, Companion.name + '正在想…', 4, ui.h - 26, '#AAAAAA');
  }
}

  async unlock(kind) {
    try {
      if (!(await Toy.ready())) {
        this.say('请在 B站 App 或电脑网页的游戏页面里操作', true);
        return;
      }
      if (kind === 'triple') {
        const v = Account.pickVideo();
        if (v) await Toy.openVideo(v);
      } else await Toy.openAuthor();
      this.say(Toy.backHint(kind));
      this.waiting = true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e instanceof ToyError ? Toy.explain(e) : e.message, true);
    }
  }
  // back from the video / the UP's page (or 我完成了，检查): checked again
  async recheck() {
    this.waiting = false;
    if (!(await Toy.ready())) {
      this.say('请在 B站 App 或电脑网页的游戏页面里检查', true);
      return;
    }
    this.layout();
    let r = null;
    try {
      r = await Account.checkUnlocks();
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    await Companion.load();
    if (Companion.unlocked) this.say('已解锁' + Companion.name + '！' + (this.game.state === 'play' ? '回到游戏，它马上就来' : '进入世界后它就会来找你'));else if (r && !r.inToy) this.say('请在 B站 App 或电脑网页的游戏页面里检查', true);else if (r && r.inToy && r.error && r.follow === null && r.triple === null) this.say('没查到（' + Toy.explain(r.error) + '），过一会儿再点检查', true);else if (r && r.inToy && !r.own) this.say('这里没登录你自己的 B站：用你的 B站 关注、三连后，在那台设备打开一次游戏就会同步', true);else if (r && r.triple === null && !Account.tripleOk()) this.say('没查到三连状态（' + (r.error ? Toy.explain(r.error) : 'B站没有返回能看懂的数据') + '），过一会儿再点检查', true);else {
      const t = Account.tripleParts,
        miss = [];
      if (!Account.unlocks.follow) miss.push('关注');
      if (!Account.tripleOk()) {
        if (t && !t.all) {
          if (!t.like) miss.push('点赞');
          if (!t.coin) miss.push('投币');
          if (!t.fav) miss.push('收藏');
        } else miss.push('三连');
      }
      this.say(miss.length ? '还差：' + miss.join('、') + '（刚操作完可能要等几秒）' : '还没有检测到，完成后再回来看看', true);
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  // (opened in the game with V: back to the game)
  back() {
    const g = this.game;
    g.ui.hideInput();
    if (this.parent) g.ui.open(this.parent);else if (g.state === 'play') g.ui.close();else g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g));
  }
  async forget() {
    try {
      Companion.status = await Account.api('/api/ai/forget', {});
      this.say(Companion.name + '已经忘掉了');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      st = Companion.status;
    if (this.waiting && document.visibilityState === 'visible' && this.leftAt && Date.now() - this.leftAt > 1500) {
      this.leftAt = 0;
      this.recheck();
    }
    if (this.waiting && document.visibilityState !== 'visible') this.leftAt = Date.now();
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      Font.center(c, '登录后才能使用 AI 伙伴', cx, 50, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    if (!st) {
      Font.center(c, '正在读取…', cx, 50, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    if (!Companion.unlocked) {
      Font.center(c, fitText(`关注 UP 主 + 给新视频三连，就能解锁${Companion.name}`, ui.w - 8), cx, 46, '#FFD24A');
      Font.center(c, fitText('三连 = 点赞 + 投币 + 收藏；之前给老视频三连过的也要再三连', ui.w - 8), cx, 60, '#A0A0A0');
      if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 8), cx, 130, this.noteColor);
      return;
    }
    Font.center(c, fitText(`${Companion.name}：会聊天、懂你在游戏里做什么的 AI 小伙伴`, ui.w - 8), cx, 34, '#7FE3FF');
    if (st.shared || st.key) {
      var _st$freeLeft;
      if (st.shared) Font.center(c, fitText(`全服免费：今天还能聊 ${(_st$freeLeft = st.freeLeft) !== null && _st$freeLeft !== void 0 ? _st$freeLeft : '?'} 句（每天 ${st.perDay || 30} 句，明天重新算）`, ui.w - 8), cx, 50, '#55FF55');
      Font.center(c, fitText('只聊游戏和日常；总让' + Companion.name + '写代码、翻译、做作业会被暂停一天', ui.w - 8), cx, 64, '#A0A0A0');
    } else Font.center(c, fitText(Companion.name + '暂时在休息，稍后再来找它吧', ui.w - 8), cx, 50, '#FF8080');
    this.drawFields(ui);
  }
}

// the watch starts with the game; the status is read again after logging in (Account.took)
(() => {
  const st = Game.prototype.startTitle;
  Game.prototype.startTitle = function (...a) {
    const r = st.apply(this, a);
    Companion.start(this);
    if (!Companion.status) Companion.load();
    return r;
  };
  const took = Account.took;
  Account.took = function (j) {
    const r = took.call(this, j);
    if (j && j.token) Companion.load();
    return r;
  };
  // (unlocked on the 解锁 screen: the service's half - following - read again, so it comes at once)
  const cu = Account.checkUnlocks;
  Account.checkUnlocks = async function (...a) {
    const r = await cu.apply(this, a);
    if (r && r.got && r.got.length) await Companion.load();
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- 鲸鲸 in the world (the user, 2026-11-01: a real sphere with the character's face, not a flat picture) ----
// A UV sphere of 32 x 16 quads: the front half shows JING_TEX's front picture, the back half its back picture, each
// projected straight on (a point's x, y on the ball is where it is in the picture; the meridians at 90 and 270
// degrees are grid lines, so no quad straddles the two). The fins, the tail, the ahoge and the headdress's frill
// stand out of the ball: flat pictures from the same atlas. Drawn with the entity shader, lit by the world.
const Jing = {
  R: 0.2,
  mesh: null,
  tail: null,
  pos: null,
  yaw: 0,
  last: 0,
  pulse: -1e9,
  TAIL_AT: [0, -0.55, -0.78],
  // where the tail's stem meets the ball (it swings about this)
  visible(g) {
    return Companion.ready && Companion.on(g) && g.state === 'play' && !!g.player && !g.player.dead && g.mode !== 'spectator';
  },
  // a mesh in the entity layout (position, uv, normal; quads)
  upload(r, d) {
    const gl = r.gl,
      vao = gl.createVertexArray();
    gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
    const buf = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(d), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 0);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 12);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 20);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, r.quadIdx);
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);
    return {
      vao,
      n: d.length / 8
    };
  },
  // a part picture made solid the way vanilla makes held items (ItemModelGenerator): the picture front and back,
  // and a side face along every edge between a drawn pixel and an empty one, in that pixel's colour.
  // W: its width (ball radii); anchor [ax, ay]: the point of the picture (0..1 from the bottom-left) put at the
  // origin; place(v): from the part's own space (x right, y up, z out of the picture) to the ball's
  extrude(d, mask, name, W, anchor, place, flip, thick = 0.14) {
    const S = JING_TEX.size,
      [rx, ry, w, h] = JING_TEX.parts[name],
      s = W / w,
      t = thick / 2;
    // (the sides on a coarser grid than the picture: about 48 cells across)
    const st = Math.max(1, Math.round(w / 48)),
      cw = Math.ceil(w / st),
      ch = Math.ceil(h / st);
    const at = (x, y) => x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= cw || y >= ch ? 0 : mask[(ry + Math.min(h - 1, y * st + (st >> 1))) * S + rx + Math.min(w - 1, x * st + (st >> 1))] >= 128;
    // picture pixel (x from the left, y from the top) -> part space
    const P = (x, y, z) => place([((flip ? w - x : x) - anchor[0] * w) * s, (h - y - anchor[1] * h) * s, z]);
    const N = n => {
      const o = place([0, 0, 0]),
        q = place(n);
      return [q[0] - o[0], q[1] - o[1], q[2] - o[2]];
    };
    const V = (p, u, v, n) => d.push(p[0], p[1], p[2], u / S, v / S, n[0], n[1], n[2]);
    const u0 = flip ? rx + w : rx,
      u1 = flip ? rx : rx + w;
    let n = N([0, 0, 1]);
    V(P(0, 0, t), u0, ry, n);
    V(P(0, h, t), u0, ry + h, n);
    V(P(w, h, t), u1, ry + h, n);
    V(P(w, 0, t), u1, ry, n);
    n = N([0, 0, -1]);
    V(P(w, 0, -t), u1, ry, n);
    V(P(w, h, -t), u1, ry + h, n);
    V(P(0, h, -t), u0, ry + h, n);
    V(P(0, 0, -t), u0, ry, n);
    for (let cy = 0; cy < ch; cy++) for (let cx = 0; cx < cw; cx++) {
      if (!at(cx, cy)) continue;
      const x = cx * st,
        y = cy * st,
        x1 = Math.min(w, x + st),
        y1 = Math.min(h, y + st);
      const u = rx + Math.min(w - 1, x + (st >> 1)) + 0.5,
        v = ry + Math.min(h - 1, y + (st >> 1)) + 0.5,
        sx = flip ? -1 : 1;
      if (!at(cx, cy - 1)) {
        n = N([0, 1, 0]);
        V(P(x, y, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x, y, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y, t), u, v, n);
      }
      if (!at(cx, cy + 1)) {
        n = N([0, -1, 0]);
        V(P(x, y1, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x, y1, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y1, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y1, -t), u, v, n);
      }
      if (!at(cx - 1, cy)) {
        n = N([-sx, 0, 0]);
        V(P(x, y, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x, y, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x, y1, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x, y1, -t), u, v, n);
      }
      if (!at(cx + 1, cy)) {
        n = N([sx, 0, 0]);
        V(P(x1, y, t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y1, -t), u, v, n);
        V(P(x1, y1, t), u, v, n);
      }
    }
  },
  build(r, img) {
    const S = JING_TEX.size,
      C = JING_TEX.cell,
      c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = S;
    const cx = c.getContext('2d');
    cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    const px = cx.getImageData(0, 0, S, S).data,
      mask = new Uint8Array(S * S);
    for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) mask[i] = px[i * 4 + 3];
    // the ball: 32 x 16 quads
    const d = [],
      NL = 32,
      NT = 16;
    const pt = (i, j) => {
      const lon = i / NL * 2 * Math.PI,
        lat = Math.PI / 2 - j / NT * Math.PI;
      return [Math.cos(lat) * Math.sin(lon), Math.sin(lat), Math.cos(lat) * Math.cos(lon)];
    };
    for (let j = 0; j < NT; j++) for (let i = 0; i < NL; i++) {
      const q = [pt(i, j), pt(i, j + 1), pt(i + 1, j + 1), pt(i + 1, j)];
      const side = q[0][2] + q[1][2] + q[2][2] + q[3][2] > 0 ? 0 : C;
      for (const p of q) d.push(p[0], p[1], p[2], (side + 0.5 + (0.5 + 0.5 * p[0]) * (C - 1)) / S, (0.5 + (0.5 - 0.5 * p[1]) * (C - 1)) / S, p[0], p[1], p[2]);
    }
    // turns: about x (y toward +z for a > 0) and y (+z toward +x), then a move
    const rx = a => v => [v[0], v[1] * Math.cos(a) - v[2] * Math.sin(a), v[1] * Math.sin(a) + v[2] * Math.cos(a)];
    const ry = a => v => [v[0] * Math.cos(a) + v[2] * Math.sin(a), v[1], -v[0] * Math.sin(a) + v[2] * Math.cos(a)];
    const rz = a => v => [v[0] * Math.cos(a) - v[1] * Math.sin(a), v[0] * Math.sin(a) + v[1] * Math.cos(a), v[2]];
    const mv = o => v => [v[0] + o[0], v[1] + o[1], v[2] + o[2]];
    const seq = (...f) => v => f.reduce((p, fn) => fn(p), v);
    // the fins: their roots in the sides a little above the middle, turned halfway between the front and the side
    // (seen whole from either), the tips drooping
    this.extrude(d, mask, 'ear', 0.8, [0.9, 0.1], seq(rz(0.35), ry(-0.8), mv([-0.78, 0.2, 0])), false);
    this.extrude(d, mask, 'ear', 0.8, [0.1, 0.1], seq(rz(-0.35), ry(0.8), mv([0.78, 0.2, 0])), true);
    // the ahoge on the crown, the headdress's frill over the forehead leaning back
    this.extrude(d, mask, 'ahoge', 0.5, [0.45, 0.02], seq(rx(-0.25), mv([0.02, 0.9, 0.12])), false, 0.12);
    this.extrude(d, mask, 'crown', 1.55, [0.5, 0.02], seq(rx(-0.55), mv([0, 0.6, 0.6])), false, 0.12);
    this.mesh = this.upload(r, d);
    // the tail (its own mesh: it swings): out of the back below the middle, the fluke up and away
    const t = [];
    this.extrude(t, mask, 'tail', 1.05, [0.5, 0.0], seq(rx(0.95), ry(Math.PI)), false, 0.16);
    this.tail = this.upload(r, t);
  },
  // where it floats (the user, 2026-11-01): called (V, the talk line, quick mode, a line of its own) it comes in front
  // of the eyes and stays while the answer is read; otherwise it waits beside the player, out of the way (in first
  // person out of sight, in third person by the shoulder). Never through blocks: the way from the eyes to where it
  // goes is walked, and it stops short of the first block in it.
  summoned(g) {
    const s = g.ui.screen;
    return performance.now() < this.until || Companion.busy || s instanceof CompanionChatScreen || s instanceof ChatScreen && Companion.quick(g);
  },
  call(ms) {
    this.until = Math.max(this.until || 0, performance.now() + ms);
  },
  place(g, now, a) {
    const p = g.player,
      w = g.world,
      cp = Math.cos(p.pitch);
    // the eyes where the camera has them (game.js): between ticks, and lower crawling, swimming, sneaking or in bed. From
    // the tick's position it jittered against the camera (flickering in first person); at standing height in a
    // one-block gap or a bed under a roof the eyes were inside the block above, and it stuck there in the wall
    const ip = p.ipos(a == null ? 1 : a),
      eh = g.smoothEye != null ? g.smoothEye : g.sleeping ? 0.2 : p.eye();
    const e = [ip[0], ip[1] + eh, ip[2]];
    const fh = [-Math.sin(p.yaw), 0, -Math.cos(p.yaw)],
      rt = [Math.cos(p.yaw), 0, -Math.sin(p.yaw)];
    let d = [-Math.sin(p.yaw) * cp, Math.sin(p.pitch), -Math.cos(p.yaw) * cp];
    if (g.perspective === 2) d = d.map(v => -v);
    const up = [rt[1] * d[2] - rt[2] * d[1], rt[2] * d[0] - rt[0] * d[2], rt[0] * d[1] - rt[1] * d[0]];
    const add = (o, ...terms) => {
      const q = o.slice();
      for (const [v, k] of terms) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) q[i] += v[i] * k;
      return q;
    };
    const call = this.summoned(g);
    let t;
    if (call) t = add(g.perspective === 0 ? e : g.renderer.camPos, [d, 1.4], [rt, 0.32], [up, -0.12]);else if (g.perspective === 0) t = add(e, [rt, 1.0], [fh, -0.45], [[0, 1, 0], -0.1]);else t = add(e, [rt, 0.75], [fh, 0.15], [[0, 1, 0], 0.35]);
    // the way there walked in steps: the last point where the whole ball is clear of blocks
    const rr = this.R * 1.15;
    const solid = (x, y, z) => {
      const b = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z))];
      return !!(b && b.solid);
    };
    const clear = q => !solid(q[0], q[1], q[2]) && !solid(q[0] + rr, q[1], q[2]) && !solid(q[0] - rr, q[1], q[2]) && !solid(q[0], q[1] + rr, q[2]) && !solid(q[0], q[1] - rr, q[2]) && !solid(q[0], q[1], q[2] + rr) && !solid(q[0], q[1], q[2] - rr);
    const reach = (a, b) => {
      const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]),
        n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / 0.08));
      let good = a;
      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const q = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * i / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * i / n, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * i / n];
        if (!clear(q)) break;
        good = q;
      }
      return good;
    };
    t = reach(e, t);
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - (this.last || now)) / 1000);
    this.last = now;
    if (!this.pos || Math.hypot(t[0] - this.pos[0], t[1] - this.pos[1], t[2] - this.pos[2]) > 12 || this.world !== w) {
      this.pos = t.slice();
      this.world = w;
    }
    const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (call ? 7 : 6));
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += (t[i] - this.pos[i]) * k;
    // (on its way it doesn't cut through a wall either)
    this.pos = reach(e, this.pos);
    // too close to the eyes to be anything but in the way (a one-block tunnel): not drawn (back only once a little
    // further: right at the limit, walking along a wall, it went on and off every frame)
    this.tooClose = g.perspective === 0 && Math.hypot(this.pos[0] - e[0], this.pos[1] - e[1], this.pos[2] - e[2]) < (this.tooClose ? 0.7 : 0.55);
    const cam = g.renderer.camPos,
      want = Math.atan2(cam[0] - this.pos[0], cam[2] - this.pos[2]);
    let dy = want - this.yaw;
    dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(dy), Math.cos(dy));
    this.yaw += dy * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));
  },
  draw(g, a, env) {
    if (!this.visible(g)) {
      this.pos = null;
      return;
    }
    const r = g.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      now = performance.now();
    if (!r.entityTex['@jing']) {
      // (a picture, not pixels: smooth, with mipmaps)
      if (!this.loading) {
        this.loading = true;
        const im = new Image();
        im.onload = () => {
          this.img = im;
          const t = gl.createTexture();
          gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
          gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, im);
          gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
          gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
          gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
          gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
          gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
          r.entityTex['@jing'] = t;
        };
        im.src = JING_TEX.src;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!this.mesh) this.build(r, this.img);
    this.place(g, now, a);
    if (this.tooClose) return;
    const s = now / 1000,
      since = (now - this.pulse) / 1000;
    // a little hop when it speaks
    const hop = since < 0.6 ? Math.sin(since / 0.6 * Math.PI) : 0;
    // (smaller right by the camera, on its way past it)
    const cd = Math.hypot(...[0, 1, 2].map(i => this.pos[i] - r.camPos[i]));
    const sq = 1 + 0.12 * hop,
      R = this.R * Math.max(0.55, Math.min(1, cd / 1.2));
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + Math.sin(s * 2.2) * 0.04 + hop * 0.12, this.pos[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, this.yaw);
    M4.rotZ(m, Math.sin(s * 1.3) * 0.08);
    M4.scale(m, R / Math.sqrt(sq), R * sq, R / Math.sqrt(sq));
    const w = g.world,
      l = w.getLight(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1]), Math.floor(this.pos[2]));
    const E = r.entBegin('@jing', [Math.max(0.5, (l >> 4) / 15), Math.max(0.5, (l & 15) / 15)], env, {});
    // half lit by the world, half its own light: the side it shows the player faces away from the sun as often as
    // not, and under the shader pack it was in the player's own shadow - it went dark (the user, 2026-11-01)
    gl.uniform1f(E.u.u_bright, r.fxOn ? 0.55 : 0.3);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(E.u.u_model, false, m);
    gl.bindVertexArray(this.mesh.vao);
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, this.mesh.n * 1.5, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
    // the tail swings about its stem
    const mt = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(mt, ...this.TAIL_AT);
    M4.rotY(mt, Math.sin(s * 3.1) * 0.35);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(E.u.u_model, false, mt);
    gl.bindVertexArray(this.tail.vao);
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, this.tail.n * 1.5, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  }
};

// quick mode: a chat line goes to it as well, without being shown twice; a command too, with what the game answered
(() => {
  const run = runCommand;
  Companion.runRaw = run;
  runCommand = function (g, text) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    run(g, text);
    const t = cmdTidy(String(text || ''));
    if (!t) return;
    if (!t.startsWith('/')) {
      if (Companion.quick(g, t)) Companion.say(g, t, false);
      return;
    }
    // a command (the user, 2026-11-01): it says something about it - what was wrong and the right form, offering to type
    // it. What the game answered is in the chat (a room's server answers a moment later)
    if (!Companion.quick(g)) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      const got = g.ui.chat.filter(m => m.t >= t0 && !m.ai && m.text),
        bad = got.some(m => m.color === '#FF5555');
      Companion.say(g, `（玩家刚输入了命令：${t}  游戏的回应：${got.map(m => m.text).join(' / ').slice(0, 300) || '没有回应'}${bad ? '（出错了）' : ''}）`, false, true);
    }, g.net ? 1500 : 300);
  };
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/extras.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers vanilla doesn't have (game/UX_IDEAS.md「体验优化」), each can be switched off:
//   the death point (an arrow and the distance on screen after respawning), a minimap with waypoints (B adds one,
//   N lists them; long press the map on a phone), markers in a room ("look here", G), sorting an inventory, a
//   warning when a tool is about to break, the item encyclopedia (J: every item, how it is made, what it makes),
//   the player list (hold Tab), quick toggles for a room's owner, a photo with a share card (F2), the automatic
//   quality step (down when the frame rate can't keep up, back up later), play time in the world list, and
//   reconnecting by itself when a room's connection drops.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Extras = {};

// ---- a direction marker on the HUD: a point in the world, shown where it is on screen (or at the edge) ----
function hudMarker(ui, pos, label, color, small) {
  const g = ui.game,
    r = g.renderer,
    vp = r.vp,
    p = g.player;
  if (!vp || !p) return;
  const x = pos[0] + 0.5,
    y = pos[1] + 1,
    z = pos[2] + 0.5;
  const cx = vp[0] * x + vp[4] * y + vp[8] * z + vp[12],
    cy = vp[1] * x + vp[5] * y + vp[9] * z + vp[13],
    cw = vp[3] * x + vp[7] * y + vp[11] * z + vp[15];
  const d = Math.hypot(x - p.pos[0], z - p.pos[2]);
  let sx,
    sy,
    edge = false;
  if (cw > 0.1) {
    sx = (cx / cw * 0.5 + 0.5) * ui.w;
    sy = (1 - (cy / cw * 0.5 + 0.5)) * ui.h;
  }
  if (cw <= 0.1 || sx < 8 || sx > ui.w - 8 || sy < 20 || sy > ui.h - 40) {
    // behind or off screen: on the edge, toward it
    const a = Math.atan2(cx / Math.max(Math.abs(cw), 0.1) * Math.sign(cw || 1), cy / Math.max(Math.abs(cw), 0.1) * Math.sign(cw || 1));
    const R = Math.min(ui.w, ui.h) * 0.42;
    sx = ui.w / 2 + Math.sin(a) * R * (cw > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    sy = ui.h / 2 - Math.cos(a) * R * (cw > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    edge = true;
  }
  sx = clamp(sx, 10, ui.w - 10);
  sy = clamp(sy, 22, ui.h - 44);
  const c = ui.ctx,
    t = `${label} ${Math.round(d)}m`;
  c.fillStyle = color;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(sx, sy - 5);
  c.lineTo(sx + 4, sy);
  c.lineTo(sx, sy + 5);
  c.lineTo(sx - 4, sy);
  c.fill();
  if (!small || !edge) {
    const w = Font.width(t) + 4;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    c.fillRect(Math.round(sx - w / 2), Math.round(sy + 7), w, 10);
    Font.center(c, t, sx, sy + 8, color);
  }
}

// ---- the death point ----
(() => {
  const dd = Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath;
  Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath = function (src) {
    const r = dd.call(this, src);
    if (this.lastDeath) this.lastDeath.at = Date.now();
    return r;
  };
})();
Extras.drawDeath = function (ui) {
  const g = ui.game,
    L = g.lastDeath,
    s = g.settings;
  if (!L || !L.at || L.dim !== g.dim || s.deathMarker === false || s.deathMarker === undefined && s.playerKind !== 'new' || g.player.deathTime > 0) return;
  const d = Math.hypot(L.pos[0] - g.player.pos[0], L.pos[2] - g.player.pos[2]);
  if (Date.now() - L.at > 300e3 || d < 3) {
    if (d < 3) L.at = 0;
    return;
  }
  hudMarker(ui, L.pos, '死亡点', '#FF6060');
};

// ---- the minimap: the top blocks around the player, north up, one pixel a block, made twice a second ----
const Minimap = {
  N: 64,
  cv: null,
  img: null,
  at: 0,
  on(g) {
    const s = g.settings;
    return s.minimap === true || s.minimap === undefined && s.playerKind === 'new';
  },
  rect(ui) {
    const s = this.N,
      sf = ui.safe ? ui.safe() : {
        l: 0,
        t: 0
      };
    return {
      x: 4 + sf.l,
      y: 4 + sf.t,
      w: s,
      h: s
    };
  },
  update(g) {
    const N = this.N,
      w = g.world,
      p = g.player;
    if (!this.cv) {
      this.cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      this.cv.width = this.cv.height = N;
      this.ctx = this.cv.getContext('2d');
      this.img = this.ctx.createImageData(N, N);
    }
    const d = this.img.data,
      px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]),
      slice = g.dim !== 'overworld',
      py = Math.floor(p.pos[1]);
    let prev = new Int16Array(N);
    for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const wx = px - N / 2 + i,
        wz = pz - N / 2 + j,
        o = (j * N + i) * 4;
      if (!w.isLoaded(wx, wz)) {
        d[o] = d[o + 1] = d[o + 2] = 0;
        d[o + 3] = 120;
        prev[i] = 0;
        continue;
      }
      let y = slice ? Math.min(py + 1, HEIGHT - 1) : w.surfaceY(wx, wz, true) + 1,
        id = 0,
        n = 0; // (water counts: the sea is blue)
      if (slice) {
        while (y > 0 && n++ < 40 && (id = w.getBlock(wx, y, wz)) !== 0) y--;
      } // (under a roof: from the player's height down)
      do {
        y--;
        id = w.getBlock(wx, y, wz);
        if (WLOG[id]) id = WATER;
      } while (y > 0 && (id === 0 || mapColorOf(id, 0) === 0));
      const col = mapColorOf(id, w.getMeta(wx, y, wz)),
        dh = j ? y - prev[i] : 0;
      prev[i] = y;
      const br = id === WATER ? 1 : dh > 0 ? 2 : dh < 0 ? 0 : 1,
        c = MAP_PAL[col * 4 + br] || [0, 0, 0, 0];
      d[o] = c[0];
      d[o + 1] = c[1];
      d[o + 2] = c[2];
      d[o + 3] = 255;
    }
    this.ctx.putImageData(this.img, 0, 0);
  },
  draw(ui) {
    const g = ui.game;
    if (!this.on(g) || ui.hideHud || g.state !== 'play') return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - this.at > 500) {
      this.at = now;
      try {
        this.update(g);
      } catch (e) {
        return;
      }
    }
    const c = ui.ctx,
      R = this.rect(ui),
      N = this.N,
      p = g.player;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    c.fillRect(R.x - 1, R.y - 1, R.w + 2, R.h + 2);
    c.drawImage(this.cv, R.x, R.y, R.w, R.h);
    const at = (x, z) => [R.x + (x - Math.floor(p.pos[0]) + N / 2), R.y + (z - Math.floor(p.pos[2]) + N / 2)];
    // waypoints, the death point
    for (const wp of Waypoints.list(g)) {
      const [mx, my] = at(wp.pos[0], wp.pos[2]);
      if (mx >= R.x && mx < R.x + N && my >= R.y && my < R.y + N) {
        c.fillStyle = wp.color;
        c.fillRect(Math.round(mx) - 1, Math.round(my) - 1, 3, 3);
      }
    }
    if (g.lastDeath && g.lastDeath.at && g.lastDeath.dim === g.dim) {
      const [mx, my] = at(g.lastDeath.pos[0], g.lastDeath.pos[2]);
      if (mx >= R.x && mx < R.x + N && my >= R.y && my < R.y + N) {
        c.fillStyle = '#FF4040';
        c.fillRect(Math.round(mx) - 1, Math.round(my) - 1, 3, 3);
      }
    }
    // the player: an arrow facing where they look
    const a = p.yaw,
      cx = R.x + N / 2,
      cy = R.y + N / 2;
    c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(cx - Math.sin(a) * 4, cy - Math.cos(a) * 4);
    c.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * 2.5 + Math.sin(a) * 2, cy - Math.sin(a) * 2.5 + Math.cos(a) * 2);
    c.lineTo(cx - Math.cos(a) * 2.5 + Math.sin(a) * 2, cy + Math.sin(a) * 2.5 + Math.cos(a) * 2);
    c.fill();
    Font.draw(c, '北', R.x + N / 2 - 4, R.y + 1, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.draw(c, `${Math.floor(p.pos[0])}, ${Math.floor(p.pos[2])}`, R.x, R.y + N + 3, '#E0E0E0');
  }
};

// ---- waypoints: per world and dimension ----
const WP_COLORS = ['#55FFFF', '#FFFF55', '#FF55FF', '#55FF55', '#FFAA00', '#FFFFFF'];
const Waypoints = {
  all(g) {
    const m = g.worldMeta;
    return m ? m.waypoints || (m.waypoints = []) : g.netWaypoints || (g.netWaypoints = []);
  },
  list(g) {
    return this.all(g).filter(w => (w.dim || 'overworld') === (g.dim || 'overworld') && w.show !== false);
  },
  add(g) {
    const A = this.all(g),
      p = g.player;
    const wp = {
      name: A.length ? '路标 ' + (A.length + 1) : '家',
      pos: p.pos.map(Math.floor),
      dim: g.dim || 'overworld',
      color: WP_COLORS[A.length % WP_COLORS.length]
    };
    A.push(wp);
    g.ui.message(`已添加路标“${wp.name}”（${wp.pos[0]}, ${wp.pos[1] + (typeof MIN_Y === 'number' ? MIN_Y : 0)}, ${wp.pos[2]}）：N 键管理`, wp.color);
  }
};
class WaypointScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, '路标', null);
    this.pauses = false;
    this.edit = -1;
    this.name = '';
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game,
      A = Waypoints.all(g);
    this.fields = {};
    this.widgets = [];
    A.slice(0, 7).forEach((wp, i) => {
      const y = 36 + i * 22;
      if (this.edit === i) {
        this.addField('name', cx - 150, y, 150, '', 16);
        this.widgets.push({
          x: cx + 4,
          y,
          w: 50,
          h: 20,
          label: '确定',
          onClick: () => {
            wp.name = this.name.trim() || wp.name;
            this.edit = -1;
            g.ui.hideInput();
            this.layout();
          }
        });
      } else this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 4,
        y,
        w: 46,
        h: 20,
        label: '改名',
        onClick: () => {
          this.edit = i;
          this.name = wp.name;
          this.layout();
        }
      }, {
        x: cx + 54,
        y,
        w: 46,
        h: 20,
        label: wp.show === false ? '显示' : '隐藏',
        onClick: () => {
          wp.show = wp.show === false;
          this.layout();
        }
      }, {
        x: cx + 104,
        y,
        w: 46,
        h: 20,
        label: '删除',
        onClick: () => {
          A.splice(i, 1);
          this.layout();
        }
      });
    });
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 150,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 148,
      h: 20,
      label: '在这里加一个路标',
      onClick: () => {
        Waypoints.add(g);
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 2,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 148,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '小地图：' + (Minimap.on(g) ? '开' : '关'),
      onClick: () => {
        g.settings.minimap = !Minimap.on(g);
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => {
        g.ui.hideInput();
        g.ui.close();
      }
    });
    if (this.edit >= 0) this.focus('name');
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      g = this.game,
      A = Waypoints.all(g),
      p = g.player;
    if (!A.length) Font.center(c, '还没有路标：按 B 在脚下添加，或点下面的按钮', cx, 50, '#A0A0A0');
    A.slice(0, 7).forEach((wp, i) => {
      if (this.edit === i) return;
      const y = 36 + i * 22,
        d = Math.round(Math.hypot(wp.pos[0] - p.pos[0], wp.pos[2] - p.pos[2]));
      c.fillStyle = wp.color;
      c.fillRect(cx - 150, y + 6, 6, 6);
      Font.draw(c, fitText(wp.name, 80), cx - 140, y + 6, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.draw(c, (wp.dim || 'overworld') === (g.dim || 'overworld') ? d + 'm' : {
        nether: '下界',
        end: '末地',
        overworld: '主世界'
      }[wp.dim], cx - 52, y + 6, '#A0A0A0');
    });
    this.drawFields(ui);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
}

// ---- markers in a room: "look here" for everyone, 30 seconds (the room service passes them on) ----
const Marks = {
  list: [],
  add(name, pos, color) {
    this.list = this.list.filter(m => m.name !== name);
    this.list.push({
      name,
      pos,
      color: color || '#FFD24A',
      at: performance.now()
    });
  },
  place(g) {
    if (!g.net) {
      Waypoints.add(g);
      return;
    }
    const t = g.target,
      pos = t ? [...t.pos] : g.player.pos.map(Math.floor);
    g.net.send({
      t: 'mark',
      pos
    });
    this.add(g.net.name || '我', pos, '#55FF55');
    Sound.click && Sound.click();
  },
  draw(ui) {
    const now = performance.now();
    this.list = this.list.filter(m => now - m.at < 30000);
    for (const m of this.list) hudMarker(ui, m.pos, m.name, m.color, true);
  }
};

// ---- the HUD additions ----
(() => {
  const hud = UI.prototype.drawHUD;
  UI.prototype.drawHUD = function () {
    hud.call(this);
    const g = this.game;
    if (g.state !== 'play' || this.hideHud) return;
    try {
      Minimap.draw(this);
      Extras.drawDeath(this);
      for (const wp of Waypoints.list(g)) if (Math.hypot(wp.pos[0] - g.player.pos[0], wp.pos[2] - g.player.pos[2]) > 4) hudMarker(this, wp.pos, wp.name, wp.color, true);
      Marks.draw(this);
      Extras.drawNet(this);
      Extras.drawPlayerList(this);
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  // keys: B waypoint, N waypoints, G mark, J encyclopedia, Tab players (held), F2 photo
  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    if (!g || g.state !== 'play' || g.ui.screen || document.activeElement === g.ui.input) return;
    if (e.code === 'KeyB') Waypoints.add(g);else if (e.code === 'KeyN') g.ui.open(new WaypointScreen(g));else if (e.code === 'KeyG') Marks.place(g);else if (e.code === 'KeyJ') g.ui.open(new ItemDexScreen(g, null));else if (e.code === 'Tab') {
      Extras.tabHeld = true;
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.code === 'F2') {
      e.preventDefault();
      Photo.take(g);
    }
  });
  addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.code === 'Tab') Extras.tabHeld = false;
  });
  // a phone: long press the minimap for the waypoints
  const sp = TouchControls.prototype.startPlay;
  TouchControls.prototype.startPlay = function (s) {
    const g = this.g,
      R = Minimap.rect(this.ui);
    if (Minimap.on(g) && s.x >= R.x && s.x < R.x + R.w && s.y >= R.y && s.y < R.y + R.h) {
      s.kind = 'button';
      s.btn = 'minimap';
      return;
    }
    return sp.call(this, s);
  };
  const bt = TouchControls.prototype.button;
  TouchControls.prototype.button = function (id) {
    if (id === 'minimap') this.g.ui.open(new WaypointScreen(this.g));else bt.call(this, id);
  };
  // the room service passes marks on
  const om = NetClient.prototype.onMessage;
  NetClient.prototype.onMessage = function (m) {
    if (m && m.t === 'mark' && Array.isArray(m.pos) && m.pos.length === 3) {
      Marks.add(String(m.name || '?').slice(0, 16), m.pos.map(v => v | 0));
      Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.note_block.pling', null, 0.6, 1.5);
      this.g.ui.message(`${m.name} 标记了一个位置`, '#FFD24A');
      return;
    }
    if (m && m.t === 'pong' && typeof m.i === 'string' && m.i[0] === 'x') {
      const t = this.myPings && this.myPings.get(m.i);
      if (t) {
        this.myPings.delete(m.i);
        this.ping = Math.round(performance.now() - t);
      }
      return;
    }
    return om.call(this, m);
  };
})();

// ---- the connection: ping every 5 s; a dropped room is joined again by itself (5 tries) ----
setInterval(() => {
  const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game,
    n = g && g.net;
  if (!n || n.closed) return;
  const id = 'x' + (n.pingN = (n.pingN || 0) + 1);
  (n.myPings || (n.myPings = new Map())).set(id, performance.now());
  if (n.myPings.size > 5) n.myPings.delete(n.myPings.keys().next().value);
  n.send({
    t: 'ping',
    i: id
  });
}, 5000);
Extras.drawNet = function (ui) {
  const g = ui.game,
    n = g.net;
  if (!n) return;
  const p = n.ping,
    bad = p === undefined ? false : p > 300,
    x = ui.w - 30,
    y = (ui.touch && ui.touch.on() ? ui.touch.topInset() : 0) + 4;
  if (!bad && !Extras.tabHeld) return;
  const bars = p === undefined ? 0 : p < 150 ? 4 : p < 300 ? 3 : p < 600 ? 2 : 1,
    c = ui.ctx;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    c.fillStyle = i < bars ? bars <= 2 ? '#FF5555' : '#55FF55' : '#404040';
    c.fillRect(x + i * 4, y + 8 - i * 2, 3, 2 + i * 2);
  }
  Font.draw(c, p === undefined ? '…' : p + 'ms', x - Font.width(String(p) + 'ms') - 3, y + 1, bad ? '#FF8080' : '#E0E0E0');
};
class ReconnectScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, n, go) {
    super(game, '游戏正在更新中');
    this.n = n;
    this.go = go;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.wait = Math.min(15, 2 * n);
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) go();
    }, this.wait * 1000);
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: u.w / 2 - 100,
      y: u.h / 2 + 20,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '不等了，回标题画面',
      onClick: () => {
        clearTimeout(this.timer);
        this.game.reconnect = null;
        this.game.ui.open(new TitleScreen(this.game));
      }
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(this.wait - (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000));
    Font.center(ui.ctx, `请稍后，${s > 0 ? s + ' 秒后' : '正在'}自动重新连接（第 ${this.n} 次，最多 5 次）…`, ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 - 10, '#FFFFFF');
  }
  onEsc() {}
}
(() => {
  const fail = NetClient.prototype.fail;
  NetClient.prototype.fail = function (reason) {
    const g = this.g,
      room = this.opts && this.opts.room;
    if (!this.closed && room && reason === '游戏正在更新中…请稍后' && (this.joined || g.reconnect) && (g.reconnect && g.reconnect.n || 0) < 5) {
      this.closed = true;
      const n = (g.reconnect && g.reconnect.n || 0) + 1,
        name = this.name;
      g.reconnect = {
        room,
        n
      };
      g.leaveServer();
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('net:reconnect');
      g.ui.open(new ReconnectScreen(g, n, () => g.joinRoom(room, name)));
      return;
    }
    g.reconnect = null;
    return fail.call(this, reason);
  };
  const om = NetClient.prototype.onMessage;
  NetClient.prototype.onMessage = function (m) {
    if (m && m.t === 'room') {
      this.joined = true;
      if (this.g.reconnect) {
        this.g.ui.message('已重新连接', '#55FF55');
        this.g.reconnect = null;
      }
    }
    return om.call(this, m);
  };
})();

// ---- the player list (hold Tab): who is in the room, the owner, this player's ping ----
Extras.drawPlayerList = function (ui) {
  const g = ui.game,
    n = g.net;
  if (!Extras.tabHeld || !n) return;
  const R = n.room,
    names = R && R.players || [...new Set(g.entities.filter(e => e.type === 'player').map(e => e.name))].concat([n.name]);
  const c = ui.ctx,
    w = 180,
    rows = Math.min(names.length, 12),
    x = Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - w / 2),
    y = 20;
  c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  c.fillRect(x, y, w, rows * 10 + 16);
  Font.center(c, R ? `${R.name}（${names.length}/${R.max}）` : '在线玩家', ui.w / 2, y + 3, '#FFFF55');
  names.slice(0, rows).forEach((nm, i) => {
    Font.draw(c, nm + (R && nm === R.owner ? '（房主）' : '') + (nm === n.name ? '（你）' : ''), x + 4, y + 14 + i * 10, '#FFFFFF');
    if (nm === n.name && n.ping !== undefined) Font.draw(c, n.ping + 'ms', x + w - 4 - Font.width(n.ping + 'ms'), y + 14 + i * 10, n.ping > 300 ? '#FF8080' : '#80FF80');
  });
};

// ---- sorting an inventory (a button on the window; not on a server's windows) ----
const sortKey = st => {
  const d = ITEMS[st.id];
  const cat = d.armor ? 2 : d.durability ? 1 : d.food ? 4 : BLOCKS[d.block] ? 5 : 3;
  return cat * 100000 + st.id;
};
function sortSlots(slots) {
  // merge stacks of the same item (same data), then order by kind and item
  const items = slots.map(s => s.get()).filter(Boolean),
    merged = [];
  for (const st of items) {
    const same = merged.find(m => m.id === st.id && m.count < maxStack(m.id) && JSON.stringify({
      ...m,
      count: 0
    }) === JSON.stringify({
      ...st,
      count: 0
    }));
    if (same) {
      const t = Math.min(maxStack(same.id) - same.count, st.count);
      same.count += t;
      st.count -= t;
      if (st.count) merged.push(st);
    } else merged.push(st);
  }
  merged.sort((a, b) => sortKey(a) - sortKey(b));
  slots.forEach((s, i) => s.set(merged[i] || null));
}
(() => {
  // (after the slots - every window draws them; subclasses have their own draw)
  const draw = ContainerScreen.prototype.drawSlots;
  ContainerScreen.prototype.drawSlots = function (ui) {
    draw.call(this, ui);
    if (this.net || this.game.net || this instanceof CreativeScreen) return;
    const r = this.sortRect = {
      x: this.x + this.gw - 22,
      y: this.y - 14,
      w: 20,
      h: 12
    };
    const hov = ui.hit(r),
      c = ui.ctx;
    c.fillStyle = hov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    c.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
    Font.center(c, '整理', r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
    const d = this.dexRect = {
      x: this.x + this.gw - 46,
      y: this.y - 14,
      w: 22,
      h: 12
    };
    c.fillStyle = ui.hit(d) ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    c.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
    Font.center(c, '图鉴', d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
    if (hov) ui.tooltip([{
      text: '整理：合并同样的物品，按种类排好'
    }, {
      text: '（只整理背包里的格子；箱子里点箱子那半边）',
      color: '#A0A0A0'
    }], ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  };
  // (clicks taken before the window's own handling: subclasses have their own mouseDown)
  const md = UI.prototype.mouseDown;
  UI.prototype.mouseDown = function (ev) {
    const sc = this.screen;
    if (!(sc instanceof ContainerScreen) || this.game.net || sc instanceof CreativeScreen) return md.call(this, ev);
    const [mx, my] = this.toGui(ev),
      hit = r => r && mx >= r.x && mx < r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my < r.y + r.h;
    if (hit(sc.dexRect)) {
      this.open(new ItemDexScreen(this.game, sc));
      return;
    }
    if (hit(sc.sortRect)) {
      sc.sortNow();
      return;
    }
    return md.call(this, ev);
  };
  ContainerScreen.prototype.sortNow = function () {
    {
      // the player's main inventory, or (a chest open) the chest's slots
      const own = this.slots.filter(s => s.group === 'main'),
        other = this.slots.filter(s => !s.group && !s.output && s.get !== undefined && !s.accept);
      sortSlots(other.length >= 9 ? other : own);
      if (this.changed) this.changed();
      Sound.click && Sound.click();
    }
  };
})();

// ---- a tool about to break: once, while it is held ----
(() => {
  const tick = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...a) {
    const r = tick.apply(this, a);
    if (this.state === 'play' && this.tickCount % 10 === 0 && this.settings.durabilityWarn !== false) {
      const st = this.player && this.player.inv.held,
        d = st && ITEMS[st.id];
      if (d && d.durability && d.durability >= 32) {
        const left = d.durability - (st.dmg || 0);
        if (left <= Math.max(5, d.durability * 0.05) && st.warned !== left) {
          st.warned = left;
          this.ui.pinMessage(`${d.cn || d.key}快坏了：只剩 ${left} 点耐久`, 3000, '#FF8040');
        }
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- 物品图鉴: every item, searchable; how it is made (crafting, smelting) and what it is used in ----
class ItemDexScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '物品图鉴', parent);
    this.titleY = 6;
    this.q = '';
    this.page = 0;
    this.sel = null;
    this.rpage = 0;
    this.all = ITEMS.map((d, i) => d && i).filter(i => i !== null && i !== undefined && ITEMS[i].key && !/^(air|.*_wall_.*|potted_.*)$/.test(ITEMS[i].key) && ITEMS[i].creative !== false);
  }
  get pauses() {
    return this.game.state === 'play' && !this.game.net;
  }
  shown() {
    const q = this.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    return q ? this.all.filter(i => {
      const d = ITEMS[i];
      return d.key.includes(q) || (d.cn || '').includes(q);
    }) : this.all;
  }
  grid() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cols = Math.max(4, Math.floor((u.w / 2 - 20) / 18)),
      rows = Math.max(3, Math.floor((u.h - 70) / 18));
    return {
      cols,
      rows,
      x: 10,
      y: 44
    };
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      G = this.grid(),
      n = G.cols * G.rows,
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.shown().length / n));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    this.fields = {};
    this.addField('q', 10, 20, G.cols * 18, '', 24, v => {
      this.page = 0;
      return v;
    });
    this.widgets = [{
      x: 10,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 30,
      h: 18,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.page > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page--;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: 44,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 30,
      h: 18,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.page++;
        this.layout();
      }
    }, {
      x: u.w - 70,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 60,
      h: 18,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    const R = this.recipes();
    if (R.length > 1) this.widgets.push({
      x: u.w / 2 + 10,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 30,
      h: 18,
      label: '<',
      enabled: this.rpage > 0,
      onClick: () => {
        this.rpage--;
      }
    }, {
      x: u.w / 2 + 44,
      y: u.h - 24,
      w: 30,
      h: 18,
      label: '>',
      enabled: this.rpage < R.length - 1,
      onClick: () => {
        this.rpage++;
      }
    });
    this.focus('q');
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    if (this.parent) this.game.ui.open(this.parent);else this.game.ui.close();
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  // the ways the selected item is made, then the recipes it goes into
  recipes() {
    const id = this.sel;
    if (id === null) return [];
    const out = [];
    for (const r of RECIPES) if (r.result === id) out.push({
      kind: 'craft',
      r
    });
    for (const k in SMELTING) if (SMELTING[k].result === id) out.push({
      kind: 'smelt',
      from: +k
    });
    if (SMELTING[id]) out.push({
      kind: 'smeltInto',
      to: SMELTING[id].result
    });
    for (const r of RECIPES) if (r.result !== id && (r.type === 'shaped' ? Object.values(r.keys).some(a => a.includes(id)) : r.ing.some(a => a.includes(id)))) {
      out.push({
        kind: 'use',
        r
      });
      if (out.length > 60) break;
    }
    return out;
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    const G = this.grid(),
      list = this.shown(),
      n = G.cols * G.rows;
    const i = Math.floor((mx - G.x) / 18),
      j = Math.floor((my - G.y) / 18);
    if (i >= 0 && i < G.cols && j >= 0 && j < G.rows && mx >= G.x) {
      const id = list[this.page * n + j * G.cols + i];
      if (id !== undefined) {
        this.sel = id;
        this.rpage = 0;
        this.layout();
        Sound.click && Sound.click();
        return;
      }
    }
    // a slot of the recipe shown: that item
    if (this.slotHits) for (const h of this.slotHits) if (mx >= h.x && mx < h.x + 16 && my >= h.y && my < h.y + 16 && h.id !== undefined) {
      this.sel = h.id;
      this.rpage = 0;
      this.layout();
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  wheel(d) {
    const G = this.grid(),
      n = G.cols * G.rows,
      pages = Math.ceil(this.shown().length / n);
    this.page = clamp(this.page - d, 0, pages - 1);
    this.layout();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      G = this.grid(),
      list = this.shown(),
      n = G.cols * G.rows;
    this.drawFields(ui);
    if (!this.q && this.field !== 'q') Font.draw(c, '搜索物品（中文名或英文 id）', 14, 26, '#707070');
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    c.fillRect(G.x - 1, G.y - 1, G.cols * 18 + 2, G.rows * 18 + 2);
    list.slice(this.page * n, this.page * n + n).forEach((id, k) => {
      const x = G.x + k % G.cols * 18,
        y = G.y + Math.floor(k / G.cols) * 18;
      if (id === this.sel) {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
        c.fillRect(x, y, 18, 18);
      }
      ui.drawItem({
        id,
        count: 1
      }, x + 1, y + 1);
    });
    Font.draw(c, `${list.length} 个物品`, 80, ui.h - 19, '#A0A0A0');
    // the right half: the selected item
    const X = Math.floor(ui.w / 2) + 10,
      W = ui.w - X - 10;
    this.slotHits = [];
    if (this.sel === null) {
      Font.draw(c, '点左边的物品，看它怎么合成、能做什么', X, 50, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    const d = ITEMS[this.sel];
    ui.drawItem({
      id: this.sel,
      count: 1
    }, X, 24);
    Font.draw(c, fitText(d.cn || d.key, W - 22), X + 20, 24, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.draw(c, 'minecraft:' + d.key, X + 20, 34, '#707070');
    const R = this.recipes();
    if (!R.length) {
      Font.draw(c, '不能合成：在世界里找到或者从生物身上获得', X, 56, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    this.rpage = clamp(this.rpage, 0, R.length - 1);
    const r = R[this.rpage],
      y0 = 62,
      slot = (id, x, y) => {
        c.fillStyle = '#8B8B8B';
        c.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, 18, 18);
        if (id !== undefined && id !== null) {
          ui.drawItem({
            id,
            count: 1
          }, x, y);
          this.slotHits.push({
            x,
            y,
            id
          });
        }
      };
    const cyc = arr => arr && arr.length ? arr[Math.floor(performance.now() / 1000) % arr.length] : undefined; // (a tag: its items in turn)
    Font.draw(c, {
      craft: '合成（工作台）',
      smelt: '烧炼（熔炉）',
      smeltInto: '烧炼成',
      use: '可以用来做'
    }[r.kind] + `　${this.rpage + 1}/${R.length}`, X, 50, '#FFD24A');
    if (r.kind === 'craft' || r.kind === 'use') {
      const rc = r.r;
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        let id;
        if (rc.type === 'shaped') {
          const ch = rc.pattern[j] && rc.pattern[j][i];
          id = ch && ch !== ' ' ? cyc(rc.keys[ch]) : undefined;
        } else {
          const k = j * 3 + i;
          id = rc.ing[k] ? cyc(rc.ing[k]) : undefined;
        }
        slot(id, X + i * 18, y0 + j * 18);
      }
      Font.draw(c, '→', X + 58, y0 + 22, '#FFFFFF');
      slot(rc.result, X + 72, y0 + 18);
      if (rc.count > 1) Font.draw(c, '×' + rc.count, X + 92, y0 + 22, '#FFFFFF');
    } else {
      slot(r.kind === 'smelt' ? r.from : this.sel, X, y0 + 18);
      Font.draw(c, '→ 熔炉 →', X + 22, y0 + 22, '#FFFFFF');
      slot(r.kind === 'smelt' ? this.sel : r.to, X + 70, y0 + 18);
    }
    Font.draw(c, fitText('点格子里的物品可以查看它；带标签的格子会轮流显示能用的物品', W), X, y0 + 62, '#707070');
  }
}

// ---- the owner's quick switches in the room screen: keep inventory, day, clear weather, difficulty, PvP ----
(() => {
  // (one row of the player list gives way to the switches)
  RoomScreen.prototype.rows = function () {
    return Math.max(2, Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 108 - 56 - (this.R && this.R.isOwner ? 22 : 0)) / 22));
  };
  const lay = RoomScreen.prototype.layout;
  RoomScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    lay.call(this);
    const R = this.R,
      g = this.game;
    if (!R || !R.isOwner) return;
    const u = g.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = u.h - 76,
      cmd = (c, msg) => {
        g.net.chat(c);
        this.say(msg);
      };
    // (a game rule in all three dimensions: each has its own on the server - keep inventory was off in the Nether)
    const rule = (r, msg) => {
      for (const d of ['overworld', 'the_nether', 'the_end']) g.net.chat('/execute in minecraft:' + d + ' run gamerule ' + r);
      this.say(msg);
    };
    const S = this.quick || (this.quick = {
      keep: true,
      pvp: true,
      diff: 2
    });
    const DF = ['peaceful', 'easy', 'normal', 'hard'],
      DN = ['和平', '简单', '普通', '困难'];
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 160,
      y,
      w: 62,
      h: 18,
      label: () => '死亡不掉落：' + (S.keep ? '开' : '关'),
      onClick: () => {
        S.keep = !S.keep;
        rule('keep_inventory ' + S.keep, S.keep ? '死亡不掉落：开' : '死亡不掉落：关');
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 96,
      y,
      w: 40,
      h: 18,
      label: '白天',
      onClick: () => cmd('/time set day', '已经设成白天')
    }, {
      x: cx - 54,
      y,
      w: 40,
      h: 18,
      label: '晴天',
      onClick: () => cmd('/weather clear', '已经放晴')
    }, {
      x: cx - 12,
      y,
      w: 70,
      h: 18,
      label: () => '难度：' + DN[S.diff],
      onClick: () => {
        S.diff = (S.diff + 1) % 4;
        cmd('/difficulty ' + DF[S.diff], '难度：' + DN[S.diff]);
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 60,
      y,
      w: 50,
      h: 18,
      label: () => 'PVP：' + (S.pvp ? '开' : '关'),
      onClick: () => {
        S.pvp = !S.pvp;
        rule('pvp ' + S.pvp, S.pvp ? '玩家可以互相伤害' : '玩家不能互相伤害');
      }
    });
  };
})();

// ---- a photo: the picture without the HUD, with the game's name and a QR code, to share or keep ----
const Photo = {
  async take(g) {
    const ui = g.ui,
      hide = ui.hideHud;
    ui.hideHud = true;
    ui.screen = null;
    g.render(1, performance.now());
    const src = g.canvas,
      W = 960,
      H = Math.round(W * src.height / src.width);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = W;
    cv.height = H + 64;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d');
    x.drawImage(src, 0, 0, W, H);
    ui.hideHud = hide;
    // the card's strip: the game's name, who took it, the QR code to play
    x.fillStyle = '#1B1B1B';
    x.fillRect(0, H, W, 64);
    x.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    x.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';
    x.fillText('OpusMC · 网页里的 Minecraft', 16, H + 30);
    x.fillStyle = '#A0A0A0';
    x.font = '15px sans-serif';
    x.fillText((typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.name || '') + ' 制作 · OpusMC 网页版', 16, H + 52);
    try {
      const q = await Toy.qrCode('index.html', 120);
      if (q && q.base64) {
        const im = new Image();
        await new Promise(r => {
          im.onload = r;
          im.onerror = r;
          im.src = q.base64.startsWith('data:') ? q.base64 : 'data:image/png;base64,' + q.base64;
        });
        x.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        x.fillRect(W - 62, H + 4, 56, 56);
        x.drawImage(im, W - 60, H + 6, 52, 52);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    g.ui.open(new PhotoScreen(g, cv));
    Sound.ev && Sound.ev('ui.button.click', null, 1, 2);
  }
};
class PhotoScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, cv) {
    super(game, null);
    this.cv = cv;
    this.pauses = !game.net;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0.6;
    this.note = '';
    this.inToy = null;
    Toy.ready().then(v => {
      this.inToy = v;
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
    });
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 152,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: '分享',
      enabled: this.inToy === true,
      tip: this.inToy ? ['分享到 B站'] : ['在 B站 App 或网页里才能分享'],
      onClick: () => this.share()
    }, {
      x: cx - 50,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '保存图片',
      onClick: () => this.save()
    }, {
      x: cx + 52,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 100,
      h: 20,
      label: '关闭',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.close()
    }];
  }
  data() {
    return this.cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88);
  }
  async share() {
    try {
      await Toy.sharePicture({
        base64Data: this.data(),
        title: 'OpusMC 截图'
      });
      this.note = '已打开分享';
      Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('photo_share');
    } catch (e) {
      this.note = Toy.explain(e);
    }
  }
  async save() {
    if (this.inToy) {
      try {
        await Toy.saveImage({
          base64Data: this.data()
        });
        this.note = '已保存到相册';
        return;
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = this.data();
    a.download = 'OpusMC-' + Date.now() + '.jpg';
    a.click();
    this.note = '已下载';
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      W = ui.w - 40,
      H = Math.min(ui.h - 50, W * this.cv.height / this.cv.width),
      w = H * this.cv.width / this.cv.height;
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    c.drawImage(this.cv, Math.round(ui.w / 2 - w / 2), 10, Math.round(w), Math.round(H));
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, this.note, ui.w / 2, ui.h - 38, '#80FF80');
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
}

// ---- automatic quality: when even the lowest resolution can't keep up, see less far; back up when it can again ----
// (fewer pixels can't help a device held up by its CPU - DynRes.cpuBound: a phone like that never got to the lowest
// resolution and kept its render distance. The limit in effect - FramePacer.playLimit, 0 = the screen's rate. Not
// while AFK or under a pausing screen - those frames are held to 30 / 10 - nor for 2.5 s after: g.fps counts whole
// seconds)
(() => {
  let low = 0,
    good = 0,
    last = performance.now();
  setInterval(() => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game,
      s = g && g.settings,
      P = g && g.pacer;
    if (!g || !P || g.state !== 'play' || !s || s.autoQuality === false || !g.fps) {
      last = performance.now();
      return;
    }
    const now = performance.now(),
      dt = now - last;
    last = now;
    if (P.afk || now - P.cappedT < 2500 || document.hidden) return;
    const target = Math.min(P.playLimit || 1000, P.hz, 60);
    const atMinRes = !s.dynRes || typeof DynRes !== 'undefined' && (DynRes.scale <= 0.55 || DynRes.cpuBound);
    if (g.fps < target * 0.6 && atMinRes) {
      low += dt;
      good = 0;
    } else if (g.fps > target * 0.95) {
      good += dt;
      low = Math.max(0, low - dt);
    } else {
      low = Math.max(0, low - dt / 2);
      good = 0;
    }
    const base = s.autoDistBase || s.renderDist;
    if (low > 20000 && s.renderDist > 4) {
      s.autoDistBase = base;
      s.renderDist = Math.max(4, s.renderDist - 2);
      g.applySettings();
      low = 0;
      g.ui.message(`画面有点卡：渲染距离自动降到 ${s.renderDist} 个区块（视频设置里可以关掉自动画质）`, '#FFAA00');
    } else if (good > 60000 && s.autoDistBase && s.renderDist < s.autoDistBase) {
      s.renderDist = Math.min(s.autoDistBase, s.renderDist + 2);
      g.applySettings();
      good = 0;
      if (s.renderDist >= s.autoDistBase) delete s.autoDistBase;
      g.ui.message(`又流畅了：渲染距离回到 ${s.renderDist} 个区块`, '#AAAAAA');
    }
  }, 2000);
  // the switch, in the video settings
  const opts = OptionsListScreen.prototype.options;
  OptionsListScreen.prototype.options = function () {
    const list = opts.call(this);
    if (this.page !== 'video') return list;
    const s = this.game.settings,
      g = this.game;
    list.splice(1, 0, {
      label: () => '自动画质：' + (s.autoQuality === false ? '关' : '开'),
      tip: ['帧率长时间太低时自动降低渲染距离，流畅后再调回来'],
      onClick: () => {
        s.autoQuality = s.autoQuality === false;
        if (s.autoQuality === false && s.autoDistBase) {
          s.renderDist = s.autoDistBase;
          delete s.autoDistBase;
          g.applySettings();
        }
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    });
    return list;
  };
})();

// ---- play time, kept with the world and shown in the world list ----
(() => {
  const sw = Game.prototype.saveWorld;
  Game.prototype.saveWorld = async function (quiet) {
    if (this.worldMeta && this.state === 'play') {
      const now = performance.now();
      this.worldMeta.playMs = (this.worldMeta.playMs || 0) + (now - (this.playFrom || now));
      this.playFrom = now;
    }
    return sw.call(this, quiet);
  };
  const lw = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = function (...a) {
    this.playFrom = performance.now();
    return lw.apply(this, a);
  };
  const de = WorldListScreen.prototype.drawExtra;
  WorldListScreen.prototype.drawExtra = function (ui) {
    de.call(this, ui);
    if (!this.worlds) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      rowH = 36,
      x0 = Math.floor(cx - this.rowW / 2) + 2,
      top = this.listTop,
      bottom = this.listBottom,
      vis = Math.floor((bottom - top - 4) / rowH);
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, top, ui.w, bottom - top);
    c.clip();
    this.shown().slice(this.scroll, this.scroll + vis + 1).forEach((w, i) => {
      if (!w.playMs) return;
      const m = Math.round(w.playMs / 60000),
        t = m < 60 ? `玩了 ${m} 分钟` : `玩了 ${Math.floor(m / 60)} 小时 ${m % 60} 分`;
      Font.draw(c, t, x0 + this.rowW - 8 - Font.width(t), top + 4 + i * rowH + 23, '#707070');
    });
    c.restore();
  };
})();

      if (!this.sceneT) this.sceneT = performance.now();
      const ready = !g.titleGround && g.world && g.world.chunks.size > 60,
        t = performance.now();
      if (ready && !this.readyT) this.readyT = t;
      const im = thumbOf(S.id),
        a = this.readyT ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - this.readyT) / 1200) : 1;
      if (a > 0) {
        const c = ui.ctx;
        c.save();
        c.globalAlpha = a;
        if (im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth) {
          c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
          c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
        } else {
          c.fillStyle = '#0B0B12';
          c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
        }
        c.restore();
      }
      // the picture for next time, a few seconds after the scene is up
      if (this.readyT && t - this.readyT > 5000 && !this.shot && !thumbOf(S.id)) {
        this.shot = true;
        try {
          g.ui.screen = null;
          g.render(1, t);
          g.ui.screen = this;
          const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
          cv.width = 192;
          cv.height = Math.round(192 * g.canvas.height / g.canvas.width);

          x.drawImage(g.canvas, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
          localStorage.setItem('mcjs-scene-' + S.id, cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7));
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    return de.call(this, ui);
  };
})();
