<script>
/* ==== js/cosmetics.js ==== */
'use strict';

// 装饰：帽子、宠物、名字前缀图标，以及穿戴和显示设置（game/COMMUNITY_PLAN.md）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Decorations (game/COMMUNITY_PLAN.md「三、装饰」), the sign-in event's rewards: hats worn on the head (a few small
// boxes like vanilla's head decorations, hidden under a helmet or a pumpkin), a pet that follows its owner (only
// drawn: no entity, no collision, nothing for the server to carry), a name prefix (an icon before the name) and the
// two penguin capes (capes.js). All original pixel art painted here, except the prefix: vanilla's potato item.
// Ids are 'kind:name' ('hat:straw'); a look carries the name alone ({ hat: 'straw', pet, pre }, beside skin and
// cape). What an account owns comes from the room service (Account.data.owned; a super administrator owns
// everything), which also checks what is worn. Whose are drawn: settings.cosShow (选项 → 皮肤与装饰).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Cosmetics = (() => {
  const LIST = [{
    id: 'hat:straw',
    kind: 'hat',
    name: '草帽'
  }, {
    id: 'hat:tophat',
    kind: 'hat',
    name: '礼帽'
  }, {
    id: 'hat:crown',
    kind: 'hat',
    name: '皇冠'
  }, {
    id: 'pet:snowman',
    kind: 'pet',
    name: '小雪人'
  }, {
    id: 'pre:potato',
    kind: 'pre',
    name: '土豆前缀'
  }, {
    id: 'cape:penguin',
    kind: 'cape',
    name: '企鹅披风'
  }, {
    id: 'cape:penguinwalk',
    kind: 'cape',
    name: '企鹅披风（动态）'
  }, {
    id: 'cape:goldapple',
    kind: 'cape',
    name: '金苹果披风'
  },
  // the mods update (11-13, the user): the announcement's gift, the mods' screen's gift (the first time it is really
  // opened - mods_ui.js), and the smeltery cape (how it is given: not decided yet)
  {
    id: 'pet:lantern',
    kind: 'pet',
    name: '灯笼小精灵',
    how: ['更新公告的礼物']
  }, {
    id: 'hat:chef',
    kind: 'hat',
    name: '厨师帽',
    how: ['第一次打开「模组」下载界面就送', '点一下去模组界面'],
    go: 'mods'
  }, {
    id: 'cape:smeltery',
    kind: 'cape',
    name: '冶炼炉披风',
    how: ['即将推出']
  }];
  const KIND = {
    hat: '帽子',
    pet: '宠物',
    pre: '名字前缀',
    cape: '披风'
  };
  const info = id => LIST.find(d => d.id === id) || null;
  const name = id => {
    const d = info(id);
    return d ? d.name : '';
  }; // ('' for one this game doesn't know yet)
  // (a super administrator - the user's account - owns every decoration this game knows, also ones the room service
  // doesn't list yet: a preview's new ones, 11-13)
  const owned = () => {
    if (typeof Account === 'undefined' || !Account.loggedIn || !Account.data) return [];
    if (Account.data.super) return [...new Set([...LIST.map(d => d.id), ...(Account.data.owned || [])])];
    return Array.isArray(Account.data.owned) ? Account.data.owned : [];
  };
  const has = id => owned().includes(id);

  // ---- the display setting: 'all' (the default), 'mine' (others' hidden), 'none' (this player's too) ----
  // The previews (the wardrobe's, the inventory's: opts.inv) always show this player's. With the graphics on 流畅 and
  // the setting never chosen, others' pets are left out (COMMUNITY_PLAN.md: weak devices)
  const mode = g => g && g.settings && g.settings.cosShow || 'all';
  function shown(g, e, opts) {
    if (opts && opts.inv) return true;
    const m = mode(g);
    return m === 'all' || m === 'mine' && !!g && e === g.player;
  }
  const othersPets = g => mode(g) === 'all' && !(g.settings.cosShow === undefined && g.settings.graphics === 'fast');

  // ---- what a player wears ----
  // this player: the wardrobe's preview while choosing, else the account's - only what it owns (the room service
  // refuses a look with anything else in it); another player: what the room said (skins.js keeps e.look)
  function lookOf(g, e) {
    if (g && e === g.player) {
      const s = typeof Skins !== 'undefined' && Skins.preview() || typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.data && Account.data.skin || null;
      if (!s) return null;
      const own = owned(),
        ok = k => s[k] && own.includes(k + ':' + s[k]) ? s[k] : null;
      return {
        hat: ok('hat'),
        pet: ok('pet'),
        pre: ok('pre')
      };
    }
    return e && e.look || g && g.net && g.net.looks && e && e.name && g.net.looks.get(e.name) || null;
  }
  // (own keys only: a look from a P2P peer is unchecked, and 'constructor' would find Object.prototype's)
  const hasKey = (T, v) => !!v && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(T, v);
  const worn = (g, e, kind) => {
    const l = lookOf(g, e),
      v = l && l[kind];
    return hasKey(kind === 'hat' ? HATS : kind === 'pet' ? PETS : PRES, v) ? v : null;
  };
  // what this player wears, for the others in a room (skins.js Skins.mine)
  function mine(g) {
    const l = g && g.player && lookOf(g, g.player) || {};
    return {
      hat: l.hat || null,
      pet: l.pet || null,
      pre: l.pre || null
    };
  }

  // ---- models: boxes with a texture of their own, painted here ----
  // parts [{ name, pivot, parent, boxes: [[x, y, z, w, h, d, inflate, paint]] }] (model pixels, y up, the front -z).
  // Each box's faces get a place in one texture (packed in rows, vanilla's cube layout) painted by
  // paint(face, i, j, fw, fh) -> '#rrggbb' or null (see-through): i across and j down the face as seen from outside;
  // faces front back left right (the wearer's) top bottom
  function buildModel(r, key, parts) {
    if (r.models[key]) return key;
    const TW = 64,
      places = [];
    let u = 0,
      v = 0,
      rowH = 0;
    for (const p of parts) for (const b of p.boxes) {
      const w = b[3],
        h = b[4],
        d = b[5];
      if (u + 2 * (w + d) > TW) {
        u = 0;
        v += rowH;
        rowH = 0;
      }
      places.push([b, u, v]);
      u += 2 * (w + d);
      rowH = Math.max(rowH, d + h);
    }
    const TH = Math.max(16, 1 << Math.ceil(Math.log2(v + rowH)));
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = TW;
    cv.height = TH;
    const cx = cv.getContext('2d'),
      img = cx.createImageData(TW, TH),
      D = img.data;
    const put = (x, y, c) => {
      if (!c) return;
      const k = (y * TW + x) * 4,
        n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16);
      D[k] = n >> 16;
      D[k + 1] = n >> 8 & 255;
      D[k + 2] = n & 255;
      D[k + 3] = 255;
    };
    const face = (b, f, x0, y0, fw, fh) => {
      for (let j = 0; j < fh; j++) for (let i = 0; i < fw; i++) put(x0 + i, y0 + j, b[7](f, i, j, fw, fh));
    };
    for (const [b, bu, bv] of places) {
      const w = b[3],
        h = b[4],
        d = b[5];
      // (render.js boxGeom: +x at u, the front (-z) at u + d, -x at u + d + w, the back after; top and bottom above)
      face(b, 'top', bu + d, bv, w, d);
      face(b, 'bottom', bu + d + w, bv, w, d);
      face(b, 'right', bu, bv + d, d, h);
      face(b, 'front', bu + d, bv + d, w, h);
      face(b, 'left', bu + d + w, bv + d, d, h);
      face(b, 'back', bu + 2 * d + w, bv + d, w, h);
    }
    cx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    const uv = new Map(places.map(([b, bu, bv]) => [b, [bu, bv]]));
    const M = {
      parts: parts.map(p => ({
        name: p.name,
        pivot: p.pivot,
        parent: p.parent,
        boxes: p.boxes.map(b => [...uv.get(b), b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5], b[6] || 0])
      }))
    };
    for (const p of M.parts) p.mesh = r.makeModelPart(p.boxes, TW, TH);
    r.models[key] = M;
    r.entityTex[key] = r.tex2D(cv, false);
    return key;
  }
  const hash = (i, j, k) => {
    const h = Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + j * 78.233 + k * 37.719) * 43758.5453;
    return h - Math.floor(h);
  };
  const FACE_N = {
    top: 1,
    bottom: 2,
    front: 3,
    back: 4,
    left: 5,
    right: 6
  };

  // ---- hats: on the head part (the player model's head pivot 0, 24, 0; the head 8 x 8 x 8 from y 0 to 8, its second
  // layer half a pixel out). Hidden under anything in the head slot ----
  // the straw hat copies X1aoZhe's (his premium skin, read from Mojang 2026-11-02): his straw is a checker of two
  // tones (#ECBF57 / #D8B45E), the top woven in a spiral (SPIRAL is his 8 x 8 hat top), a dark red band (#8A1E1E /
  // #701515) a row up from the brim, and the brim sticking out round the head - here made a real brim and crown
  const SL = '#ECBF57',
    SD = '#D8B45E';

  // the lantern spirit (移动光源, 11-13): a little iron lantern with two eyes in its warm glass and a handle on top,
  // always afloat by its owner's shoulder, swaying and leaning back as it follows; it glows (drawn lit by itself, a

  PETS.lantern = [{

  // pets that float by the shoulder all the time; pets that light themselves (block light 0-1, flickering)
  const PET_FLOAT = {

    };
  const PET_SCALE = 0.85,
    PET_MAX = 20,
    PET_FAR = 32;
  const model = (r, kind, id) => buildModel(r, 'cos_' + kind + '_' + id, (kind === 'hat' ? HATS : PETS)[id]);

  // ---- name prefixes: a character of their own in the text, drawn as the icon (Font.render below) ----
  const PRES = {
    potato: {
      ch: ''
    }
  };
  // vanilla's potato item, copied out of the block / item texture strip once it is loaded
  let potCv = null;
  function potato() {
    if (potCv) return potCv;
    const r = window.game && window.game.renderer;
    if (!r || !r.stripCanvas || typeof ITEM_KEY === 'undefined' || ITEM_KEY.potato === undefined) return null;
    const [sx, sy] = r.tileXY(ITEMS[ITEM_KEY.potato].tex);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = cv.height = 16;
    cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(r.stripCanvas, sx, sy, 16, 16, 0, 0, 16, 16);
    return potCv = cv;
  }
  const PRE_IMG = {
    '': potato
  };
  // the name as shown (name tags, the room's player list, chat): with the icon in front when the player wears one
  function prefixed(g, e, nm, look) {
    const s = String(nm),
      l = look || lookOf(g, e),
      p = l && hasKey(PRES, l.pre) && PRES[l.pre];
    return p && !s.startsWith(p.ch) ? p.ch + s : s;
  }
  function tagName(g, e, nm) {
    if (!g || !e || e !== g.player && e.type !== 'player' || !shown(g, e)) return nm;
    return prefixed(g, e, nm);
  }
  // by name alone (chat lines, the room's list): this player's own, or another's from what the room said
  function preName(g, nm) {
    if (!g || !nm) return nm;
    const me = g.net && g.net.name || typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && Account.name;
    if (nm === me) return shown(g, g.player) ? prefixed(g, g.player, nm) : nm;
    if (!shown(g, null)) return nm;
    const e = (g.entities || []).find(x => x.type === 'player' && x.name === nm);
    const l = e && e.look || g.net && g.net.looks && g.net.looks.get(nm) || null;
    return l ? prefixed(g, e, nm, l) : nm;
  }
  // the font draws a prefix character as its icon: the text either side as usual, the icon (untinted, like the
  // emoji; not in the shadow) in the 9-pixel space it takes
  (() => {
    const R0 = Font.render,
      cache = new Map(),
      CH = Object.keys(PRE_IMG),
      RE = new RegExp('([' + CH.join('') + '])');
    Font.render = function (str, color) {
      const s = String(str);
      if (!CH.some(c => s.includes(c))) return R0.call(this, s, color);
      const key = color + (this.noEmo ? '\u0001' : '\u0000') + s;
      let cv = cache.get(key);
      if (cv) return cv;
      const cell = window.FONT_MC.cell;
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.width(s) * 2) + 2);
      cv.height = cell;
      const x = cv.getContext('2d');
      x.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      let px = 0,
        ready = true;
      for (const part of s.split(RE)) {
        if (!part) continue;
        if (PRE_IMG[part]) {
          const im = PRE_IMG[part]();
          if (!im) ready = false;else if (!this.noEmo) x.drawImage(im, 0, 0, 16, 16, px + 1, 0, cell - 1, cell - 1);
          px += this.charW(part) * 2;
        } else {
          x.drawImage(R0.call(this, part, color), px, 0);
          px += this.width(part) * 2;
        }
      }
      // (kept once the icon could be drawn)
      if (ready) {
        cache.set(key, cv);
        if (cache.size > 200) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
      }
      return cv;
    };
  })();

  // ---- drawn with the player model (capes.js Capes.draw: game.js drawMob, the inventory and wardrobe previews) ----
  function drawOn(g, e, m, poses, lt, env, opts) {
    if (!shown(g, e, opts)) return;
    const r = g.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      cull = gl.isEnabled(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    try {
      const hat = worn(g, e, 'hat'),
        helmet = e.inv ? e.inv.slots[36] : (e.armorItems || [])[0];
      if (hat && !helmet) {
        const k = model(r, 'hat', hat);
        r.drawModel(k, k, m, {
          head: poses && poses.head
        }, lt, env, opts || {});
      }
      // the wardrobe's turning preview: the pet standing by the feet
      const pet = opts && opts.inv && e === g.player && typeof Skins !== 'undefined' && Skins.preview() && worn(g, e, 'pet');
      if (pet) {
        const k = model(r, 'pet', pet),
          mm = M4.copy(m),
          now = performance.now();
        if (PET_FLOAT[pet]) M4.translate(mm, 0.5, 1.15 + Math.sin(now / 500) * 0.05, -0.1);else M4.translate(mm, 0.45, Math.abs(Math.sin(now / 300)) * 0.05, -0.1);
        M4.scale(mm, PET_SCALE, PET_SCALE, PET_SCALE);
        r.drawModel(k, k, mm, petPose(null, now, pet), PET_GLOW[pet] ? glowLight(lt, now) : lt, env, opts);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (g.reportError) g.reportError('decoration', err, true);
    } finally {
      if (cull) gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    }
  }

  // ---- pets following their owners ----
  // A pet's state lives on its owner (e.cosPet), eased each frame: on the ground it keeps behind and to one side,
  // a block or so away, hopping while it moves, standing still it bobs and now and then waves; with the owner in the
  // air (flying, gliding, swimming, or no floor within 3 blocks) it floats by the shoulder. Left far behind (a
  // teleport) it is simply put there
  const solidAt = (w, x, y, z) => {
    const b = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z))];
    return !!(b && b.solid);
  };
  // the floor under (x, z) from a block above y to 3 below: a solid block with room above it
  function floorAt(w, x, y, z) {
    for (let yy = Math.floor(y + 1); yy >= Math.floor(y) - 3; yy--) if (!solidAt(w, x, yy, z) && solidAt(w, x, yy - 1, z)) return yy;
    return null;
  }
  // (lit by itself: block light near full, a slow flicker in it; the sky's light as it is)
  const glowLight = (lt, now) => [lt ? lt[0] : 1, 0.88 + 0.08 * Math.sin(now / 130) * Math.sin(now / 370) + 0.04 * Math.sin(now / 53)];
  function petPose(S, now, id) {
    const t = now / 1000,
      wave = S && S.wave > 0 ? Math.sin(S.wave * 12) * 0.5 + 0.9 : 0;
    // the lantern: swaying a little, leaning back as it hurries after its owner; the handle swinging the other way
    if (id === 'lantern') {
      const sway = Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.07,
        lean = S ? Math.min(0.4, (S.speed || 0) * 0.09) : 0;
      return {
        body: {
          rx: lean,
          rz: sway
        },
        handle: {
          rz: -sway * 0.8
        }
      };
    }
    return {
      head: {
        ry: Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.25,
        rz: Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.06
      },
      rarm: {
        rz: 0.35 + wave + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.05
      },
      larm: {
        rz: -0.35 - Math.sin(t * 2 + 1) * 0.05
      }
    };
  }
  function drawPet(g, e, a, env, now, id) {
    var _ref, _e$bodyYaw;
    const r = g.renderer,
      w = g.world,
      ip = e.ipos(a),
      me = e === g.player;
    const S = e.cosPet || (e.cosPet = {
      pos: null,
      t: now,
      yaw: 0,
      hop: 0,
      hopAmt: 0,
      idle: 0,
      wave: 0,
      side: Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1
    });
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, Math.max(0, (now - S.t) / 1000));
    S.t = now;
    const by = me && g.playerBodyYaw ? g.playerBodyYaw(a) : (_ref = (_e$bodyYaw = e.bodyYaw) !== null && _e$bodyYaw !== void 0 ? _e$bodyYaw : e.yaw) !== null && _ref !== void 0 ? _ref : 0;
    const fw = [-Math.sin(by), -Math.cos(by)],
      rt = [Math.cos(by), -Math.sin(by)];
    const below = floorAt(w, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    const air = !!PET_FLOAT[id] || !!(e.flying || e.gliding || e.swimming || e.netSwim || me && e.inWater) || below === null;
    let tx, ty, tz;
    if (air) {
      // (by the left shoulder - the right is where the AI companion floats, companion.js place(); in first person
      // further back, out of the way of the view)
      const back = me && g.perspective === 0 ? 0.6 : 0.15,
        low = e.gliding || e.swimming || e.netSwim;
      tx = ip[0] - rt[0] * 0.8 - fw[0] * back;
      tz = ip[2] - rt[1] * 0.8 - fw[1] * back;
      ty = ip[1] + (low ? 0.3 : 1.3);
    } else {
      let fy = null;
      for (const [b, s] of [[0.9, 0.6 * S.side], [0.9, 0], [0, 0]]) {
        tx = ip[0] - fw[0] * b + rt[0] * s;
        tz = ip[2] - fw[1] * b + rt[1] * s;
        fy = floorAt(w, tx, ip[1], tz);
        if (fy !== null) break;
      }
      // (on the owner's level - a slab, a path - it stands where the owner stands)
      ty = fy === null ? ip[1] : Math.abs(fy - ip[1]) < 0.6 ? ip[1] : fy;
    }
    if (!S.pos || S.world !== w || Math.hypot(tx - S.pos[0], ty - S.pos[1], tz - S.pos[2]) > 12) {
      S.pos = [tx, ty, tz];
      S.world = w;
    }
    const P = S.pos,
      ox = P[0],
      oz = P[2],
      d = Math.hypot(tx - ox, tz - oz);
    // on the ground it sets off once more than half a block from its place and goes all the way (no creeping)
    if (air || d > 0.5) S.going = true;else if (d < 0.08) S.going = false;
    if (S.going) {
      const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (air ? 4 : 5));
      P[0] += (tx - P[0]) * k;
      P[2] += (tz - P[2]) * k;
    }
    P[1] += (ty - P[1]) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * (air ? 4 : 12)));
    const sp = dt > 0 ? Math.hypot(P[0] - ox, P[2] - oz) / dt : 0,
      moving = sp > 0.3;
    S.speed = (S.speed || 0) + (sp - (S.speed || 0)) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));
    // facing where it goes, else its owner
    const want = moving ? Math.atan2(-(P[0] - ox), -(P[2] - oz)) : Math.atan2(-(ip[0] - P[0]), -(ip[2] - P[2]));
    let dy = want - S.yaw;
    dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(dy), Math.cos(dy));
    S.yaw += dy * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 8));
    S.hopAmt += ((moving && !air ? 1 : 0) - S.hopAmt) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 8));
    if (S.hopAmt > 0.01) S.hop += dt * 8;
    S.idle = moving ? 0 : S.idle + dt;
    if (S.wave > 0) S.wave -= dt;else if (!air && S.idle > 3 && Math.random() < dt * 0.15) S.wave = 1.2;
    const t = now / 1000,
      hopY = Math.abs(Math.sin(S.hop)) * 0.2 * S.hopAmt;
    const y = P[1] + hopY + (air ? Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.06 : 0);
    // (too close to the camera to be anything but in the way)
    if (me && g.perspective === 0 && Math.hypot(P[0] - r.camPos[0], y + 0.3 - r.camPos[1], P[2] - r.camPos[2]) < 0.6) return;
    if (!aabbInFrustum(r.planes, P[0] - 0.4, y, P[2] - 0.4, P[0] + 0.4, y + 0.7, P[2] + 0.4)) return;
    const sq = air ? 1 : 1 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.025 * (1 - S.hopAmt) - Math.cos(S.hop * 2) * 0.05 * S.hopAmt;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, P[0], y, P[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, S.yaw);
    M4.scale(m, PET_SCALE / Math.sqrt(sq), PET_SCALE * sq, PET_SCALE / Math.sqrt(sq));
    const L = w.getLight(Math.floor(P[0]), Math.floor(y + 0.3), Math.floor(P[2]));
    let lt = L ? [(L >> 4) / 15, (L & 15) / 15] : e.lightAt();
    if (PET_GLOW[id]) lt = glowLight(lt, now);
    // (where it is, for its light - Cosmetics.lights)
    S.glow = PET_GLOW[id] ? [P[0], y + 0.3, P[2]] : null;
    S.glowT = now;
    const k = model(r, 'pet', id);
    r.drawModel(k, k, m, petPose(S, now, id), lt, env, {});
    if (!air && hopY < 0.5) r.drawShadow(P[0], P[1], P[2], 0.28, 0.45 * (1 - hopY * 2));
  }
  // (an invisible owner's pet would give them away - the potion, or a server's flag, as game.js drawMob reads it)
  const hidden = e => !!(e.invisible || e.hasEffect && e.hasEffect('invisibility'));
  function drawPets(g, a, env) {
    const p = g.player,
      now = performance.now(),
      list = [];
    if (p && !p.dead && !(p.deathTime > 0) && g.mode !== 'spectator' && !hidden(p) && shown(g, p)) {
      const id = worn(g, p, 'pet');
      if (id) list.push([p, id]);
    }
    if (p && othersPets(g)) {
      const near = [];
      for (const e of g.entities) {
        if (e.type !== 'player' || e === p || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0 || hidden(e)) continue;
        const id = worn(g, e, 'pet');
        if (!id) continue;
        const dd = Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - p.pos[0], e.pos[1] - p.pos[1], e.pos[2] - p.pos[2]);
        if (dd <= PET_FAR) near.push([dd, e, id]);
      }
      near.sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]);
      for (const [, e, id] of near.slice(0, PET_MAX)) list.push([e, id]);
    }
    if (!list.length) return;
    const gl = g.renderer.gl;
    gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    for (const [e, id] of list) try {
      drawPet(g, e, a, env, now, id);
    } catch (err) {
      g.reportError('pet', err, true);
    }
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  }
  // (with the entities, before the companion and the name tags: the tags don't write depth, so a pet drawn after
  // them would paint over one in front of it; and still recording, so the shader pack's shadow map has the pets.
  // Once a frame - the first-person shadow pass calls drawMob itself)
  (() => {
    const de = Game.prototype.drawEntityList;
    Game.prototype.drawEntityList = function (list, a, env, cam) {
      de.call(this, list, a, env, cam);
      if (this.state === 'play' && this.world && this.player) try {
        drawPets(this, a, env);
      } catch (err) {
        this.reportError('pets', err, true);
      }
    };
  })();

  // ---- icons on menus (the wardrobe, the sign-in card): any decoration id, size pixels square ----
  const ICONS = {
    straw: {
      pal: {
        L: SL,
        D: SD,
        R: '#8A1E1E',
        r: '#701515',

      },
      rows: ['................', '................', '................', '................', '.....LDLDLD.....', '....LDLDLDLD....', '....DLDLDLDL....', '....LDLDLDLD....', '....RrRRrRRr....', '....DLDLDLDL....', '.LDLDLDLDLDLDLD.', 'LDLDLDLDLDLDLDLD', '.bbbbbbbbbbbbbb.', '................', '................', '................']
    },
    tophat: {
      pal: {

        g: '#5A5A68',
        R: '#9A1A2C',
        r: '#7A1020',
        s: '#0E0E12'
      },
      rows: ['................', '.....gggggg.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....KkKKKK.....', '.....RRRRRR.....', '.....rrrrrr.....', '..gggggggggggg..', '.KKKKKKKKKKKKKK.', '..ssssssssssss..', '................', '................', '................']
    },
    crown: {
      pal: {
        y: '#FFF2A0',
        G: GOLD,
        L: GOLD_L,
        d: GOLD_D,
        R: '#E0303A',
        B: '#3A6AE0',
        E: '#2FC46A'
      },
      rows: ['................', '................', '................', '..y....yy....y..', '..G...GGGG...G..', '..GG..GRRG..GG..', '..GGGGGGGGGGGG..', '..LLLLLLLLLLLL..', '..GBGGGRRGGGEG..', '..GBGGGRRGGGEG..', '..GGGGGGGGGGGG..', '..dddddddddddd..', '................', '................', '................', '................']
    },
    snowman: {
      pal: {
        W: '#F4F8FF',
        S: '#C5D0DE',
        k: COAL,
        o: '#F08A24',
        R: '#D23A3A',
        t: '#6B4A2B'
      },
      rows: ['................', '......WWWW......', '.....WWWWWW.....', '.....WkWWkW.....', '.....WWWWooo....', '.....WkWkWW.....', '......WkWW......', '....RRRRRRRR....', '..t.WWWWWRWW.t..', '...tWWWkWRWWt...', '....WWWWWRWW....', '....WWWkWWWW....', '....WWWWWWWW....', '.....SSSSSS.....', '................', '................']
    },
    // (11-13) the chef's hat, the lantern spirit
    chef: {
      pal: {
        W: '#FFFFFF',
        s: '#D8D8E2',
        p: '#E6E6EE',
        d: '#B8B8C4',
        g: '#5DAA3C',
        G: '#3E8A2A'
      },
      rows: ['................', '.....WW..WW.....', '...WWWWWWWWWW...', '..WWWWWWWWWWWW..', '..WWWWWWWWWWWW..', '..WsWWWWWWWWsW..', '...ssWWWWWWss...', '....ssssssss....', '....WgWWWWWW....', '....WGgWpWpW....', '....WWpWpWpW....', '....pWpWpWpW....', '....dddddddd....', '................', '................', '................']
    },
    lantern: {
      pal: {
        k: '#55555F',
        K: '#33333B',
        y: '#FFC24A',
        Y: '#FFE08A',
        W: '#FFF6D0',
        e: '#5A3A10',
        m: '#B0601A',
        b: '#FFB08A'
      },
      rows: ['................', '......kkkk......', '......k..k......', '....KKKKKKKK....', '.....KKKKKK.....', '....kyyyyyyk....', '....kYYYYYYk....', '....kYeYYeYk....', '....kbYWWYbk....', '....kYYmmYYk....', '....kyYWWYyk....', '....kyyyyyyk....', '....KKKKKKKK....', '.....KKKKKK.....', '................', '................']
    }
  };
  const grey = c => {
    const n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16),
      l = Math.round(((n >> 16 & 255) * 0.3 + (n >> 8 & 255) * 0.59 + (n & 255) * 0.11) * 0.5 + 20);
    return 'rgb(' + l + ',' + l + ',' + l + ')';
  };
  function drawPix(c, art, x, y, size, locked) {
    const n = art.rows.length,
      s = size / n;
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) for (let i = 0; i < art.rows[j].length; i++) {
      const col = art.pal[art.rows[j][i]];
      if (!col) continue;
      const x0 = Math.floor(x + i * s),
        y0 = Math.floor(y + j * s);
      c.fillStyle = locked ? grey(col) : col;
      c.fillRect(x0, y0, Math.floor(x + (i + 1) * s) - x0, Math.floor(y + (j + 1) * s) - y0);
    }
  }
  function drawIcon(c, id, x, y, size, locked) {
    const [kind, v] = String(id || '').split(':');
    c.save();
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    try {
      if (kind === 'cape' && typeof Capes !== 'undefined') {
        const s = size / 16;
        Capes.drawFlat(c, v, Math.round(x + (size - 10 * s) / 2), y, s, locked);
      } else if (kind === 'pre') {
        const im = hasKey(PRES, v) && PRE_IMG[PRES[v].ch]();
        if (im) {
          if (locked) c.globalAlpha = 0.35;
          c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, 16, 16, x, y, size, size);
        }
      } else if (hasKey(ICONS, v)) drawPix(c, ICONS[v], x, y, size, locked);
    } finally {
      c.restore();
    }
  }

  // the wardrobe (skins.js WardrobeScreen) on a tab: 'skin' 'cape' 'hat' 'pet' 'pre' (or a decoration's id)
  function openWardrobe(game, parent, kind) {
    const s = new WardrobeScreen(game, parent);
    const k = String(kind || '').split(':')[0];
    if (['skin', 'cape', 'hat', 'pet', 'pre'].includes(k)) s.tab = k;
    game.ui.open(s);
    return s;
  }

  // the lights pets give (the lantern spirit): this player's, drawn within the last second - for the 移动光源 mod
  // (game/mods/dynlights: a light of its own while 移动光源 is on in the world)
  function lights(g) {
    const p = g && g.player,
      S = p && p.cosPet;
    if (!S || !S.glow || performance.now() - (S.glowT || 0) > 1000) return [];
    return [{
      key: S,
      x: S.glow[0],
      y: S.glow[1],
      z: S.glow[2],
      L: 12
    }];
  }
  return {
    LIST,
    KIND,
    info,
    name,
    lights,
    owned,
    has,
    shown,
    lookOf,
    worn,
    mine,
    drawOn,
    drawIcon,
    openWardrobe,
    tagName,
    preName,
    PRE_CHAR: PRES.potato.ch,
    preChar: v => hasKey(PRES, v) ? PRES[v].ch : ''
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/news.js ==== */
'use strict';

// 公告：主界面的吊牌、掉下来的公告板、超级管理员的编辑（game/COMMUNITY_PLAN.md）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The news board: a hanging sign beside the logo on the title screen that swings a little more, glows and shows a
// red count while there is news the player hasn't read. Tapped, its chains snap, it falls to the middle of the
// screen, bounces twice and opens into the board. The list comes from the room service (GET /api/news) and is kept
// in this browser for offline. Super administrators write, publish and delete from the board itself.
// (the sign's place is shared with the check-in button under it, checkin.js: NewsBoard.signRect / checkinRect)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const NewsBoard = {
  list: null,
  adminList: null,
  ver: 0,
  lastFetch: 0,
  loading: false,
  pending: null,
  err: '',
  wood: null,
  seenV: null,
  autoId: '',
  load() {
    try {
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-news') || 'null');
      if (s && Array.isArray(s.list)) this.list = s.list;
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  isSuper() {
    return typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && !!(Account.data && Account.data.super);
  },
  // the newest publication time the player has seen (kept in memory too: read every frame for the sign)
  seen() {
    if (this.seenV === null) {
      try {
        this.seenV = +localStorage.getItem('mcjs-news-seen') || 0;
      } catch (e) {
        this.seenV = 0;
      }
    }
    return this.seenV;
  },
  markSeen() {
    const n = Math.max(0, ...(this.list || []).filter(x => !x.draft).map(x => x.at || 0));
    if (n <= this.seen()) return;
    this.seenV = n;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mcjs-news-seen', String(n));
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  unread() {
    const s = this.seen();
    return (this.list || []).filter(x => !x.draft && (x.at || 0) > s);
  },
  // the published list (anyone; logged in or not); force: once more after a fetch already on the way (after a save).
  // quiet: the title screen's own refreshes go by one plain fetch, nothing reported - Account.api sends net_fail with
  // the statistics, and a device that can't reach the service would add one every title open and every 5 minutes
  // (as checkin.js quiet())
  fetch(force, quiet) {
    if (this.pending) return force ? this.pending.then(() => this.fetch()) : this.pending;
    if (typeof RoomService === 'undefined' || !RoomService.base() || typeof Account === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve();
    this.loading = true;
    this.lastFetch = performance.now();
    const get = async () => {
      if (!quiet) return Account.api('/api/news');
      let f;
      try {
        f = await fetch(RoomService.base() + '/api/news');
      } catch (e) {
        throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
      }
      let j;
      try {
        j = await f.json();
      } catch (e) {
        j = {
          error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
        };
      }
      if (!f.ok || j.error) throw new Error(j.error || 'HTTP ' + f.status);
      return j;
    };
    return this.pending = (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await get();
        this.list = (r.list || []).filter(x => !x.draft);
        this.err = '';
        this.ver++;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('mcjs-news', JSON.stringify({
            list: this.list,
            at: Date.now()
          }));
        } catch (e) {}
      } catch (e) {
        this.err = e.message;
      }
      this.loading = false;
      this.pending = null;
    })();
  },
  // drafts included (super administrators)
  async fetchAdmin() {
    if (!this.isSuper()) return;
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/news/list');
      this.adminList = r.list || [];
      this.ver++;
    } catch (e) {
      this.err = e.message;
    }
  },
  // a paragraph with **bold** in it, wrapped to w: lines of runs [{ t, b }] (an unpaired ** stays as it is)
  rich(para, w) {
    const runs = [],
      parts = String(para).split('**');
    if (parts.length % 2 === 0) parts[parts.length - 2] += '**' + parts.pop();
    parts.forEach((t, i) => {
      if (t) runs.push({
        t,
        b: i % 2 === 1
      });
    });
    const lines = [];
    let line = [],
      lw = 0;
    for (const r of runs) for (const ch of r.t) {
      const cw = Font.width(ch);
      if (lw + cw > w && line.length) {
        lines.push(line);
        line = [];
        lw = 0;
      }
      const last = line[line.length - 1];
      if (last && last.b === r.b) last.t += ch;else line.push({
        t: ch,
        b: r.b
      });
      lw += cw;
    }
    if (line.length) lines.push(line);
    return lines;
  },
  plain(t) {
    return String(t || '').replace(/\*\*/g, '');
  },
  sorted(l) {
    return (l || []).slice().sort((a, b) => !!b.pin - !!a.pin || (b.at || 0) - (a.at || 0));
  },
  // Beijing time: 11月06日 18:30 (the year only when it isn't this one)
  date(at) {
    const p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'),
      d = new Date((at || 0) + 8 * 3600e3),
      y = new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 3600e3).getUTCFullYear();
    return (d.getUTCFullYear() !== y ? d.getUTCFullYear() + '年' : '') + `${p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}月${p(d.getUTCDate())}日 ${p(d.getUTCHours())}:${p(d.getUTCMinutes())}`;
  },
  // an important announcement the player hasn't seen drops by itself, once
  autoItem() {
    const l = (this.list || []).filter(x => !x.draft);
    if (!l.length) return null;
    const n = l.reduce((a, b) => (b.at || 0) > (a.at || 0) ? b : a);
    if (!n.imp || (n.at || 0) <= this.seen() || this.autoId === String(n.id)) return null;
    let done = '';
    try {
      done = localStorage.getItem('mcjs-news-auto') || '';
    } catch (e) {}
    return done === String(n.id) ? null : n;
  },
  autoDone(n) {
    this.autoId = String(n.id);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mcjs-news-auto', String(n.id));
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  // no falling board: the low preset, or the player asks the browser for less motion
  noAnim(g) {
    const s = g && g.settings || {};
    if (s.newsAnim === false || (s.preset === 'auto' ? s.autoPreset : s.preset) === 'low') return true;
    try {
      return matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  },
  open(g, parent, auto) {
    if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count(auto ? 'news_auto' : 'news_open');
    g.ui.open(new NewsScreen(g, parent, {
      auto
    }));
  },
  // ---- the sign on the title screen ----
  // top right, under the unlock button (chains from its bottom) or hanging from the top edge; on narrow screens the
  // logo takes the whole top, so under the logo, right of the menu buttons. top = where the chains start
  // (in between, 380-503 wide - 1280x720 / 1366x768 windows: the splash text, w/2+123 at -20 degrees, reaches about
  // w/2+190 at y 40-68 and was hidden behind the sign: under it then, on short chains like the narrow one - long ones
  // from the top would cross the splash)
  signRect(ui) {
    const unlock = typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && Account.allUnlocked && !Account.allUnlocked();
    if (ui.w / 2 + 190 <= ui.w - 62) return {
      x: ui.w - 60,
      y: 26,
      w: 54,
      h: 36,
      top: unlock ? 22 : 0
    };
    if (ui.w / 2 + 128 <= ui.w - 62) return {
      x: ui.w - 60,
      y: 72,
      w: 54,
      h: 36,
      top: 66
    };
    // (as wide as the room right of the menu buttons allows - they end at w/2+100 - not just right of the logo: at
    // 320 wide that was a 30 x 20 sign, too small to notice)
    const w = Math.max(30, Math.min(54, Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - 112))),
      h = Math.round(w * 2 / 3);
    return {
      x: ui.w - 6 - w,
      y: 88,
      w,
      h,
      top: 82
    };
  },
  // the check-in button's place, right under the sign (for checkin.js)
  checkinRect(ui) {
    const r = this.signRect(ui);
    return {
      x: r.x,
      y: r.y + r.h + 4,
      w: r.w,
      h: 16
    };
  },
  // the chains count too; a little wider for fingers (never down onto the check-in button)
  hitRect(ui, g) {
    const r = this.signRect(ui),
      touch = typeof touchOn === 'function' && g && touchOn(g) || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0,
      m = touch ? 8 : 2;
    return {
      x: r.x - m,
      y: r.top,
      w: r.w + m * 2,
      h: r.y + r.h - r.top + 3
    };
  },
  // where the board is now: it swings about the chains' top (more while there's news)
  pose(ui, now) {
    const r = this.signRect(ui),
      hot = this.unread().length > 0,
      t = now / 1000;
    const ang = Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2 / 3.4) * (hot ? 0.06 : 0.022) + (hot ? Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2 / 1.3) * 0.01 : 0);
    const px = r.x + r.w / 2,
      py = r.top,
      d = r.y + r.h / 2 - r.top;
    return {
      cx: px - Math.sin(ang) * d,
      cy: py + Math.cos(ang) * d,
      w: r.w,
      h: r.h,
      ang,
      chain: r.y - r.top,
      px,
      py
    };
  },
  drawSign(ui, g, now) {
    const p = this.pose(ui, now),
      n = this.unread().length;
    this.drawBoard(ui, g, {
      ...p,
      k: 1,
      hover: ui.hit(this.hitRect(ui, g)),
      glow: n ? 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(now / 1000 * Math.PI * 2 / 1.4) : 0,
      badge: n
    });
  },
  // dark oak planks, tiled once into a canvas big enough for the open board (copied from, never pattern-filled on
  // the screen: see UI.tiled)
  woodTex(g) {
    if (this.wood) return this.wood;
    const r = g && g.renderer;
    if (!r || !r.stripCanvas || typeof T !== 'function') return null;
    const t = document.createElement('canvas');
    t.width = 16;
    t.height = 16;
    t.getContext('2d').drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(T('dark_oak_planks')), 16, 16, 0, 0, 16, 16);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = 640;
    cv.height = 480;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d');
    x.fillStyle = x.createPattern(t, 'repeat');
    x.fillRect(0, 0, 640, 480);
    return this.wood = cv;
  },
  // a hanging chain, drawn up from the board (y1) to y0: links facing us (rings) and edge-on in turn
  chain(c, x, y0, y1) {
    for (let y = y1 - 4, i = 0; y + 4 > y0; y -= 4, i++) {
      const top = Math.max(y, y0),
        hh = y + 4 - top;
      if (i % 2 === 0) {
        c.fillStyle = '#9AA2B3';
        c.fillRect(x - 1, top, 1, hh);
        c.fillStyle = '#4B505C';
        c.fillRect(x + 1, top, 1, hh);
        c.fillStyle = '#6F7786';
        if (y >= y0) c.fillRect(x, y, 1, 1);
        c.fillRect(x, y + 3, 1, 1);
      } else {
        c.fillStyle = '#5E6574';
        c.fillRect(x, top, 1, hh);
        c.fillStyle = '#A9B1C1';
        c.fillRect(x, top + (hh > 2 ? 1 : 0), 1, 1);
      }
    }
  },
  // the board centred on (cx, cy), turned by ang, scaled by k: chains above it, glow, planks, border, 「公告」, badge
  drawBoard(ui, g, o) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      w = o.w,
      h = o.h,
      x = -w / 2,
      y = -h / 2,
      wood = this.woodTex(g),
      a0 = c.globalAlpha;
    c.save();
    c.translate(o.cx, o.cy);
    c.rotate(o.ang || 0);
    c.scale(o.k || 1, o.k || 1);
    if (o.chain > 0) {
      var _o$chainA;
      c.globalAlpha = a0 * ((_o$chainA = o.chainA) !== null && _o$chainA !== void 0 ? _o$chainA : 1);
      this.chain(c, x + 8, y - o.chain, y);
      this.chain(c, x + w - 9, y - o.chain, y);
      c.globalAlpha = a0;
    }
    if (o.glow > 0) {
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 5; i >= 1; i--) {
        c.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,196,64,${(o.glow * 0.55 * (6 - i) / 5).toFixed(3)})`;
        c.strokeRect(x - i + 0.5, y - i + 0.5, w + 2 * i - 1, h + 2 * i - 1);
      }
    }
    if (wood) c.drawImage(wood, 0, 0, w, h, x, y, w, h);else {
      c.fillStyle = '#3B2614';
      c.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
    }
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeStyle = '#140A04';
    c.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, h - 1);
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.32)';
    c.strokeRect(x + 1.5, y + 1.5, w - 3, h - 3);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)';
    c.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, 1);
    c.fillStyle = '#2A2D34';
    c.fillRect(x + 7, y + 1, 3, 2);
    c.fillRect(x + w - 10, y + 1, 3, 2); // where the chains hold
    if (o.glow > 0) {
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,210,100,${(o.glow * 0.22).toFixed(3)})`;
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2);
    }
    if (o.hover) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2);
    }
    if (o.label !== false) {
      const ts = w >= 44 && h >= 26 ? 2 : 1;
      c.save();
      c.scale(ts, ts);
      Font.center(c, '公告', 0, -4, o.hover ? '#FFFFFF' : '#FFF0C8');
      c.restore();
    }
    if (o.badge) {
      // (an exclamation mark, not a count: "有新公告" is all it has to say - the user, 2026-11-02)
      const s = '!',
        bw = Math.max(10, Font.width(s) + 4),
        bx = Math.round(x + w - bw + 4),
        by = Math.round(y - 5);
      c.fillStyle = '#6E0000';
      c.fillRect(bx, by + 1, bw, 9);
      c.fillRect(bx + 1, by, bw - 2, 11);
      c.fillStyle = '#E8262B';
      c.fillRect(bx + 1, by + 1, bw - 2, 9);
      Font.draw(c, s, bx + Math.round((bw - Font.width(s)) / 2), by + 2, '#FFFFFF', false);
    }
    c.restore();
  }
}

// the title screen: refresh when it opens and every 5 minutes, the sign, a tap on it, the important one dropping
(() => {
  const lay = TitleScreen.prototype.layout,
    dx = TitleScreen.prototype.drawExtra,
    md = TitleScreen.prototype.mouseDown;
  TitleScreen.prototype.layout = function (...a) {
    const r = lay.apply(this, a);
    if (!this.newsT) {
      this.newsT = performance.now();
      if (!NewsBoard.lastFetch || this.newsT - NewsBoard.lastFetch > 20e3) NewsBoard.fetch(false, true);
    }
    return r;
  };
  TitleScreen.prototype.drawExtra = function (ui) {
    dx.call(this, ui);
    const now = performance.now(),
      g = this.game,
      ns = ui.screen;
    if (ns === this) {
      if (NewsBoard.lastFetch && now - NewsBoard.lastFetch > 300e3) NewsBoard.fetch(false, true);
      const a = !this.newsAuto && now - (this.newsT || now) > 1000 && NewsBoard.autoItem();
      if (a) {
        this.newsAuto = true;
        NewsBoard.autoDone(a);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (g.ui.screen === this) NewsBoard.open(g, this, true);
        }, 0);
      }
    }
    // (the board is down: the news screen draws it)
    if (typeof NewsScreen !== 'undefined' && ns instanceof NewsScreen && ns.parent === this && ns.from) return;
    NewsBoard.drawSign(ui, g, now);
  };
  TitleScreen.prototype.mouseDown = function (ui, mx, my, b) {
    if (b === 0 && ui.hit(NewsBoard.hitRect(ui, this.game), mx, my)) {
      Sound.init && Sound.init();
      NewsBoard.open(this.game, this, false);
      return;
    }
    return md.call(this, ui, mx, my, b);
  };
})();

// ---- the board, open ----
// fall 0.34 s, two bounces (0.17 s, 0.10 s), then it grows into the panel (0.22 s); closing: shrink, fly back up
const NEWS_T = {
  fall: 340,
  b1: 170,
  b2: 100,
  grow: 220,
  shrink: 120,
  fly: 260
};
NEWS_T.drop = NEWS_T.fall + NEWS_T.b1 + NEWS_T.b2;
const newsEase = u => 1 - Math.pow(1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, u)), 3);
const newsEaseIO = u => {
  u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, u));
  return u < 0.5 ? 2 * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 2) / 2;
};
class NewsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, opts = {}) {
    super(game, null);
    this.parent = parent || null;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.auto = !!opts.auto;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.rows = [];
    this.btns = [];
    this.contentH = 0;
    this.ver = -1;
    this.drag = null;
    this.del = null;
    this.msg = '';
    this.msgT = 0;
    this.busy = false;
    const now = performance.now();
    this.t0 = now;
    this.phase = 'open';
    this.openT = now;
    this.from = null;
    this.bits = [];
    if (typeof TitleScreen !== 'undefined' && parent instanceof TitleScreen && !NewsBoard.noAnim(game)) {
      const F = this.from = NewsBoard.pose(game.ui, now);
      this.phase = 'drop';
      this.snd = 0;
      Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.chain.break', null, 0.9, 1);
      // bits of chain flying off where the links broke
      for (const lx of [-F.w / 2 + 8, F.w / 2 - 9]) {
        const ly = F.chain / 2,
          X = F.px + lx * Math.cos(F.ang) - ly * Math.sin(F.ang),
          Y = F.py + lx * Math.sin(F.ang) + ly * Math.cos(F.ang);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.bits.push({
          x: X,
          y: Y,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70 + Math.sign(lx) * 12,
          vy: -20 - Math.random() * 50
        });
      }
    }
    // (seen from now on; the ones that were new keep their NEW mark while the board is open)
    this.seen0 = NewsBoard.seen();
    NewsBoard.markSeen();
    if (NewsBoard.isSuper()) NewsBoard.fetchAdmin();
    if (!NewsBoard.lastFetch || now - NewsBoard.lastFetch > 20e3) NewsBoard.fetch();
  }
  panel() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      w = Math.min(u.w - 12, 320),
      h = Math.min(u.h - 12, 400);
    return {
      x: Math.floor((u.w - w) / 2),
      y: Math.floor((u.h - h) / 2),
      w,
      h
    };
  }
  area() {
    const p = this.panel();
    return {
      x: p.x + 8,
      y: p.y + 28,
      w: p.w - 16,
      h: p.h - 36
    };
  }
  // how big the falling board gets
  boardK() {
    const F = this.from;
    return F ? Math.max(1, Math.min(2, this.panel().w * 0.4 / F.w)) : 1;
  }
  layout() {
    if (this.parent && this.parent.layout) this.parent.layout();
    const g = this.game,
      p = this.panel();
    // (×: hit 5 px round it - phones have no Esc, and a full-width panel leaves little to tap outside)
    this.widgets = [{
      x: p.x + p.w - 22,
      y: p.y + 6,
      w: 16,
      h: 16,
      pad: 5,
      label: '×',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    let bx = p.x + 6;
    if (typeof CheckinScreen !== 'undefined' && typeof Checkin !== 'undefined' && Checkin.shown()) {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: bx,
        y: p.y + 6,
        w: 56,
        h: 16,
        gold: true,
        label: '签到活动',
        onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CheckinScreen(g, this))
      });
      bx += 60;
    }
    if (NewsBoard.isSuper()) this.widgets.push({
      x: bx,
      y: p.y + 6,
      w: 36,
      h: 16,
      label: '新建',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new NewsEditScreen(g, this, null))
    });
    this.ver = -1; // (laid out again for the new width)
  }
  items() {
    return NewsBoard.sorted(NewsBoard.isSuper() && NewsBoard.adminList ? NewsBoard.adminList : NewsBoard.list);
  }
  // each announcement: title row, date row, the body wrapped to the width (its own line breaks kept)
  build() {
    this.ver = NewsBoard.ver;
    NewsBoard.markSeen();
    const W = this.area().w - 10;
    let y = 2;
    this.rows = [];
    for (const it of this.items()) {
      const lines = [];
      for (const para of String(it.body || '').split('\n')) {
        if (!para.trim()) lines.push(null);else lines.push(...NewsBoard.rich(para, W));
      }
      const gh = it.gift && typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.info(it.gift) ? 32 : 0; // (the gift's row)
      const r = {
        it,
        y,
        lines,
        gh,
        h: 23 + gh + lines.length * 10 + 2
      };
      this.rows.push(r);
      y += r.h + 8;
    }
    this.contentH = y;
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll, 0, this.maxScroll());
  }
  maxScroll() {
    return Math.max(0, this.contentH - this.area().h);
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.msg = t;
    this.msgBad = !!bad;
    this.msgT = performance.now();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const g = this.game,
      c = ui.ctx,
      now = performance.now(),
      N = NEWS_T;
    if (this.ver !== NewsBoard.ver) this.build();
    // the title screen behind, without hover on its buttons
    if (this.parent) {
      const mx = ui.mouse.x,
        my = ui.mouse.y;
      ui.mouse.x = -1000;
      ui.mouse.y = -1000;
      this.parent.draw(ui);
      ui.mouse.x = mx;
      ui.mouse.y = my;
      if (ui.screen === this.parent) ui.screen = this; // (the title's scene thumbnail swaps ui.screen while it renders)
    } else ui.dim(0.5);
    const p = this.panel(),
      F = this.from,
      K = this.boardK(),
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      cy = ui.h / 2;
    if (this.phase === 'drop') {
      const t = now - this.t0;
      if (t >= N.drop + N.grow) {
        this.phase = 'open';
        this.openT = now;
      } else {
        ui.dim(0.5 * Math.min(1, t / N.drop));
        if (t < N.drop) {
          let x = cx,
            y = cy,
            ang = 0,
            k = K;
          if (t < N.fall) {
            const u = t / N.fall;
            x = F.cx + (cx - F.cx) * (1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u));
            y = F.cy + (cy - F.cy) * u * u;
            k = 1 + (K - 1) * u;
            ang = F.ang + (0.16 - F.ang) * u;
          } else if (t < N.fall + N.b1) {
            const u = (t - N.fall) / N.b1,
              H = Math.min(26, Math.max(0, cy - F.cy) * 0.22);
            y = cy - H * 4 * u * (1 - u);
            ang = 0.16 - 0.22 * u;
            if (this.snd < 1) {
              this.snd = 1;
              Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.wood.fall', null, 1, 1);
            }
          } else {
            const u = (t - N.fall - N.b1) / N.b2,
              H = Math.min(8, Math.max(0, cy - F.cy) * 0.07);
            y = cy - H * 4 * u * (1 - u);
            ang = -0.06 * (1 - u);
            if (this.snd < 2) {
              this.snd = 2;
              Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.wood.fall', null, 0.5, 1.15);
            }
          }
          // the broken chains: what stays up there fades, a piece falls with the board, bits fly off
          if (F.chain > 3 && t < 400) {
            c.save();
            c.globalAlpha = 1 - t / 400;
            c.translate(F.px, F.py);
            c.rotate(F.ang);
            NewsBoard.chain(c, -F.w / 2 + 8, 0, F.chain / 2);
            NewsBoard.chain(c, F.w / 2 - 9, 0, F.chain / 2);
            c.restore();
          }
          if (t < 500) {
            const s = t / 1000;
            c.globalAlpha = 1 - t / 500;
            c.fillStyle = '#A9B1C1';
            for (const b of this.bits) c.fillRect(b.x + b.vx * s, b.y + b.vy * s + 200 * s * s, 1, 1);
            c.globalAlpha = 1;
          }
          NewsBoard.drawBoard(ui, g, {
            cx: x,
            cy: y,
            w: F.w,
            h: F.h,
            ang,
            k,
            chain: F.chain > 3 ? Math.min(8, F.chain / 2) : 0,
            chainA: Math.max(0, 1 - t / N.fall)
          });
        } else {
          // growing into the panel
          const u = newsEase((t - N.drop) / N.grow),
            bw = F.w * K,
            bh = F.h * K;
          const r = {
            x: cx - bw / 2 + (p.x - (cx - bw / 2)) * u,
            y: cy - bh / 2 + (p.y - (cy - bh / 2)) * u,
            w: bw + (p.w - bw) * u,
            h: bh + (p.h - bh) * u
          };
          this.drawPanel(ui, r, K + (1 - K) * u);
          const ts = F.w >= 44 && F.h >= 26 ? 2 : 1; // (as drawBoard: the narrow board's label is drawn at 1)
          c.save();
          c.globalAlpha = 1 - u;
          c.translate(r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2);
          c.scale(ts * K, ts * K);
          Font.center(c, '公告', 0, -4, '#FFF0C8');
          c.restore();
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    if (this.phase === 'close') {
      const t = now - this.tc,
        P = NewsBoard.pose(ui, now),
        bw = F.w * K,
        bh = F.h * K;
      if (t >= N.shrink + N.fly) {
        Sound.ev && Sound.ev('block.chain.place', null, 0.7, 1);
        this.finish();
        return;
      }
      if (t < N.shrink) {
        const u = newsEase(t / N.shrink);
        ui.dim(0.5);
        const r = {
          x: p.x + (cx - bw / 2 - p.x) * u,
          y: p.y + (cy - bh / 2 - p.y) * u,
          w: p.w + (bw - p.w) * u,
          h: p.h + (bh - p.h) * u
        };
        this.drawPanel(ui, r, 1 + (K - 1) * u);
      } else {
        const u = newsEaseIO((t - N.shrink) / N.fly);
        ui.dim(0.5 * (1 - u));
        NewsBoard.drawBoard(ui, g, {
          cx: cx + (P.cx - cx) * u,
          cy: cy + (P.cy - cy) * u,
          w: F.w,
          h: F.h,
          ang: P.ang * u,
          k: K + (1 - K) * u,
          chain: u > 0.6 ? P.chain : 0,
          chainA: (u - 0.6) / 0.4
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    // open
    ui.dim(0.5);
    this.drawPanel(ui, p, 1);
    const ca = Math.min(1, (now - this.openT) / 150);
    c.save();
    c.globalAlpha = ca;
    Font.center(c, '公告', p.x + p.w / 2, p.y + 10, '#FFF0C8');
    this.drawList(ui, ca >= 1);
    for (const w of this.widgets) ui.button(w);
    c.restore();
    if (ca >= 1) for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.tip && ui.hit(w)) ui.tooltip(w.tip.map(t => ({
      text: t
    })), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  // the board's planks at rect r (ts: how big the planks are drawn), dark border
  drawPanel(ui, r, ts = 1) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      wood = NewsBoard.woodTex(this.game);
    if (wood) c.drawImage(wood, 0, 0, Math.min(640, r.w / ts), Math.min(480, r.h / ts), r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);else {
      c.fillStyle = '#3B2614';
      c.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
    }
    c.strokeStyle = '#140A04';
    c.lineWidth = 2;
    c.strokeRect(r.x + 1, r.y + 1, r.w - 2, r.h - 2);
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.32)';
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeRect(r.x + 2.5, r.y + 2.5, r.w - 5, r.h - 5);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)';
    c.fillRect(r.x + 3, r.y + 3, r.w - 6, 1);
  }
  drawList(ui, live) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      a = this.area(),
      sup = NewsBoard.isSuper(),
      now = performance.now();
    this.btns = [];
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.38)';
    c.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
    c.clip();
    const x0 = a.x + 4,
      W = a.w - 10;
    if (!this.rows.length) {
      Font.center(c, NewsBoard.loading ? '正在读取公告…' : '还没有公告', a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2 - 8, '#A0A0A0');
      if (!NewsBoard.loading && NewsBoard.err && !NewsBoard.list) Font.center(c, fitText(NewsBoard.err, a.w - 8), a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2 + 6, '#FF8080');
    }
    for (const r of this.rows) {
      const y = Math.round(a.y + r.y - this.scroll),
        it = r.it;
      if (y > a.y + a.h || y + r.h + 4 < a.y) continue;
      const isNew = !it.draft && (it.at || 0) > this.seen0,
        tag = it.draft ? '草稿' : isNew ? 'NEW' : '';
      const right = x0 + W,
        tw = tag ? Font.width(tag) + 6 : 0;
      let x = x0;
      if (it.pin) x = Font.draw(c, '[置顶]', x, y, '#FFAA00') + 3;
      if (it.imp) x = Font.draw(c, '[重要]', x, y, '#FF5555') + 3;
      Font.draw(c, fitText(it.title || '', Math.max(12, right - tw - x)), x, y, '#FFFF55');
      if (tag) Font.draw(c, tag, right - Font.width(tag), y, it.draft ? '#A0A0A0' : '#55FF55');
      Font.draw(c, NewsBoard.date(it.at) + (it.draft ? '（未发布）' : ''), x0, y + 11, '#A0A0A0');
      // super administrators: publish / edit / delete on the date row (delete asks once more)
      if (sup && live) {
        let bx = x0 + W;
        const add = (label, act) => {
          const w = Font.width(label) + 10;
          bx -= w;
          const b = {
            x: bx,
            y: y + 9,
            w,
            h: 12,
            label,
            act,
            enabled: !this.busy
          };
          ui.button(b);
          this.btns.push(b);
          bx -= 3;
        };
        const asking = this.del && this.del.id === it.id && now - this.del.t < 4000;
        add(asking ? '确定删除？' : '删除', () => this.remove(it));
        add('编辑', () => this.game.ui.open(new NewsEditScreen(this.game, this, it)));
        if (it.draft) add('发布', () => this.publish(it));
      }
      if (r.gh) this.drawGift(ui, it, x0, y + 22, W, live);
      let ly = y + 23 + r.gh;
      // (bold: gold, drawn twice half a pixel apart)
      for (const l of r.lines) {
        let lx = x0;
        if (l) for (const run of l) {
          if (run.b) Font.draw(c, run.t, lx + 0.5, ly, '#FFD24A');
          lx = Font.draw(c, run.t, lx, ly, run.b ? '#FFD24A' : '#E8E8E8');
        }
        ly += 10;
      }
      const sy = y + r.h + 3;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      c.fillRect(x0, sy, W, 1);
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
      c.fillRect(x0, sy + 1, W, 1);
    }
    c.restore();
    const max = this.maxScroll();
    if (max > 0) {
      const th = Math.max(10, Math.floor(a.h * a.h / this.contentH)),
        ty = a.y + Math.round((a.h - th) * this.scroll / max);
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
      c.fillRect(a.x + a.w - 3, a.y, 2, a.h);
      c.fillStyle = '#C0B090';
      c.fillRect(a.x + a.w - 3, ty, 2, th);
    }
    if (this.msg && now - this.msgT < 4000) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
      c.fillRect(a.x, a.y + a.h - 12, a.w, 12);
      Font.center(c, fitText(this.msg, a.w - 8), a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h - 10, this.msgBad ? '#FF6060' : '#FFFFFF');
    }
  }
  // an announcement's gift, a row of its own under the date: the decoration large in a slot, its name, a button. Not
  // taken yet: the slot glows and has a red ! (the user, 2026-11-02) and the button takes it with one tap; taken: to
  // the wardrobe
  drawGift(ui, it, x, y, W, live) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      own = Cosmetics.has(it.gift),
      can = !own && !it.draft,
      S = 28;
    const pulse = can ? 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 1000 * Math.PI * 2 / 1.4) : 0;
    if (can) {
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 3; i >= 1; i--) {
        c.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,196,64,${(pulse * 0.6 * (4 - i) / 3).toFixed(3)})`;
        c.strokeRect(x - i + 0.5, y - i + 0.5, S + 2 * i - 1, S + 2 * i - 1);
      }
    }
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    c.fillRect(x, y, S, S);
    if (can) {
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,210,100,${(0.12 + pulse * 0.16).toFixed(3)})`;
      c.fillRect(x, y, S, S);
    }
    c.strokeStyle = can ? '#E8B830' : '#555555';
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, S - 1, S - 1);
    Cosmetics.drawIcon(c, it.gift, x + 2, y + 2, S - 4, false);
    if (can) {
      const bx = x + S - 6,
        by = y - 4;
      c.fillStyle = '#6E0000';
      c.fillRect(bx, by + 1, 10, 9);
      c.fillRect(bx + 1, by, 8, 11);
      c.fillStyle = '#E8262B';
      c.fillRect(bx + 1, by + 1, 8, 9);
      Font.draw(c, '!', bx + Math.round((10 - Font.width('!')) / 2), by + 2, '#FFFFFF', false);
    }
    const label = this.busy === it.id ? '领取中…' : own ? '去穿戴' : '领取',
      w = Math.max(48, Font.width(label) + 16),
      tw = W - S - 8 - w - 6;
    Font.draw(c, fitText('礼物：' + Cosmetics.name(it.gift), tw), x + S + 8, y + 4, '#FFD24A');
    Font.draw(c, fitText(it.draft ? '发布以后玩家才能领取' : own ? '已领取，在「皮肤和装饰」里穿上' : '点「领取」马上到账，永久保留', tw), x + S + 8, y + 16, '#A0A0A0');
    const b = {
      x: x + W - w,
      y: y + 5,
      w,
      h: 18,
      label,
      gold: !own,
      enabled: live && !this.busy,
      act: () => this.takeGift(it)
    };
    if (live) {
      ui.button(b);
      this.btns.push(b);
    }
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    if (b !== 0) return;
    // a tap while it falls: straight to the open board
    if (this.phase === 'drop') {
      this.t0 = performance.now() - NEWS_T.drop - NEWS_T.grow;
      this.snd = 2;
      return;
    }
    if (this.phase !== 'open') return;
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      const m = w.pad || 0;
      if (w.enabled !== false && ui.hit(m ? {
        x: w.x - m,
        y: w.y - m,
        w: w.w + 2 * m,
        h: w.h + 2 * m
      } : w, mx, my)) {
        Sound.init && Sound.init();
        Sound.click();
        w.onClick();
        return;
      }
    }
    const a = this.area();
    if (ui.hit(a, mx, my)) {
      for (const bt of this.btns) if (bt.enabled !== false && ui.hit(bt, mx, my)) {
        Sound.click();
        bt.act();
        return;
      }
      this.drag = {
        y: my,
        s: this.scroll
      }; // (a mouse drags the list; a finger scrolls it through wheel(), touch.js)
      return;
    }
    if (!ui.hit(this.panel(), mx, my)) this.back();
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (this.drag && ui.mouse.down) this.scroll = clamp(this.drag.s - (my - this.drag.y), 0, this.maxScroll());
  }
  mouseUp() {
    this.drag = null;
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    if (this.phase === 'open') this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll + Math.sign(dy) * 20, 0, this.maxScroll());
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  // closing: the board flies back up and hangs on its chains again (straight away while it is still falling)
  back() {
    if (this.phase === 'close') return;
    if (this.from && this.phase === 'open') {
      this.phase = 'close';
      this.tc = performance.now();
      this.drag = null;
      return;
    }
    this.finish();
  }
  finish() {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.parent) g.ui.open(this.parent);else if (g.state === 'play') g.ui.close();else g.ui.open(new TitleScreen(g));
  }
  // an announcement's gift: logged out - log in first, then back here; taken - to the wardrobe on its tab
  async takeGift(it) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (it.draft) {
      this.say('发布以后玩家才能领取');
      return;
    }
    if (Cosmetics.has(it.gift)) {
      Cosmetics.openWardrobe(g, this, it.gift);
      return;
    }
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      if (typeof LoginScreen !== 'undefined') g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => {
        g.ui.open(this);
        this.takeGift(it);
      }, () => g.ui.open(this)));
      return;
    }
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = it.id;
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/gift', {
        id: it.id
      });
      if (r.account) Account.took({
        account: r.account
      });
      Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1);
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('news_gift');
      this.say(`领到了${Cosmetics.name(r.gift) || '礼物'}！点「去穿戴」穿上`);
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
  }
  async publish(it) {
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在发布…');
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/news/save', {
        id: it.id,
        title: it.title,
        body: it.body,
        pin: !!it.pin,
        imp: !!it.imp,
        publish: true
      });
      if (r.list) NewsBoard.adminList = r.list;
      NewsBoard.ver++;
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('news_publish');
      this.say('已发布');
      NewsBoard.fetch(true);
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
  }
  async remove(it) {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (!this.del || this.del.id !== it.id || now - this.del.t > 4000) {
      this.del = {
        id: it.id,
        t: now
      };
      return;
    }
    this.del = null;
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('正在删除…');
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/news/delete', {
        id: it.id
      });
      NewsBoard.adminList = r.list || [];
      NewsBoard.ver++;
      this.say('已删除');
      NewsBoard.fetch(true);
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
  }
}

// ---- writing one (super administrators) ----
// pasting into the body: main.js's window capture handlers take the right-click / long-press menu away from all but
// its own field (and send the presses to the screen), so the text box's events stop here first - this file loads
// before window.onload binds those
for (const t of ['contextmenu', 'mousedown']) window.addEventListener(t, e => {
  if (e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('news-ta')) e.stopImmediatePropagation();
}, true);
// the title in the game's own text field; the body in a real multi-line text box laid over the canvas (the game's
// field is one line), removed when the screen closes
class NewsEditScreen extends FormScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, item) {
    super(game, item ? '编辑公告' : '新建公告', parent);
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.item = item || null;
    this.ttl = item ? item.title || '' : '';
    this.body = item ? item.body || '' : '';
    this.pin = !!(item && item.pin);
    this.imp = !!(item && item.imp);
    this.gift = item && item.gift || null;
    this.busy = false;
    this.msg = '';
    this.msgBad = false;
    this.ta = null;
    this.checks = [];
    this.first = true;
  }
  live() {
    return !!(this.item && !this.item.draft);
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      fw = Math.min(u.w - 16, 320),
      fx = Math.floor(cx - fw / 2);
    this.fields = {};
    this.addField('ttl', fx, 30, fw, '标题（30 字以内）', 30);
    const ay = 66,
      ah = Math.max(36, u.h - ay - 60);
    this.box = {
      x: fx,
      y: ay,
      w: fw,
      h: ah
    };
    this.checks = [{
      x: fx,
      y: ay + ah + 5,
      w: 50,
      h: 12,
      k: 'pin',
      label: '置顶'
    }, {
      x: fx + 58,
      y: ay + ah + 5,
      w: 50,
      h: 12,
      k: 'imp',
      label: '重要'
    }];
    // a published one: saved as it is (no one is told again), or published again as new
    const by = u.h - 24,
      bw = Math.floor((fw - 8) / 3),
      live = this.live();
    // the gift (cosmetics.js): none, or one of the decorations - each tap the next
    const gifts = [null, ...(typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics.LIST.map(d => d.id) : [])];
    this.giftBtn = {
      x: fx + fw - 120,
      y: ay + ah + 4,
      w: 120,
      h: 14,
      label: () => '礼物：' + (this.gift ? Cosmetics.name(this.gift) : '无'),
      tip: ['玩家在这条公告右上角点「领取」就拿到', '再点一下换下一件'],
      onClick: () => {
        this.gift = gifts[(gifts.indexOf(this.gift) + 1) % gifts.length];
      }
    };
    this.widgets = [this.giftBtn, {
      x: fx,
      y: by,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: live ? '保存修改' : '保存草稿',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: live ? ['改了以后照样显示，不算新公告'] : ['只有超级管理员看得到'],
      onClick: () => this.save(live ? {} : {
        draft: true
      })
    }, {
      x: fx + bw + 4,
      y: by,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      gold: true,
      label: live ? '重新发布' : '发布',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      tip: ['所有玩家都看得到，时间算现在，没看过的玩家牌子上会有提醒'],
      onClick: () => this.save({
        publish: true
      })
    }, {
      x: fx + 2 * (bw + 4),
      y: by,
      w: fw - 2 * (bw + 4),
      h: 20,
      label: '取消',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    this.place();
    // (resized - the phone's keyboard coming up: the title field moves along, without taking the focus back)
    if (this.field && u.inputBox) {
      const b = this.fields[this.field],
        s = u.scale / u.dpr,
        el = u.input;
      u.inputBox.x = b.x + 4;
      u.inputBox.y = b.y + 6;
      el.style.left = (b.x + 4) * s + 'px';
      el.style.top = (b.y + 6) * s + 'px';
      el.style.width = (b.w - 8) * s + 'px';
    }
    if (this.first) {
      this.first = false;
      if (!this.item) this.focus('ttl');
    }
  }
  place() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      b = this.box,
      s = u.scale / u.dpr;
    let ta = this.ta;
    if (!ta) {
      const touch = navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
      ta = this.ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.maxLength = 3000;
      ta.value = this.body;
      ta.placeholder = '正文（换行就是分段）';
      ta.spellcheck = false;
      ta.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
      // (16px on touch screens: iPhones zoom the page in on a smaller field; the page itself turns selection and
      // touch scrolling off, the box turns them back on)
      Object.assign(ta.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        zIndex: '6',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        margin: '0',
        padding: '6px 8px',
        resize: 'none',
        background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)',
        color: '#F0F0F0',
        border: '2px solid #A0A0A0',
        borderRadius: '0',
        outline: 'none',
        font: (touch ? 16 : 14) + 'px/1.45 "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif',
        userSelect: 'text',
        webkitUserSelect: 'text',
        touchAction: 'auto',
        overflowY: 'auto',
        whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
        webkitTouchCallout: 'default'
      });
      ta.className = 'news-ta'; // (main.js's menu blocker lets it be: below)
      // the game's own handlers stay out of it (touch.js would swallow the taps, main.js the keys)
      const stop = e => e.stopPropagation();
      for (const ev of ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'touchstart', 'touchmove', 'touchend', 'touchcancel', 'wheel', 'keyup']) ta.addEventListener(ev, stop, {
        passive: true
      });
      ta.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          e.preventDefault();
          ta.blur();
        }
      });
      ta.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this.body = ta.value;
      });
      ta.addEventListener('focus', () => {
        ta.style.borderColor = '#FFFFFF';
        const gu = this.game.ui;
        if (gu.inputBox) {
          this.field = null;
          gu.hideInput();
        }
      });
      ta.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        ta.style.borderColor = '#A0A0A0';
      });
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
    }
    Object.assign(ta.style, {
      left: b.x * s + 'px',
      top: b.y * s + 'px',
      width: b.w * s + 'px',
      height: b.h * s + 'px'
    });
  }
  close() {
    if (this.ta) {
      this.ta.remove();
      this.ta = null;
    }
  }
  submit() {
    if (this.ta) this.ta.focus();
  } // (Enter in the title: on to the body)
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      b = this.box,
      body = this.ta ? this.ta.value : this.body;
    this.drawFields(ui);
    Font.draw(c, fitText(`正文（可以分段，**两边加两个星号**是加粗，${body.length}/1000）`, b.w), b.x, b.y - 11, '#A0A0A0');
    c.fillStyle = '#000';
    c.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h); // (behind the text box)
    for (const k of this.checks) {
      const hov = ui.hit(k);
      c.fillStyle = '#000';
      c.fillRect(k.x, k.y, 12, 12);
      c.strokeStyle = hov ? '#FFFFFF' : '#A0A0A0';
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.strokeRect(k.x + 0.5, k.y + 0.5, 11, 11);
      if (this[k.k]) {
        if (typeof drawIcon === 'function') drawIcon(c, 'check', k.x + 2, k.y + 2, 1, '#55FF55');else Font.draw(c, '✓', k.x + 3, k.y + 2, '#55FF55');
      }
      Font.draw(c, k.label, k.x + 16, k.y + 2, '#FFFFFF');
    }
    const k1 = this.checks[1],
      hx = k1.x + k1.w + 6;
    if (this.giftBtn.x - 4 - hx > 40) Font.draw(c, fitText('重要：玩家第一次看到时自动掉下来', this.giftBtn.x - 4 - hx), hx, k1.y + 2, '#808080');
    // a line of how it will look in the list, or what the last save said
    const py = this.checks[0].y + 16;
    if (this.msg) {
      Font.draw(c, fitText(this.msg, b.w), b.x, py, this.msgBad ? '#FF6060' : '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    let x = Font.draw(c, '预览：', b.x, py, '#A0A0A0');
    if (this.pin) x = Font.draw(c, '[置顶]', x, py, '#FFAA00') + 3;
    if (this.imp) x = Font.draw(c, '[重要]', x, py, '#FF5555') + 3;
    x = Font.draw(c, fitText(String(this.ttl || '').trim() || '（还没有标题）', Math.max(20, (b.x + b.w - x) * 0.5)), x, py, '#FFFF55') + 6;
    const first = NewsBoard.plain(body.split('\n').find(l => l.trim()) || '');
    if (first && b.x + b.w - x > 20) Font.draw(c, fitText(first.trim(), b.x + b.w - x), x, py, '#E0E0E0');
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    if (b === 0) for (const k of this.checks) if (ui.hit({
      x: k.x - 2,
      y: k.y - 4,
      w: k.w + 4,
      h: k.h + 8
    }, mx, my)) {
      Sound.click();
      this[k.k] = !this[k.k];
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.msg = t;
    this.msgBad = !!bad;
  }
  async save(opt) {
    if (this.busy) return;
    const body = this.ta ? this.ta.value : this.body,
      title = String(this.ttl || '').trim();
    if (!title) {
      this.say('标题是空的', true);
      return;
    }
    if (!body.trim()) {
      this.say('正文是空的', true);
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.say(opt.publish ? '正在发布…' : '正在保存…');
    this.layout();
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/news/save', {
        id: this.item ? this.item.id : undefined,
        title,
        body,
        pin: this.pin,
        imp: this.imp,
        gift: this.gift,
        ...opt
      });
      if (r.list) NewsBoard.adminList = r.list;
      NewsBoard.ver++;
      if (opt.publish && typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('news_publish');
      NewsBoard.fetch(true);
      if (this.parent instanceof NewsScreen) this.parent.say(opt.publish ? '已发布' : '已保存');
      this.busy = false;
      if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.back();
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
    }
    this.busy = false;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/checkin.js ==== */
'use strict';

// 签到：开服签到活动的界面和入口（game/COMMUNITY_PLAN.md）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sign-in event (community.js on the room service): 7 days, cumulative, one a Beijing day, each giving the next
// decoration of event.rewards (read from the service - the rewards may change there, so nothing here hardcodes
// their order). The service's clock decides: the device's is only corrected by it for the countdowns.
// Ways in: the title screen (under the news sign, a red dot while today can be signed), the pause menu, and the
// news panel (news.js opens CheckinScreen). All of them go away after the event ends; CheckinScreen still works.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Checkin = (() => {
  const BJ = 8 * 3600e3,
    DAY = 86400e3;
  const dayKey = t => new Date(t + BJ).toISOString().slice(0, 10); // (the service's: a day in Beijing time)
  const bj = t => new Date(t + BJ); // read with getUTC*: Beijing time whatever the device's zone is
  const p2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const tc = k => {
    if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count(k);
  };
  // (the names when cosmetics.js has none: what the service gives today)
  const NAMES = {
    'hat:straw': '草帽',
    'cape:penguin': '企鹅披风',
    'hat:tophat': '礼帽',
    'pet:snowman': '小雪人',
    'cape:penguinwalk': '企鹅动态披风',
    'hat:crown': '皇冠',
    'pre:potato': '土豆名字前缀'
  };
  const KINDS = {
    hat: '帽子',
    cape: '披风',
    pet: '宠物',
    pre: '名字前缀'
  };
  const C = {
    st: null,
    skew: 0,
    err: '',
    busy: null,
    busyWho: null,
    busyLoud: false,
    game: null,
    tried: -1e9,
    triedWho: null,
    wait: 60000,
    seq: 0,
    claimAt: 0,
    claiming: 0,
    // (reads are numbered: one sent before a claim answered is older than the claim's)
    dayKey,
    now() {
      return Date.now() + this.skew;
    },
    who() {
      return Account.loggedIn && Account.data ? String(Account.data.id || Account.data.name || '?') : '';
    },
    // the status read for the player as they are now (another account's, or a guest's after logging in, is not)
    cur() {
      return this.st && this.st.who === this.who() ? this.st : null;
    },
    phase(st = this.st) {
      if (!st) return '';
      const t = this.now();
      return t < st.event.start ? 'before' : t >= st.event.end ? 'ended' : 'open';
    },
    count(st = this.st) {
      return st && st.event.rewards && st.event.rewards.length || 7;
    },
    // signed today: as read, until Beijing midnight passes (then the next day may be signed without a reload)
    today(st = this.st) {
      return !!(st && st.today && dayKey(this.now()) === st.dayAt);
    },
    canSign(st = this.cur()) {
      return !!(st && st.logged && this.phase(st) === 'open' && st.days < this.count(st) && !this.today(st));
    },
    // the red dot: today can be signed (logged out: while the event is open - signing needs the login)
    dot() {
      const st = this.cur();
      if (!st || this.phase(st) !== 'open') return false;
      return st.logged ? this.canSign(st) : true;
    },
    // the ways in: only while the event is on - not before it starts, for the super administrators neither (the user,
    // 2026-11-02: 周五再开放); they appear by themselves at the start (the server's time), no update needed
    shown() {
      const t = this.now();
      return !!this.st && t >= this.st.event.start && t < this.st.event.end;
    },
    name(id) {
      if (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.name) {
        try {
          const n = Cosmetics.name(id);
          if (n) return n;
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      return NAMES[id] || '装饰';
    },
    kind(id) {
      return String(id || '').split(':')[0];
    },
    kindName(id) {
      return KINDS[this.kind(id)] || '装饰';
    },
    // '11月6日', '18:30' in Beijing time
    day(t) {
      const d = bj(t);
      return `${d.getUTCMonth() + 1}月${d.getUTCDate()}日`;
    },
    time(t) {
      const d = bj(t);
      return `${p2(d.getUTCHours())}:${p2(d.getUTCMinutes())}`;
    },
    // '11月6日 18:30 – 12月15日': the end is the midnight after the last day
    dates(e) {
      const end = this.time(e.end) === '00:00' ? this.day(e.end - 1) : this.day(e.end) + ' ' + this.time(e.end);
      return `${this.day(e.start)} ${this.time(e.start)} – ${end}`;
    },
    span(ms) {
      const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000)),
        d = Math.floor(s / 86400),
        h = Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24,
        m = Math.floor(s / 60) % 60;
      return (d ? d + ' 天 ' : '') + `${p2(h)}:${p2(m)}:${p2(s % 60)}`;
    },
    untilMidnight() {
      return DAY - (this.now() + BJ) % DAY;
    },
    // the status from the service. Forced (the check-in screen): by Account.api. Not forced (the title screen and the
    // pause menu ask each time they lay out): quietly, at most once a minute, every 10 minutes after the network failed,
    // never offline - Account.api sends each failed request to the statistics as net_fail, and an offline player or a
    // phone that can't reach the service (the IDC's SNI whitelist) would bury the login failures read from there
    load(g, force) {
      if (g) this.game = g;
      const who = this.who();
      // (one in flight is shared - unless it reads another player (logged in meanwhile), or it is quiet and this is
      // forced: then this one goes after it)
      if (this.busy) return this.busyWho === who && (!force || this.busyLoud) ? this.busy : this.busy.then(() => this.load(g, force));
      // (a failed read waits its minute too: every answer lays the title out again, which asks again)
      if (!force && (this.triedWho === who && performance.now() - this.tried < this.wait || navigator.onLine === false)) return Promise.resolve(this.cur());
      this.tried = performance.now();
      this.triedWho = who;
      this.wait = 60000;
      if (typeof RoomService === 'undefined' || !RoomService.base()) {
        this.err = '还没有配置游戏服务器地址';
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }
      this.busyWho = who;
      this.busyLoud = !!force;
      this.busy = (force ? this.fetch() : this.quiet()).catch(e => {
        this.err = e.message || String(e);
      }).then(() => {
        this.busy = null;
        this.notify();
        return this.st;
      });
      return this.busy;
    },
    async fetch() {
      const t0 = Date.now(),
        s = ++this.seq;
      let r = null,
        who = this.who();
      if (who) {
        try {
          r = await Account.api('/api/account/checkin', {});
        } catch (e) {
          if (Account.loggedIn) throw e;
        } // (401: the token was dropped - read as a guest)
      }
      if (!r) {
        who = '';
        r = await Account.api('/api/event');
      }
      this.took(r, t0, Date.now(), who, s);
    },
    // the same by one plain fetch, nothing reported; a 401 goes the loud way (the network is up then, and Account.api is
    // what drops a dead token)
    async quiet() {
      const t0 = Date.now(),
        s = ++this.seq,
        base = RoomService.base(),
        who = this.who();
      const get = async (path, body) => {
        let f;
        try {
          f = await fetch(base + path, body ? {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(body)
          } : undefined);
        } catch (e) {
          this.wait = 600000;
          throw new Error('游戏正在更新中…请稍后');
        }
        if (f.status === 401) return null;
        let j;
        try {
          j = await f.json();
