        } catch (e) {
          j = {
            error: '游戏正在更新中…请稍后'
          };
        }
        if (!f.ok || j.error) throw new Error(j.error || 'HTTP ' + f.status);
        return j;
      };
      if (who) {
        const r = await get('/api/account/checkin', {
          _t: Account.token
        });
        return r ? this.took(r, t0, Date.now(), who, s) : this.fetch();
      }
      this.took(await get('/api/event'), t0, Date.now(), '', s);
    },
    // a status answer (also the claim's); the service's now corrects the device clock
    took(r, t0, t1, who = this.who(), s) {
      // (a read sent before the last claim answered, or answered while one is out, may be from before it: dropped - else
      // the card and the red dot went back to "not signed today")
      if (s !== undefined && (this.claiming > 0 || s < this.claimAt)) return;
      if (!r || !r.event) {
        this.err = '现在没有签到活动';
        return;
      }
      const now = r.now || t1;
      if (r.now) this.skew = r.now - (t0 + t1) / 2;
      this.st = {
        event: {
          ...r.event,
          rewards: r.event.rewards || []
        },
        now,
        days: r.days | 0,
        today: !!r.today,
        dayAt: dayKey(now),
        who,
        logged: !!who
      };
      this.err = '';
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('mcjs-checkin', JSON.stringify({
          st: this.st,
          skew: this.skew
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
    },
    // the screens that show it lay out again (an entry appears, a dot, the card)
    notify() {
      const g = this.game,
        s = g && g.ui && g.ui.screen;
      if (!s || !s.layout) return;
      if (typeof TitleScreen !== 'undefined' && s instanceof TitleScreen || typeof PauseScreen !== 'undefined' && s instanceof PauseScreen || s instanceof CheckinScreen) s.layout();
    },
    // where the title screen's button goes: under the news sign (news.js), else where the sign would be
    titleRect(u) {
      if (typeof NewsBoard !== 'undefined' && NewsBoard.signRect) {
        try {
          const s = NewsBoard.signRect(u);
          if (s) return {
            x: s.x,
            y: s.y + s.h + 4,
            w: s.w,
            h: 16
          };
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      // (narrow: the logo reaches the right edge - under it, right of the menu buttons)
      if (u.w / 2 + 128 > u.w - 62) return {
        x: u.w - 60,
        y: 84,
        w: 54,
        h: 16
      };
      return {
        x: u.w - 60,
        y: 66,
        w: 54,
        h: 16
      };
    },
    drawDot(c, x, y) {
      const k = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 260);
      c.fillStyle = '#3A0000';
      c.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, 7, 7);
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${Math.round(40 + 30 * k)},${Math.round(40 + 30 * k)},1)`;
      c.fillRect(x, y, 5, 5);
      c.fillStyle = '#FFB0B0';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 1, 1);
    },
    // a decoration's icon (cosmetics.js); without it: the cape's outside, the potato item, or a question mark
    drawReward(ui, id, x, y, size, locked) {
      const c = ui.ctx;
      if (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.drawIcon) {
        try {
          Cosmetics.drawIcon(c, id, x, y, size, locked);
          return;
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      const k = this.kind(id),
        v = String(id || '').split(':')[1];
      if (k === 'cape' && typeof Capes !== 'undefined' && Capes.get && Capes.get(v)) {
        const s = Math.max(1, Math.floor(size / 16));
        Capes.drawFlat(c, v, Math.round(x + (size - 10 * s) / 2), Math.round(y + (size - 16 * s) / 2), s, locked);
        return;
      }
      if (k === 'pre' && v === 'potato' && typeof ITEM_KEY !== 'undefined' && ITEM_KEY.potato !== undefined) {
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y);
        c.scale(size / 16, size / 16);
        ui.drawItem({
          id: ITEM_KEY.potato,
          count: 1
        }, 0, 0);
        c.restore();
      } else {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
        c.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, size - 4, size - 4);
        Font.center(c, '?', x + size / 2, y + size / 2 - 4, '#FFFFFF');
      }
      if (locked) {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
        c.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
      }
    },
    tc
  };
  // the last status, so the ways in show before the service answers (read again as soon as the title opens)
  try {
    const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-checkin') || 'null');
    if (s && s.st && s.st.event) {
      C.st = s.st;
      C.skew = +s.skew || 0;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return C;
})();

// ---- 开服签到「冬日足迹」(the user, 2026-11-03: rewritten with more design) ----
// A winter night in one panel: stars, a moon and a slow aurora over far mountains, snow falling, and a snowy slope
// rising to the right with the 7 days' gift boxes along it (the 7th, the biggest, gold, on the top with a flag).
// Footprints join them - walked ones darker. A penguin in a red scarf stands where the player has got to: signing,
// it hops to today's box, the box shakes and bursts open in snow and sparks, and the reward flies down to the bar
// at the bottom, which tells about the box tapped or hovered (else the next one) and holds the buttons.
// Box states: 'got' opened, its reward over it with a tick; 'today' glowing with a bouncing arrow; 'later' wrapped,
// its reward faint above it.
const CHK_PENGUIN = ['..kkkk..', '.kkkkkk.', '.kWkkWk.', '.kkookk.', 'kkrrrrkk', 'kkWWWWrk', '.kWWWWk.', '.kWWWWk.', '..kkkk..'];
const CHK_PAL = {
  k: '#1E1E26',
  W: '#F7F7F2',
  o: '#F29A2E',
  r: '#E8262B'
};
// each day's paper and ribbon (the 7th: gold)
const CHK_BOX = [['#E8473F', '#FFE27A'], ['#4AA3E8', '#FFFFFF'], ['#5DBB63', '#E8262B'], ['#B06AE0', '#FFE27A'], ['#F28C38', '#FFFFFF'], ['#E85D9A', '#FFFFFF'], ['#F2C230', '#C8261E']];
const chkRnd = (i, s) => {
  const h = Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + s * 78.233) * 43758.5453;
  return h - Math.floor(h);
};
class CheckinScreen extends MenuScreen {
  // again: the same visit coming back (logged in from here) - not counted as another opening
  constructor(game, parent, again) {
    super(game, null);
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = game.state === 'play' && !game.net;
    this.bgDim = 0.6;
    this.note = '';
    this.noteBad = false;
    this.sel = null;
    this.got = null;
    this.busy = false;
    this.key = '';
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    if (!again) Checkin.tc('checkin_open');
    this.asked = performance.now();
    Checkin.load(game, true);
  }
  say(t, bad) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteBad = !!bad;
    this.noteT = performance.now();
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  // what the bar shows
  state() {
    const st = Checkin.cur();
    if (!st) {
      // (nothing for this player and nothing on the way - an answer dropped, the account changed: ask again, not stuck
      // on 正在读取 for good)
      if (!Checkin.busy && !Checkin.err && performance.now() - this.asked > 3000) {
        this.asked = performance.now();
        Checkin.load(this.game, true);
      }
      return Checkin.busy || !Checkin.err ? 'loading' : 'error';
    }
    if (this.got) return 'got';
    const ph = Checkin.phase(st);
    if (ph === 'ended') return 'ended';
    if (!st.logged) return 'login';
    if (ph === 'before') return 'before';
    if (st.days >= Checkin.count(st)) return 'all';
    return Checkin.today(st) ? 'today' : 'sign';
  }
  // the panel, its header, the scene, the bar; the slope's height at x; each day's stop on it
  geo() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      n = Checkin.count(Checkin.st);
    const W = Math.min(u.w - 8, 440);
    let H = Math.min(u.h - 8, 270),
      x = Math.floor((u.w - W) / 2),
      y = Math.floor((u.h - H) / 2);
    // inside Bilibili on a phone the container's capsule (… and ✕) floats over the top right corner whatever the safe
    // area says (mobile.js closeRect): the panel - its × and the snowflakes - kept clear of it: moved left where the
    // screen has room, else down and a little shorter (players, 11-06: the two ✕ on top of each other)
    if (typeof Stage !== 'undefined' && Stage.inToy && !Stage.rot) {
      const k = u.dpr / u.scale,
        cw = Math.ceil(110 * k),
        ch = Math.ceil(50 * k);
      if (x + W > u.w - cw && y < ch) {
        if (u.w - cw - W >= 4) x = u.w - cw - W;else {
          y = ch + 2;
          H = Math.min(270, u.h - y - 4);
        }
      }
    }
    const P = {
      x,
      y,
      w: W,
      h: H
    };
    const bar = {
      x: x + 4,
      y: y + H - 50,
      w: W - 8,
      h: 46
    };
    const scene = {
      x: x + 4,
      y: y + 34,
      w: W - 8,
      h: bar.y - (y + 34)
    };
    const rise = Math.min(34, scene.h * 0.3);
    const ground = gx => Math.round(scene.y + scene.h - 14 - (gx - scene.x) / scene.w * rise - 3 * Math.sin((gx - scene.x) * 0.05));
    const left = scene.x + 34,
      step = (scene.w - 34 - 30) / Math.max(1, n - 1),
      stops = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const sx = Math.round(left + i * step),
        gy = ground(sx);
      stops.push({
        i,
        x: sx,
        gy,
        big: i === n - 1,
        hit: {
          x: sx - 15,
          y: gy - 50,
          w: 30,
          h: 58
        }
      });
    }
    return {
      u,
      n,
      P,
      bar,
      scene,
      ground,
      stops,
      step,
      icon: {
        x: bar.x + 6,
        y: bar.y + 5,
        w: 36,
        h: 36
      }
    };
  }
  layout() {
    const g = this.game,
      G = this.geo(),
      st = Checkin.cur(),
      s = this.state(),
      B = G.bar;
    this.key = s + (this.got && this.got.done ? '+' : '');
    this.widgets = [{
      x: G.P.x + G.P.w - 20,
      y: G.P.y + 5,
      w: 15,
      h: 15,
      pad: 5,
      label: '×',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    const bw = 76,
      bh = 22,
      by = B.y + Math.round((B.h - bh) / 2);
    let bx = B.x + B.w - 6 - bw;
    const add = w => {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: bx,
        y: by,
        w: bw,
        h: bh,
        ...w
      });
      bx -= bw + 4;
    };
    if (s === 'sign') add({
      gold: true,
      glow: true,
      label: () => this.busy ? '正在签到…' : '签到',
      enabled: !this.busy,
      onClick: () => this.claim()
    });
    if (s === 'login') add({
      gold: true,
      label: '登录',
      onClick: () => {
        if (typeof LoginScreen !== 'undefined') g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => g.ui.open(new CheckinScreen(g, this.parent, true)), () => g.ui.open(this)));
      }
    });
    if (s === 'error') add({
      label: '重试',
      onClick: () => {
        Checkin.err = '';
        Checkin.load(g, true);
        this.layout();
      }
    });
    // 去穿戴: once something was signed for (right after a claim: when the reward has landed)
    const wear = st && st.logged && st.days > 0 && (!this.got || this.got.done) && s !== 'sign' && (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' || typeof WardrobeScreen !== 'undefined');
    if (wear) add({
      gold: !!this.got,
      label: '去穿戴',
      onClick: () => this.wear(this.got ? Checkin.kind(this.got.id) : undefined)
    });
  }
  wear(kind) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' && Cosmetics.openWardrobe) return Cosmetics.openWardrobe(g, this, kind);
    if (typeof WardrobeScreen !== 'undefined') g.ui.open(new WardrobeScreen(g, this));
  }
  async claim() {
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.say('');
    this.layout();
    const t0 = Date.now(),
      from = Checkin.cur() ? Checkin.cur().days - 1 : -1;
    // (reads still out when it answers - the one this screen opened with - are older than the claim: took drops them)
    let r = null,
      err = null;
    Checkin.claiming++;
    try {
      r = await Account.api('/api/account/checkin/claim', {});
    } catch (e) {
      err = e;
    }
    Checkin.claiming--;
    if (r) Checkin.claimAt = ++Checkin.seq;
    try {
      if (err) throw err;
      // (the new decoration is owned at once: the wardrobe reads the account)
      if (r.account) {
        Account.data = r.account;
        Account.save();
      }
      Checkin.took(r, t0, Date.now());
      const n = Checkin.count(),
        idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, (r.days | 0) - 1));
      const sparks = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) sparks.push({
        a: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        v: 25 + Math.random() * 70,
        c: ['#FFD24A', '#FFF2B0', '#FFFFFF', '#9FD8FF'][i % 4],
        s: i % 3 ? 2 : 3
      });
      this.got = {
        id: r.reward || Checkin.st.event.rewards[idx],
        idx,
        from: Math.min(from, idx - 1),
        t0: performance.now(),
        sparks,
        opened: false,
        landed: false,
        done: false,
        last: (r.days | 0) >= n
      };
      this.sel = null;
      Checkin.tc('checkin_claim');
    } catch (e) {
      this.say(e.message, true);
      Checkin.load(this.game, true); // (already signed elsewhere, the event over: the card as it really is)
    }
    this.busy = false;
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button) {
    if (button === 0) for (const s of this.geo().stops) if (ui.hit(s.hit, mx, my)) {
      this.sel = s.i;
      Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.pad && w.enabled !== false && ui.hit({
      x: w.x - w.pad,
      y: w.y - w.pad,
      w: w.w + 2 * w.pad,
      h: w.h + 2 * w.pad
    }, mx, my)) {
      Sound.click();
      w.onClick();
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button);
  }
  // the day the bar tells about: hovered, else tapped, else the next to sign for (the last signed when all are)
  focus(G) {
    const h = G.stops.find(s => G.u.hit(s.hit));
    if (h) return h.i;
    if (this.got) return this.got.idx;
    if (this.sel !== null && this.sel < G.n) return this.sel;
    const st = Checkin.cur();
    return st ? Math.min(G.n - 1, st.days) : 0;
  }
  // a day's box: 'got' signed, 'today' the one signing now gives, 'later'
  slotState(i, st) {
    if (!st) return 'later';
    if (i < st.days) return 'got';
    return i === st.days && Checkin.canSign(st) ? 'today' : 'later';
  }
  // where the penguin stands: by the last box signed (left of the first before any), hopping to the new one while a
  // claim plays; its feet on the snow
  penguinAt(G, now) {
    const st = Checkin.cur(),
      spot = i => i < 0 ? {
        x: G.stops[0].x - 22,
        y: G.ground(G.stops[0].x - 22)
      } : {
        x: G.stops[i].x - (G.stops[i].big ? 22 : 18),
        y: G.stops[i].gy
      };
    if (this.got) {
      const t = (now - this.got.t0) / 1000,
        a = spot(this.got.from),
        b = spot(this.got.idx);
      if (t < 0.45) {
        const k = t / 0.45,
          e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
        return {
          x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * e,
          y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * e - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 16,
          hop: true
        };
      }
      return b;
    }
    return spot(st ? Math.min(G.n, st.days) - 1 : -1);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      G = this.geo(),
      st = Checkin.cur(),
      any = Checkin.st,
      s = this.state(),
      now = performance.now(),
      T = (now - this.t0) / 1000;
    // (the countdown reached the start, midnight passed, the reward landed: other buttons)
    if (s + (this.got && this.got.done ? '+' : '') !== this.key) this.layout();
    const P = G.P,
      S = G.scene;
    // ---- the panel: cut corners, a dark edge and a frosty line inside ----
    const rect = (x, y, w, h, col) => {
      c.fillStyle = col;
      c.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
    };
    rect(P.x + 2, P.y, P.w - 4, P.h, '#060B1A');
    rect(P.x, P.y + 2, P.w, P.h - 4, '#060B1A');
    rect(P.x + 1, P.y + 1, P.w - 2, P.h - 2, '#060B1A');
    rect(P.x + 2, P.y + 2, P.w - 4, P.h - 4, '#101C3C');
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,225,255,0.55)';
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeRect(P.x + 2.5, P.y + 2.5, P.w - 5, P.h - 5);
    // ---- the header: the name, the dates and the rule; the progress as 7 snowflakes ----
    Font.draw(c, any && any.event.name || '开服签到', P.x + 10, P.y + 8, '#FFFFFF');
    const tw = Font.width(any && any.event.name || '开服签到');
    Font.draw(c, '· 冬日足迹', P.x + 14 + tw, P.y + 8, '#9FD8FF');
    const n = G.n,
      done = st ? Math.min(n, st.days) : 0;
    const pipX = P.x + P.w - 30 - n * 10;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.flake(c, pipX + i * 10, P.y + 9, i < done ? '#FFD24A' : 'rgba(160,190,230,0.35)', i < done && this.got && i === this.got.idx ? 1 + 0.4 * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs((now - this.got.t0) / 1000 - 1.3) * 3) : 1);
    if (any) Font.draw(c, fitText(Checkin.dates(any.event) + ' · 累计签满 ' + n + ' 天就行，不用连续', P.w - 20), P.x + 10, P.y + 20, '#7F93BF');
    // ---- the scene ----
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(S.x, S.y, S.w, S.h);
    c.clip();
    this.drawSky(c, S, T);
    this.drawSlope(c, G, T);
    const rewards = any ? any.event.rewards : [],
      fs = this.focus(G);
    // footprints between the stops (walked: darker), then the boxes, then the penguin in front
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < G.n; i++) this.steps(c, G, G.stops[i], G.stops[i + 1], st && i + 1 < st.days, i);
    if (G.n) this.steps(c, G, {
      x: G.stops[0].x - 22,
      gy: G.ground(G.stops[0].x - 22)
    }, G.stops[0], st && st.days > 0, -1);
    for (const sp of G.stops) this.drawStop(ui, G, sp, rewards[sp.i], this.slotState(sp.i, st), sp.i === fs, now);
    const pg = this.penguinAt(G, now);
    this.drawPenguin(c, pg.x, pg.y, T, !!pg.hop);
    this.drawSnow(c, S, T);
    c.restore();
    // ---- the bar ----
    this.drawBar(ui, G, rewards, fs, s, st, now);
  }
  // a little 5 x 5 snowflake (the header's progress)
  flake(c, x, y, col, k = 1) {
    c.save();
    c.translate(x + 2.5, y + 2.5);
    c.scale(k, k);
    c.fillStyle = col;
    c.fillRect(-0.5, -2.5, 1, 5);
    c.fillRect(-2.5, -0.5, 5, 1);
    c.fillRect(-1.5, -1.5, 1, 1);
    c.fillRect(0.5, -1.5, 1, 1);
    c.fillRect(-1.5, 0.5, 1, 1);
    c.fillRect(0.5, 0.5, 1, 1);
    c.restore();
  }
  // night sky, stars, a crescent moon, the aurora drifting, far mountains
  drawSky(c, S, T) {
    const gr = c.createLinearGradient(0, S.y, 0, S.y + S.h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, '#081230');
    gr.addColorStop(0.55, '#1C3266');
    gr.addColorStop(1, '#3F5E9C');
    c.fillStyle = gr;
    c.fillRect(S.x, S.y, S.w, S.h);
    for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
      const x = S.x + Math.floor(chkRnd(i, 1) * S.w),
        y = S.y + Math.floor(chkRnd(i, 2) * S.h * 0.55),
        tw = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(T * (1 + chkRnd(i, 3) * 2) + i));
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(tw * (0.4 + 0.6 * chkRnd(i, 4))).toFixed(2)})`;
      c.fillRect(x, y, 1, 1);
    }
    const mx = S.x + S.w - 34,
      my = S.y + 10;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,248,214,0.12)';
    c.fillRect(mx - 4, my - 4, 18, 18);
    c.fillStyle = '#FFF4C8';
    c.fillRect(mx, my + 2, 10, 6);
    c.fillRect(mx + 2, my, 6, 10);
    c.fillRect(mx + 1, my + 1, 8, 8);
    c.fillStyle = '#16295A';
    c.fillRect(mx + 4, my, 6, 7);
    c.fillRect(mx + 5, my - 1, 6, 8); // (the shadow that makes the crescent)
    for (let x = 0; x < S.w; x += 2) {
      const u = x / S.w;
      for (const [k, col, ph, yy] of [[1, '90,255,190', 0, 0.16], [0.7, '120,200,255', 2.1, 0.26]]) {
        const y = S.y + S.h * yy + Math.sin(u * 7 + T * 0.35 + ph) * 7 + Math.sin(u * 17 - T * 0.2 + ph) * 3;
        const a = k * 0.16 * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(u * 5 - T * 0.5 + ph));
        c.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},${a.toFixed(3)})`;
        c.fillRect(S.x + x, Math.round(y), 2, 12);
        c.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},${(a * 0.5).toFixed(3)})`;
        c.fillRect(S.x + x, Math.round(y) + 12, 2, 8);
      }
    }
    // far mountains: stepped, snow on the peaks
    const mh = u => S.h * (0.16 + 0.16 * Math.abs(Math.sin(u * 4.3 + 0.6)) + 0.05 * Math.sin(u * 13)),
      base = S.y + S.h * 0.8;
    let peak = 0;
    for (let x = 0; x < S.w; x += 2) peak = Math.max(peak, mh(x / S.w));
    const mg = c.createLinearGradient(0, base - peak, 0, base);
    mg.addColorStop(0, '#3A5694');
    mg.addColorStop(1, '#22386C');
    for (let x = 0; x < S.w; x += 2) {
      const h = mh(x / S.w),
        top = Math.round(base - h);
      c.fillStyle = mg;
      c.fillRect(S.x + x, top, 2, S.y + S.h - top);
      c.fillStyle = '#6F8CC6';
      c.fillRect(S.x + x, top, 2, 1);
      const snow = Math.min(4, Math.round((h - peak * 0.86) * 0.5)); // (snow caps: only near the peaks)
      if (snow > 0) {
        c.fillStyle = '#DCE8F8';
        c.fillRect(S.x + x, top, 2, snow);
        c.fillStyle = '#AFC3E4';
        c.fillRect(S.x + x, top + snow, 2, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  // the snowy slope the boxes stand on
  drawSlope(c, G, T) {
    const S = G.scene;
    for (let x = 0; x < S.w; x += 2) {
      const gx = S.x + x,
        gy = G.ground(gx);
      c.fillStyle = '#E3EFFA';
      c.fillRect(gx, gy, 2, S.y + S.h - gy);
      c.fillStyle = '#F7FBFF';
      c.fillRect(gx, gy, 2, 2);
      c.fillStyle = '#C9DCEF';
      c.fillRect(gx, gy + 7 + ((x >> 1) % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0), 2, 1);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      // (glints in the snow)
      const gx = S.x + Math.floor(chkRnd(i, 9) * S.w),
        gy = G.ground(gx) + 3 + Math.floor(chkRnd(i, 10) * 8);
      if (Math.sin(T * 2 + i * 1.7) > 0.7) {
        c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        c.fillRect(gx, gy, 1, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  steps(c, G, a, b, walked, i) {
    const n = Math.max(2, Math.floor((b.x - a.x) / 6));
    for (let k = 1; k < n; k++) {
      const x = Math.round(a.x + 6 + (b.x - 12 - a.x) * k / n),
        y = G.ground(x) + 3 + (k % 2 ? 0 : 2);
      c.fillStyle = walked ? '#8EA7C6' : 'rgba(150,175,205,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(x, y, 2, 1);
    }
  }
  drawSnow(c, S, T) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const sp = 8 + chkRnd(i, 5) * 14,
        x = S.x + ((chkRnd(i, 6) * S.w + Math.sin(T * 0.8 + i) * 6) % S.w + S.w) % S.w;
      const y = S.y + (chkRnd(i, 7) * S.h + T * sp) % S.h;
      c.fillStyle = i % 5 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), i % 7 ? 1 : 2, i % 7 ? 1 : 2);
    }
  }
  // one day: its box on the snow (wrapped, glowing today, opened once signed), its reward over it, the day under it
  drawStop(ui, G, sp, id, ss, focused, now) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      k = sp.big ? 1.5 : 1,
      bw = Math.round(16 * k),
      bh = Math.round(13 * k),
      x = sp.x - bw / 2,
      y = sp.gy - bh + 1;
    const [paper, ribbon] = CHK_BOX[sp.i % CHK_BOX.length],
      hot = ui.hit(sp.hit);
    const claiming = this.got && this.got.idx === sp.i,
      t = claiming ? (now - this.got.t0) / 1000 : 9;
    const opened = ss === 'got' && !(claiming && t < 0.55);
    if (ss === 'today' || claiming && t < 0.7) {
      const p = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now / 260);
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,214,90,${(0.16 + 0.16 * p).toFixed(3)})`;
      c.fillRect(x - 6, y - 26, bw + 12, bh + 32);
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,236,160,${(0.2 + 0.2 * p).toFixed(3)})`;
      c.fillRect(x - 3, y - 3, bw + 6, bh + 6);
    }
    if (focused) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
      c.fillRect(sp.hit.x, sp.hit.y, sp.hit.w, sp.hit.h);
    }
    if (sp.big) {
      // (the last day's flag on the top)
      const fx = x + bw + 2,
        fy = y - 16;
      c.fillStyle = '#6B4A2A';
      c.fillRect(fx, fy, 1, 16 + bh - 1);
      const wv = Math.round(Math.sin(now / 300));
      c.fillStyle = '#E8262B';
      c.fillRect(fx + 1, fy, 7, 2);
      c.fillRect(fx + 1, fy + 2, 6 + wv, 2);
      c.fillRect(fx + 1, fy + 4, 5, 1);
    }
    // the box: shaking while it bursts open
    const sh = claiming && t >= 0.45 && t < 0.6 ? Math.round(Math.sin(t * 90) * 1.5) : 0;
    c.save();
    c.translate(sh, 0);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,50,90,0.25)';
    c.fillRect(x + 1, sp.gy, bw, 2); // (its shadow)
    const rw = Math.round(2 * k);
    const lidY = y,
      lidH = Math.round(4 * k);
    c.fillStyle = paper;
    c.fillRect(x, y + lidH - 1, bw, bh - lidH + 1);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
    c.fillRect(x, y + bh - 2, bw, 2);
    c.fillRect(x + bw - 2, y + lidH, 2, bh - lidH);
    c.fillStyle = ribbon;
    c.fillRect(x + Math.floor(bw / 2) - 1, y + lidH - 1, rw, bh - lidH + 1);
    if (opened) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,0.55)';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + lidH - 1, bw - 2, 2);
    } // (light from inside)
    // the lid (tipped up and back once opened) and the bow
    c.save();
    if (opened) {
      c.translate(x + bw + 1, sp.gy + 1);
      c.rotate(-1.15);
      c.translate(-(x - 1), -lidY);
    }
    c.fillStyle = paper;
    c.fillRect(x - 1, lidY, bw + 2, lidH);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    c.fillRect(x - 1, lidY, bw + 2, 1);
    c.fillStyle = ribbon;
    c.fillRect(x + Math.floor(bw / 2) - 1, lidY, rw, lidH);
    if (!opened) {
      const bx = x + Math.floor(bw / 2);
      c.fillRect(bx - 4, lidY - 2, 3, 2);
      c.fillRect(bx + 1, lidY - 2, 3, 2);
      c.fillRect(bx - 1, lidY - 1, 2, 1);
    }
    c.restore();
    if (ss === 'later') {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(16,28,60,0.28)';
      c.fillRect(x - 1, y - 2, bw + 2, bh + 2);
    }
    c.restore();
    // the reward over it (hidden while it flies off)
    const flying = claiming && t < 1.25,
      iy = y - 25 - (sp.big ? 2 : 0) + (ss === 'today' ? Math.round(Math.sin(now / 300) * 1.5) : 0);
    if (id && !flying) {
      c.save();
      if (ss === 'later') c.globalAlpha = 0.45;
      Checkin.drawReward(ui, id, sp.x - 10, iy, 20, false);
      c.restore();
      if (ss === 'got') {
        drawIcon(c, 'check', sp.x + 5, iy + 13, 1, '#103010');
        drawIcon(c, 'check', sp.x + 4, iy + 12, 1, '#55FF55');
      }
    }
    if (ss === 'today') {
      const ay = iy - 9 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(now / 220)) * -3);
      c.fillStyle = '#FFD24A';
      c.fillRect(sp.x - 3, ay, 7, 1);
      c.fillRect(sp.x - 2, ay + 1, 5, 1);
      c.fillRect(sp.x - 1, ay + 2, 3, 1);
      c.fillRect(sp.x, ay + 3, 1, 1);
    }
    // the day under it, on the snow
    const lbl = G.step >= 44 ? '第' + (sp.i + 1) + '天' : String(sp.i + 1);
    Font.center(c, lbl, sp.x, sp.gy + 4, ss === 'got' ? '#2E7D32' : ss === 'today' ? '#B5650A' : '#5B7397', false);
    if (hot) {
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.strokeRect(sp.hit.x + 0.5, sp.hit.y + 0.5, sp.hit.w - 1, sp.hit.h - 1);
    }
  }
  // the penguin (2 px a pixel), feet at (x, y): a waddle, a blink now and then; a hop leans it forward
  drawPenguin(c, x, y, T, hop) {
    const lean = hop ? 0.25 : Math.sin(T * 3) * 0.06,
      blink = T % 3.3 < 0.12,
      s = 2,
      w = 8 * s,
      h = CHK_PENGUIN.length * s;
    c.save();
    c.translate(Math.round(x), Math.round(y));
    c.rotate(lean);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,50,90,0.25)';
    c.fillRect(-w / 2 + 2, 0, w - 4, 2);
    CHK_PENGUIN.forEach((row, j) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        let ch = row[i];
        if (ch === '.') continue;
        if (blink && j === 2 && ch === 'W') ch = 'k';
        c.fillStyle = CHK_PAL[ch];
        c.fillRect(-w / 2 + i * s, -h - 2 + j * s, s, s);
      }
    });
    const step = hop ? 0 : Math.floor(T * 3) % 2; // (the feet)
    c.fillStyle = CHK_PAL.o;
    c.fillRect(-w / 2 + 2, -2 - (step ? 1 : 0), 4, 2);
    c.fillRect(w / 2 - 6, -2 - (step ? 0 : 1), 4, 2);
    c.restore();
  }
  // the bar: the focused day's reward in a frame, its name and what it takes; a note over it; the buttons (widgets)
  drawBar(ui, G, rewards, fs, s, st, now) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      B = G.bar,
      I = G.icon;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,10,28,0.88)';
    c.fillRect(B.x, B.y, B.w, B.h);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(190,225,255,0.35)';
    c.fillRect(B.x, B.y, B.w, 1);
    c.fillStyle = '#1B2A50';
    c.fillRect(I.x, I.y, I.w, I.h);
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,225,255,0.5)';
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeRect(I.x + 0.5, I.y + 0.5, I.w - 1, I.h - 1);
    const id = this.got ? this.got.id : rewards[fs],
      ss = this.got ? 'got' : this.slotState(fs, st),
      tx = I.x + I.w + 8;
    const btnL = Math.min(...this.widgets.filter(w => w.y >= B.y).map(w => w.x), B.x + B.w - 4),
      room = btnL - 6 - tx;
    if (id && !(this.got && !this.got.landed)) Checkin.drawReward(ui, id, I.x + 4, I.y + 4, 28, ss === 'later');
    const line = (t, i, col) => Font.draw(c, fitText(t, room), tx, B.y + 10 + i * 13, col);
    const n = Checkin.count(st),
      ev = Checkin.st && Checkin.st.event;
    if (s === 'loading') {
      line('正在读取…', 0.5, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    if (s === 'error') {
      line(Checkin.err, 0.5, '#FF6060');
      return;
    }
    if (this.got) {
      if (!this.got.landed) return;
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - this.got.t0 - 1250) / 300);
      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, k);
      line('获得：' + Checkin.name(this.got.id), 0, '#FFD24A');
      line(this.got.last ? `${n} 天全部签满！所有奖励都是你的了` : `已签 ${st ? st.days : 0}/${n} 天 · 明天再来`, 1, '#C8D6F0');
      c.restore();
      return;
    }
    if (id) {
      const e = Font.draw(c, fitText(`第${fs + 1}天 · ${Checkin.name(id)}`, room - 40), tx, B.y + 10, '#FFFF55');
      if (e + 6 + Font.width(Checkin.kindName(id)) <= tx + room) Font.draw(c, Checkin.kindName(id), e + 6, B.y + 10, '#7F93BF');
    }
    let sub = '',
      col = '#C8D6F0';
    const left = st ? fs + 1 - st.days : fs + 1;
    if (s === 'ended') sub = st.logged && st.days ? `活动已结束 · 你领到了 ${st.days} 件装饰，永久保留` : '活动已结束';else if (s === 'login') sub = '登录后签到，换设备也在';else if (s === 'before') {
      sub = `${Checkin.day(ev.start)} ${Checkin.time(ev.start)} 开始 · 还有 ${Checkin.span(ev.start - Checkin.now())}`;
      col = '#FFD24A';
    } else if (ss === 'got') {
      sub = '已领取';
      col = '#55FF55';
    } else if (ss === 'today') {
      sub = '今天签到就能领';
      col = '#FFD24A';
    } else if (s === 'all') {
      sub = '奖励已全部领取';
      col = '#55FF55';
    } else if (s === 'today' && left === 1) {
      sub = `明天就能领 · 还有 ${Checkin.span(Checkin.untilMidnight())}`;
      col = '#FFD24A';
    } else sub = `再签 ${left} 天就能领`;
    line(sub, 1, col);
    if (this.note && now - this.noteT < 5000) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
      c.fillRect(B.x, B.y - 13, B.w, 12);
      Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, B.w - 8), B.x + B.w / 2, B.y - 11, this.noteBad ? '#FF6060' : '#FFFFFF');
    }
  }
  draw(ui) {
    super.draw(ui);
    const G = this.geo(),
      st = Checkin.st,
      c = ui.ctx;
    // the sign button breathes
    const sb = this.widgets.find(w => w.glow);
    if (sb && sb.enabled !== false) {
      const p = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 260);
      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,230,140,${(0.35 + 0.45 * p).toFixed(2)})`;
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.strokeRect(sb.x - 1.5, sb.y - 1.5, sb.w + 3, sb.h + 3);
    }
    if (this.got) this.drawClaim(ui, G);
    // the reward's name over a hovered box
    const h = G.stops.find(s => ui.hit(s.hit));
    if (h && st && st.event.rewards[h.i]) {
      const id = st.event.rewards[h.i];
      ui.tooltip([{
        text: Checkin.name(id),
        color: '#FFFF55'
      }, {
        text: Checkin.kindName(id) + ' · 第' + (h.i + 1) + '天奖励',
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      }], ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    }
  }
  // the claim, after the penguin's hop (0.45 s): the box shakes and bursts open in a flash, snow and sparks (0.45-0.7);
  // the reward rises and flies down to the bar's frame (0.65-1.25), lands with the level-up sound and a burst there
  drawClaim(ui, G) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      g = this.got,
      t = (performance.now() - g.t0) / 1000,
      sp = G.stops[g.idx];
    if (!sp) return;
    const I = G.icon,
      bx = sp.x,
      by = sp.gy - (sp.big ? 20 : 13);
    if (t >= 0.45 && !g.opened) {
      g.opened = true;
      if (typeof Sound !== 'undefined' && Sound.ev) Sound.ev('entity.item.pickup', null, 0.8, 0.9);
    }
    if (t >= 1.25 && !g.landed) {
      g.landed = true;
      if (typeof Sound !== 'undefined' && Sound.ev) {
        Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1);
        if (g.last) Sound.ev('ui.toast.challenge_complete', null, 0.7, 1);
      }
    }
    if (t >= 1.5 && !g.done) {
      g.done = true;
      this.layout();
    }
    if (t >= 0.55 && t < 0.9) {
      // (the flash and a ring)
      const k = (t - 0.55) / 0.35;
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,250,220,${(0.7 * (1 - k)).toFixed(2)})`;
      c.fillRect(bx - 12 - k * 10, by - 12 - k * 10, 24 + k * 20, 24 + k * 20);
      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,214,90,${(1 - k).toFixed(2)})`;
      c.lineWidth = 2;
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(bx, by, 6 + k * 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      c.stroke();
    }
    const burst = (cx, cy, k, list) => {
      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - k / 0.8);
      for (const q of list) {
        const r = q.v * k;
        c.fillStyle = q.c;
        c.fillRect(Math.round(cx + Math.cos(q.a) * r), Math.round(cy + Math.sin(q.a) * r + 30 * k * k), q.s, q.s);
      }
      c.restore();
    };
    if (t >= 0.55 && t < 1.35) burst(bx, by, t - 0.55, g.sparks.slice(0, 18));
    if (t >= 0.65 && t < 1.25) {
      const k = (t - 0.65) / 0.6,
        e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k),
        m = 1 - e;
      const x0 = bx,
        y0 = by - 18,
        x2 = I.x + I.w / 2,
        y2 = I.y + I.h / 2,
        x1 = (x0 + x2) / 2,
        y1 = Math.min(y0, y2) - 50;
      const x = m * m * x0 + 2 * m * e * x1 + e * e * x2,
        y = m * m * y0 + 2 * m * e * y1 + e * e * y2,
        size = Math.round(20 + 12 * e + 10 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI));
      c.save();
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,90,0.35)';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(x - size / 2 - 3), Math.round(y - size / 2 - 3), size + 6, size + 6);
      c.translate(Math.round(x), Math.round(y));
      c.rotate(Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 0.4);
      Checkin.drawReward(ui, g.id, -Math.round(size / 2), -Math.round(size / 2), size, false);
      c.restore();
    }
    if (t >= 1.25 && t < 2.05) burst(I.x + I.w / 2, I.y + I.h / 2, t - 1.25, g.sparks.slice(18));
  }
}

// ---- the ways in: the title screen (under the news sign) and the pause menu, each with the red dot ----
(() => {
  const tl = TitleScreen.prototype.layout;
  TitleScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    tl.call(this);
    const g = this.game;
    Checkin.load(g); // (each time the title opens, at most once a minute)
    if (!Checkin.shown() || !(typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('title.checkin'))) return; // (the admin panel can hide it: js/live.js)
    const r = Checkin.titleRect(g.ui);
    this.widgets.push({
      ...r,
      label: '签到',
      checkin: true,
      tip: ['开服签到：累计签 ' + Checkin.count() + ' 天，领原创装饰'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CheckinScreen(g, this))
    });
  };
  const pl = PauseScreen.prototype.layout;
  PauseScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    pl.call(this);
    const g = this.game;
    Checkin.load(g);
    if (!Checkin.shown() || !(typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('title.checkin'))) return;
    // (the top left: the menu's own rows change with rooms, the AI companion and local rooms; the top right is where the
    // touch HUD's pause button is - a second tap there to get back to the game opened this)
    this.widgets.push({
      x: 4,
      y: 4,
      w: 54,
      h: 16,
      label: '签到',
      checkin: true,
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CheckinScreen(g, this))
    });
  };
  for (const K of [TitleScreen, PauseScreen]) {
    const d = K.prototype.draw;
    K.prototype.draw = function (ui) {
      d.call(this, ui);
      if (!Checkin.dot()) return;
      const b = this.widgets.find(w => w.checkin);
      if (b) Checkin.drawDot(ui.ctx, b.x + b.w - 4, b.y - 2);
    };
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/shareholders.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 股东名单 (the user 11-13): who follows the UP gets in (the title screen's 股东名单 button - in Bilibili, not
// following: the follow screen first) and may put their own name in it (their Bilibili nickname: the account's,
// so logged in). The names flow past in one of two looks, picked at random each time it opens (the user 11-13:
// 弹幕 and 烟花 only, not chosen by the player), the count
// above them, live: the room service is asked every few seconds what came in since (multiplayer/rooms/shareholders.js)
// - a new one comes in with a welcome, their name thrown into the flow. 找到我: the player's own name comes into the
// flow and stands out of it - the others dim and slow, theirs held in the light a while, then the flow goes on (the
// user 11-13: not a lottery reel); joining throws their name in the same way, from the button - a danmaku sent, a
// rocket going up. The player can take their name out again (a tap on 第 N 位股东).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Share = {
  count: 0,
  seq: -1,
  pool: [],
  at: 0,
  me: null,
  err: '',
  news: [],
  ok: false,
  url(q) {
    return RoomService.base() + '/api/shareholders' + (q || '');
  },
  async get(q) {
    const f = await fetch(this.url(q));
    if (!f.ok) throw new Error('股东名单读取失败（' + f.status + '）');
    return f.json();
  },
  // the first look: the count, a sample of names (random ones and the newest), shuffled
  async load() {
    const r = await this.get('');
    this.count = r.count | 0;
    this.seq = r.seq | 0;
    const names = [...new Set([...(r.names || []), ...(r.recent || []).map(x => x[0])])];
    for (let i = names.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [names[i], names[j]] = [names[j], names[i]];
    }
    this.pool = names;
    this.at = 0;
    this.ok = true;
    this.err = '';
  },
  // what came in since the last look: into the pool, and welcomed
  async poll() {
    if (this.seq < 0) return this.load();
    const r = await this.get('?after=' + this.seq);
    this.count = r.count | 0;
    this.seq = r.seq | 0;
    for (const [name, no] of r.add || []) {
      if (!this.pool.includes(name)) this.pool.splice(Math.floor(Math.random() * (this.pool.length + 1)), 0, name);
      this.news.push({
        name,
        no,
        t: performance.now()
      });
    }
    if (this.news.length > 20) this.news.splice(0, this.news.length - 20);
  },
  async mine() {
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      this.me = null;
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.me = await Account.api('/api/account/shareholders/me', {});
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  async join() {
    // (the follow told to the account first - the service lets in only those it knows follow. Following is all it
    // asks, no 三连 (the user 11-13): only the follow is read and told, not the whole unlock check)
    try {
      if (typeof Toy !== 'undefined' && !Toy.phoneWeb && (await Toy.ready()) && (await Toy.following()) === true) await Account.api('/api/account/unlocks', {
        follow: true
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    const r = await Account.api('/api/account/shareholders/join', {});
    this.me = r;
    this.count = Math.max(this.count, r.count | 0);
    if (r.name && !this.pool.includes(r.name)) this.pool.push(r.name);
    return r;
  },
  async leave() {
    const r = await Account.api('/api/account/shareholders/leave', {});
    this.me = r;
    this.count = r.count | 0;
    return r;
  },
  // the next name to show (round the pool; nothing yet: an empty seat)
  next() {
    if (!this.pool.length) return null;
    if (this.at >= this.pool.length) this.at = 0;
    return this.pool[this.at++];
  }
};

// ---- small things the looks share ----
const SH = {
  hash(s) {
    let h = 2166136261;
    for (const ch of String(s)) {
      h ^= ch.codePointAt(0);
      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
    }
    return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  },
  // text at a scale (1 = the game's 8 px font), alpha, from its left or centred
  text(c, s, x, y, col, k = 1, a = 1, center = false, shadow = true) {
    if (a <= 0.01) return;
    c.save();
    c.globalAlpha *= Math.min(1, a);
    const w = Font.width(s);
    c.translate(center ? x - w * k / 2 : x, y);
    if (k !== 1) c.scale(k, k);
    Font.draw(c, s, 0, 0, col, shadow);
    c.restore();
  },
  hsl: (h, s, l) => 'hsl(' + Math.round((h % 360 + 360) % 360) + ',' + s + '%,' + l + '%)',
  hex(h, s, l) {
    // (the font wants #rrggbb)
    s /= 100;
    l /= 100;
    const k = n => (n + h / 30) % 12,
      a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
    const f = n => Math.round(255 * (l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, 9 - k(n), 1)))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    return '#' + f(0) + f(8) + f(4);
  },
  stars(n, seed) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push([SH.hash(seed + 'x' + i), SH.hash(seed + 'y' + i), SH.hash(seed + 's' + i)]);
    return out;
  }
};
const EMPTY_SEAT = '虚位以待';

// ---- the looks: each { id, name, init(S), step(S, dt, t), draw(S, c, t) } with its own things in S.st ----
// S: the screen (S.w, S.h, S.top: under the heading, S.bot: above the buttons, S.me: the player's own name or null,
// S.slow: 0-1 how much the flow is held back - 找到我)
const SHARE_STYLES = [
// 弹幕: names flying across like Bilibili's danmaku - most white, some coloured, now and then a big one; the
// player's own in a box (as one's own danmaku is); a newcomer's welcome fixed at the top
{
  id: 'danmaku',
  name: '弹幕',
  COLS: ['#FFFFFF', '#FFFFFF', '#FFFFFF', '#FFFFFF', '#FE0302', '#FFFF00', '#00CD00', '#89D5FF', '#FF7204', '#CC0273', '#4266BE'],
  init(S) {
    S.st = {
      items: [],
      lanes: [],
      top: []
    };
  },
  step(S, dt) {
    const st = S.st,
      lh = 12,
      n = Math.max(3, Math.floor((S.bot - S.top - 8) / lh));
    while (st.lanes.length < n) st.lanes.push(0);
    st.lanes.length = n;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      st.lanes[i] -= dt;
      if (st.lanes[i] > 0) continue;
      // (a newcomer's name thrown in: big, gold, the next lane free)
      const inc = i < n - 1 && S.incoming.length ? S.incoming.shift() : null;
      const name = inc || Share.next() || EMPTY_SEAT,
        big = !!inc || Math.random() < 0.06 && i < n - 1,
        k = big ? 2 : 1;
      const w = Font.width(name) * k,
        v = (55 + Math.random() * 45) * (S.w / 400 + 0.4) * (big ? 0.8 : 1);
      const col = inc ? '#F2C94C' : name === EMPTY_SEAT ? '#808080' : this.COLS[Math.floor(SH.hash(name) * this.COLS.length)];
      st.items.push({
        name,
        x: S.w + 4,
        y: S.top + 4 + i * lh,
        v,
        k,
        w,
        col,
        mine: name === S.me
      });
      st.lanes[i] = (w + 24) / v + Math.random() * 1.6;
      if (big) st.lanes[i + 1] = Math.max(st.lanes[i + 1], st.lanes[i]);
    }
    for (const it of st.items) it.x -= it.v * dt * (1 - S.slow * 0.85);
    st.items = st.items.filter(it => it.x + it.w > -4);
    for (const nw of Share.news.splice(0)) st.top.push({
      text: '欢迎 ' + nw.name + ' 成为第 ' + nw.no + ' 位股东！',
      t: 0
    });
    for (const x of st.top) x.t += dt;
    st.top = st.top.filter(x => x.t < 4);
    // the player's own name: in (from the right like any danmaku, or sent up from the join button), easing to a stop
    // in the middle, held there big and lit; then off to the left with the rest
    const h = st.hero;
    if (h) {
      h.t += dt;
      if (h.skip && h.t > h.IN && h.t < h.IN + h.HOLD) h.t = h.IN + h.HOLD;
      if (h.t < h.IN) {
        const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - h.t / h.IN, 3);
        h.s = h.from ? 1 + e : 2;
        h.cx = h.x0 + (S.w / 2 - h.x0) * e;
        h.cy = h.y0 + (h.yc - h.y0) * e - (h.from ? Math.sin(e * Math.PI) * 26 : 0);
      } else if (h.t < h.IN + h.HOLD) {
        h.s = 2;
        h.cx = S.w / 2;
        h.cy = h.yc;
        if (!h.landed) {
          h.landed = true;
          Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1.3);
        }
      } else {
        h.dim = false;
        h.v = (h.v || 40) + 520 * dt;
        h.cx -= h.v * dt;
        if (h.cx + Font.width(h.name) < -8) st.hero = null;
      }
    }
  },
  hero(S, h) {
    const yc = Math.round((S.top + S.bot) / 2 - 8);
    Object.assign(h, {
      t: 0,
      IN: h.from ? 0.8 : 1.2,
      HOLD: 2.8,
      dim: true,
      s: h.from ? 1 : 2,
      yc,
      x0: h.from ? h.from.x : S.w + 4 + Font.width(h.name),
      y0: h.from ? h.from.y - 8 : yc
    });
    h.cx = h.x0;
    h.cy = h.y0;
    S.st.hero = h;
    if (typeof Sound !== 'undefined' && Sound.click) Sound.click();
  },
  // (over the dimmed flow: the name in gold in its own-danmaku box, a glow and a few glints round it, a line under it)
  drawHero(S, c, t) {
    const h = S.st.hero;
    if (!h) return;
    const held = h.landed && h.dim,
      k = h.s + (held ? Math.sin(h.t * 5) * 0.06 : 0),
      w = Font.width(h.name) * k,
      x = Math.round(h.cx - w / 2),
      y = Math.round(h.cy),
      my = y + 4 * k;
    const gl = c.createRadialGradient(h.cx, my, 0, h.cx, my, w / 2 + 34);
    gl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,90,' + (held ? 0.32 : 0.18) + ')');
    gl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,214,90,0)');
    c.fillStyle = gl;
    c.fillRect(h.cx - w / 2 - 40, my - w / 2 - 40, w + 80, w + 80);
    const bx = x - 3,
      by = y - 3,
      bw = Math.round(w) + 6,
      bh = Math.round(8 * k) + 5;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,20,0.8)';
    c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
    c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 1);
    c.fillRect(bx, by + bh, bw + 1, 1);
    c.fillRect(bx, by, 1, bh);
    c.fillRect(bx + bw, by, 1, bh);
    SH.text(c, h.name, x, y, '#FFE94A', k, 1);
    if (held) {
      const a = Math.min(1, (h.t - h.IN) * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const q = Math.sin(t * 3 + i * 2.1);
        if (q < 0.3) continue;
        const gx = Math.round(h.cx + Math.cos(i * 0.785 + 0.3) * (w / 2 + 14)),
          gy = Math.round(my + Math.sin(i * 0.785 + 0.3) * (6 * k + 6));
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,' + (a * q).toFixed(2) + ')';
        c.fillRect(gx, gy - 1, 1, 3);
        c.fillRect(gx - 1, gy, 3, 1);
      }
      SH.text(c, h.kind === 'join' ? '欢迎你成为第 ' + h.no + ' 位股东！' : '你在这里 · 第 ' + h.no + ' 位股东', S.w / 2, by + bh + 8, '#FFFFFF', 1, a, true);
    }
  },
  draw(S, c, t) {
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, S.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0B0E1A');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#171C30');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, S.w, S.h);
    // (a player's frame: faint scan lines, a pink progress bar running)
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.025)';
    for (let y = 0; y < S.h; y += 3) c.fillRect(0, y, S.w, 1);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    c.fillRect(8, S.bot - 3, S.w - 16, 1);
    const pg = t / 40 % 1 * (S.w - 16);
    c.fillStyle = '#FB7299';
    c.fillRect(8, S.bot - 3, pg, 1);
    c.fillRect(8 + pg - 1, S.bot - 5, 3, 5);
    for (const it of S.st.items) {
      if (it.mine) {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
        const x = Math.round(it.x) - 2,
          y = it.y - 2,
          w = it.w + 4,
          h = 8 * it.k + 3;
        c.fillRect(x, y, w, 1);
        c.fillRect(x, y + h, w, 1);
        c.fillRect(x, y, 1, h);
        c.fillRect(x + w, y, 1, h + 1);
      }
      SH.text(c, it.name, it.x, it.y, it.col, it.k, 1);
    }
    let y = S.top + 2;
    for (const x of S.st.top) {
      const a = Math.min(1, x.t * 4, (4 - x.t) * 2);
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + 0.45 * a + ')';
      c.fillRect(S.w / 2 - Font.width(x.text) / 2 - 4, y - 2, Font.width(x.text) + 8, 12);
      SH.text(c, x.text, S.w / 2, y, '#FFE94A', 1, a, true);
      y += 13;
    }
  }
},
// 烟花: rockets from the town below bursting over it - a burst's name large in the middle, a few more flung out and
// falling with the sparks
{
  id: 'fireworks',
  name: '烟花',
  init(S) {
    S.st = {
      rockets: [],
      sparks: [],
      names: [],
      spawn: 0.2,
      sky: SH.stars(90, 'f')
    };
  },
  step(S, dt) {
    const st = S.st,
      k = 1 - S.slow * 0.85,
      gy = 70;
    st.spawn -= dt * k;
    if (st.spawn <= 0) {
      st.rockets.push({
        x: S.w * (0.15 + Math.random() * 0.7),
        y: S.bot - 14,
        vy: -(S.bot - S.top) * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.35),
        h: Math.random() * 360
      });
      st.spawn = 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.7;
    }
    for (const r of st.rockets) {
      // (the player's own rocket - and its sparks - at full speed while the rest is held back)
      const kk = r.hero ? 1 : k;
      r.x += (r.vx || 0) * dt * kk;
      r.y += r.vy * dt * kk;
      r.vy += gy * 1.6 * dt * kk;
      if (Math.random() < (r.hero ? 1 : 0.6)) st.sparks.push({
        x: r.x + (Math.random() - 0.5),
        y: r.y + 2,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 10,
        t: 0,
        life: r.hero ? 0.6 : 0.4,
        c: '#FFE2A0',
        hero: r.hero
      });
      if (r.vy > -30 || r.y < S.top + 20) {
        r.done = true;
        if (r.hero) {
          // (the player's own: a big gold and white burst, their name in the middle of it)
          for (let i = 0; i < 140; i++) {
            const a = i / 70 * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.05,
              v = (i < 70 ? 95 : 55) + Math.random() * 25;
            st.sparks.push({
              x: r.x,
              y: r.y,
              vx: Math.cos(a) * v,
              vy: Math.sin(a) * v,
              t: 0,
              life: 1.8 + Math.random() * 0.8,
              c: i % 3 ? '#FFD86A' : '#FFFFFF',
              hero: true
            });
          }
          const h = st.hero;
          if (h) {
            h.up = false;
            h.x = r.x;
            h.y = r.y;
            h.bt = 0;
          }
          Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.firework_rocket.large_blast', null, 1, 1);
          continue;
        }
        const col = SH.hsl(r.h, 90, 65);
        for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
          const a = i / 46 * Math.PI * 2,
            v = 40 + Math.random() * 40;
          st.sparks.push({
            x: r.x,
            y: r.y,
            vx: Math.cos(a) * v,
            vy: Math.sin(a) * v,
            t: 0,
            life: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.6,
            c: col
          });
        }
        // (a newcomer's name thrown in: theirs the big one)
        const big = S.incoming.length && S.incoming.shift() || Share.next() || EMPTY_SEAT;
        st.names.push({
          name: big,
          x: r.x,
          y: r.y,
          vx: 0,
          vy: -6,
          t: 0,
          life: 2.6,
          k: 2,
          col: SH.hex(r.h, 90, 75)
        });
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const n = Share.next() || EMPTY_SEAT,
            a = i / 5 * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random();
          st.names.push({
            name: n,
            x: r.x,
            y: r.y,
            vx: Math.cos(a) * 34,
            vy: Math.sin(a) * 26 - 10,
            t: 0,
            life: 2.2,
            k: 1,
            col: SH.hex(r.h + 30 * i, 80, 80),
            g: 1
          });
        }
      }
    }
    st.rockets = st.rockets.filter(r => !r.done);
    for (const s of st.sparks) {
      const kk = s.hero ? 1 : k;
      s.t += dt * kk;
      s.vx *= Math.exp(-dt * kk * 1.8);
      s.vy = s.vy * Math.exp(-dt * kk * 1.8) + gy * dt * kk;
      s.x += s.vx * dt * kk;
      s.y += s.vy * dt * kk;
    }
    st.sparks = st.sparks.filter(s => s.t < s.life);
    for (const n of st.names) {
      n.t += dt * k;
      n.x += n.vx * dt * k;
      n.y += n.vy * dt * k;
      if (n.g) n.vy += 22 * dt * k;
      n.vx *= Math.exp(-dt * 0.8);
    }
    st.names = st.names.filter(n => n.t < n.life);
    // the player's own name: up with its rocket, then out of the burst - grown big, held in the light, fading
    const h = st.hero;
    if (h) {
      if (h.up) {
        if (!st.rockets.includes(h.rocket)) st.hero = null;
      } else {
        h.bt += dt;
        h.y -= 4 * dt;
        if (h.skip && h.bt > 0.6 && h.bt < 3.4) h.bt = 3.4;
        if (h.bt > 3.4) h.dim = false;
        if (h.bt > 4.2) st.hero = null;
      }
    }
  },
  // the player's own rocket: from the join button (or the town's middle) to burst high over the middle
  hero(S, h) {
    const x0 = h.from ? h.from.x : S.w / 2,
      y0 = h.from ? h.from.y - 6 : S.bot - 14,
      tx = S.w / 2,
      ty = Math.round(S.top + (S.bot - S.top) * 0.36);
    const a = 70 * 1.6,
      vy = -Math.sqrt(2 * a * Math.max(20, y0 - ty) + 900),
      T = (-vy - 30) / a;
    const r = {
      x: x0,
      y: y0,
      vx: (tx - x0) / T,
      vy,
      h: 45,
      hero: true
    };
    S.st.rockets.push(r);
    Object.assign(h, {
      up: true,
      rocket: r,
      bt: 0,
      dim: true
    });
    S.st.hero = h;
    Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.firework_rocket.launch', null, 1, 1);
  },
  // (over the dimmed sky: the rocket with the name riding under it; then its sparks, the name big in gold, a line under)
  drawHero(S, c, t) {
    const h = S.st.hero;
    for (const s of S.st.sparks) {
      if (!s.hero) continue;
      c.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - s.t / s.life);
      c.fillStyle = s.c;
      c.fillRect(Math.round(s.x), Math.round(s.y), 1, 1);
    }
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (!h) return;
    if (h.up) {
      const r = h.rocket;
      c.fillStyle = '#FFF4D0';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(r.x), Math.round(r.y), 2, 4);
      SH.text(c, h.name, r.x + 1, r.y + 8, '#FFE94A', 1, 1, true);
      return;
    }
    const bt = h.bt,
      e = Math.min(1, bt / 0.35),
      k = 0.8 + 1.8 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - e, 3)) + (bt > 0.35 ? Math.sin(bt * 4) * 0.05 : 0);
    const a = bt > 3.6 ? Math.max(0, 1 - (bt - 3.6) / 0.6) : 1,
      w = Font.width(h.name) * k;
    const gl = c.createRadialGradient(h.x, h.y, 0, h.x, h.y, w / 2 + 40);
    gl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,90,' + (0.35 * a).toFixed(2) + ')');
    gl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,214,90,0)');
    c.fillStyle = gl;
    c.fillRect(h.x - w / 2 - 44, h.y - w / 2 - 44, w + 88, w + 88);
    SH.text(c, h.name, h.x, h.y - 4 * k, '#FFE94A', k, a, true);
    if (bt > 0.3) SH.text(c, h.kind === 'join' ? '欢迎你成为第 ' + h.no + ' 位股东！' : '你在这里 · 第 ' + h.no + ' 位股东', h.x, h.y + 4 * k + 8, '#FFFFFF', 1, a * Math.min(1, (bt - 0.3) * 3), true);
  },
  draw(S, c, t) {
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, S.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#03051A');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1C1236');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, S.w, S.h);
    for (const [x, y, s] of S.st.sky) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.2 + 0.5 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.5 + s * 50))).toFixed(2) + ')';
      c.fillRect(Math.floor(x * S.w), Math.floor(y * S.h * 0.7), 1, 1);
    }
    c.fillStyle = '#F4F0DA';
    c.fillRect(S.w - 40, S.top + 4, 10, 10);
    c.fillStyle = '#E2DCC0';
    c.fillRect(S.w - 38, S.top + 6, 2, 2);
    c.fillRect(S.w - 34, S.top + 10, 2, 2);
    for (const s of S.st.sparks) {
      if (s.hero) continue;
      c.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - s.t / s.life);
      c.fillStyle = s.c;
      c.fillRect(Math.round(s.x), Math.round(s.y), 1, 1);
    }
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
    for (const r of S.st.rockets) {
      if (r.hero) continue;
      c.fillStyle = '#FFF4D0';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(r.x), Math.round(r.y), 1, 3);
    }
    for (const n of S.st.names) {
      const a = Math.min(1, n.t * 4) * Math.min(1, (n.life - n.t) * 1.5),
        mine = n.name === S.me;
      SH.text(c, n.name, n.x, n.y - 4 * n.k, mine ? '#FFD24A' : n.col, n.k + (n.k > 1 ? Math.min(0.4, n.t * 0.3) : 0), a, true);
    }
    // the town below: blocky roofs and trees in silhouette, a few lit windows
    const base = S.bot - 6;
    for (let x = 0, i = 0; x < S.w; i++) {
      const w = 10 + Math.floor(SH.hash('b' + i) * 4) * 6,
        h = 8 + Math.floor(SH.hash('h' + i) * 5) * 4,
        tree = SH.hash('t' + i) < 0.3;
      c.fillStyle = '#0A0814';
      if (tree) {
        c.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 1, base - 6, 2, 6);
        c.fillRect(x + 1, base - 14, w - 2, 9);
      } else {
        c.fillRect(x, base - h, w, h);
        c.fillRect(x + 2, base - h - 3, w - 4, 3);
        if (SH.hash('w' + i) < 0.6) {
          c.fillStyle = Math.sin(t * 0.7 + i) > -0.6 ? '#FFC860' : '#4A3A20';
          c.fillRect(x + 3, base - h + 3, 2, 2);
        }
      }
      x += w + 1;
    }
    c.fillStyle = '#0A0814';
    c.fillRect(0, base, S.w, S.h - base);
  }
}];
class ShareholdersScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, null);
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.si = Math.floor(Math.random() * SHARE_STYLES.length);
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.last = this.t0;
    this.slow = 0;
    this.shown = Share.count;
    this.bump = 0;
    this.plus = [];
    this.toast = [];
    this.incoming = [];
    this.heroOn = false;
    this.note = '';
    this.busy = false;
    this.st = null;
    this.style().init(this);
    Share.news.length = 0;
    this.loading = true;
    Share.load().catch(e => {
      Share.err = e.message;
    }).then(() => {
      this.loading = false;
      this.shown = Share.count;
    });
    Share.mine().then(() => this.layout());
    // (live: what came in since, every 3 s while this is open)
    this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!document.hidden) Share.poll().then(() => this.took()).catch(() => {});
    }, 3000);
  }
  close() {
    clearInterval(this.timer);
  }
  style() {
    return SHARE_STYLES[this.si];
  }
  // the count went up: a little bump and +n floating up; a welcome for each newcomer
  took() {
    const d = Share.count - Math.round(this.shown);
    if (d > 0) {
      this.bump = 1;
      this.plus.push({
        n: d,
        t: performance.now()
      });
    }
    for (const nw of Share.news) {
      this.toast.push({
        ...nw,
        t: performance.now()
      });
      // (their name thrown into the flow - not the player's own: that went in from the button)
      if (nw.name !== this.me && this.incoming.length < 6) this.incoming.push(nw.name);
    }
    // (the danmaku look shows them its own way)
    if (this.style().id !== 'danmaku') Share.news.length = 0;
    if (this.toast.length > 3) this.toast.splice(0, this.toast.length - 3);
  }
  get me() {
    return Share.me && Share.me.in ? Share.me.name : null;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      W = Math.min(u.w - 12, 360),
      x0 = Math.floor(u.w / 2 - W / 2),
      bw = Math.floor((W - 8) / 3),
      y = u.h - 24,
      inn = !!(Share.me && Share.me.in);
    this.widgets = [{
      x: x0,
      y,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }, {
      x: x0 + bw + 4,
      y,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      gold: !inn,
      enabled: !this.busy,
      label: () => this.busy ? '…' : inn ? '第 ' + Share.me.no + ' 位股东' : '加入股东名单',
      tip: inn ? ['你已经在股东名单里了', '再点一下可以退出'] : ['用你的 B站 昵称加入股东名单'],
      onClick: () => inn ? this.askLeave() : this.join()
    }, {
      x: x0 + 2 * (bw + 4),
      y,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      glowBlue: inn,
      enabled: !this.heroOn,
      label: '找到我',
      tip: ['在名单里找到你自己'],
      onClick: () => this.findMe()
    }];
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent || new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
  onEsc() {
    if (this.st && this.st.hero) {
      this.st.hero.skip = true;
      return;
    }
    this.back();
  }
  async join() {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => {
        g.ui.open(this);
        this.join();
      }, () => g.ui.open(this)));
      return;
    }
    if (this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.layout();
    try {
      await Share.join();
      Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1);
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('share_join');
      this.busy = false;
      this.layout();
      this.launch('join');
    } catch (e) {
      this.busy = false;
      this.say(e.message);
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  askLeave() {
    const g = this.game;
    g.ui.open(new ConfirmScreen(g, '要退出股东名单吗？', '你的名字会从名单里拿掉（以后还可以重新加入）', '退出', async yes => {
      g.ui.open(this);
      if (!yes) return;
      try {
        await Share.leave();
        this.say('已经退出股东名单');
      } catch (e) {
        this.say(e.message);
      }
      this.layout();
    }));
  }
  say(t) {
    this.note = t;
    this.noteT = performance.now();
  }
  // 找到我: the player's own name into the flow, standing out of it (the look's own way: a danmaku stopping in the
  // middle, a rocket bursting into it)
  findMe() {
    if (!this.me) {
      this.say(Account.loggedIn ? '先点「加入股东名单」，再来找自己' : '先登录，再加入股东名单');
      return;
    }
    this.launch('find');
  }
  // (kind: 'find', or 'join' - thrown in from the join button)
  launch(kind) {
    if (!this.me || this.st && this.st.hero) return;
    const b = this.widgets && this.widgets[1],
      from = kind === 'join' && b ? {
        x: b.x + b.w / 2,
        y: b.y
      } : null;
    try {
      this.style().hero(this, {
        name: this.me,
        no: Share.me.no,
        kind,
        from
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    this.heroOn = true;
    this.layout();
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    // (a tap away from the buttons while it is held: on with the flow)
    if (this.st && this.st.hero && b === 0 && !this.widgets.some(w => ui.hit(w, mx, my))) {
      this.st.hero.skip = true;
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      now = performance.now(),
      dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - this.last) / 1000),
      t = (now - this.t0) / 1000;
    this.last = now;
    const S = this;
    S.w = ui.w;
    S.h = ui.h;
    S.top = 40;
    S.bot = ui.h - 30;
    // (the player's own name standing out: the rest dimmed and slowed while it is held)
    const H = this.st && this.st.hero;
    if (!!H !== this.heroOn) {
      this.heroOn = !!H;
      this.layout();
    }
    this.slow += ((H && H.dim ? 1 : 0) - this.slow) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
    const st = this.style();
    try {
      st.step(S, dt, t);
    } catch (e) {
      if (this.st) this.st.hero = null;
    }
    c.save();
    try {
      st.draw(S, c, t, ui);
    } catch (e) {}
    c.restore();
    if (this.slow > 0.02) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (0.62 * this.slow).toFixed(3) + ')';
      c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
    }
    c.save();
    try {
      st.drawHero(S, c, t);
    } catch (e) {}
    c.restore();
    this.drawHead(ui, t, dt);
    // the bar under the buttons: a dark strip for them to sit on
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, ui.h - 34, 0, ui.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, ui.h - 34, ui.w, 34);
    if (this.note && now - this.noteT < 4000) SH.text(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 16), ui.w / 2, ui.h - 36, '#FFD24A', 1, Math.min(1, (4000 - (now - this.noteT)) / 500), true);
    if (this.loading) SH.text(c, '正在读取股东名单…', ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2, '#E0E0E0', 1, 1, true);else if (Share.err && !Share.ok) SH.text(c, fitText(Share.err, ui.w - 16), ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2, '#FF7070', 1, 1, true);
    for (const w of this.widgets) ui.button(w);
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.tip && ui.hit(w)) ui.tooltip(w.tip.map(x => ({
      text: x
    })), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  // the heading: 股东名单 in gold with a light sweeping across it, the count rolling up to the real one (a bump and a
  // +n when it grows), a red dot for live; the newcomers' welcome on the right
  drawHead(ui, t, dt) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      now = performance.now();
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 44);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, 44);
    const title = '股东名单',
      tw = Font.width(title) * 2,
      tx = Math.round(cx - tw / 2);
    SH.text(c, title, tx, 4, '#F2C94C', 2);
    const sw = (t * 0.5 % 1.6 - 0.3) * (tw + 40) - 20;
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(tx + sw, 0, 10, 24);
    c.clip();
    SH.text(c, title, tx, 4, '#FFF8D8', 2, 1, false, false);
    c.restore();
    this.shown += (Share.count - this.shown) * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
    if (Math.abs(Share.count - this.shown) < 0.5) this.shown = Share.count;
    this.bump = Math.max(0, this.bump - dt * 2.5);
    const num = Math.round(this.shown).toLocaleString('en-US'),
      line = '感谢 ' + num + ' 位股东',
      lw = Font.width(line),
      k = 1 + this.bump * 0.25;
    SH.text(c, line, cx, 25 - (k - 1) * 4, this.bump > 0 ? '#FFFFFF' : '#E8E8E8', k, 1, true);
    // (live: a red dot breathing)
    const dx = Math.round(cx + lw * k / 2 + 6),
      a = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now / 300);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,60,' + (0.5 + 0.5 * a).toFixed(2) + ')';
    c.fillRect(dx, 27, 4, 4);
    SH.text(c, '实时', dx + 7, 25, '#FF8080', 1, 0.9);
    for (const p of this.plus) {
      const s = (now - p.t) / 1000;
      SH.text(c, '+' + p.n, cx + lw / 2 + 36, 22 - s * 14, '#7CFF7C', 1, 1 - s / 1.4, true);
    }
    this.plus = this.plus.filter(p => now - p.t < 1400);
    let y = 44;
    for (const x of this.toast) {
      const s = (now - x.t) / 1000;
      if (s > 4) continue;
      const text = fitText('欢迎 ' + x.name + ' 成为第 ' + x.no + ' 位股东！', ui.w * 0.6),
        w = Font.width(text) + 10,
        ox = s < 0.3 ? (1 - s / 0.3) * (w + 8) : s > 3.6 ? (s - 3.6) / 0.4 * (w + 8) : 0;
      if (this.style().id === 'danmaku') continue;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,24,0,0.75)';
      c.fillRect(ui.w - w - 6 + ox, y, w, 12);
      c.fillStyle = '#F2C94C';
      c.fillRect(ui.w - w - 6 + ox, y, 2, 12);
      SH.text(c, text, ui.w - w - 1 + ox, y + 2, '#FFE9A0');
      y += 14;
    }
    this.toast = this.toast.filter(x => now - x.t < 4000);
  }
}

// the way in: follow the UP first (in Bilibili - elsewhere it can't be seen, so not asked), as the single-player
// game's own gate does
async function openShareholders(g, parent) {
  // (a super administrator - the UP, who can't follow themselves - and an account the service already knows follows:
  // straight in, as the single-player gate does; the UP was kept out by Bilibili's "not following" - the user 11-13)
  if (typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.loggedIn && Account.data && (Account.data.super || Account.unlocks && Account.unlocks.follow)) {
    g.ui.open(new ShareholdersScreen(g, parent));
    return;
  }
  let f = null,
    err = null;
  if (typeof Toy !== 'undefined' && Toy.following) {
    try {
      f = await Toy.following();
    } catch (e) {
      err = e;
    }
  }
  if (f === false && !err && typeof FollowGateScreen !== 'undefined') {
    g.ui.open(new FollowGateScreen(g, parent, () => g.ui.open(new ShareholdersScreen(g, parent)), '关注 UP 主「土豆味小哲」后就能进入股东名单'));
    return;
  }
  g.ui.open(new ShareholdersScreen(g, parent));
}

      ck = this.widgets.find(w => w.checkin);

      w: r.w,
      h: 16,
      label: '股东名单',
      gold: true,
      tip: ['关注 UP 主后，把你的名字加进股东名单'],
      onClick: () => openShareholders(g, this)
    });
  };
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/live.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The live settings (multiplayer/rooms/admin.js LIVE, changed in the admin panel - tools/admin): GET /api/live on
// the room service. Read as the page starts (the last ones kept in this browser, so they apply before the answer
// comes), every 5 minutes on the menus while the page is shown, at once when a room says so ({ t: 'live' }, net.js),
// and in single player when the announcements' answer names a newer one (social.js) - so nobody asks twice. Without a service (a test page, offline) every setting is the
// game's own, as before.
// Where each is used: title.* here and in checkin.js / shareholders.js / mods_ui.js; mods.* in mods.js / mods_ui.js;
// jing.* in companion.js; client.telemetry in telemetry.js; client.announceMin in social.js; defaults.* and the
// title's notice, splash and feedback button here.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Live = {
  v: 0,
  values: {},
  busy: false,
  at: 0,
  get(k, d) {
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.values, k) ? this.values[k] : d;
  },
  // a switch that is on unless the panel turned it off
  on(k) {
    return this.get(k, true) !== false;
  },
  load() {
    try {
      const j = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mcjs-live') || 'null');
      if (j && j.values) {
        this.v = +j.v || 0;
        this.values = j.values;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  // asked again (v: the one a room or the announcements named - nothing to do when it is this one)
  async fetch(v) {
    if (v !== undefined && +v === this.v) return;
    if (this.busy || typeof RoomService === 'undefined' || !RoomService.base()) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - this.at < 2000) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.at = now;
    try {
      const r = await fetch(RoomService.base() + '/api/live?v=' + this.v, {
        cache: 'no-store'
      });
      const j = await r.json();
      if (r.ok && j && !j.same && j.values) {
        const old = JSON.stringify(this.values);
        this.v = +j.v || 0;
        this.values = j.values;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('mcjs-live', JSON.stringify({
            v: this.v,
            values: this.values
          }));
        } catch (e) {}
        if (JSON.stringify(this.values) !== old) this.changed();
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    this.busy = false;
  },
  // what changes at once: the defaults of a new player, the title screen redrawn
  changed() {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    if (!g || !g.settings) return;
    this.defaults(g);
    const sc = g.ui && g.ui.screen;
    if (sc && typeof TitleScreen !== 'undefined' && sc instanceof TitleScreen) sc.layout();
  },
  // a player's settings never saved: the panel's defaults (defaults.*) for the ones the player hasn't set
  defaults(g) {
    let saved = {};
    try {
      saved = g.loadSettings() || {};
    } catch (e) {}
    const D = {
      fov: ['defaults.fov', 1],
      volume: ['defaults.volume', 100],
      sens: ['defaults.sens', 100],
      clouds: ['defaults.clouds'],
      bobbing: ['defaults.bobbing']
    };
    for (const [k, [lk, div]] of Object.entries(D)) {
      if (k in saved || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.values, lk)) continue;
      const v = this.values[lk];
      if (div) {
        const n = Number(v);
        if (Number.isFinite(n)) g.settings[k] = n / div;
      } else if (typeof v === 'boolean') g.settings[k] = v;
    }
  }
};
Live.load();

// ---- the title screen: the panel's notice over the buttons, its splash, the feedback button hidden ----
(() => {
  if (typeof TitleScreen !== 'function') return;
  const COLORS = {
    gold: '#FFAA00',
    red: '#FF5555',
    green: '#55FF55',
    aqua: '#55FFFF',
    white: '#FFFFFF'
  };
  let first = true;
  const lay = TitleScreen.prototype.layout,
    dx = TitleScreen.prototype.drawExtra;
  TitleScreen.prototype.layout = function (...a) {
    if (first && this.game) {
      first = false;
      Live.defaults(this.game);
    }
    lay.apply(this, a);
    const sp = String(Live.get('title.splash', '') || '').trim();
    if (sp) this.splash = sp;else if (this.liveSplash) this.splash = SPLASHES[Math.random() * SPLASHES.length | 0];
    this.liveSplash = !!sp;
    if (!Live.on('client.feedback')) {
      const fb = this.widgets.find(w => w.label === '反馈问题'),
        sk = this.widgets.find(w => w.label === '皮肤和装饰');
      if (fb) {
        this.widgets.splice(this.widgets.indexOf(fb), 1);
        if (sk && sk.y === fb.y) sk.w = fb.x + fb.w - sk.x;
      }
    }
  };
  TitleScreen.prototype.drawExtra = function (ui) {
    dx.call(this, ui);
    const t = String(Live.get('notice.text', '') || '').trim();
    if (!t) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      l = Math.floor(ui.h / 4 + 48),
      y = l - 14,
      tw = Math.min(ui.w - 8, Font.width(t) + 12);
    const blink = Live.get('notice.blink', false) === true ? 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 260) : 1;
    c.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    c.fillStyle = '#000';
    c.fillRect(Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - tw / 2), y - 2, tw, 12);
    c.globalAlpha = blink;
    Font.center(c, fitText(t, ui.w - 16), ui.w / 2, y, COLORS[Live.get('notice.color', 'gold')] || COLORS.gold);
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  };
})();

// ---- asked: as the page starts, then every 5 minutes on the menus while it is shown (playing: the room or the
// announcements' answer says when) ----
(() => {
  const menus = () => {
    const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game;
    return !g || g.state !== 'play';
  };
  setTimeout(() => Live.fetch(), 1500);
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!document.hidden && menus()) Live.fetch();
  }, 5 * 60e3);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (!document.hidden && menus() && Date.now() - Live.at > 5 * 60e3) Live.fetch();
  });
})();
